74la༄༄)ri (7 )dzā/tso//mu 88)ཿkāXshā〉 snyeX/ rtordo nyam kyi ( nyag na ye sa75 5 ra ridzon755 046me/ (47mer༅༅/ /bod gangs can gyi ljongs su mi lo nyis stong brgal ba'i sngon nas skad yig gis mtshon pa'i rig gnasadar 'phel shin tu chen 11 byung sku da/ lhag par btsan wa ༄rgyas rgyal 'o/ paṇa rnams kyi thugs rje bka' drin las 47na pa sangs rgyas kyi chos tshul dpal nā leṇḍa'i mkhas pa'i bzhed rgyunanang casan rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rtsab brtan 14 tshugasate skye rgu grangs las 'das pa'i 'di phyi'i re ba stong thub pa byung yod pa ni 'das pa'i lo rgyus deb ther nang gsal ba ltar yin/ deng gi dus su'ang bod mi rigs dang / de mtshungs lo rgyus thog bod kyi nang chos rig gzhung khyab gdal chen po byung ba'i chen wa ༄)ra gyi yul dang / ru su'i khongs kyi thu ba dang gal mug sogs/ de bzhin chen po rgya yi yul/ phyogs mtshungs ri bo hi ma la ya'i stod rgyud du chags pa'i 'brug 'bras dang la dwags/ khu nu/ spi ti sogs kyis ma tshad par 'dzam gling gi sa khul du mar bod kyi nang chos lta grub kyis spyir 'gro ba mi'i bde don dang / lhag par nang sems kyi zhi bde'i thog zhabs 'degs gang 'tshams bsgrubs dang sgrub mus su yod par ma zad slad kyang phyi'i tshan rig dang zungadu 'brel ba'i sgo nas sngar lhag zhabs 'degs sgrub thub rgyu yin pa garo/ra mi za/rgyu mtshan de ltar la brten nas da lam khen ḍa snu na krisal bod kyi gtsug lag zhib dakhyod khang gis ྅ped kyi gtsug lag ba/ces btus zhes pa 11da kyi ris med mkhas grub tshad ldan du mas brtsams pa'i bstan ba35sa 10da phreng sum cu tham pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigasate zhus dag nges 'drongs song ba deng rabs kyi srol dang mthun pa deb gzugs thog dpar skrun byed bzhinaskyo/da par snying nas yi rang bsngags brjod byed pa dang chabs cig gtsug lag gces btus 'dis bod kyi slob gnyer gyi bsti gnas mang por gal che'i bod kyi bstan bcos 'di dag blta chog yong rgyu dang / lhag par rang rigs blo gsar ga'on nu rnams so so'i mi rigs kyi chos dang rig gzhung rgya cheganying zab 'di la do snang cher bskyed dang gzhung don slob gnyer bya rgyu'i cha rkyen dang go skabs gsar pa zhig thob rgyu'i re smon bcas/ twa la'i bla mar 'bod pa/ shukya'i dge sbyong bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags rta zla lta: tshes 27() / bod kyi gtsug lag gces btus pod phreng cha tshang phyogs sgrig dang dpa ra skrun gyi rgyu 'ogro0'a mthun rkyan drangasalja gas —ca/ sngagar ཿli rlungangali/ rsāsku bste cermesiliskostsa /dngas 4badzrakros 3 stukhu1bya'ikhu〉 lcamaskukhro ni her she 00bas13 stukhu18605 her she'i khyim tshang gi dge rtsa 1smodzi5615565ba'ismosmo15605baspu'i 10ba bcas nas sbyar bar dad gtong sbyin bdag rnams tshe lhag don ldan thog 'di phyi'i legs tshogs bsam don bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i smon 'dun zhu/

phyogs sgrig pa'i gleng brjod/da lam 'dir ris med bod kyi mkhas grub yongs su grags pa du masangartsams bsgrigs mdzad pa'i gzhung gal che ba brgya phrag gnyis lhag tsam zhig phyogs gcig tubasdus te bod kyi gtsug lag gces btus zhes pa'i pod phreng gsar du phyogs bsgrigs kyis dpar bskrun zhub ni/ gtso bo rang re'i bod kyi ches mtho'i rig gnas spyi dang lhag par nang don rig pa'i gnas zab mo rnams cha tshang ba pod grangs mi mang ba zhig gi thog nas deng rabs blo gsar ba'i yid ngor legs par mtshon thub pa dang / de mtshungs blo gsar don gnyer can rnams nas galace'ibastan bcos 'di rnams la thos bsam bgyi ba'i go skabs bzang po thob pa'i dmigs yul gyi ched duyin/ dmigs yul gzhan yang rim pas gal che'i bod kyi bstan bcos 'di rnams dbyin yig sogs 'dzam gling skad yig gzhan du phab sgyur gyi lam nas nam zhig gzhung rtsom pa po'i bod kyi mkhas grub che khag rnams kyi mtshan 'dzam gling yongs la grags thub pa ma zad de rnams kyis brtsams pa'i gal che'i gzhud rnams kyang 'dzam gling spyi'i sne che'i gtsug lag gi gral duslobs te skye rgumang por phan thogs yong ba'ang srid snyam/pod phreng 'di nyid phyogasabasgrigs zhutshul ni/rtsa ba kho bo thub bstan sbyin pas 'gan khur gyis lo shas ring dpe mdzod khang mang por dpyad zhib kyis pod phreng 'di nang ji bzhugs kyi phyag dpe'i mtshan tho'i gzhi ma bkod bsgrigs zhus shing / las don 'di'i thog 7spyo nor gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen pos dbus ris med bla chen khag dang de mtshungs bod kyi mkhas dbang khag la'ang bka' slob zhus yod/ de yang spyir rang cag bod kyi skad yig nang sngon gyi gasdang srol la rig gnas che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga zhes grags pa ltar chos dang 'jig rten gyi lam lugs sna tshogs ston pa'i bstan bcos khri phrag brgal ba bzhugs mod/ 'dir ni gtso bo'i dbang dubyas te phyi lo dus rabs bdun pa'i nang da lta yongs sugrags pa'i bod kyi yi ge 'di'i srol gtod pa nas bzung dus rabs nyi shupa'i stod cha'i bar gyi dus yun mi lo chig stong sum brgya tsam 'di'i nang dubyung ba'i mkhas dbang tshad ldan gal che ba rnams kyi rtsom gzhung gnad che ba khag mang tsam zhig pod phreng 'di nang gces btus zhus yod/ de yang gtso bo brjod bya'i dbang du byas te thog mar bod dulo rgyus kyi nang byung ba'i chos brgyud chen po jo bo bka' gdams pa/sa dge bka' rnying jo nang bon dang bcas pa so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag ston pa'i glegs bam khag de nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa'i skor/sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag sngags bla med kyi bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag

de nas mtshan nyid kyi sde tshan la phar phyin dang / zab mo dbuma'i lta ba/ tshad ma rig pa/ mngon pa gong 'og gnyis/grub mtha'i rnam gzhag bcas dang /de bzhin dulegs bshad lugs kyi bslab bya sogs ston pa'i mkhas pa dang grub pa la 'jug pa'i sgo'i gzhung gces btus sna tshogs/gzhan yang gso ba rig pa sman gyi gzhung /sngar srol gyi rtsis/bod kyi lha mo'i gzhung chen khag rgyal rabs dang chos 'byung rnying rigs gal che dpe mtshon bcas sde tshan 'di cha tshang pod grangs so gnyis nang legs par mtshon thab pa zhus yod/pod phreng 'di bzhin zhusgrog dngos gzhi zhuskabs thog mar gzhung so so dam puṭa'i nang 'thug dus ma dpe bod dpar rnying pa tshad ldan zhig utshugs kyis 'tshol zhib byas te de phyi mor bzungs/de nas gzhung de'i ma dpe bod dpar mi 'dra ba ji bzhugs phan tshun zhib bsdur byas te ma dpe mi 'dra ba'i nang dpar yig mthun min ji yod ngos legs par bzung ste mchan tho bkod de ma dpe'i nang mngon gsal can gyi nor rigs rnams bcos shing gsham du mchan nang de don gsal bshad dang / gzhan drogs gzhi yod pa rnams rang sor bzhag ste 'og gi mchan nang nor bces ji ltar dgos min gyi bsam 'char phul yod pa las rtsa ba'i ma dpe bod dpar gang la gzhibacol ba de tshad ldan rang dubyas te zhu dag gtsang nges thengs du ma song ba zhus yod/ de dang chabs cig klog pa po don gnyer can rnams nas khungs bcol gyi yig cha khag la dpyad zhib gnang bde'i slad lung gzhung so so'i nang lung 'dren ji yod gang thub ngos 'dzin gyis bka' bstan dang gsung 'bum sogs gang yin tshad ldan dpar ma zhig gi steng nas phyag dpe so so'i mtshan/ dpar ma gang yin gyi ngos 'dzin/ pod ang grangs/ shog bu dang yig phreng gi ang grangs bcas gsal po bkod de gsham du zhusprig pa'i mchan zhes pa'i nang bcug yod/ dpe deb klog skabs gzhung gi tshan pa gal che rnams ngos 'dzin sla ba dang /phyag dpe gzigs bde po yong ched gzhus don gal che ba rnams deb kyi dbur dkar chag logs su bkod pa ltar tshan pa so sor bgos te 'gor sa bcad che khag gang yin bkod pa ma zad nang don rnams kyang deng rabs kyi dpe deb sgrig lugs ltar dum buso sor byas te snga phyi'i dbye mtshams gsal po ngos 'dzin thub pa byas yod/ gzhan yang pod so so'i nang ji bzhugs kyi gzhung gang yin drang de dang 'brel ba'i don gnas dper na rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus snying don dang /gzhung so so'i don rags rim tsam 'grel brjod sogs gsal ba'i sngon gleng ngo sprod kyang bkod yod pa bcas snga phyi'i las don mtha' dag la gang shes kyis dam don ci nus zhukhul yang da dung yi ge chad lhag dang /gzhung mtshams snga phyi phye tshul sogs gang thad nas nor 'khrul gyur yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams nas bzod par mdzad 'tshal/

de bzhin dung tsho zhusprig pa rnams gzhung mthong rgya zhan pa dang /lhag par ma dpe lag son mgyurab sogs kyis pod phreng 'di nang nges par bzhugs su'os pa'i dpe gzhung gal che'i rigs mang po zhig lus yod nges pas mang thos mkhas pa'i mdun sar bzod gsol zhu ba dang chabs cig slad nas kyang rim pas pod phreng 'dir pod grangs gsar pa bsnon pa'i go skabs kyang 'ong srid na der sman pa'i bka' slob dgongs 'char yang lhug stsol yong ba 'ekhug re batho(5 yang zhukhusmyumatha' don bod kyi gtsug lag gces btus kyi pod phreng 'di bzhin phyogs bsgrigs kyis dpar bskrun rim pas zhuba'i gal che'i las don 'di thog nga tshor lharāṇa sī bod kyi ches mtho'i slob gnyer khang nas zhusprig pa tshor mtho slob kyi dpe mdzod khang duji bzhugs kyi bod dpe rnams lhug par dpyad zhib zhurgyu'i go skabs gnang ba dang / de bzhin dudape gzhung dkon rigs rnams a ri nang bstan bod kyi dpe tshogs lte gnas khang nas g.yar gnang skyabs 'jug thob pa dang / gzhung gi ma dpe rnams gam pu ṭa'i nang 'jug rgyu'i thugs 'gan dga' ldan shar rtse grwa tshang gi dpe mdzod khang nas bzhes pa bcas la shugs rje che zhukhuskrugazhan yang phyag dpe zhusgrog gtsos lung khungs 'tshol zhib sogs kyi las don che phra'i rigs rnams deb so so'i ched bkod zhu sgrig pas gnang thog kho bo thub bstan sbyin pas kyang lung rnyed dka' ba rnams la gang shes 'tshol zhib rogs byas pa ma zad/ lhag par gzhung che khag rnams deng rabasadang mthun par gzhung 'tshams 'byed rgyu dang skabs 'bab 'go brjod 'god rgyu sogs kyi 'gan blangs shing / de bzhin du gzhung yongs rdzogs thengs snga phyi gnyis klog ste zhudag thub pa sogs zhus yod/zhusprig pa tshos bkod pa'i nor bcos dang mchan rnams dang de'i steng kho bos tha ma'i zhusprig bgyis pa'i nor bcos dang mchan kha bsnon rnams ma nor bar skabs so sor 'khodapa sogs las don duma'i 'gan blo bzang chos dar nas gnang ba bcas/ tshang mar thugs rje che zhuba'i sngon 'gro'i gleng brjod kyi tshul du/ bod kyi gtsug lag gces btus kyi phyogs sgrig dang zhusgrog 'gan 'dzin glang ri ba lha rams thub bstan sbyin pas zla tshes la// //

bcad lhug spel ma gsum gyi sgo nas gzhung rtsom dgos tshul gsungs te/ snyan ngag gi bshad pa dngos ni lus dang rgyan gnyis su 'dus par gsungs/ de yang lho phyogs bidhanta'i mkhas pa dang / shar phyogs go ḍa ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyi dbar tshig gi sbyor ba'i khyad par ji ltar yod tshul rnams gsungs/ rtsa tshig6ngo bos dngos su bsngags pa ni/ /rang bzhin brjod dang rigs yin te/ /de sogs de yi rgyan bshad bya/nya 12 /zhes sogs kyis spyir rgyan gyi rnam gzhag dang / yang / ‘ltolo dang dngos po bzlog pa dang / /phan tshun dpe dang nges pa'i dpe/ /nges pa med dang sdud pa'i dpe/ /de sogs dpe ni sprod de bshad/ha 13 /zhes sogs kyis/ slob dpon daṇḍi'i 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉mar byung ba'i don rgyan so lnga'i nang gses dpe rgyan gyi rnam grangs sum cu skor zhig yod pa rnams/ re re nas tshigs bcad drangs te bkod pa byung /14 gzhan yang snyan ngag gi mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi skor dang / dpe dang don sbyor mi sbyor gyi skyon yon sogs kyi khyad par yang gsungs pa sogs/ mdor na 〈〈mkhas 'jug 〉〉le'u 'dir snyan ngag gi skor la bshad pa byung ba 'di ni/ bod du ches mtho'i rig gnas byung rim gyi lo rgyus kyi cha nas shin tu gal che ba'i gnas shig ste/ 'dis bod skad nang legs sbyar lugs kyi snyan ngag gi bshad pa thog mar ngo sprad par 'jog dgos pas/ bod la sku drin shin tu che ba'i sa paṇa gyi mdzad pa'i cha shas shig tu gyur yod/le'u 'di'i nang du byung ba'i snyan ngag gi bshad pa'i gzhung don rnams/ sa skya ngag dbang chos grags (1572—1641)kyi 'grel par/ 66rtsom tshul mdor bstan pa dang / gar gyi nyams dgu bshad pa /

sngon gleng ngo spyod/ sgo1 dpe don chos mtshungs tshul dgos par bshad pa/ brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi tshig gi dbye ba/ rtag tu snyan ngag mkhan du 'gyur bar smon pa/mi zhes sa bcad don tshan che khag lngar phye zhing / sa bcad bzhi pa la nang gses/ 66bcad lhug spel gsum du dbye ba dang / tshigs bcad bye brag tu bshad pa/ha zhes pa gnyis dang / tshigs bcad bye brag tu bshad pa la'ang / 66bshad tshul gnyis su dbye ba/ gnyis po so sor bshad pa/ brjod tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ tshigs bcad kyi tshig sbyor ro/mi /zhes dang / gnyis pa brjod tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba la'ang nang gses/ 66grol ba sogs bzhir dbye ba/ snyan ngag skyon med la dmigs bsal bshad pa/ snyan ngag brjod tshul gyi lugs gnyis bshad pa'o/mi /zhes don tshan gsum du phye ba dang /bzhi pa tshigs bcad kyi tshig sbyor tshul la/ 66lho shar ba'i lugs brjod pa dang / rang bzhin brjod pa/dpe rgyan bshad pa mi zhes gsum du phye ba sogs/ gzhung yongs rdzogs kyi chings 'dus che ba zhig 'khod pa rnams/ 〈lakhasa'ajug 〉〉klog pa'i tshe rtsagazhung la sbyar tshe gzhungadon khong du chud par phan nges par mthong 15le'u gnyis pa 'chad pa'i sgo la/16 'chad par byed pa slob dpon dang bshad yul slob ma'i mtshan nyid sogs ston pa'i rjes su/ dngos gzhi bshad pa la 'jug par ston/ de la dbyig gnyen gyis 〈〈rnam bshad rigs par 〉〉gsungs pa'i bshad thabs yan lag lnga ste/ dgos don/ bsdus don/tshig don/ mtshams sbyar dang / brgal lan bcas gsungs pa le'u de'i sgrom du mdzad cing / dgos don dang bsdus don gyi bshad pa mdor bsdus pa zhig gi rjes su/ tshig don nam 66ngag gi don bshad pa la tshig gi sbyor ba dang / tshig rnam par bshad pa'i tshul/mi 17 zhes sa bcad che khag gnyis su byas/ de gnyis las tshig gi sbyor ba'i tshul ni shugs che ba tshig bsdu'i skor dang 'brel bas/ de don sa paṇa rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos gzhan dang / 〈〈smra sgo mtshon cha 〉〉la sogs par blta bar bya'o/18/zhes zhal 'phangs mdzad cing 〈〈mkhas 'jug 〉〉tu sgo smros pa tsam zhig las ma gsungs/ 66tshig rnam par bshad pa/mi zhes pa'i sa bcad kyi khongs su/ gzhung lugs gang dang gang 'chad kyang byed pa'i tshig sbyar te tshig don legs par bshad pa sgra pa dag gi lugs yin par gsungs la/ bod kyi skad yig la dmigs bsal/ bya ba'i yul dang / byed pa po dang / bya ba'i tshig sbyar te gzhung don sbrel dgos tshul dang /19 de bzhin du/ gang / gang la/ gang gis/ ji ltar zhes pa'i spyi sgra dri tshig tu bkod pa dang sbrel te gzhung don dpyis phyin par 'grel dgos par gsungs la/ sdom gyi tshul du/ 66gzhung las khyad par gyi

551 1 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gzhi bsdus la ngag don blang / khyad par gyi chos bshad de tshig rnam par dbye bar bya'o/’ 20 /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams bod kyi brda sprod la shin tu gal che ba'i gnad du mthong /de nas gzhung du/ 6thog mar sgra la mkhas pa yis/ /tshig don rnam par phye ste bstan/ /de nas don la mkhas pa yis/ /lhag chad 'khrul ba med par bshad/mi 21 /zhes sgra la mkhas pas tshig don rnam par phye ste 'chad tshul dang / don la mkhas pas gzhung don lhag chad med par bstan tshul gnyis su 'byed de/ dang po'i khongs su sgra rig pa'i gnad mang dag cig gsungs pa'i zhor du/ 6bod kyi skad la mi shes pa/ /phal cher thos pa chung ba'i skyon/mi 22 /zhes sogs kyis/ legs sbyar nas bod skad du bsgyur tshul la/ dag mi dag dang / sgra 'thad 'gyur dang don 'gyur/ gzhan yang sngon gyi lo tsā ba 'ga' shas kyis rig byed dang rgya gar gyi sngon rabs kyi gtam brgyud ma shesapa'i rkyen gyis skyon cha byung tshul sogs/23dpyad pa dper brjod dang bcas pa byung ba ni/ bod yig nang 'gyur gyi skor la bshad pa mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la/ 〈〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉〉kyi rjes su 'di las gal che ba med par mthong / de rjes/ 66gzhan yang bstan bcos chen po las/ /dpe dang tshig sbyar mang bshad pa/ /de dag kyang ni mdor bsdus te/ /bshad par bya ba cung zad nyon/mi 24 /ces bka' dang bstan bcos las byung ba'i dpe don gyi rigs yongs grags kha cig la gsal bshad mdzad/ mjug tu bshad thabs kyi yan lag lhag ma mtshams sbyar dang brgal lan gnyis kyi skor la bshad pa mdor bsdus shig mdzad rjes/ theg pa chen po spyi'i lugs kyis sangs rgyas kyi gsung la drang nges dang / dgongs ldem dgongs sogs kyi rnam dbye'i sgo nas bkral ba'i tshul rags tsam zhig ngo sprad pa sogs kyis 'chad pa'i sgo'i le'u rdzogs par byas pa bcas so//〈〈mkhas 'jug 〉〉gi gzhung 'di sa paṇa gyis thun mong ba'i rig gnas so so'i skor la gzhung che khag dper na 〈〈sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos me tog mchun po 〉〉dang / ming gi mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 〈〈tshig gi gter/〉〉 sgra'i bstan bcos 〈4gas rab 'phro ba/〉〉25 lugs kyi bstan bcos 〈〈legs par bshad pa'i gter 〉〉sogs brtsams zin pa'i rjes su byung ba gzhung rang nyid las thon pas/ dus kyi cha nas phyis rtsom du 'jog dgos la/ sa paṇa rang nyid kyis kyang gzhung de nyid gtsigs chen por gnang bar mngon pas/ rang cag bod kyi ches mtho'i rig gnas la brtse zhen dang yid smon yod pa kun dang /lhag par bod kyi rig gnas gzhan la slob ston byed pa'i dge rgan rnams nas/ gzhung 'di bod kyi rig

sngon gleng ngo sprod/ ca 55bo gnas kyi rtsa ba'i bstan bcos shin tu gal che ba zhig gi ngos 'dzin dang / de bstun bdag gces dang slob sbyong bgyid dgos pa mthong ngo /brda dag gi gzhung lugs byung rim skor/de la bod kyi brda sprod kyi byung ba 'chad pa na/ chu 'go gangs la thug pa'i dpe ltar/ slob dpon drin can thon mi la gtugs dgos pa ni yongs su grags pa zhu mi dgos/ de yang gsung srol la thon mis brda sprod kyi gzhus brgyad brtsams pa las/ 〈'gum cu pa 〉〉dang / 〈〈rtags kyi 'jug pa 〉〉gnyis las lhag ma rnams ches snga tsam nas brlags par bshad pa sogs ni/ rang cag la rlung ltar grags pas 'dir bskyar bshad kyi ngal ba mi bya/ sngon gyi gsung srol las dogasapa gcod dgos pa zhig ni/ rgya gar gyi yi ger/ ca sde'i yi ge ca cha ja gsum dang / zha za 'a gsum bcas drug med pas/ slob dpon thon mis gsar du bsnan par bshad pa de lags/ don gnad der mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel nas rigs pa'i rgyab rten dang bcas/ ca cha ja gsum rgya gar gyi yi ger yod pa tsam du ma zad/ rgya gar gyi byis pa tshun chad kyi lcer brjod bde tshul sogs gsungs ste 'di rnams brnan pa'i yi ger 'jog mi rung ba bsgrubs la/ brnan pa'i yi ge ni ca sde min cing / tsa sde'i tsa tsha dza gsum du 'jog dgos par gsungs/ dge chos rang nyid kyis dpyad pa'i grub don du/ thon mis rgya gar gyi yi ge'i steng bod kyi skad kyi gdangs thun mong ma yin pa mtshon pa'i phyir brnan pa'i yi ge ni bdun du 'jog dgos te/ tsa tsha dza gsum dang / zha za 'a gsum/ wa bcas yin par gsungs/ de ltar gsar du brnan pa'i rtags kyang btab yod par grub ste/ tsa tsha dza gsum la re rer tsha lag re mngon gsal dod por yod pa zhu mi dgos la/ zha za 'a gsum la sngon gyi yig rnying 'ga' shas nang tsha lag lta bu re yod par gzigs pa gsungs/da lta'i wa yig ni zhib mor dpyad na/ 'a dang ba gnyis bsres nas 'a la ba zur btags pa'i gzugs rim gyis 'gyur nas da lta'i yig gzugs/ ba yig gi steng du la yig yod pa lta bu de grub par gsungs pa rnams/26 kho bos brtags na shin tu rigs pa dang ldan par mthong la/ rang nyid kyang lugs 'di nyid 'thad pa'i phyogs su bzung ngo / /srol rgyun gyi bshad srol de 〈〈gtam brgyud gser thang 〉〉du thog mar zhwa lu lo tsā bas gsungs pa phyis kyi mkhas pas rjes zlos bgyis pa lta bu zhig thon mod/ zhib mor

551 5 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/brtags na/ ca cha ja gsum rgya gar gyi yi ger med par bod la mkho bas bsnan tshul gyi bshad pa de chesasnga sa zhig nas yod par mngon te/ dper na myang ral gyi 〈〈chos 'byung me tog snying po sbrang rtsi'i bcud 〉〉du gtam de ji lta ba bzhin byung /27dogs gcod kyi gnad gal che ba gzhan zhig ni/ slob dpon thon mis bod kyi brda sprod kyi srol gtod pa dang lhan cig tu bod du yi ge'i 'bri srol thog mar gsar du gtod ma gtod kyi skor de yin/ dri ba de ni deng dus kyi bod kyi mkhas pa mang pos dpyad zhib bgyis dang bgyid mus dang / 'ga' shas kyis thon mi'i sngon la bod la bris pa'i yi ge yod pa dang / de yang zhang zhung dmar yig tu grags pa de yin pa sogs bshad cing / mang po zhig gis ni de'i dus su bod la bris pa'i yi ge med par mtha' gcig tu smra ba sogs langs phyogs mi 'dra ba dag spel gyi 'dug mod/ kho bos brtags na da lta'i char ni dri ba de'i lan mtha' chod pa gcig 'ong dka' bar mthong ste/ rim pas mna' rdzas brngogs shul dang /ches mna' bo'i yi ge dang ri mo sogs brag dang byang bu rus pa sogs la bris pa 'dra rnyed srid tshe dpyad gzhi rgya che ru 'gro nges la/ de bzhin du khyim mtshes kyi rgyal khab mna' dus kyi rgya nag dang / spel te/'bru sha li yul dang / ta sig ste mna' dus kyi par shi ya'i rgyal khabasogs kyi yig cha rnying pa dag las kyang bod kyi skor la bshad pa thon pa dag phan tshun gung bsgrigs te brtags nas gtan 'bebs bya dgos pa'i gnas su mthong /gzhan yang rang cag gi brda sprod kyi rtsa gzhung sum rtags gnyis dang 'brel ba'i dogs gnas shig ni/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i gong du gzhung de gnyis la 'grel pa phar bzhag mtshan 'don gyi zhal 'phangs tsam yang da lta mjal du yod pa'i sngon gyi dpe gang du'ang mi byung ba de lags/dper na dus rabs dgu pa'i smad rgyal po khri sde srong btsan gyi dus su bsgrigs pa'i 〈〈sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa'i 〉〉nang / bod kyi brda sprod kyi skor la bshad pa kha gsal thon mod/ byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mthun dgos par gsungs pa tsam las/28 dbu zhabs gang du'ang sum rtags kyi gzhus la zhal 'phangs mi snang / de bzhin du spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i stod du byung ba'i smri ti'i brda sprod kyi bstan bcos 〈〈smra sgo mtshon cha'i 〉〉nang / bod kyi skad dang yi ge'i skor la dmigs kyis bshad pa mdzad mod/dngos shugs gang du'ang sum rtags gnyis la thugs rgyus yod pa'i rnam pa ma bstan/ lhag par dus

sngon gleng ngo sprod/ 555rabs de'i nang rngog blo ldan shes rab kyis nga tsho'i glegs bam 'di nang bzhugs pa'i brda dag gi gzhung 〈〈dag yig nyer mkho bsdus pa 〉〉zhes pa brtsams pa'i nang bod kyi yi ge dang brda sprod kyi 'gro stangs la bshad pa rgyas tsam gnang la/ rngog lo gzigs rgya che bas de dus sum rtags gnyis mjal du yod tshe/rang nyid kyi brda sprod kyi bshad pa'i nang mtshan 'don tsam zhig nges par mdzad dgos pa lta bu yod mod ma gnang / de bzhin du sa skya rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos 〈〈byis pa bde 'jug 〉〉tu/ yi ge'i skye gnas kyi skor la sngon gyi rgan po'i yi ge las zhes pa tsam las/29 bod kyi yi ge dang brda sprod kyi skor la sum rtags gnyis la zhal 'phangs tsam yang ma mdzad/ gzhan yang 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis bod kyi brda sprod kyi bstan bcos 〈〈yi ge'i sbyor ba 〉〉dang / 〈〈sgra la 'jug pa/〉〉 mkhas pa'i kha rgyan sogs dang / de bzhin du 〈〈mkhas 'jug 〉〉bcas kyi nang / brda sprod kyi gnad shin tu mang po zhig la bshad pa bgyis skabs/ smri ti'i 〈〈smra sgo mtshon cha 〉〉dang / bsod nams rtse mo'i 〈〈byis pa bde 'jug 〉〉tsam ma gtogs/sum rtags gnyis la thugs rgyus yod pa'i rnam pa gang du'ang bstan ma gnang ba sogs la bsams na/gnas don 'di shin tu ya mtshan pa zhig tu mthong / gong gi rgyu mtshan de rnams lta bu la bsams te/'ga' shas kyis/ sum rtags gnyis spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i rjes su byung bar bshad pa ni/cung thal cha che ba'i bshad par mthong /deng ngos 'dzin thub pa'i sum rtags kyi 'grel pa la snga shos ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa yas mas su byung ba'i dbus pa blo gsal gyi de yin par mngon la/ spyir sum rtags kyi 'grel ba byung rim gyi sko ra la kho bos 〈〈brda sprod gsar bsgrigs smra sgo'i lde mig 〉〉gi sngon 'gro'i dpyad rtsom du rags tsam zhig smras zin pa der gzigs 'tshal/ 'dir nga tsho'i glegs bam du spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i nang byung ba'i dngul chu dharma bhadra'i gsung 〈〈si tu'i zhal lung 〉〉zhes pa/ go bde la rgyas bsdus shin tu 'tshams pa de bzhugs su gsol yod/ de lta na'ang sum rtags gnyis su ma thon pa'i bod kyi brda sprod kyi gnas gal che ba mang dag cig smriti'i 〈〈smra sgo mtshon char 〉〉gsal te/ dper na bod kyi yi ge'i skye gnas dang / byed rtsol/ gdangs kyi bye brag sogs kyi skor dang / lhag par la na gnyis kyi 'jug tshul mi 'dra ba'i gnas/ nyid dang kho na sogs bsnan pa'i tshig dang sgra'i 'jug tshul sum rtags su mi gsal ba/ de bzhin du 'di sgra/ gzhan yang / gang sgra dang / de sgra/ 'di sgra gsum la bsgyur ba bdun te/30 dper na/

5551 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnabasakyi gzhung gnyes btus/gang / gang la/ gang gis/ gang gi phyir/ gang las/ gang gi gang du zhes pa dang ldan tshul/ da ni/ zhes pa sbyor tshul dang / ni sgra'i 'jug tshul gyi rnam grangs/ yang sgra bsnan pa la 'jug pa/ tsam sgra tshad 'dzin la 'jug pa/ yongs su/ kun tu/ lta bu'i nye bsgyur gyi tshig rnams dang / lhag par/ gal te/ gal te na/ lta bu'i phrad 'dus kyi skor sogs gnas gal che ba mang po zhig gtan la phab pas/ 〈〈smra sgo mtshon cha 〉〉de sum rtags gnyis kyi steng du sngon gyi bod kyi brda sprod kyi rtsa gzhung zhig tu ngos 'dzin dgos so/ /〈〈smra sgo'i 'grel pa 〉〉'di kha cig gis rong zom paṇḍi'i gsung du ngos 'dzin mod/31 rtsom gyi gshis dang rtsa ba'i tshig 'dren tshul sogs la brtags na sngon gyi bod kyi mkhas pa mang pos rang 'grel du bzhed pa ltar don la gnas par mthong la/ bstan 'gyur du'ang 'di smri ti'i rang 'grel du brtsis snang /dus rabs kyi cha nas bod kyi brda sprod kyi gzhung ches snga gras shig ni nga tsho'i glegs bam 'di bzhugs su gsol ba'i rngog lo'i 〈〈dag yig nyer mkho bsdus pa 〉〉der 'jog dgos/ bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan du dag yig ces 'khod mod/ de ni brda sprod dang dag yig gnyis su phye ba'i phyi ma'i don la go mi nyen/ rngog lo'i gzhung 'dir/ 1 yi ge'i rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / 2 spyir bstan pa de dag grangs nges pa'i tshul dper brjod dang bcas pa bkod pa dang / 2 tshig phrad kyi skor dang / 4 sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug 'thob mi 'thob kyi tshul dang / 5 dmigs bsal so sor dbye ba zhes pa/ sgra 'dra la don mi 'dra ba'i tshig rnams so so nas dag cha ma nor bar 'bri tshul bcas/ don tshan che khag lnga gtan la phab pa gzhung rang nyid las mkhyen 'tshal/ gzhung rtsom pa'i dgos pa'ang / 66'dir nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge 'di'i ming 'di zhes bya zhing / don 'di brjod pa la tshig 'di dang 'di 'jug go zhes bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir bstan bcos 'di rtsom mo/mi 32 /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa las shes nus/zhwa lu'i 〈〈dag yig za ma tog 〉〉ni/ rngog lo'i dag yig dang 'dra bar bod kyi yi ge'i 'jug tshul gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bcos shig tu ngos 'dzin dgos la/ thog mar rkyang pa'i brda ste rkyang pa'i ming tshig rnams ka kha'i go rim dang mthun par bsgrigs te tshig bcad du dper brjod dang bcas pa bkod/de nas rim gyis sngon 'jug pho yig ba ma ning / ga da gnyis/ mo yig 'a/ shin tu mo/ ma bcas so so'i 'jug tshul dper brjod tshigs bcad dang bcas pa bkod/ de rjes mgo can gyi brda tshig ste/ ra mgo la mgo sa mgo bcas kyi brda tshig dang / mthar snga ma'i ming shugs kyis phyi ma ji ltar 'thob tshul

sngon gleng ngo sprod/ 0511 ste/rjes 'jug la ltos pa'i phrad rnams kyi 'jug tshul dpe dang bcas pa bkod/ gzhung 'di'i mjug byang du rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis/ bstan bcos 'dis legs sbyar gyi sgra'i gzhung dang / de bzhin du thon mi'i sum rtags dang / sgra sbyor bam gnyis sogs sngon gyi bod kyi brda dag gi gzhung rnams kyi snying po bsdus te ston par gsungs/33 kha cig gis gzhung 'di legs sbyar gyi mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 〈〈sna tshogs gsal ba 〉〉zhes pa zhwa lu lo tsā ba rang nyid nas bod bsgyur gnang ba der dpe blangs pa'ang bshad pa brtag34dpang lo blo gros brtan pa'i 〈〈tshogs gsum gsal ba 〉〉ni/ gtso bor legs sbyar gyi sgra'i gzhung gi bshad pa'i ched du brtsams par snang mod/ sngon gyi bod kyi mkhas pa rnams nas 'di la brda sprod kyi gzhung rang rkang zhig tu ngos bzung ste gtsigs chen por mdzad srol 'du gshis 'dir yang nga tshos gzhung 'di glegs bam du bzhugs su gsol yod/ bstan bcos 'di'i sgrom ni/ rang nyid kyi mtshan du gsal ba ltar tshogs gsum ste/ yi ge'i tshogs dang / ming gi tshogs/ tshig gi tshogs bcas don tshan che khag gsum du byas te brda sprod kyi gnad rnams gtan la 'bebs/ gzhung 'dir dngos shugs su smri ti'i 〈〈smra sgo mtshon char 〉〉dgag pa mang tsam thon la/ brtags na dpang lo'i gzigs tshul du/ bar skabs shig nas bod nang 〈〈smra sgo mtshon cha'i 〉〉grags pa che cher 'phel zhing / de'i 'chad nyan kyang khyab brdal du phyin pa'i rkyen gyis/ legs sbyar gyi sgra'i gzhung dngos kyi 'chad nyan cung nyams pa lta bur gyur pas/dpang los 〈〈smra sgo 〉〉de phyogs gcig nas mkhas pa smi ti'i gsung min tshul dang / don gyi cha nas kyang skyon cha yod tshul sogs gsungs/35 lhag par du tshig phrad kyi skor la/ 〈〈bye brag rtogs byed chen mo 〉〉dang / 〈〈smra sgo 〉〉gnyis gar tshig phrad min pa mang dag cig phrad du 'khrul te ngos 'dzin tshul gsungs mod/36 kha pos brtags na/ bod skad rang gi 'gro stangs nas bltas na don gnad 'di thog dpang lo las smi ti 'thad par mthong /gzhan yang / bod kyi brda sprod kyi skor la sngon gyi mkhas pa'i gzhung gal che ba khag gcig ni gong du smros zin pa ltar 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyi gzhung rnams lags/ de dag las sa paṇa gyi 〈〈yi ge'i sbyor ba'i 〉〉nang 〈〈rtags 'jug 〉〉 tu byung ba'i tshigs bcad mang tsam zhig dang / gzhan yang 〈'akyim cu par 〉〉byung ba'i tshig 'ga' shas kyang ji lta ba bzhin bzhugs pa sogs kyis/ bod kyi brda sprod kyi phyi mo'i

5551 1 1 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gzhung zhig rtsom bzhed pa lta bur mngon pa dpyad gzhi che/ bstan bcos 〈〈mkhas pa'i kha rgyan 〉〉du ni sngon rjes kyi yi ge'i sgra'i sbyor tshul dang / de bzhin du slar bsdu dang / la don/ i ldan gyi phrad/ kyang yang 'ang gsum/ bdag sgra'i pa ba sogs kyi sgra'i sbyor tshul/ gzhan yang bya byed las gsum la bya tshig gi gzugs mi 'dra ba sbyor tshul sogs ston/ 〈〈sgra la 'jug pa 〉〉zhes pa'i bstan bcos kyis ni/ 〈〈gnas brgyad 〉〉rtsa 'grel du byung ba'i sgra rig pa'i gnas brgyad rnams/37 yi ge'i tshogs dang / ming gi tshogs dang / tshig gi tshogs gsum du bsdus te brda sprod kyi gnas rnams ston la/ gzhan yang gong du zhus zin pa ltar/〈〈mkhas 'jug 〉〉gi skabs mang por byung ba'i bod kyi brda sprod dang 'brel ba'i bshad pa rnams kyang sa paṇa gyi brda sprod kyi gzhung du brtsi dgos pas/ sa paṇa gyis bod kyi brda sprod kyi skor la bshad pa zhib mor mdzad snang / de lta na'ang phyis kyi bod kyi brda sprod pa rnams nas sum rtags kyi gzhung la gtso bor mdzad pa las/ sa paṇa gyi brda sprod kyi gzhung la dpyad zhib dang de dag las legs cha bsdu gang thub byed pa phal cher ma byung ba lta bur 'dug pa yid pham gyi gnas shig tu mthong / de yang sum rtags gnyis las ma thon pa sa paṇa gyi gzhung las byung ba'i gnad/ dper na bod skad la byed pa'i tshig bkod de/gang la/ gang gis/ gang gi phyir/ tshul ji ltar/ zhes pa'i spyi sgra'i dri tshig sbyar te tshig don rtogs tshul dang /de bzhin du/ de ltar/ de'i phyir/ de bas na/ zhes sogs de sgras sne drangs pa'i phrad 'dus rnams la 66dmigs kyis 'dzin pa'i phrad 'dus mi dang / gang ltar/ gang gi phyir/ zhes sogs/ gang sgras sne drangs pa rnams la 66dmigs kyis mi 'dzin pa mi zhes pa'i rnam dbye 'byed tshul thon pa sogs 〈〈smra sgo'i lde mig 〉〉tu zhus zin pas de nas mkhyen 'tshal/38sum rtags kyi 'grel pa snga gras la/ gong du smras pa'i dbus pa blo gsal gyi de'i steng / lo chen nam mkha' bzang po/ snar thang pa saṅgha shi yar 'brog pa rin chen tog dge yi ba tshul khrims seṅge /shākya mchog ldan/ go rams pa/ dpa' bo gtsug phreng / zur mkhar ba blo gros rgyal po/ rab 'byams smra ba chos rgyal/ bol ba rab 'byams pa/ sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba/ gting skyes tshogs bsags sogs kyis brtsams pa sogs yod mod/39 de dag las bod du brda sprod kyi rig par shugs rkyen che shos thebs pa zhig ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga pa'i nang zhwa lu lo tsā bas brtsams pa de yin nges/zhwa lu lo tsā ba'i rjes su dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang rnam gling paṇa chen dang / dus rabs de'i smad dam

sngon gleng ngo sprod/ 5515bco brgyad pa'i stod du/ bra ti rin chen don grub dang / rkarma si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed so sos brtsams pa'i 'grel chen gnyis dang / dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i nang si tu'i 'grel chen gyi snying don gyi tshul du dngul chus 〈〈si tu'i zhal lung brtsams pa byung la/ dngul chu'i slob ma dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rjes sum bcu pa'i snying po sdom gyi tshul du bsdus pa'i bstan bcos 〈〈legs bshad ljon dbang 〉〉dang / rtags 'jug gi 〈〈dka' gnad sel ba'i mo long 〉〉gnyis brtsams/ dus de nas bzung ste bod du sa khul mang por brda sprod slob pa'i skabs/ 〈〈legs bshad ljon dbang 〉〉blo 'dzin thog gzhung gi dngos gzhi'i 'dzub khrid 〈〈si tu'i zhal lung〉〉 gi steng nas dang / dka' gnad zhib bshad dang dogs gcod kyi skor la bra ti'i 'am si tu'i 'grel chen gang rung zhig gi steng nas bgyi ba'i srol khyab cher dar bar snang /gzhan yang bod kyi brda sprod kyi skor la rang rkang gi gzhung gal che ba ni/ glegs bam 'di nang bzhugs pa'i zhwa lu lo tsā ba dang dpang lo'i gzhung gnyis kyi steng / shes rab 'od zer gyi 〈〈sa mtha'i rnam dbye rab gsal sgron me/〉〉 sum pa mkhan po ye shes dpal 'byor gyi 〈〈brda dag rab gsal sgron me/〉〉a kyu yongs 'dzin dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyi 〈〈rnam dbye brgyad dang bya byed las sogs kyi khyad par mdo tsam brjod pa/〉〉 bstan dar lha rams pa'i 〈〈yi ge'i bshad pa mkhas pa'i kha rgyan 〉〉sogs yin la/ yig cha de rnams su bod kyi brda sprod kyi gnad la sngon gyi mkhas pa'i gsung las ma thon pa'i bshad mang tsam zhig bzhugs/ lhag par bra ti dang / si tu'i 'grel chen gnyis dang / de'i steng dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i smad du byung ba'i 〈〈gser tog 〉〉sum rtags bcas/ gzhung 'grel gsum gyi nang /40 brda sprod kyi rtsa gzhung sum rtags gnyis dang / 〈〈smra sgo mtshon cha 〉〉bcas gsum gyi gnad rnams legs par btus te/ yi ge'i sbyor tshul dang / skye gnas dang byed rtsol sogs las sgra drag zhan 'gyur tshul/ rnam dbye/ phrad kyi rnam gzhag bya tshig rnams bdag gzhan dus gsum du sbyor tshul sogs/ bod skad kyi brda sprod kyi gnad rnams gsal zhing rgyas par gtan la phab pa rnams la brtags na/ bod du brda sprod rig pa'i chu tshad mthon por son pa shes nus/41 deng rabs kyi dus su'ang sum rtags gnyis la 'grel pa gal che ba dper na tshe tan zhabs drung gi 〈〈thon mi'i zhal lung 〉〉lta bu mang tsam zhig thon yod mod/ 'dir ni gtso bo spyi lo'i dus rabs nyi shu'i stod yan gyi bod kyi mkhas pa'i gtsug lag gi gzhung rnams la gtso 'don zhu bas/ deng rabs kyi brda dag gi bstan bcos rnams kyi ming 'don gyi ngal ba mi bya'o//

555 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gcesabatus/snyan ngag dang mngon brjod kyi skor/spyir bod du snyan ngag gi lag len te tshig la snya/na pa'i rgyan sbyar nas rtsom srol ches snga sa zhig nas yod pa ni/ sngon gyi bod rtsom dper na slob dpon thon mis srong btsan sgam por bstod pa phul ba'i tshigs bcad rnams dang / de bzhin du 〈〈bka' gdams glegs bam 〉〉du byung ba'i tshigs bcad/ rje mi la'i gsung mgur sogs las gsal bar dpog nus/ de lta na'ang bod du snyan ngag bya ba ches mtho'i rig gnas kyi sde tshan du byas nas rkang btsugs te srol gtod pa ni/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis 〈〈mkhas 'jug 〉〉mdzad pa'i sku drin las byung bar ngos 'dzin dgos pa ni gong du rags tsam zhus zin pa ltar lags/ de yang 〈〈mkhas 'jug 〉〉tu legs sbyar lugs kyi snyan ngag gi bshad pa la lus dang rgyan gnyis su phye tshul dang / lus la bcad lhug spel ma gsum yod tshul dang / tshigs bcad la sdeb sbyor ji ltar bya dgos tshul/ rgyan la'ang spyir tshig rgyan sbyor tshul dang / dpe 'god tshul/ mtshungs pa gsal byed/ snyan ngag gi skyon yon/ gzhan yang nang gi bsam tshor dper na sgeg pa dang dpa' ba dang mi sdug pa'i nyams sogs tshig dang rgyan gyi sbyor tshul las ji ltar 'don tshul sogs kyi bshad pa rnams gsal bar mdzad de/ bod la legs sbyar lugs kyi snyan ngag gi rig pa thog mar ngo sprad/sa paṇa gyis 〈〈mkhas 'jug 〉〉tu skabs mang por/ snyan ngag gi rgyan rnams kyi ngos 'dzin dang bshad pa/ de bzhin du dper brjod kyi tshigs bcad mang dag cig 6 rgyan las ri zhes slob dpon daṇḍi'i 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉las drangs snang / skabs der gzhung de la bod 'gyur med pas sa paṇa gyis de las gang drangs pa rnams rgya dpe rang nas bod skad du thad bsgyur gnang bar nges/ de bzhin du 〈〈dbyangs can mgul rgyan 〉〉bya ba dang / legs sbyar gyi snyan ngag gi gzhung grags chen dga' ba'i lha'i 〈〈klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar 〉〉dang / slob dpon dpa' bo'i 〈〈skyes rabs so bzhi pa 〉〉nas kyang dper brjod bkod de snyan ngag gi nyams dang dpe don sbyor tshul sogs la bshad pa mdzad pa sogs kyis/ 〈〈mkhas 'jug 〉〉gi rtsom pa'i le'u de nyid kyis bod du ches mtho'i snyan ngag gi rig pa thog mar srol gtod par mthong bas/ kho bos skabs mang por bod kyi ches mtho'i rig gnas la sa paṇa nyid sku drin che shos su 'dug ces smra bang rgyu mtshan 'di dang 'di 'dra ba rnams la bsams pa'o//de ltar 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyisagazhi btingasazin pa'i rjes su/ spyi le'i dus rabs bcu gsum

sngon gleng ngo sprod/ 5551 pa'i smad du/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku dus su shong ston lo tsā bas 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉bod skad du bsgyur cing de la sa bcad kyi chings btab la/ rang gi slob ma dpang los mchan 'grel brtsams pa sogs kyis me long ma'i 'chad nyan thog mar spel/ de bzhin du shong ston gyis legs sbyar gyi snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 〈〈rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing 〉〉bya ba de/ rtsom rig gi chu tshad shin tu mthon po'i lam nas bod bsgyur gnang ba dang / mngon brjod 〈〈'chi med mdzod 〉〉la'ang mchan 'grel brtsams te rgya gar rig byed dang sngon rabs las byung ba'i gtam brgyud rnams la'ang bshad pa thon pa sogs byung ba dang / rang gi slob ma dpang lo blo gros brtan pa sogs snyan ngag mngon brjod dang / sgra rig pa sogs la mdzad rjes can mang du spel te/ bod du legs sbyar lugs kyi snyan ngag gi srol rgyas par mdzad pa byung bas/ shong dpang gnyis la bod kyi thun mong rig gnas la bar du sku drin che ba zer ba'ang don la gnas par mthong /〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉ni rgya gar gyi slob dpon daṇḍi 'am dbyug pa can gyis brtsams pa'i legs sbyar gyi rgyan gyi bstan bcos shin tu grags can zhig tu gyur yod/42 gzhung de tshigs bcad du bzhugs shing le'u gsum gyi bdag nyid can yin la/ gzhung tshad ni le'u dang por shlauka 105 le'u gnyis par/365 le'u gsum par shlauka 186 bcas gzhung dngos la bsdoms shlauka 656 yod/ gzhung gi brjod bya dngos ni snyan ngag gi lus dang / rgyan dang / skyon bsal ba gsum gyis bsdus shing / snyan ngag gi lus zhes pa ni/ 66rang gis gang brjod byar 'dod pa'i khyad par de dang ldan pa'i ming tshig gi tshogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi tshig gi phreng ba'am ngag gi rgyun la 'dod do/ 43 /zhes mkhas dbang tshe tan 'khas drung gis gsungs pa ltar dang / rgyan zhes pa ni/ dper na lus mjes pa la rgyan btags pa'i sgo nas lhag par mdzes par byed pa ltar/ tshig gi phreng bar gyur pa'i snyan ngag gi lus der/ don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan sogs nyams phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par byed pa'i tshig rnams la zer la/ skyon bsal ba zhes pa ni/ 66ngag tshig 'brel med don gzhan dang / tshig don snga phyi 'gal ba dang / bskyar zlos mang ba dang / sgro 'dogs gcod mi nus pa dang / lung rigs dang 'gal ba sogs kyi skyon bsal ba'i tshul nyal go dgos so//44

5551 1 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/snyan ngag gi lus ni mdor bsdus na bcad lhug spel ma gsum ste/ tshigs bcad dang / tshig lhug bcad lhug spel ma gsum du 'jog cing / rgyan la don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan/ gab tshig bcas gsum du 'dus/ me long gi le'u dang por/ gtso bo yi ge 'jam rtsub kyi sbyor tshul gyi khyad par las rgya gar lho shar gyi mkhas pa rnams mdzes char brtsi tshul mi 'dra bar 'dod pa'i thun min gyi rgyan rnams ston cing /le'u gnyis pas lho shar thun mong du 'dod pa'i rgyan la don rgyan so lngar phye ste nang gses so so'i rnam dbye dper brjod dang bcas pa rgyas par gtan la phab/ le'u gsum pas sgra rgyan dang gab tshig gi tshul te/ gtso bor rjod byed kyi tshig rang dang 'brel ba'i rgyan gyi sbyor tshul rnams ston/ de la sgra rgyan zhes pa ni dper na zung ldan gyi rgyan mi 'dra ba rnams dang / bya dka' ba'i rtsom dper na dbyangs nges pa can gyi rtsom rje tsong kha pa chen po'i 〈〈blo sbyong snyan ngag sgra rgyan 〉〉du byung ba lta bu dang / gab tshig ces pa ni/ 66blos btags pa'i 'dra bzhag sna tshogs pas skung tshig bshad pa la bya zhing /45 rang cag gi khed ces pa dang rigs gcig par gsungs pa ltar na/ bod du 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉ma dar gong nas kyang lag len khyab cher yod par mngon/ me long ma'i lugs kyi snyan ngag la gzhir byas pa'i bod kyi ches mtho'i snyan ngag gi lugs la lus dang / rgyan/ skyon bsal ba gsum gyi rnam gzhag ji ltar bya dgos min dang / de bzhin du don rgyan so lnga dang sgra rgyan sogs kyi rgyan gyi ngo bo dang rnam dbye sogs zhib par nga tsho'i glegs bam 'dir bzhugs pa'i a kyu yongs 'dzin gyi snyan ngag gi spyi don las mkhyen nges la/ gzhung gzhan tshe tan zhabs drung gi 〈〈snyan ngag spyi don 〉〉du'ang shin tu gsal bas de nas kyang mkhyen 'tshal/〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉la bod du 'grel pa shin tu mang ba byung la/ grags che ba ni gong gi dpang lo'i mchan 'grel gyi steng / snar thang saṅga shrī'i 'grel pa dang / 'jam dbyangs kha che'i 'grel pa/ rin spungs ngag dbang 'jig grags gi 〈〈seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro'i dbyangs/〉〉 bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs kyi 〈〈daṇḍi'i dgongs rgyan/〉〉 rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i 〈〈dbyangs can dgyes glu 〉〉dang / khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i 〈〈dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho 〉〉ste khams pa snyan 'grel du grags pa rnams lags/ de dag las khams pa snyan 'grel ni/ si tu paṇa chen gyi phyag tu me 'ostong ma'i rgya 'grel ratna shrī dang / ngag dbang grags pa'i ṭika chen gyi rgya dpe 'byor ba gzigs te brtsams pa zhig yin gshis/'grel pa de nyid legs bshad khyad du 'phags so zhes rang nyid kyi snyan ngag gi slob dpon skyabs rje dze

sngon gleng ngo sprod/ 555111 smad rin po ches gsungs/46 me long ma bod skad du bsgyur rjes/ bod du ches mtho'i snyan ngag gi rig par shugs snon shin tu che bar thebs shing / snyan ngag slob pa'i tshe thams cad kyis me long ma spyi dang lhag par le'u gnyis pa lho shar thun mong ba'i lugs kyi don rgyan so lnga la/ nang gses kyi rgyan re rer dper brjod tshigs bcad 'bri ba dang sbrags te sbyong ba'i srol shin tu dar bas/ deng bod kyi mkhas pa mang po'i gsung 'bum du don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod kyi tshigs bcad mjal du yod pa de byung /gang ltar yang sa paṇa gyis legs sbyar gyi snyan ngag bod du srol gtod pa dang / shong dpang gnyis kyis me long ma'i 'chad nyan spel te bar du dar rgyas shin tu che bar mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis/ bod du snyan ngag gi rtsom bris kyi chu tshad shin tu mthon por son thub pa byung ba ni/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa man chad kyi bod kyi mkhas pa'i snyan rtsom la gzigs na bde blag tu mkhyen nges la/47 nga tsho'i glegs bam 'dir yang dpe mtshon gyi tshul du rje tsong kha pa chen po'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 〈〈rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod 〉〉dang / mdo mkhar tshe ring dbang rgyal gyi 〈〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam brgyud 〉〉las btus pa'i tshan pa bcas bzhugs pa las kyang / bod kyi sngon gyi mkhas pa'i snyan rtsom gyi ro brgya'i snying bcud rnams legs por myong thub pa 'ong nges lags/ snyan ngag gi skor la nges dgos pa zhig ni/ snyan ngag gi lus dang rgyan sogs gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos dper na me 'phang ma rtsa 'grel lta bu dang / ched du snyan ngag gis lam nas bris pa'i bstan bcos dang snyan rtsom dbar la rnam dbye 'byed dgos pa de yin/ de la nga tsho'i glegs bam du bzhugs pa'i a kyu yongs 'dzin gyi 〈〈snyan ngag spyi don 〉〉du/48 mkhas grub rje'i bzhed pa 49drangs te me long ma lta bu ni snyan ngag gi gzhung yin gyi snyan ngag min pa dang / 〈〈skyes rabs 〉〉dang 〈〈rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing 〉〉lta bu ni snyan ngag yin gyi snyan ngag gi gzhung min par gsungs/ kha cig snga ma rnams rgyan gyi bstan bcerdzos dang / phyi ma rnams rnams snyan ngag gi bstan bcos su bya dgos bar bshad pa'ang don la gnas par mthong /spyir bod kyi snyan ngag tshad mthon po'i bstan bcos grags can che gras la/ sde pa rin spungs pa'i 〈〈sa paṇa rtogs brjod dang / de'i shambha la'i lam yig karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i 〈〈skyes rabs brgya pa/〉〉 rje tsong kha pa chen po'i 〈〈rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod 〉〉dang / de'i 〈〈spyan snga grags pa byang chub bzang po'i rtogasabarjod/〉〉 zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i 〈〈rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod/〉〉 mdo mkhar ba'i 〈〈gzhon nu

5551 5 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/zla med kyi gtam brgyud 〉〉dang / de'i 〈〈mi dbang rtogs brjod/〉〉 dza dpal sprul gyi lha chos dang mthun pa'i 〈〈gtam padma'i tshal gyi zlos gar 〉〉sogs bzhugs pa dang / gzhan yang mkhas grub rje'i 〈〈'jam dbyangs smra seng ge'i bstod pa 〉〉lta bu'i bstod pa'i rigs dang / nyams mgur/ bslab bya/ phrin yig sogs mang dag cig snyan ngag tshad mthon po'i tshigs bcad du brtsams yod pa rnams kyang srol rgyun gyi ches mtho'i snyan rtsom du 'jog dgos so/ /de yang snyan rtsom de dag gi nang rtsom pa po so so'i gshis kyis nyams 'don tshul mi 'dra ba'ang yod de/ dper na sa paṇa dang rje tsong kha pa chen po'i gsung rnams ni rang bzhin brjod pa'i brjid nyams che ba dang / mkhas grub rje dang / zhang zhung pa/ rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po/mdo mkhar ba sogs ni sgeg pa dang dpa' ba'i brjid nyams che ba dang / snar thang saṅga shrī/ rgyal mchog dang po dang / bdun pa/ bod mkhas pa mi pham dge rgya mtsho sogs ni snying rje dang sdug pa'i nyams kyis snyan 'jebs dang ldan che ba dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me dang / dza dpal sprul gyi rtsom la dgod pa'i nyams kyi tshad mthon po yod pa sogs gsung srol la snang ba ltar bden par kho bos kyang mthong /mngon brjod kyi brjod don gtso bo ni ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ de'ang gtso bor legs sbyar gyi snyan ngag gi bstan bcos che khag dang / de bzhin du rig byed dang sngon rabs sogs legs sbyar gyi gzhung rnying dag las byung ba'i gtam brgyud gzhir byas pa'i ming tshig rnams kyi rnam grangs rnams phyogs gcig tu btus pa'i gzhung la bya dgos/ de yang bod kyi mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos thog mar mdzad pa po ni 'jam mgon sa paṇa du bya dgos la/ des mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 〈〈tshig gi gter 〉〉bya ba mdzad do/ /de nas rim gyis legs sbyar bstan bcos grags can 〈〈'chi med mdzod 〉〉dang / 〈〈sna tshogs gsal ba 〉〉rnams kyang bod skad du bsgyur pa byung la/ de dag las bod du 'gro don che shos ni slob dpon 'chi med seṅges mdzad pa'i 〈〈'chi med mdzod 〉〉yin pa gdon mi za/ 〈〈'chi med mdzod 〉〉la rgya cher 'grel rab 'byor zla bas mdzad pa de grags che zhing / bod 'grel la yar lung grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bod 'gyur la zhwa lu lo tsā bas legs bcos kyis skad gnyis bshad sbyar du bsgrigs pa la phyis kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas zhus chen mdzad pa de dang / si tu paṇa chen gyis rgya cher 'grel 〈〈'dod 'jo'i ba mo 〉〉dang / de'i 〈〈ming dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gsal byed legs bshad sgo brgya 'byed

sngon gleng ngo sprod/ 5545pa'i lde mig 〉〉bya ba brtsams/ bod rtsom rang gi mngon brjod kyi gzhung grags can ni/ sa paṇa gyi de'i steng /rin spungs pa'i mngon brjod shin tu rgyas pa 〈〈mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/〉〉 dpal khang lo tsā ba'i 〈〈padma dkar po'i phreng ba/〉〉 dngul chu dharma bhadra'i 〈〈mngon brjod chu thigs rgya mtsho 〉〉bcas su lags/ mngon brjod ni bod kyi snyan rtsom klog pa dang 'bri ba sngon gleng ngo sprod/ 555511 dam chos kyi 〈〈bzo rig pa'i rnam bshad/〉〉 'ju mi pham gyi 〈〈bzo gnas nyer mkho'i za ma tog 〉〉sogs bzo rig gi skor la bstan bcos mang tsam zhig byung / dus rabs kyi cha nas bshad na/ ri mo la bod du sman mkhyen gnyis zhes/ sman bla don grub zhabs kyi sman thang lugs su grags pa dang / yang gong dkar sgang stod du byung ba'i mkhyen brtse chen mo'i lugs gnyis shin tu grags che bar byung la/ phyis su gtsang pa chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i sman gsar lugs dang / rkarma bkris bya bas garma sgar bris su grags pa sogs byung tshul yongs su grags/ de yang rgyal mchog lnga pa'i bka' khyab 'og bod du bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan dang / gsung rab dpar skun/ po tā la'i ar las sogs/ rig gzhung gi gnas mang por las 'gur rgya cher spel ba'i rkyen gyis/ lnga pa chen po'i sku dus de bod du bzo rig che cher 'phel ba'i dus skabs shig la phyi mi'i bzo rig gi skor la mkhas pa rnams smra ba don la gnas par mngon/bzo rig pa'i skor la ngo sprod cha tshang ba ni stag tshang gi 〈〈rig gnas kun shes 〉〉rtsa 'grel du byung ba de yin la/ de'i steng 'jam mgon kong sprul gyi 〈4nis bya kun khyab 〉〉du/54 lus ngag yid gsum gyi bzor dbye tshul dang / lus kyi bzo la'ang mchog phal gnyis dang / dang po la'ang sku gsung thugs gsum gyi rten du 'jog tshul/ dang po la'ang lha sku'i cha tshad dang / 'phros don phyag mtshan sogs dang / de bzhin du rten gzhal yas khang sogs/ gsung rten la yi ge'i rigs spyi dang / bod kyi yi ge bye brag tu bshad pa/ yi ge'i 'bri thabs/ thugs kyi rten la spyir mchod rten gyi dbye ba/ de dag so so'i cha tshad dang /zhar la lugs 17la khyad par can smras pa rbestogs/ bshad pa kha gsal la rgyas tsam zhig byung ba de gnad che/ bzo rig gi ngo sprod mdor bsdus shing bod pa rang gi bzo rig la 'phel 'gyur dang sbyar nas ston pa ni/ kho bo'i slob dpon skyabs rje dze smad rin po che'i 〈〈rig gnas lnga'i byung ba brjod pa gtam tshangs pa'i rol mor 〉〉bzhugs pa de yin par mthong /bzo rig pa'i cha shas rol mo'i skor la/ spyir bod la rol mo'i lag len ches snga sa nas yod pa ni mna' bo'i mi rigs gzhan gyi lo rgyus dang mtshungs mod/ de lta na'ang rol mo'i lag len gyi gzhi dbyangs dang / tshig dang / de gnyis sbyor ba'i tshul sogs kyi sgo nas/ rol mo'i bshad pa rkang btsugs te bstan bcos brtsams pa ni sa paṇa gyi sku drin du ngos 'dzin dgos pa bston du med/ de lta na'ang rol mo'i bstan bcos su byung ba'i bshad pa rnams ni/ sngon dus kyi rgya gar gyi zlos gar dang rol mo'i lugs

55551 1 1 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gtsor bzung mdzad pa'i bshad pa yin cing / de dag gi gnad mang dag cig bodakyi sgra la tshur sbyar du rung mod/ gzhung du bod pa rang gi gzhas dang bro sogs rol mo'i lag len dang 'brel nas bshad pa mdzad med pa mngon gsal dod por yod pa zhu mi dgos/ spyir rgya gar du rol mo'i bstan bcos grags che ba 〈〈nabyu shāsta/〉〉bya ba spyi 'pha'i gong gi dus rabs gsum pa yas mas su byung ba de yin la/ bstan bcos de ni phyis kyi rol mo'i bstan bcos yod do cog gi rtsa ba'i khungs lta bur gyur pa'ang bshad/ 'on kyang sa paṇa gyi 〈〈rol mo'i bstan bcos〉〉kyi khungs dngos ni/ saskya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan (159741660)gyis brtsams pa'i rol mo'i bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa la brtags na/phal cher slob dpon tsand+ra go mi'i dbyangs kyi bstan bcos 〈〈blo gsal mgul rgyan 〉〉dang / de'i 〈〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉〉gnyis yin par mngon/rol mo'i bstan bcos de la gong du spros pa'i 'grel pa de tsam las dmigs bsal ma mthong la/ lag len gyi cha nas kyang / rol mo'i bstan bcos su gsungs pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'gyur dang /dbyangs dang tshig gi sbyor ba mi 'dra ba sogs bod pa rang gi rol mo'i lugs la tshur sbyor thabs byed pa ni su gcig kyang byung bar mi snang / rol mo'i bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa'i nang sa skya bsod nams dbang pos brtsams pa'i rol mo'i bstan bcos gcig shes kun grol zhes pa'i mtshan thon mod kho bos gzhung de mjal ma thub/55 spyir bod du chos brgyud so so'i dge sde khag gi nang cho ga'i lag len shin tu rgya che ba dang / cho ga dang 'brel ba'i dbyangs yig dang / de bzhin du rol yig sogs kyang yod mod/ de dag gi 'bri klog gi tshul ni mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len gyi rgyun kho na bskyangs pa las/ sa paṇa gyi 〈〈rol mo'i bstan bcos su byung ba'i gnad rnams tshur sbyar srol zhig dar bar mi mngon pa dang / de bzhin du skya bo'i zlos gar gyi sgyu rtsal a lce lha mo sogs la'ang rol mo'i bstan bcos las bshad pa'i gnas rnams tshur sbyor ba'i srol dar ba ma byung ba sogs la bsams na/ sa paṇa gyi rol mo'i bstan bcos 'dis bod kyi rol mo'i lag len la de tsam shugs rkyen thebs pa ni byung mi snang /mtha' don/ 'dir nga tshos bod kyi thun mong ba'i rig gnas khag dang 'brel ba'i gzhung grags can bco brgyad phyogs gcig tu btus te dpar du bskrun pa las/ rang cag bod kyi spyi tshogs nang mi rabs du ma'i ring la/ nang bstan gyi lta grub zab mo tsam min par/ tha snyad rig gnas kyi thad la'ang

snyan 'grel dang / dka' gnad gsal bshad rnamasakhamasapa snyan 'grel la gtugs pa'i steng / rgyan so so'i dper brjod la/ sngon gyi bod kyi snyan ngag mkhan mang dag cig gi dper brjod phyogs gcig tu btus pa zhig rgya gar du 1960 'i nang dge rgan 'os sbyong gi ched du lag bris kyisasnum dpar btab pa'i deb gcig 'dug pa der 'dris par byas te sbyangs pa'i skal ba thob/47 gzhan yang spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i smad nas smin gling lo chen dharma shrī'i sku drin las smin grol gling du/ dbus kyi mi sna gal che rnams gzhon dus su sgra rig pa dang snyan sum/ skar rtsis bcas thung mong ba'i rig gnas la slob gnyer bgyi ba'i srol lta bu zhig chags par mngon la/ de'i rkyen gyis skya bo'i gras nas rig gnas dang snyan rtsom la ches mkhas pa mdo mkhar zhabs drung dang / rdo rings paṇḍita lta bu thon pa byung /48 deb 'di'i shog 20449 mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag gsung 'bum/ nya 3|ga 21 ba1 zhol dpar ma/50 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉le'u dang po'i dbur/ 66grol ba dang ni rigs dang mdzod/ /'dus pa zhes bya der 'du la/ /tshigs bcad rgya che sargas bcings/ /zhes/byung /51 'dir tshigs bcad la rigs bzhi'i ngo bo bkod pa rnams mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung gi 〈〈snyan ngag spyi don 〉〉las btus/gangs can rig brgya'i sgo 'byed lde mig deb/ 〈 shog 8652 〈〈rig gnas kun shes/〉〉 stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi gsung 'bum/ deb/ 1 shog 3253 sa paṇa rang nasa'adi la zhal 'phangs mdzad mod/ deng bzhugasapa'i gsung 'bum kha skong dang bcas par med pas dpe snga tsam nas brlags par snang ba brtag54 〈4nis bya kun khyab/〉〉 deb/ 2 shog nas bar/55 〈〈rol mo'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs blo gsal yid 'phrog 〉〉(shog 36 ba4)thad du/ 'grel byed pa rang nyid nas sa paṇa gyi sku dus kyi ma dpe yin snyam pa'i dpe rnying yig chung gi mchan bu btab pa zhig gzigs pa dang / rang nyid kyi 'grel pa'i nang gzhung tshan so sor phye tshul gyi chings kyang sa paṇa gyi dpe rnying de la khungs gtugs pa sogs bshad/

dpe skrun gsal bshad//'dir nga tshos bod kyi gtsug lag gces btus kyi pod phreng sum cu par bod kyi brda sprod dang /snyan ngagamangon brjod/bzo rig pa sogs sa mong ba'i rig gnas skor gyi gci bco brgyad phyogs gcig tu bskyu te dpar du bskrun pa las/gzhung so so'i ma dpe gang la gzhi bcol ba ni/thog mar mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i slob ma dgra 'dul dbang pos mdzad pa'i 〈〈tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba 〉〉ni/gangs can rig mdzod deb grangs bzhi pa bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 1987lor dpar dubatab pa'i mang thos klusgrub rgya mtsho'i bstan brtsis kyi lhan thabs subyung ba der gzhi bzung /slob dpon thon mi sastoṭa'i 〈〈lung duston pa'i rtsa ba sum cupa 〉〉dang /〈〈lung duston pa rtags kyi 'jug pa 〉〉gnyis kyi ma dpe ni sde dge bstan 'gyur/sna tshogs/pod/co par bzhugs pa de yin la/rtsa gzhung de gnyis kyi dpar ma mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas dpar dubatab pa'i bstan 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i nang ji ltar yod pa ltar 'dir bkod yod/dngul chu'i 〈〈sum cupa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i rnam bshad mkhas mchog si tu'i zhal lung 〉〉ni/khong gi gsung 'bum pod ca pa'i nang bzhugs pa la gzhi bzung zhing /de dang mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 1993lor deb gzugs sudapar dubatab pa gnyis phan tshun bsdur zhib zhus/rngog lo tswab blo ldan shes rab kyi 〈〈dag yig nyer mkho bsdus pa 〉〉ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas phyi lo 2006lor dpar dubatab pa'i bka' gdams gasdang 'bum phyogs bsgrigs nang bzhugs pa der gzhi bzung la/de dang rda sa bod gzhung shes rig las khungs nas 2010lor dpar dubaskrun pa 〈gangs ljongs brda dag kun btus 〉〉nang du yod pa dang phan tshun bsdur zhib zhus/rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo'i 〈〈yi ge'i bklag thabs byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa 〉〉sde dge dpar ma'i sa skya bka' 'bum nga par bzhugs pa la gzhi bzung la/de dang 〈〈gangs ljongs brda dag kun btus 〉〉suyod pa gnyis dpar ma bsdur/'jam mgon sa skya paṇḍita'i 〈〈sgra la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 〉〉ni sde dge dpar ma'i sa skya bka' 'bum tha pa'i nang bzhugs pa la gzhi bzung ste/sa skya mtho slob nas phyi lo 244lor sa skya bka' 'bram deb gzugs sudapar dubatab pa dang phan zhe bsdur zhib zhus/zha lulo stob chos skyong bzang tsho 〈bod kyibarda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa si po tsho za ma rtag bas pa 〉ji 〈gangs ljongs brda dag ༅ btus 〉〉nang bzhugs pa la gzhi bzung /de dang mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 1998loradapar dubatab pa 〈dag yig phyogs bsgrigs mutig tshom ba'i 〉〉nang bsas pa gnyis bsdur/dpang lotsāb blo gros brtan pa'i

7171 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/〈〈tshogs gsum gsal ba 〉〉ni pe cing mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas 2006lor dpar du btab pa 〈〈gangs ljongs rig bcu'i snying bcud chen mo/〉〉glegs bam dang po/ 〈〈sgra snyan mngon sdeb 〉〉zhes pa'i deb nang bzhugs pa de yin la/ dpar ma bsdur yul ni/ 〈〈dag yig phyogs bsgrigs mutig tshom bu'i 〉〉nang bzhugs pa de yin/ dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i gasdang 〈〈legs bshad ljo na dbang 〉〉dang /〈〈rtags 'jag gi snying po dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long 〉〉gnyis kyi ma dpe ni/ dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum ga par bzhugs pa la gzhi bzung /de dang pe cing mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 1998lor dpar dubatab pa dang phan tshun bsdur zhib zhus/a lag sha bstan dar lha rams pa'i 〈〈yi ge'i bshad pa mkhas pa'i kha rgyan 〉〉ni gsung 'bum sku'abum byams pa gling gi dpar ma la gzhi bzung nas/de dang phyi lo 2008 lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas dpar du btab pa'i gsung 'bum deb chen de'i nang bzhugs pa gnyis phan rnam bsdur zhib zhus/a kyuyongs 'dzin dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyi 〈snya/na dngags kyi bstan bcos mutig phreng ba 〉〉ni/phyi lo 1971 sog bla gu ru de was ldi lir dpar du btab pa'i gsung 'bum pod kha par bzhugs pa la gzhi bzung la/dpar ma bsdur yul gyi dpe gzhan ma rnyed/ rje myong kha pa chen po'i gsung 〈〈byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa'i 〉〉ni bkra shis lhun po'i dpar ma gsung 'bum pod kha gsung thor bu'i shog grangs 117rgyab nas shog grangs 168nang bzhugs pa la gzhi bzung /de dang zhol dpar/sku'abum dpar ma bcas phan tshan bsdur zhib zhus/mdo mkhar zhabs brong tshe ring dbang rgyal gyi 〈gshon nazla med kyi gtam rjod 〉phos tshan bshus ni/mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 195lor dpar dubatab pa 〈gangs ljongs mkhas dbang rim byon gyi rtsom yig gser gyi sbram bu 〉〉nas bkod/ dpal khang lo tsā ba'i gsung 〈〈ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba 〉〉ni mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 2002 lor dpar du btab pa 〈〈bod kyi bcu phrag rig mdzod chen mo 〉〉bka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab pod gnyis pa/ 〈〈snyan ngag dang mngon brjod 〉〉kyi deb nang bzhugs pa la gzhi bzung /'jam mgon sa paṇa gyi 〈〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉〉ni sde dge dpar ma sa skya bka' 'bum tha pa'i nang bzhugs pa la gzhi bzung zhing /de dang sa skya mtho slob nas phyi lo 2004lor deb gzugs su dpar du btab pa'i bka' 'bum nang bzhugs pa dang phan tshun bsdur/mthar stag tshang lotsāb shes rab rin chen gyi 〈〈rten gsum gzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las sku'i phyag tshad kyi skabs zur duphyung ba 〉〉ni de'i gsung 'bum/pod gnyis pa/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i 〈'as po'i 〈lta bzhag 〉〉deb sum cupar dpar dubatab pa der gzhi bzung /

dpe skrun gsal bshad/ 51711 gzhi rkang nga tshos ma dpe nor bcos sustangs gang yin bod kyi gtsug lag gces btus sgrig pa po'i gleng brjod nas mkhyen nges la/gzhung so sor bka' bstan dang de bzhin dubod kyi mkhas grub snga rjes kyi gsung shin tumang ba zhig yang na dngos sulung 'dren mdzad pa'am/ yang na zhal 'phangs mdzad pa rnams ci nas kyi soso'i khungs 'tshol zhib zhus te mdzad pa po dang gzhung so so'i mtshan/de bzhin du gsung 'bum gyi pod kyi ang grangs/shog grangs yig phreng dang bcas pa gsal bar ngos 'dzin byas te mchan bkod yod/ bka' bstan gyi lung ngos 'dzin skabs sde dge zhes pa'i bsdus yig bkod pa ni sde dge bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur la go dgos shing /de yang nga tshos dpyad zhib zhuyul ni rgya gar ldi lir dpar bshus kyi dpar dubatab pa'idapar ma de yin pas pod kyi ang grangs dang shog grangs sogs bkod pa dpar ma de gzhi bzung yin/ de yang mdun shog la rtags na dang / rgyab shog la rtags gabacas bkod cing / de'i mjug du yig phreng yang ngos 'dzin zhus yod/ sde dge dpe tho'i ang grangs ni nyi hong to ho ku mtho slob kyi dpe mdzod khang nas phyogs bsgrigs gnang ba'i sde dge bka' bstan gyi dkar chags gzhi bzung gi ang grangs de rnams yin/ṣpecing zhes pa ni pe cing nas dpar bskrun gnang ba'i bka' bstan la go dgos shing /de'i dpe tho'i ang grangs ni nyi hong nas pe cing dpar ma deb gatshugs subaskyar dudapar bskrun byed skabs kyi phyag dpe'i mtshan tho bsgrigs pa de yin lags/mtha' don/'dir nga tshos bod kyi gtsug lag gces btus kyi pod 'di nang /bod kyi brda sprod dang snyan ngag sogs thun mong ba'i rig gnas khag dang 'brel ba'i gzhus grags chen khag gcig phyogs bsgrigs kyis dpar dubatab pa 'di la brten nas/rang rigs blo gsal don gnyer can mang po zhig nas/bod kyi tha snyad rig gnas phyug po'i nor gyi rin thangs la nges pa rnyed thub pa tsam du ma zad/ nyin re'i mi tshe'i nang du'ang ngoms med rgyun du longs su spyod pa'i skal ba'ang dang du len pa'i smon 'dun zhu/bod kyi gtsug lag zhib dpyod khang nas/spyi lo 2012 zla tshes la/

༄༄/ /tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs rbedu//dgra 'dul dbang po/ra༅༅/ /swasti pra dza bhyaḥ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas ma rig pa'i/ /mun pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus nyer bsal te/ /rig pa'i gnas la blo gros mchog stsol ba'i/ /klu sgrub rgya mtsho snying nas dran no skyongs/ /tshul gnas gser gyi yol go rnam dpyod kyi/ /'od snang rmongs mun 'joms la dpa' ba dang / /lhan cig brtson 'grus lhag bsam rgyan bkra ba'i/ /mdza' bshes legs bshad mchog sbyin 'dir dgyes rol//zhes bsngags brjod sngon du song nas/ 'dir rang cag gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal pos 'dul bar bya ba'i bstan pa 'di la ni thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bla na med pa thob par 'dod pa'i blo gsal dag gis bslab par bya ba'i gnas ni rig pa'i gnas lnga po 'di nyid yin te/ mdo drin lan gsab pa las/ de bas na bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir du rig pa'i dngos po lnga la bslab par bya'o/1 /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga/2 zhes sogs dang / bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi tas/ rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' bas ring / /de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang mkhas rnams kyis/ /shes bya'i gnas rnams sbyong zhes legs par gsungs/3 /zhes dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po sgra pa shes rin pas/ rig pa'i gnas lngar legs par ma sbyangs na/ /dgra bcom gyis kyang kun mkhyen thob mi srid/ /de bas don gnyis mthar phyin bya ba'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen lam 'dir mkhas rnams brtson par rigs/4 /zhes dang / 'dren pa dam pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ lnga rig chos la ma sbyangs zag med kyi/ /bdud rtsi thob pa'i rgyal ba 'ga' yang med/ /rig gnas che chung shes bya'i gnas rnams la/ /blo gros rtsal du thon cig grogs po dag5 /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sgra rig pa/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ nang rig pa ste lnga po la legs par bslab dgos pa yin no//'o na de lnga la slob pa las dgos pa ji lta bu snyam na/ tha snyad tshig gi cha la legs par sbyangs pas/ de nyid mkhas par shes pa na/ tshig gi cha la log rtog zhugs pa thams cad tshar gcod par byed pa

2 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/dang / mngon gyur sogs don gyi cha la legs pa ra sbyangs pas de'i tshul bzhin du shes na don la log rdog zhugs pa thams cad sun 'byin nas pas/ rig sams ngang po gnyis theg na rikhros ba ngar 5 ga'am dag tshar gcod pa dang / bzo gnas sku gzurges kyi cha chod dang / gser 'gyur gyi rtsi la sogs pa shes pas skye bo 'byor pa can dang / dbul phongs rnams kyi don byed cing / gso ba rig pa'i gnas tshul bzhin du shes pas sems can nad pa sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa rnams rjes su bzung ba'i phyir rig gnas bar pa gnyis dang / rang nyid kun shes mkhas pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob par bya ba'i phyir rig gnas lnga la legs par bslab dgos pa yin te/ gzhan dag tshar gcod rjes su gzung phyir dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir/6 zhes gsungs pas so//byams mgon gyi gzhung 'di nyid la rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po 'gyur med bde chen gyi bzhed pas/ 'phags mchog gis kyang zhes pa ni cung zad mi 'thad de/ 'phags mchog rnams kyis rig gnas la sbyang mi dgos shing gzhung 'di'i dod du yang / ka tarnyi zhes pa cis kyang gi skad dod yod pa yin gyis /gis kyang zhes pa'i skad dod kyang med pa'i phyir/ des na gzhung gi 'bru gnyer ba'i tshe 'khor du gnas pa'i 'phags mchog rnams la 'phags mchog ces bos nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par byed na cis kyang rig gnas lnga la sbyang dgos zhes gsungs/7 thams cad mkhyen pa mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i bzhed pas/ de lta bu'i dgos pa ni rang gi blo tshod du/ 'phags pa mchog gis rig gnas la sbyang mi dgos so snyam pa shar ba'i tshod dpag las yin mod/ 'dir skabs kyi 'phags pa ni byang sems 'phags pa rnams yin pas/ de rnams sa yongs sbyongs kyi skabs su shes bya'i gnas thams cad la slob dgos par bshad yod pas/ 'phags pa dman pa nyan rang las ches mchog tu gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sar gnas rnams kyis kyang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i phyir du rig pa'i gnas lnga la slob dgos na/ so skye'i blo gsal rnams kyis rig gnas la slob dgos pa lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes pa'i don yin gsungs te/ bla na med pa'i bshad tshul yin no//byams pa'i gzhung 'di nyid kyis rig gnas lnga'i go rim dang / thog mar gang nas 'jug gi rim pa yang log smra tshar gcod pa'i yan lag gnyis thog mar bstan/ don gnyer rjes su 'dzin pa'i yan lag bar du bstan/ nang rig pa rjes su ston par mdzad pa las tshad mar ci yang ma mdzad par/rig gnas kun shes las/ rig gnas dang po don gnyer rjes 'dzin te/ /bstan pa gnas phyir dkon

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 3mchog gsum gyi rten/ /bzhengs bar 'dod pa'i 'byor ldan lhag bsam can/ /rgyal bas bstan 'dzin nyid du lung bstan zhing /8 /zhes bya ba la sogs pas bzo rig rig gnas dang por mdzad pa ni cung zad mi 'thad par mngon no/ /de ltar rig gnas lnga las kyang thog mar sgra rig pa la slob dgos te/ brjod bya'i don rtogs pa ni rjod byed kyi tshig la rag las shing / de'i tha snyad rtogs pa yang sgra rig pa la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du yang slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi nus/ /dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs na/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/9 /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na/ don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs pa'i thabs su tha snyad sgra rig pa'i gzhung lugs la legs par slob dgos pa yin no//sgra rig pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ji ltar slob pa'i tshul la yang gnyis te/ sgra rig pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / ji ltar byung ba'i sgra rig pa bshad pa'o/10 /dang po la lnga/ rgyal bas gsungs tshul/ rgyal sras kyis mdzad tshul/ lha yul du byung tshul/ rgya gar du dar tshul/ bod du 'gyur tshul bshad pa'o//dang po ni/ mkhas pa'i dbang po sgra pa shes rin pas rig gnas kun shes las/ gsum pas tshig la 'khrul pa sel ba'i phyir/ /de la log par smra ba tshar gcod byed/ /sgra rig de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ni/ /nges tshig so so yang dag rig pa yi/ /yi ge dbri dang bsnan dang bsgyur ba dang // tshig gi rnam dbye sogs kyi rnam 'gyur ro/ /khyad par rnga bo che yi mdo las ni/ /byings dang ming dang kun bshad nyer bsgyur dang / /kritra dang de phan gyis bsdus sgrub pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab las 'byung gsal bar gsungs/11 /zhes gsungs pas/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs tshul ston pa yin te/ de la spyir nges don par rlom pa rtsing por gzu lums su spyod cing / tha snyad kyi bden pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa dag na re/ sgra rig pa'i gzhung lugs ni/ rig pa'i gnas thun mong ba tsam yin zhing / lhag par phyi rol pa'i drang srong dag gis bshad pa la gtso bor brten pa yin gyi/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rnams las gsal bar mi 'byung zhing / bslab par bya ba'i gnas kyang ma yin no snyam du sems shing / de skad tshig tu yang smra bar byed do//

4 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/'di ni 'thad pa ma yin te/ gal te khyod kyi 'dod pa gzhir bzhag na thun mong ba'i rig gnas dang / lam la slob tu mi rung zhes par song la/ de lta ni khyed rang gi lag len dang dngos su 'gal ba ste/khyed rang yang tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom zhing / de'i nang nas phyi rol pa dang thun mong ba'i chos med par khas len dgos shing / khyad par grub mtha' bye brag smra ba nas bzung ste dbu ma pa'i bar gyi zhi lhag gi nyams len dang / bya rgyud nas bla med kyi bar gyi zhi lhag gi nyams len spyir bshad pa rnams dang /lhag par snying po'i bcud phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i tshe/ lhag mthong gi rten gzhir gyur pa'i zhi gnas shig bsgom mam mi bsgom/ bsgom na ni phyi rol pa dang thun mong ba'i nyams len khyed rang yang byed bzhin par ma song ngam/ leṭa par soms shig gal te de la kho na re/ zhi gnas tsam sgom yang lhag mthong dang byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i khyad par yod do zhe na/ kho bo cag kyang de skad smra ba yin te/sgra rig tsam thun mong yin kyang / lhag bsam byang chub kyi sems dang / gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i gnas dang / thos don snying por dril lugs kyi khyad par shin tu che ba yin no//yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung las mi 'byung snyam pa yang khyed rang thos pa chung ba'i skyon te/ spyir chos dang / don dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / spobs pa so so yang dag pa ste bzhi'i gsum pa nges pa'i tshig 'chad pa'i tshe/ yul ljongs kyi skad dang nges tshig mtha' dag sogs skad rigs spyir slob tshul dang / khyad par so: ta la yi ge dbri ba dang / bsnan pa dang / bsgyur ba dang / tshig thams cad ka lā pa ltar si sogs te sogs dang / tsand+ra pa ltar supu dang ting gi mtha' can khyad par 'bor lo tha ma'i mdor gtogs pa rnga bo che'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung las sangs rgyas rtag pa dang bdag la sogs pa med pas de dag ni phyis 'ga' zhig gis rang bzor byas pa'o zhes smra bar 'gyur yang / de lta min te/ de dag de'i gsung las rgyas par 'byung tshul gsungs shing /12de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la skad kyi byings la sogs pa med pas/ de dag phyis 'ga' zhig gis rang bzor byas so zhes smra bar 'gyur yang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la byings la sogs pa yod par gsungs shing / gzhan yang sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' tshul ston yang /don la thar pa'am myang 'das ni rtag brtan ther zug yin pas skye 'jig med pa'i dpe khang bzang bzhig kyang de'i nam mkha' mi 'jig pa dang / de dper byas na ṇidha zhes bya ba'i skad kyi byings kyi don ni kta zhes bya ba'i rkyen gyis de grub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rkyen du 'gyur te/ ji ltar 'jig rten pa'i bstan

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 5bcos rnams las/ nā mukhyu ta u pa sarga krita tad dhi ta zhes bya ba la sogs pa bsdus pa'i grub pa'i tshig de la grub pa zhes bya'o/ /grub pa'i tshig de'i grub pa gang yin pa de ni yang mi mngon pa med do zhes byings rkyen gyis bsgyur yang / byings kyi rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba ni thar pa'i dper gsung zhing / sgrub tshul de dag ston pa'i gzhung ni/ nā ma zhes pa'i ming le dang / ā khyu ta kun bshad/ kṛta ces pa kṛta kyi le'u ste sgra'i lus gzhung tshan gsum du bsdus shing / de dag gi rnam 'gyur dang nyer mkho ni u pa sarga nye bsgyur dang /tad dhi ta de phan la sogs pa'i gzhung ngo //de yang tetu bstan bcos la ste bkra shis pa'o/ /zhes pa'i byings bzhag de la las la kta'o zhes pas kta'i rkyen sbyin/ byings mtha'i u dang / rkyen gyi ka rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/ gha dzha rte dha bha rnams kyi dha min pa'i ta tha dag la dha'o zhes pas dha ru bsgyur/ byings kyi dang po te'i sa'o zhes pas ṣa sa ru bsgyur/dhu ṭa rnams kyi gsum pa'o zhes pa'i mdos dha yig da ru bsgyur/ ming tshig tu sgrub pa la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i am byin pas/ grub pa zhes pa grub pa la 'jug pa'i grub pa'i tshig go /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i skad kyi byings ni mkhas shing khong du chud pa'o gsungs te/ budha khong du chud pa'i rtogs pa la'o/ zhes pa'i byings las sgrub ces gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang / khyad par sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams su gzungs sngags kyi rigs phal cher zhig legs par sbyar ba dang mtshungs par gsungs pas/legs sbyar ma shes na de dag klog pa dang / 'chad pa'i thabs mi shes pas thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son par 'dod pa'i blo gsal dag gis brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs la 'bad pa chen pos brtson par bya'o zhes snying nas gdams so// gnyis pa rgyas sras kyis mdzad tshul ni/ kun shes las/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gis/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbyangs gsal la brten pa'i/ /yi ge'i bsdu ba mdzad pa'i sgra yi mdo/ /yod par dbyangs 'char mdor bsdus thog mar gsal/13 /zhes gsungs pa ltar/'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs kyis gsungs pa'i sgra mdo yang yod pa yin te/ dus 'khor dbyangs 'char gyi mdor bsdus thog mar/ dbyangs dag gi dang po la a yig yin pa de ni/ a sogs lnga ste/ a i ṛ u '-i zhes rang byung gi bshad pa'o/ /a i u ṇa ṛ '-i ka zhes pa ni so sor bsdu ba gzung phyir ro/ /e o zhes bklag pa las mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ste/ e yig dang o yig dag gi yon tan gyis so/ /ṛ kṛ a ṇa las ri la dag go /zhes pa'i mdo'i phyir/ ṛ '-i dag ni ma ning du mi 'gyur te/ de

6 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gnyis kyang yon tan dang ldan pas e yig la sogs pa rnams dang khyad med do/ /zhes sogs nas de dag kyang nam mkha' la sogs rang bzhin gyi dbang gis grangs bzhin du 'jam dpal gyis/ rang gis brda sprod pa las bris so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//14gsum pa lha yul du byungatshul ni/ kun shes las/ tshangs pa rtag zhi bas byas pa yang yod/ /brgya byin gyis byas ind+ra byā ka ra/ /de la drang srong phur bus legs sbyangs pas/ /shin tu mkhas pa'i nga rgyal mchog tu gyur/ /nga rgyal brgya byin gyis bcom zhum nas ni/ /lha phran blo gsal mang la 'chad 'phro bzhagad dung rang nyid sgra la sbyong bar zhus/ /nyan 'chad gnyis ka gyis zhes bkas bskul bas/ /dus bzang brgyad la gzhan la mi ston par/ /rang nyid bslab pa'i sbyor la brtson pas na/ /nyan po gzhan gyis dus bzang bsrung dgos shar/15 /zhes gsungs te/'di dag gi lo rgyus rgyas par ni spyi don du gsal zhing / sarba dzñā zhes pa'i sgra mkhan cig gis lha'i dbang po la bslabs zhes pa'i sarba dzñā ni tshangs pa'i ming yin la/ 'di dag ni phyi rol pas mchod pa'i lha yin zhing / des bshad pa'i sgra rig rnams kyang phyi rol pa'i lugs yin mod/ gang zag dang bstan bcos de dag ngan par ni mi blta ste/ tshangs pa la sogs pa de dag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul du mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa las gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ mdo de nyid las/ bskal pa bzang po 'di 'das pa'i sngon bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa na/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i cha byad kyis mi 'dul bar/ phyi rol pa'i lha'i gzugs dang rtags dang mtshan mas 'dul bar mkhyen nas/ lha thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs te/ tshangs pa phrag pa nasabyung / dbang phyug dpral ba nas byung / nyi ma spyan g.yas nas byung / zla ba spyan g.yon nas byung / chu lha lto ba nas byung / dbyangs can ma zhal gyi lce rtse las phyung ngo /16 /zhes gsungs pa yin no//

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 7rgya gar yul du sgra dar tshul/bzhi pa rgya gar du dar tshul la gsum ste/ pā ṇi byu ka ra ṇa byung tshul/ tsand+ra byā ka ra ṇa byung tshul/ka lā pa byā ka ra ṇa byung tshul lo//dang po ni/ kun shes las/ de bzhin bram ze pā ṇi ni las kyang / rang ming ldan pa'i bstan bcos chen po sbyar/17 /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bram ze pā ṇi ni byung tshul spyi don du gsal zhing /12 spyir 'phags pa'i yul du grags pa'i sgra mdo ka tsan gnyis su ma 'dus pa dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇa ka lā pa'i mdo shin tu rgyas pa zhig paṇḍi ta rā dza shris ka tsan gnyis kyi don bsdus pa rā dza shri byā ka ra ṇa zhes bya ba dang / rje btsun mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i chos 'byung las/ rgyal po tsanda skyong gi grogs po bram ze ind+ra dhu ba zhes bya bas lha'i dbang po bsgrubs nas sgra'i nges gnas zhus te/ des bshad pa bris pa ind+ra dbang po'i brda sprod pa byā ka ra ṇa zhes grags pa sho lo ka nyis khri lnga stong yod pa 'di la lhas bstan pa'i brda sprod pa zhes zer ro gsung bas/16 ind+ra byā ka ra ṇa'i bshad rgyun yang rgya gar na yod par gsal lo//gnyis pa ni/ kun shes las/ de la tsand+ra go mis bsdus pa yi/ /gzhung la tsand+ra par grags chos 'bangs kyis/ /byas pa'i 'grel pa dang bcas bod du 'gyur/20 /zhes slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa'i tsand+ra pa char gtogs dang bcas pa byung tshul ston pa ste/ de yang lo rgyus yongs grags rnams gni // na gsal zhing / der cung mi gsal ba rje btsun mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i chos 'byung du gsal ba slob dpon tsand+ra go mis ni shar phyogs wa rargyur 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong ba'i paṇḍi ta zhig mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i ston pa zhig dang rtsod par gyur te/ de'i ring lugs sun phyung yang rig pa ni blos rnam par brtags pa yin pas/ gang blo sgrims pa de rgyal bar zad kyis/ skye ba snga phyi yod pa'i rtags mngon sum du med pas/ kho bo cag de mi 'dod zer ba na/ rgyal po la sogs pa dpang por bzhag ste/ nga nyid skye ba len pa yin pas dpral bar rtags thob cig byas nas des dpral bar mtshal gyi thig le sha thim pa zhig byas/ kha nang du mu tig bcug ste/ de nyid du 'das te de'i lus zangs kha sbyar gyi nang du bcug ste rgyal pos rgyas btab bo/ /de'i tshe rgyal rigs kyi paṇḍi bi sha sa kha zhes bya ba'i bur skye ba blangs pa bzhin/ de la khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas ma thag tu/ mtshal gyi thig le dpral bar yod pa kha na mu tig yod pa de byung / rgyal po sogs kyis sngar gyi phung po de la bltas pas/ dpral

8 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ba'i mtshal gyi thig le yang byi/ mu tig gi shul har re 'dug go /der mu stegs de yang skye ba snga phyi yod par yid ches skad/ khye'u des ma la btsas ma thag tu phyag byas te/ zla ba bcu 'o brgyal bar ma gyur tam byas pas/ byis pa btsas ma thag smra ba ni ltas ngan no snyam nas kha rog 'dug byas so/ /de nas lo bdun gyi bar cang ma smras pas lkugs pa'o snyam mo//der mu stegs kyi rgol ba zhig gis/ shin tu go dka' ba'i snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' 'gog pa zhig brtsams nas rgyal po dang mkhas pa'i tshogs la 'grims so//der bi sha sa kha'i khyim du byung ba na/ de yun ring du brtags pas sgra don ji bzhin go ba yang med na lan gdab par ga la nus te/ don de sems shing khyim gyi phyi rol tu bya ba zhig la song ngo / /de tsand+ra go mi lo bdun lon pa des bltas pa na/ don shes shing lan gdab par dka' ba med de/ de'i don 'grol ba'i yig chung btab/ lan gyi tshigs bcad kyang bris so/ /pha nang du 'ong ba na de ltar bris pa mthong nas/khyim du su byung zhes tsand+ra go mi'i ma la dris so/ /gzhan su yang ma 'ongs te bu lkugs pa blta zhing bri'o/ /der phas bu la dris pa na ma'i gdong la blta zhing 'dug go /mas spros shig byas pas/ 'di ni bdag gis bris pa yin te/ rgol ba 'di ldog pa ni dka' ba ma yin no zhes zer/ de nas nang par zhig na tsand+ra go mi dang / mu stegs kyi ston pa de rtsod pas tsand+ra go mi rgyal te bya dga' chen po thob/ /de nas sgra dang rtog ge la sogs pa'i rig gnas thun mong ba thams cad ma bslabs par rang shes shig byung ste/ phyogs thams cad du grags pas khyab bo//de nas theg pa chen po'i slob dpon zhig la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gnas lnga blangs/ slob dpon chen po blo gros brtan pa la mdo sde dang mngon pa'i sde snod nan cher lan cig nyan pa tsam gyis mkhyen/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon mya ngan med pa zhes bya ba la bka' lung nod de rig sngags bsgrubs pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang / sgrol ma'i zhal mngon sum gzigs/ shin tu mkhas pa chen por gyur/ de nas shar phyogs su rgyal po bha ra ṣa yul du sman dpyad dang sdeb sbyor dang bzo'i gnas kyi ston pa mang du byas/ khyad par du sgra rig pa mang du bshad cing yod/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i bu mo ta rā zhes bya ba bag mar blangs shing rgyal pos yul 'khor zhig kyang sbyin/ lan cig de'i g.yog mos ta rā zhes 'bod kyi 'dug pas/ yi dam dang mtshan mthun pa khyim thab tu mi rung ngo snyam nas/ slob dpon nyid yul gzhan du 'gro ba rgyal pos shes te/ de nga'i bu mo dang lhan cig mi 'dug na sgrom du chug la gaṅgā

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 9la skyur cig ces bsgos te de bzhin du byas pa na/ slob dpon gyis sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkha' dang rgya mtsho phrad mtshams kyi gling zhig la thon/ gling de 'phags mas sprul pa yin yang zer te/tsand+ra dī pa zhes bya ba tsand+ra go mi nyid der bzhugs pa la ming chags shing da lta yang yod/ grong bdun stong tsam shong ba zhig 'dug zer/ der slob dpon gyis bzhugs te 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma'i rdo sku bzhengs/ thog mar nya pa rnams kyis gtam de thos/ de nas rim gyis skye bo gzhan yang byung ste grong khyer chags/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bskul bas go mis dge bsnyen mdzad/ mtshan de ltar grags/de nas tshong pa rnams kyis khyer te siṅga'i gling du byon/ yul de na klu nad mang du 'byung ba zhig yod pa las der seng ge sgra'i lha khang bzhengs pas rang zhi/ sman dpyad dang rig gnas rgya cher spel/ gling phran gyi skye bo/ rnams la phan btags/ theg chen ci rigs bshad/ yul bdag gnod sbyin las nor blangs te chos mang du btsugs/ slar 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho phyogs kyi brgyud du byon/ bram ze mchog srid kyi lha khang na/ klu la sgra nyan pa'i bkod pa dang / klu she ṣas byas pa'i pā ṇi pa'i 'grel pa 'dug pa yang gzigs pas/ 'grel pa zhes bya ba tshig nyung la don mang ba/ ma zlos pa tshang ba zhig dgos pa yin pa las/ klu ni rab tu rmongs te tshig mang ba/ don nyung ba/ zlos pa ma rdzogs pa'o/ /zhes smad nas pā ṇi'i don 'grel du tsand+ra bya ka ra ṇa yan lag brgyad dang bcas pa bcas mdzad/ gzhung der nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag rdzogs/ /zhes pa yang klu la zur za ba'o/ /de nas rig pa'i 'byung gnas na lend+rar byon/ de nas zla grags dang rtsod pa mdzad pa'i tshul rnams phal cher spyi don bzhin la/ tsand+ra go mis thogs med kyi srol la brten te rnam rig gi
