phyogs bzung / zla grags kyis klu sgrub kyi gzhung sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs kyis bkral ba la brten te ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyogs bzung / lo gsum gyi bar du bgro gleng gi brgal brtag mdzad do/ /rtsod pa de blta ba'i phyir skye bo mang po rtag tu 'dus pas/ grong pa'i khye'u dang bu mo tshun chad kyis kyang phyogs tsam rig nas/ kye ma 'phags pa klu sgrub gzhung / /la la'i sman la la la'i dug /mi pham 'phags pa thogs med gzhung / /skye bo kun gyi bdud rtsi nyid/22 /ces glur len no//de nas na naland+rar bzhugs nas/ bzo gnas brgya rtsa/ sgra/ rtog ge sman dpyad/ sdeb sbyor/zlos gar/ mngon brjod/ snyan ngag skar rtsis la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mang du brtsams/ slob ma rnams la de rnams gtso bor bshad pa'i tshe/ 'phags ma sgrol mas/ sa bcu pa dang zla ba sgron me dang //

10 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/sdong po rgyan pa dang ni laṅka 'jug /rgyal ba rnams kyi yul gyur klogs shig kye/ /sdeb sbyor ngan g.yo'i sbyor bas khyed la ci/23 /zhes gsungs pas phyi rol gyi rig pa'i gnas rnams nyung ngur bstan cing /rmad du byung ba'i mdo lnga po de dag dus rtag tu gsungs/ bdag nyid kyang nyin rer zhal 'don mdzad/ mdo de rnams la bsdus don re yang mdzad/ spyir snga phyir mdzad pa la bstod pa brgya dang brgyad/ nang rig pa'i bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad phyi rol gyi bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad bzo gnas brgya dang brgyad de phra mo thor bu ba bzhi brgya dang sum cu rtsa gnyis brtsams zer/ pra ti ma ta mi zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos byang chub sems dpa'i lam rim mtha' dag ston pa zhig kyang mdzad de ches ma dar/ 'gro lding dang siṅga'i gling na de 'chad pa'i srol da lta'ang 'dug gsung / sdom pa nyi shu pa dang zla ba sgron me'i 'grel pa dang / sku gsum la 'jug pa ni/ theg chen gyi paṇḍi ta phyis byon pa thams cad kyis slob par byed pa byung ngo / /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa zhes slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa bod du 'gyur bar snang ngo / /khyad par tsand+ra pa'i mdo le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ sho lo ka bdun brgya yod pa pā ṇi dang mthun pa nyung ngu rnam gsal/ de'i yan lag tu yi ge'i mdo dang / u ṇa de'i mdo dang / ting supa kyi 'grel pa/ nye bsgyur gyi 'grel pa rnams mdzad/ ride ltar sems can gyi don yun du mdzad nas/ mthar po tā lar gshegs par bzhed de/ 'dzam bu'i gling nas dha na shri'i gling du byon pa na/ sngon klu she ṣa la smad pas 'khon du bzung nas rgya mtsho'i rlabs chen pos gru gzings gzhig par brtsams/ rgya mtsho'i dbus nas sgra byung nas tsand+ra go mi phyir phyung zhig zer/sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ 'phags ma gtso 'khor lnga nam mkha' lding la chibs pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon nas klu rnams 'jigs shing skrag nas bros/ gru dha na shrīr bde bar slebs/ der dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten la mchod cing / sgrol ma'i lha khang brgya rtsa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang brgya rtsa bzhengs/ ri bo po ta lar gshegs nas da lta yang lus ma spangs par bzhugs yod/ slob ma la springs pa'i 'phrin yig ni/ rgyal po'i bu rin chen grags pa zhes bya ba rab tu byung ba phab pa zhig la po ta la nas tshong pa rnams las bskur bas/ de yang slob springs mthong nas chos bzhin spyod par gyur to zhes grags so/24 /zhes 'byung / tsand+ra pa'i yan lag tu 'grel bshad sogs don 'grel ji ltar byung ba ni spyi don bzhin no//gsum pa (ka lā pa byā ka ra ṇa byung tshul )ni/ kun shes las/ dbang phyug go chas gzhon nu gdong drug

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 11brjo/bas/ /sdi/ba nas tshar gcig bstan pas tshig stordon chenags/ /cha bsags ka lā pa yi mastordo zhes bya/ /rang sde'i mkhas pa bgrod dka' seng ge yis/ /sbyar ba'i 'grel pa dur sing zhes bya dang / /gzhan sde jo bo grags 'byor gyis sbyar ba'i/ /slob phan zhes pa'i 'grel pa bod du byon/25 /zhes gsungs pa ste/lo rgyus rags rim spyi don ltar dang /26 der mi gsal ba'i lo rgyus ngo bo mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i chos 'byung dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyi grogs po slob dpon bram ze mchog sred ces bya ba dang /rgyal po bde byed kyi mdun na 'don du gnas so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i btsun mo tha chung zhig gi sgra'i gnas cung zad shes la rgyal pos ni mi shes so/ /skyed mos tshal du chu la rtse ba'i tshe/ rgyal pos de la chu gtor bas/ des ma mo da ka piñtsa zhes bod skad du bdag la chu ma 'thor zhes pa'o/ rgyal pos lho phyogs kyi yul skad dang sbyar pas/ bal sran gyi 'a9rgyar ba til mar gyis bcesas pa byin cig ces par bo/ nas de byin pas/ btsun mo des rgyal po ba lang lta bu dang lhan cig tu gnas pa las shi ba sla'o snyam nas/ lceb par brtsams pa las/ rgyal pos bzung nas sgra slob par byas te/ bram ze mchog sred la legs par bslabs so/ /'on kyang cung zad ma rdzogs pa las slob dpon sapta warma las blangs pa yin no//de la slob dpon mchog sred kyi lo rgyus ni/27 sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mngon par dad pa'i bram ze las drug la brtson pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub naland+ra'i mkhan po mdzad pa'i tshe mdza' bshes su gyur pa zhig ma ga dha'i shar phyogs ra ra'i yul na yod pa las/ des lo bcu gnyis su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sngags bzlas shing / mthar gser 'bum phrag bzhi'i yo byad sbyin sreg tu phul bas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal mngon sum du bstan nas/ khyod ci 'dod gsung ba la/ bdag grub pa chen po brgyad kyis sems can gyi don bya bar 'dod pas nag po chen po mngag gzhug tu 'tshal zhus pas de bzhin du gnang nas/ deng phyin chad du rig sngags thams cad ji ltar 'angesad pa bzhin du sdi/ba cing /ri lu la sogs pa grub pa brgyad po stong phrag res sems can rnams la phan btags so/ /grub pa thob pa stong phrag brgyad po de dag kyang khong la bla mar 'dzin/ rig pa mtha' dag kyang ma bslabs par rang shes so//de nas nub phyogs kyi yul du song nas rgyal po sandi wa ha na zhes bya ba longs spyod chen po dang ldan pa'i yul du gnas so/ /der yang sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor bas sems can la phan 'dogs shing gnas pa las/ wā rā ṇa sir 'ongs pa'i tshe/ bar skabs der byung ba'i rgyal po bi ma shu la zhes bya ba'i yul du'ang

12 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/sems can gyi don rgya chen po byas te/ skabs der ka lī dā sa'i lo rgyus sbyar/ de nas lho phyogs su phyin/rgyal po bde byed sgra slob par 'dod pa la/ sgra pā ṇi yongs su rdzogs par shes pa'i slob dpon ma rnyed nas/klu'i rgyal po she ṣa zhes bya ba pā ṇi pa yongs su rdzogs pa shes pa zhig yod par shes nas/ bram ze mchog sred kyi rig sngags kyi mthus bkug nas :rdzo ka 'bum gyi pā ṇi pa'i don thams cad rgya cher 'grel nus par 'chad par byas shing / slob dpon gyis yi ger 'bri ba las/ de gnyis kyi bar du yol bas chod par byas so/ /shlau ka stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga song ba na/ de'i lus ni ci 'dra snyam slob dpon gyis yol ba btegs nas bltas pas/ sprul chen po 'gying ba mthong / klu yang ngo tsha na bros so/ /de man chad du slob dpon nyid kyis 'grel pa byas te/ de la ni tshigs su bcad pa stong phrag bcu gnyis kyi tshad las med do/ /de gnyis bsdoms pa la klus bstan pa'i brda sprod pa zhes grags/ der sgra la sogs pa'i rig pa'i gnas rnams kyang mang du bstan/ mthar nag po chen pos phrag pa la thogs te/ ri rab kyi rtse mo yongs 'du sa brtol gyi gnas su gshegs so/ /zhes grags so/ /der rgyal po bde byed slob dpon mchog sred kyis byas pa'i 'grel pa la yid ma ches par/ bram ze sapta warma gzhon nu gdong drug bsgrub tu bcug go /grub nas khyod ci 'dod zer ba la/ ind+ra byā ka re ṇa shes par 'tshal lo byas pas/ sirnyo waṇis ma nā ya/ zhes brjod pa tsam gyis sgra'i don mtha' dag shes so//sngar bod du grags pa'i lo rjes ltar na/ ka lā pa'i kun bshad bzhi pa yan chad gzhon nu gdong drug gis bshad cing / ka lā pa zhes pa cha bsags kyi don rma bya'i mjug sgro kha dog sna tshogs pa bsags pa'i don du 'chad mod/ 'dir ni de ltar ma grags te/ ka lā pa ni sapta warma nyid kyis brtsams la cha bsags kyi don ni nye bar mkho ba'i cha shas mtha' dag bsags pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /de bzhin du slob dpon 'di'i ming la dbang phyug go cha zhes bya ba yin cing / sarba warma zhes pa yang yig nor brgyud pa ste/ sapta warma bdun pa'i go cha yin no//kā li da sa'i lo rgyus ni/28 lha rā ṇa si'i rgyal po bi ma shukla'i mchod gnas su bram ze mchog sred yod pa'i che/ rgyal po'i bu mo dpyid ldan ma zhes bya ba bram ze mchog sred la sbyin par byas pa las/dpyid ldan ma nga rgyal gyis dregs pas mchog sred las kho mo mkhas pa'i phyir g.yog mo mi byed do zhes byas so/ /der mchog sred kyis 'di rdzun gyis bslu bar bya'o snyam nas/ 'o na bdag gi slob dpon mkhas pa/ bdag las blo gros brgya 'gyur gyis che ba zhig yod pas de spyan drangs la/ de la rgyal pos dpyid

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 13ldan ma stsol cig ces byas nas/ ma ga dha'i gnag rdzi gzugs bzang ba zhig shing gi yal ga'i rtse mo la gnas te/ yal ga'i rtsa ba la ste'u bsnun par byed par mthong nas/ shin tu blun par shes te/ de bos nas zhag 'gar khrus dang bku mnye phun sum tshogs par byas/ bram ze parji ta'i cha byad du bcos/ oṃ swasti zhes bya ba gcig pu bslabs te/ rgyal po skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas bzhugs pa'i dbus su/ rgyal po la me tog gtor te/ oṃ swasti zhes bya ba 'di brjod cig gzhan su zhig gis dris kyang lan 'debs par ma byed cig ces bsgos te de ltar byed rgyu la/ de ngag btab ste rgyal po la me tog gtor nas/ u sha ra ṭa zhes zer ro/ /der slob dpon gyis yi ge bzhi po de dag gi don bkrol te/ u ma ya sa hi to ru hra/ shaṅka ra sa ni twa bi ṣṭa ṭam ka ra shā la pā ṇiñtsa/ rakṣarsāshi ba sarba ta zhes pa'i don te/ shis pa brjod pa yin zhes kha bsgyur ro/dku/tshig de bod skad du bsgyur na/ u ma dang bcas drag po dang / bde byed dang bcas 'jug sel te/ṭaṃ tshul phyag na mdung thung yang / zhi bas rtag tu bsrung bar mdzod/ ces so/ /de nas dpyid ldan mas sgra'i don la sogs pa dris kyang cang mi smra la/ mchog sred kyis bdag gi slob dpon mkhas pa 'di bud med kyis dris pa la lan ci la 'debs/ zhes rmongs par byas nas/ bram ze mchog sred lho phyogs su bros so//de nas lha khang rnams su khrid kyang cang mi smra'o/ /mthar lha khang gi phyi khyams su srog chags sna tshogs pa'i gzugs bris pa la/ ba lang gi gzugs brnyan mthong ba dang dga' ste/ phyugs skyong pa'i rnam 'gyur byed do/ /de nas kye ma ho 'di ni ba lang rdzi'o zhes te bslus par shes so/ /blo dang ldan na sgra bslab par bya'o zhes brtags pas skye bo shin tu blo rtul bar byung ste/ dpyid ldan mas kyang sdang por byas shing /nyin re bzhin me tog 'thu ru btang ngo / /ma ga dha'i phyogs gcig na lha mo nag mo'i sku lha'i bzo bos byas pa zhig yod de/ nyin re bzhin de la me tog mang du phul nas phyag btsal te gus pas gsol ba btab pas dus nam zhig na/ dpyid ldan ma lha la mchod pa'i dus shig la/ des tho rangs me tog 'thu ru song ba'i tshe dpyid ldan ma'i g.yog mo zhig kyal ga'i don du go la mur bzhin du lha mo nag mo'i rten gyi rgyab tu yib cing 'dug go /phyugs rdzi des sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ g.yog mo des go la mur 'phro lag tu gtad pas/ 'di ni lha mos dngos grub tu gnang ba yin no snyam du sems shing yid ches so/ /de nyid blo gros thogs pa med pas rtog ge dang / brda sprod pa dang / snyan ngag smra ba chen por gyur te/ lag pa g.yas su padma'i me tog dang / g.yon du utpal zhig thogs te/ padma ni me tog bzang yang yu ba rtsub/utpal ni me tog chung yang yu ba 'jam pas gang zhig 'dod/ ces pa'i don la/ bdag gi lag pa g.yas na

14 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/padma dang / /g.yon na de bzhin utpala'i me tog /'jam pa'i yu ba'am rtsub pa'i yu ba can/ /gang 'dod long zhig padma'i mig can ma/ /zhes brjod pas mkhas par song ba shes te bkur sti chen po byas/ des lha mo nag mo la shin tu gus par byas pas/ kā li da sa ste nag mo'i 'bangs sam nag mo'i khol por grags/ dus de tsam na snyan ngag mkhan mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bur gyur/ sprin gyi pho nya la sogs pa pho nya brgyad dang / gzhon nu 'byung ba la sogs pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos che ba yang mang du brtsams/'di dang sabha warma gnyis ka grub mtha' ni phyi rol pa zhig go /zhes 'byung ngo //29bod du 'gyur tshul bshad pa las/thu mi sastoṭa'i dus su brda sprod pa'i dbu brnyes tshul/lnga pa bod du 'gyur tshul bshad pa la gsum ste/ thu mi sam bho ṭa'i dus su brda sprod pa'i dbu brnyes tshul/ ska cog dang rin chen bzang pos srol btod tshul/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa dang / shong dpang yab sras kyi skabs su dar zhing rgyas tshul bshad pa'o//dang po ni/ rje btsun sprul pa'i lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po'i gsung las/ bod yul dbus kyi rgyal po mchog /gnam ri srong btsan yan chad la/ /bod la yi ge med ces grags/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /mkhan po thu mi sam bho ṭas/ /latsā'i yi ge dper mdzad nas/ /dbyangs yig i u e tse( bzhi/ /gsal byed ka sogs sum cu mdzad/ /de las rjes su 'jug pa bcu/ /de las kyang ni sngon 'jug lnga/ /ra la sa yi mgo gsum dang / /ya ra la yi smad 'dogs gsum/ /da dang sa yi yang 'jug sogs/ /ston pa'i bstan bcos rnam brgyad mdzad/ /bka' srol de nyid la brten nas/ /lo paṇa skyes mchog du ma yis/ /rgya gar rgya nag kha che dang / /li dang bal po'i yul sogs nas/ /thub pa'i gsung rab sna tshogs bsgyur/ /brda yang mi 'dra sna tshogs bsgyur/30 /ces gsungs pa ltar/bod yul mun pa'i gling 'dir brjod pa sna tshogs kyi skad gdangs yod kyang / rjod byed kyi yi ge med pas/ gsung rab dang / lugs brgya'i gtsug lag bzang po'i srol lam med pa ni/ dper na skyes bu blo dang ldan yang smra ba'i lce med pa dang tshul mtshungs par gyur pa'i tshe/ de dag thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung bar bzhed nas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid mi'i gzugs kyi rnam par rol pa mkhan po thu mi sam bho ṭa zhes bya ba chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su byung bar gyur te/ de yang thu mi a nu'i

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 15bu thu mi sam bho ṭa zhes bya ba rgya gar du brdzangs/ paṇḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge dang / yig mkhan bram ze li byin la sogs pa la yi ge dang brda sprod pa'i tshul legs par bslabs/ mkhas par mkhyen/ bod du byon nas/ lha sa'i pho brang dgu mkhar mar bod la nye bar mkho ba'i gzugs 'cho bar mdzad de/ de yang rgya gar gyi gyi phyi mo lnga bcu las/ bod du phyi mo sum cur byas/ dbyangs bcu drug las i u e o bzhi rnams dbyangs su mdzad/ a gsal byed du bsdus/ gsal byed las kyang ṭa'i sde pa dor/ sde pa gzhan bzhi'i yang / bzhi pa rnams dang ṣa rnams mi dgos par gzigs nas bzhag tsa tsha dza rnams rgya gar shar phyogs pa 'ga' zhig ca cha ja zhes te de gsum bkod/ rgya gar la med kyang bod la zha za 'a rnams dgos par dgongs te btsud/ de dag la nye bar mkho ba'i yan lag tu brda sprod pa'i gzhung tshan pa brgyad tsam mdzad par grags na'ang / bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis phal cher nub nas mi snang la/ sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis ni deng sang du yang mkhas pa dpyod ldan thams cad kyis tshad grub tu mdzad cing / rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs ltar rtogs dka' zhing / rtogs na gzhung don phun sum tshogs la gsung rab spyi la 'jug na yang gsal byed kyi mig lta bur gyur pa zhig ste/ de yang gzhung 'di nyid kyi yi ge'i rnam gzhag dang 'jug tshul sogs bod kyi skad gsung rab dang sbyor tshul rang tshugs thub par bshad cing / brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs chen po rnams dang sbyar na/ sum cu pa las ka lā pa'i ming le dang bshad tshul mtshungs shing / rtags 'jug gi kun bshad kyi brjod don 'brel ba yin no//de ltar bstan bcos dang yi ge de dag rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos kyang slob tshul yun ring du bstan/ thu mis thog mar mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa dang / mdo sde dkon mchog sprin sogs bsgyur/gzhan yang bod kyi slob dpon dharma ko sha sogs blo gsal mang po la bshad pas/ bstan pa rin po che'i srol legs par tshugs/ rab byung gi gra med kyang rgyal pos spyan ras gzigs kyi chos skor mang du gsungs shing / de dag gi sgom gra legs par btsugs pas/ thar pa bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob pa yang mang du byung ba yin no//de ltar bstan bcos 'di nyid dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos phyis su byung ba yang /bdag nyid chen po bsod nams rtse mo'i byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇḍi tas de'i 'grel pa dang / sgra'i bstan bcos mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ dbus pa blo gsal gyi sum rtags kyi 'grel pa/ sgra pa saṅga shrī'i sum cu pa'i 'grel pa/ yar 'brog pa rin chen tog gi rtags 'jug gi 'grel pa/ paṇa

16 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/chen shākya mchog ldan gyi sum rtags kyi don 'grel pa chos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ kun mkhyen go ram 'byams pa'i rtags kyi 'jug pa'i ṭī ga snyigs dus kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag gi mig zha lu lo tsā ba chen po'i sum rtags kyi 'grel pa/ garma pa'i sum rtags kyi 'grel pa/ don 'grel yi ge'i brda dag ston pa la lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis nyer mkho bsdus pa/ dbus pa blo gsal gyi phrad kyi gnad bsdus pa'i 'grel chung /snye thang pa grags bzang gi gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ gtsang nag sbug pa thugs rje seng ge'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ stag tshang gzhon nu dpal gyi 'od zer brgya pa/ bu ston seng ge 'od kyi sgra don rgya mtsho'i me long / rje byams pa gling pa'i smra ba'i rgyan/ bsam sdings pa kun bzang gi 'khrul pa spong ba/ rje btsun zha lu lo chen gyi za ma tog bkod pa/ dpal khang lotsā ba'i ngag gi sgron ma/ thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtshos slob ma la phan pa la sogs pa mang du yod pa yin no//ska cog dang rin chen bzang pos srol btod tshul/gnyis pa ska cog dang rin chen bzang pos srol btod tshul ni/ zha lu lo chen gyis/ chos rgyal ral pa can gyi dus/ /ska cog zhang gsum mkhas mang gis/ /rgyal po'i bkas bskul gsar bcad kyi//skad kyis brda sbyar gtan la phab/ /slad nas rin chen bzang po dang / /blo ldan shes rab la sogs pa//mkhas mchog rnams kyi de la brten/31 /zhes gsungs pa ltar/bar skabs su lo tsā ba chen po ska cog zhang gsum dang / rin chen bzang po/ blo ldan shes rab la sogs pa rnams kyis tshul 'di'i srol ches cher btod bar mdzad pa yin te/ de yang rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi dus su rgyal blon rnams kyi bkas bskul te/ sngon lha sras yab kyi ring la mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ye shes dbang po/ zhang rgyal nyen nyi bzang / blon po khri sher sang shrī/ lo tsā ba dzñā de wa ko ga lce khyi 'brugabram ze a nanta la sogs pas 'gyur mdzad pa rnams la chos kyi skad bod la ma grags pa mang dag cig byung zhing / rgya dkar nag dang / li dang / za hor la sogs pa yul sna tshogs nas bsgyur bas yul de dag gi brda mi 'dra ba mang pos chos slob dka' bar gzigs nas nyi 'og gi mkhas pa ā tsarya dzi na mi tra dang /su rend+ra bo dhi dang / shī lenda bo dhi dang / dwa na shī la dang / bod kyi mkhan po ratna rakṣi ta dang / sto shrī la dang / lo tsā ba mkhas par tshud pa ska ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ dzñā na se na ste zhang ye shes sde dang / dza ya rakṣi ta dang / mañdzu shrī warma dang / ra nant+ra shī la la sogs pas theg pa che chung las byung

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 17ba'i chos rgya gar skad las bod kyi skad du bsgyur zhing / ming du btags pa rnams dkar chag tu bris nas nam du yang gzhung lugs de ga las mi bsgyur zhing / kun gyis slob tu rung bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal pa la brten nas/ sngar bsgyur ba rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ bkas bcad rnam pa gsum mdzad de/ skad dod so so dang bsgyur tshul yig char bkod/ sde pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba las gzhan dang / gsang sngags rnams rgyal blon lo paṇa dang bcas pa mthun grub na ma gtogs/ lkog tu mi bsgyur bar bkas bcad/ tha na bre dang srang zho la sogs pa yang rgya gar dang mthun par bcos/ de thams cad lo paṇa rgyal blon dang bcas pa'i phyag rgyas btab/ dkar chag tu bkod de/ bod 'bangs thams cad la de dag las mi 'da' bar dril bsgrags pa yin no//ji skad du yang sgra sbyor bam gnyis las/ rta'i lo la btsan po khri lde srong btsan pho brang 'on cang rdo na bzhugs/ stod smad kyi dmag rje dang rkun chen btul/ gar log gi pho nyas phyag btsal/ blon chen zhang khri zur ram shags dang / blon ma rje lha mdo 32la sogs pas bya 33las gnang mang po bcad de/ rnga rta dang ba mar phal mo che phyag tu phul/ zhang blon man chad so sor bya dga' stsal ba'i lan la/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsarya dzi na mi tra dang / su rend+ra bo dhi dang / shī lend+ra bo dhi dang / dwa na shī la dang / bo dhi mi tra dang / bod kyi mkhan po ratna rakṣi ta dang / dharma tā shī la dang / lo tsā ba mkhas par tshud pa dzñā na se na dang /dza ya rakṣi ta dang / mañdza shri warma dang / rasnes shī la la sogs pas theg pa che chung gi chos las byung ba'i rgya gar gyi skad las bod kyi skad du bsgyur zhing ming du btags pa rnams dkar chag tu bris te/ nam du yang gzhung lugs de las mi 'gyur zhing 34kun gyis slob tu rung bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal nas/ sngon lha sras yab kyi ring la ā tsarya bo dhi satwa dang / ye shes dbang po dang / zhang rgyal nyen nyi bzang dang / blon po khri sher sang shī dang / lo tsā ba dzñā na de ba ko ṣa dang / lce khyi 'brug dang / bram ze ā nanta la sogs pas chos kyi skad bod la ma grags pa las/ ming du btags pa dag cig mchis pa'i nang nas/ kha cig chos kyi gzhung dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi mthun te/ mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams kyang bcos/ skad kyi ming gces so 'tshal gyis kyang bsnan nas theg pa che chung gi gzhung las ji skad 'byung ba dang / gna'i mkhan po chen po nā gā rdzu na dang / bha su bantu la sogs pas ji ltar bshad pa dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs las ji skad du/ 'dren pa dang yang bstun te mjal dka' ba rnams kyang tshig so sor bkral nas gtan tshigs kyis bshad de gzhung du bris/ skad rkyang pa bshad mi 'tshal ba sgra ji bzhin du bsgyur bar rigs pa

18 bde dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/rnams kyang sgra btsan par bgyis te ming du btags/ skad kha cig don bzhin du gdags pa'i rigs pa rnams kyang don btsan par bgyis te ming du btags te/ btsan po'i spyan sngar bande chen po dpal gyi yon tan dang /bande chen po ting nge 'dzin sogs pa'ang 'tshogs te/ rje blon gdan 'dzoms pa la zhus nas dharma bsgyur ba'i thabs dang / rgya gar gyi skad las bod gyi skad du ming gdags pa'i rnam gzhag bkas bcad de gtan la phab/dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i lugs ni sgra dang mthun la/ don dang yang mi 'gal la/ bod skad las kyang gar bde bar gyis shig dharma bsgyur ba la rgya gar gyi skad go rim las mi nor bar bod kyi skad du bsgyur na don dang tshig tu 'brel zhing / bde na ma bsnor bar sgyur zhig bsgor na bde zhing go ba bskyed pa zhig yod na/ tshigs bcad la ni rtsa ba bzhi pa'am drug pa'ang rung ste/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi nang gar bde bar bsnor zhing sgyur cig rkyang pa la ni don gang snyegs pa yan chad kyi tshig dang don gnyis ka la gar bde bar bsgor zhing sgyur cig skad cig la ming du ma 'dren pa ste/ ltag 'og dang bstun la gar snyegs pa bzhin du ming thogs shig go ta ma lta bu go'i sgra las/ tshig dang / phyogs dang / sa dang /'od dang / rdo rje dang / ba lang dang / mtho ris la sogs pa rnam pa du mar snyegs pa dang / ko'u shi ka lta bu rtswa ku sha thogs pa dang / mkhas pa dang / pad ma la dga' ba dang / 'ug pa dang / mdzod ldan la sogs pa sgra'i lugs las drangs shing bsgyur na/ rnam grangs mang po zhig tu snyegs la/ bsgyur ba rnams gcig gi nang du ni/ rnam grangs de kun 'dur yang mi btub ste/ gcig tu chad par bya gtan tshigs chen po med pa rnams ni mi bsgyur bar/ rgya gar gyi skad so na zhog cig gar yang drang du rung ba'i tshig byung na/ phyogs gcig tu 'chad par mi bsgyur bar/ spyir snyegs su rung bar gyis shig yul dang sems can dang / me tog dang rtsi shing la sogs pa'i ming bsgyur ba mi go zhing tshig mi bde ba dang / 'ol cir bsgyur du rung yang don du de ltar yin nam min gtol med pa rnams ni 'go la yul zhes sam/ me tog ces bya ba gang la bya ba'i ming zhig bla thabs su bsnon la/ rgya gar gyi skad so na zhog cigagrangs la rgya gar gyi skad bzhin du bsgyur na/ dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum zhes 'byung ba la sogs pa ni/ stong nyis brgya lnga bcu zhes tha mal par bod kyi lugs bzhin du bsgyur na don dang yang mi 'gal la/ bod kyi skad la yang bde bas grangs bsdom du rung ba rnams bod kyi lugs bzhin du thogs shig pa ri dang / sam dang / u pa lta bu la sogs pa tshig gi phrad dang rgyan lta bur 'byung ba

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 19rnams bsgyur na/ don dang mthun zhing 'byor ba'i thabs ni/ yongs su zhe'am/ yang dag pa zhe'am/ nye ba zhes sgra ji bzhin du sgyur cig don lhag par snyegs pa med pa rnams ni tshig gi lhad kyis bsnan mi dgos kyi don bzhin du thogs shig rnam grangs su gtogs pa'i tshig rnams ni ma 'doms na ming gang / bod skad du phyir gdags 35shing tshig tu gang bde bar gdags so/ /'doms na so sor btags pa bzhin du thogs shig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos la sogs pa la zhes dang / ko long gi tshig gi rim pa ni/ sangs rgyas la zhe sa'i tshig tu bsgyur/ gzhan ma tshig 'bring po yan 36chad tsam du bya ste/ sngon lha sras yab kyi spyan sngar mkhan po dang lo tsā ba mkhas pa tshogs pas/ dharma dkon mchog sprin dang /'phags pa laṅkar gshegs pa bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'i lugs bzhin du sgyur cigaskad kyi lugs 'di ltar bkas bcad pa las so sor nas su yang 'chos shing 'og tu ming gsar du 'dogs su mi gnang gi /bsgyur ba dang 'chad pa'i grwa so so nas skad gsar du ming gdags dgos pa zhig na/ so so'i grwa grwar ming chad pa ma gdags par/ chos kyi gzhung dang sgra'i lugs las ji ltar 'byung ba'i gtan tshigs dang / chos la ji skad du gdags pa spyod de/37 pho brang du bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs kyi 'dun sa dang / dharma zhu chen 'tshal ba'i grwar phul la snyan du zhus te bkas bcad nas skad kyi dkar chag gi dkyus su bsnon/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud rnams gzhung gis gsang bar bya ba yin te/ snod du ma gyur pa rnams la bshad cing bstan du yang mi rung la/ bar du bsgyur zhing spyod du gnang gis kyang / ldem po'i dag tu bshad pa ma khrol nas sgra ji bzhin du 'dzin cing log par spyod pa dag kyang 'byung / sngags kyi rgyud kyi nang nas thu zhing bod skad du bsgyur ba dag kyang 'byung zhes gdags kyi/ phyin chad gzungs sngags dang / rgyud bla nas bka' stsal te bsgyur du bcug pa ma gtogs pa sngags kyi rgyud dang / sngags kyi tshig thu zhing bsgyur du mi snang ngo //38zhes gsungs pa ltar de ltar sngar dar gyi skabs su sgra'i yig cha byung ba ni/ lo tsā ba lce khyi 'brug gis sgra'i gnas brgyad pa rtsa 'grel/ lo tsā ba spyis thun mong du bye brag rtogs byed che 'bring chung gsum sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa sogs so/ /de dag gi rjes su zhugs nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su lo tsā ba rnams kyi mchog rin chen bzang po dang / blo ldan shes rab la sogs pas kyang gtso bor lo tsā ba rnams kyi brda chad las ma g.yos shing / cung zad bcos pa gnyi zla la nyi zla dang / bstan chos la bstan bcos dang / stug po la mthug po la sogs pa yod do/ /de ltar brda gsar rnying gi bye brag rnam par 'byed tshul

20 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/yang / dbus pa blo gsal gyi bstan bcos thor bu kha re dang / paṇa chen shāka mchog gi brda'i bye brag rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos/ smin drug lo tsā ba'i legs par bshad pa li shi'i gur khang la sogs pa rnams la rtog par bya'o//bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa dang / shong dpang yab sras kyi skabs su dar zhing rgyas tshul bshad pa/rtsa ba'i gsum pa bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa dang / shong ston yab sras kyi skabs su dar zhing rgyas tshul bshad pa ni/ kun shes las/ snga ma'i byings mdo yi ge'i mdo 'grel bcas/ /phyi ma'i byings mdoyaṇa 'grel par bcas/ /byings dang kun bshad dpung gnyen si sogs kyi/ /bya ba rgyas pa la sogs mang po dang / /snga ma'i supu mtha' rin chen 'byung ldan sogs/ /sgra yi yan lag sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung / /snyan ngag me long mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod/ /kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar la sogs pa//shong dpang yab sras rnams kyis bsgyur zhing bshad/ /sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod dang //zlos gar rnams la rig gnas chung ngu 'am/ /tha snyad rig pa'i gnas lngar grags pa rnams/ /chos rje sa paṇa yan la ma dar zhing / /thar loyan la sgra mdo 'gyur ba med/ /sgra rig brjod bya spros te bshad na ni/39/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//'di dag gi don legs par 'grel ba la sa bcad rnam pa gsum ste/ dang por bka' drin che ba bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa byon tshul/ bar du bka' drin che ba shong dpang yab sras byon tshul/ mthar bka' drin che ba zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po byon tshul bshad pa'o//dang por bka' drin che ba bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa byon tshul/dang po ni/ skye ba du mar sbyangs pa dang / /mkhas pa du ma bsten pa dang / /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ /shes bya kun la 'jigs med thob/40 /ces rang nyid kyi zhal gyis bzhes shing mkhas pa thams cad kyi tshad mar gyur pa/ bod du rig gnas rnam pa bcu'i srol gang zag gcig nyid kyi dang por phye ba ni bdag nyid chen po sa paṇḍi ta kho na ste/ de yang / yab dpal chen 'od po dang / yum nyi khri lcam gyi sras su 'khrungs pa nas bzung ste/ rnam thar rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes shing / 'dir rig gnas kyi tshul

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 21legs par gsan pa'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ gog mkhyen tsam gyi dus skye ba snga ma'i bag chags sad pa'i stobs kyis so: ta'i skad du ma smra ba byung bas/ yum na re/ 'di la rang ga gcig pa yong ba lags sam/ gtam go rgyu med pa'i ngag ngog mang po zer ba zhig gda' zhus pas/ rje bas so: ta'i skad mkhyen pas/ khyod kyi bu la gang yang byung dogs med gsungs/ yang sa la phyag mdzub kyis nā ga ra dang / lalha'i dbyangs gsal bris nas klog tshul mdzad/ mi 'gom par phyag gis byil phyis nas gtong ba byung / thog mar rang gi yab las kye rdor gyi dbang sogs nod/ yi ge'i bye brag du ma dang / rtsis dang gso dpyad ri mo la sogs pa mthar phyin par bslabs/ rje btsun rin po che la dbang rgyud man ngag sogs gsang sngags yab chos thams cad dang / rig gnas kyi cha shas 'ga' zhig kyang gsan pas tshegs med du thugs su chud/de nas dge bshes zhu la sogs pa'i bod ston du ma las/ bod la yongs su grags pa'i chos skor thams cad gsan pas thams cad tshar re la thugs su chud/ lhag par rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung du lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs zhus pas/ dus de nyid du bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gzigs/ chos thams cad skad cig la thugs su chud/ shes bya'i gnas thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa yin te/ bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / zab mo'i lam gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i che/41 /zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'o//'on kyang tha snyad du gnas bcu gsan nas srol phye tshul cung zad brjod na/ thog mar sgra rig pa la/ rje btsun chen po grags pa'i zhabs drung du sgra'i gnas brgyad smra sgo la sogs pa rnams gsan cing /de nas 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan dam par gyur pa/ kha che'i bsod snyoms pa chen po mahā paṇḍi ta shākya shrī la sgra ka tsan snying po bsdu ba la sogs pa'i sgra'i mdo rnams rags rim gsan cing / nub phyogs a ti na war sku zhabrungs pa'i bram ze'i slob dpon chen po surga ta shrī dpal ldan sa skyar spyan drangs nas lo gnyis kyi bar du ka lā pa rtsa ba dang / de'i 'grel pa stong phrag drug pa dang bcas pa/ ming sgrub pa su wanti/ byings sgrub pa ti wanti/ rab tu sgrub pa mtha' dag gsan/ paṇḍi ta chen po saṅga shrī la tsand+ra pa/ de'i ming dang byings kyi sgrub pa rnams mtha' chod dang bcas pa gsan nas khong du chud par mdzad de/ de dag gi tshul gsal bar ston pa la/ sgra la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ smra sgo'i don bsdu la sogs pa mdzad nas/ sgra rig pa'i phyogs kyi srol legs par btod pa yin te/ nyid kyi gsung las/ gzhan dag

22 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gis ni sngon chad lugs 'byung 'di/ /gangs ri'i ngogs 'dir rgyas par ma mdzad la/ /de na mkhas pa rnams kyang rmongs gyur pas/ /'di la kho bo blo gros gsal phyir dbye/42 /zhes gsungs shing / dpal khang lo tsā ba'i bstod par yang / ind+ra pā ṇi byā gar cha bsags sogs/ /legs sbyar rgya mtsho de nyid skad cig la/ /gzigs tshe brda sprod byed pa sarbadzñā/ /skabs gsum bla ma'i snyan las babs sam snyam/43 /zhes gsungs pa yin no//de bzhin du tshad ma rig pa yang bod ston rnams las mang du gsan cing / khyad par kha che paṇa chen la rnam 'grel le'u dang po'i 'grel pa stong phrag phyed dang bzhi pa yan gsan nas bsgyur cing zhus/slob dpon thar pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i rtog ge'i skad ces pa'i bstan bcos gsan cing bsgyur/gzhan phyi rol rig byed kyi tshad ma drang srong chen po gzegs zan gyis sbyar ba'i rtog ge'i bstan bcos rig pa zhes bya ba sogs gsan cing / mdor na sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i yan lag thams cad thugs su chud cing / de dag gi don 'brel bar byed pa tshad ma rigs pa'i gter rtsa 'grel gnyis mdzad pa yin cing / nyid kyi gsung las/ shes bya'i mkha' la thogs med rgyu nus shing / /phas rgol nyi zla'i gzi brjid za nus kyang / /rtag tu skye bo kun gyis ma mthong ba'i/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i sgra gcan 'dra/44 /zhes gsungs shing / /bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / /tshad ma gsum gyi gnas gsum gzhal bya'i don/ /ma lus rtogs pas sgrub dang sun 'byin gyi/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom tshar gcod par/ /sde bdun mdzad pa'i blo bdun khyod kyi mtshan/45 /zhes gsungs so//yang sdeb sbyor gsan pa'i tshul yang / paṇḍi ta saṅga shrī la dmar ser dang rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung / khyad par de dag las yon tan brgyad kyis khyad par du 'phags pa slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bṛta ma la sogs pa gsan nas legs par khong du chud/ de dag gi don 'grel pa la sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po mdzad de rig gnas 'di'i srol legs par phye ba yin te/ gzhung de nyid du/sngon chad gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mkhas rnams kyi/ /rna ba'i snod du nye bar ma lhung zhing / /lce yi dbang pos kun nas ma myangs pa/ /ro brgya'i 'byung gnas dpag bsam shing 'di skyed/46 /ces gsungs shing /bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / dmar ser rgyal lha'i lugs las khyad par du/ /yon tan brgyad kyis 'phags pa'i sdeb sbyor gzhung / /bṛtta dzā ti'i ngo mtshar rtogs byed la/ /zhi ba'i zhabs dang khyod blo mthun

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 23mong gyur/47 /zhes gsungs so//snyan ngag gi rig pa ni/ rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan la skyes rabs so bzhi pa dang /gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa la sogs pa'i skyes rabs kyi rigs du ma gsan cing / paṇḍi ta saṅga shrī la snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po gsum dang chung ngu gsum/ rgyan gyi bstan bcos dbyangs can gyi mgul rgyan stong phrag brgyad pa/ dpag bsam 'khri shing la sogs pa mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi ston pa'i bstan bcos mang du gsan zhing / lhag par daṇḍi'i tshig rgyan la mkhas par bslabs te/ de dag gi brjod don ma lus pa mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgor gtan la phab pas rig gnas 'di nyid kyi srol bla na med pa phye ba yin te/ bdag nyid chen po'i gsung las/ 'ga' zhig sgra dang rnam par dbye ba dang / /khams dang byed tshig dpe dang tshig gi rgyan/ /dbye bsdu grangs dang go rim nges pa la/ /'di na phal cher rmongs par mthong nas 'dir/ /mang du thos shing mthong nas goms pa dang / /man ngag dbang gis dpal ldan kun dga' yi/ /rgyal mtshan 'di na 'ga' tsam 'chad pa la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dga' ba bskyed de nyon/48 /zhes gsungs shing / bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / dbyangs can lang tsho zag zad ye shes kyi/ /rtse dgas thugs yid gcugs pa'i seng ge brtsen/ /tshig rgyan bal la ki ste lha'i rol sgras/ /yid bsgyur khams gsum dbugs 'byin snyan ngag mkhan/49 /zhes gsungs pa yin no//de bzhin du mngon brjod kyi rim pa yang bod du yongs su grags pa'i sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa'i ming gi tshogs mtha' yas pa dang / de dag kyang 'dod rgyal dang / rjes grub 'dra 'brel sogs so sor phye zhing / bkas bcad thog mtha' bar gsum du grags pa ltar/ brda gsar rnying gi bye brag thams cad legs par phyed cing / lhag par mkhas pa chen po dge 'dun dpal las mngon brjod kyi/ bstan bcos las yi ge re re'i mngon brjod gsan cing bsgyur/ a ma ra ko ṣa dang / sna tshogs gsal ba'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsan cing / de dag sde gsum mam bzhir 'dus shing /rtags gsum gyi rnam dbye legs par phyed pa'i sgo nas rig gnas 'di'i srol cher btod pa yin te/nyid kyi gsung las/ byang phyogs 'di na tshig la mkhas pa med/ /legs par shes nas 'chad pa kho bo tsam/ /rtags kyi dbye ba phal cher 'dir mi 'jug /'on kyang bod la mkho ba tsam zhig bsdu/50 /zhes gsungs shing / bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / ting supu mtha' dang rtags kyi rnam dbye sogs/ /so sor ma

24 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/'dres sna tshogs mngon brjod dag /'chad mkhas mtha' yas ming la ma rmongs pas/ /'chi med seng ge'i khengs pa thung ngur mdzad/51 /ces gsungs so//de bzhin du zlos gar gyi bstan bcos kyang paṇḍi ta saṅga shrī las gzugs kyi nyi ma'i bstan bcos dang / dha rata la sogasapagasan cing khong du chud de/ de dag gi tshul phyogs tsam ston pa la rol mo'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba mdzad cing / nyid kyi gsung las kyang / /sngon chad gzhan gyi yid la ma shar ba/ /'di 'dra gang gis shes de blo gros ldan/ /rgan po rnams kyis yang yang rnam dpyad pa'i/ /don de rtogs kyang de la ngo mtshar med/52 /ces gsungs shing / bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / sngon byung zlos pa'i gar de skad rigs bzhi/ /brda sbyor la byang rgya mtsho'i mtha' la sogs/ /tshar phyin thugs chud zin dang ma zin pa'i//sgra skad kun gyis khyod la lung du ston/53 /ces gsungs so//de bzhin du dus sbyor shes pa yang / rtsis kyi gzhi lo zla dag pa/ lnga bsdus/ sgra gcan/ gza' lnga/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin/ du mjug la sogs 'char ba dang / nub pa'i mtha' dang / de dag gi dge legs kyi rtsis dang / dbyangs 'char la sogs pa'i rtsis rnams kyang phul du phyin pa mkhyen cing / de dag rgan po rnams la grags zin pa'i phyir/ srol 'byed kyi bstan bcos ni ma mdzad la/ legs par gsungs pa'i brgyud pa'i srol ni mang du yod pa yin no/ /bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / rtsis grangs rig pa kun rdzob rten 'brel che/ /za 'og ltar gzigs srid pa'i ā darsha/ /dkar nag rtsis la byang ba'i rnam rig gi /gtsug lag rgya mtsho ri byi'i khyor chu bzhin/54 /zhes gsungs so//de bzhin du bzo rig pa yang rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams las legs par sbyangs shing / ri mo dang sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dang / cha tshad la sogs pa mdo rgyud kyi lung dang mthun par mkhyen cing /zhar byung brtag pa rnam pa brgyad kyang khong du chud/ de dag gi mtshan nyid ston pa'i sku gzugs kyi bstan bcos dang / brtag pa'i bstan bcos sogs yod par gsungs kyang / deng sang dpe rgyun mthong ba ma byung la/ de'i phyir nyid kyi gsung las/ shes bya'i me tog yon tan dri bsung can/ /snyan pa'i mdog mdzes kun gyis bsngags na yang / /sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po min pas shes bya'i bcud ma rnyed/55 /ces gsungs shing / de bzhin du bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / lus ngag yid dang bzo dang mchog phal gyi/ /gzugs brnyan bskrun la tshad dang 'phrul gyi dbyibs/ /sna tshogs byed po las tshul mtshar sdug gi /tshon brgya 'dren pa dpyod ldan dga' ba'i gnyen/56 /zhes sogs dang / gso ba rig

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 25pa'i tshul yang / spyir phyi nang gi gzhung lugs du ma las byung ba rnams dang / khyad par yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po 'grel pa zla zer dang bcas pa thugs su chud cing / de dag gi don legs par ston pa'i bstan bcos yan lag brgyad pa'i bsdus pa zhes bya ba mdzad pa yin te/ ji skad du/ bstod pa mdzad pas/ ma rig rtsa ba bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /'phel zad 'khrug pa'i gnyen po che'i rig byed/ /thar pa'i 'tsho srog bsrung ba'i thabs tshul stong / /ji bzhin mkhyen pa de 'dra gzhan gyis min/57 /zhes gsungs so//nang rig pa ni/ rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams las/ bsam pa'i ra ba las 'das pa zhig gsan zhing /khyad par rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bka' drin gyis/ mdo rgyud thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad mnga' ba yin pas/ de'i tshul rgyas par su zhig gis brjod par nus/ che long tsam brjod na yang mang du dogs pas 'dir rgyas par ma spros la/dpyod ldan dag gis gzhan du shes par gyis shig de dag gi tshul ston pa'i bstan bcos kyang / gzhung lugs legs bshad/ thub pa dgongs gsal/ sems bskyed chen mo/ sdom gsum rab dbye/ bdag med bstod 'grel la sogs pa ji snyed cig yod pa yin pas bka' 'bum du shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du nyid kyi gsung las kyang / bstan pa'i 'jug der bstan la rab gus shing / /bstan pa mtha' dag bsrung zhing 'dzin 'dod pa/ khukya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang pos bstan la phan phyir 'di sbyar ro/58/zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / yongs 'du'i tshal du kumbhi da ra dang / /'od ldan tshogs pa'i mkha' nang nyin byed ltar/ /mkhas mang 'dus pa'i dbus na thams cad mkhyen/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa sngon dang phyi mthar su/59 /zhes gsungs so//de ltar na rig gnas rnam pa bcu'i srol legs par phye nas gangs ri'i ljongs kyi blo gsal dag mkhas pa mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su chud cing / rigs pa dang mi rigs pa'i tshul mtha' dag 'byed shes pa ni rje btsun nyid kyi sku drin yin la/ de lta bu'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la ston par bzhed nas/nyid kyi gsung las/ sgra pa nga yin rtog ge pa nga smra ba ngan 'joms nga 'dra med/ /sdeb sbyor nga mkhas snyan ngag nga nyid mngon brjod 'chad la 'gran med nga / /dus sbyor ngas shes phyi nang kun rig rnam dpyod blo gros mtshungs med nga / /de 'dra gang yin sa skya pa ste mkhas pa gzhan dag gzugs brnyan yin/60 /zhes gsungs shing / rang nyid kyi 'grel pa'i sgo nas kyang gsal bar mdzad pa yin no//gnad des na bod yul gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir theg pa gsum dang rig gnas cha shas tsam

26 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gyis 'gyur dang bshad pa mdzad pa ni sngon dus kyang mang du byung mod/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa ma byon gong du ni rig gnas rnam pa bcu'i srol cher ma dar la/ dper na nor bu rin po che rdog ma phul du phyin pa yod kyang / de nyid la bug pa phug ste/ srad bu brgyu ba'i lam med na lha dang mi rnams kyi mgrin pa'i rgyan du ci yang byed mi nus la/ de nyid la bzo bo mkhas pas rdo rje rin po che ste pha lam gyis bug pa phug zin na dar la sogs pa'i skud pa 'jam pos kyang rin po che rnams phreng bar byas nas mgrin pa'i rgyan du byed nus pa ltar/ bdag nyid chen po rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros rdo rje rin po che pha lam gyi zegs mas rig gnas rnam bcu'i nor bu brjod don legs par 'byed pa'i bug pa'i snang bas srol ma phye bar/ lo tsā ba gzhan mkhas par rlom pa'i rig pa srad bu'i tshogs kyis 'jug pa thod pa min na/ bod kyi blo gsal rnams kyi mgrin pa'i rgyan du rngo gar yang thogs pa min la/ de'i phyir bdag nyid chen pos srol btod/shong dpang yab sras kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad nas/ rig gnas rnam pa bcu'i nor bu'i phreng bas bod kyi blo gsal rnams kyi mgrin pa'i rgyan mdzes par byed pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed ni sa paṇḍi ta yin no/ /zhes pa'i snyan grags 'og min gyi bar du khyab bo zhes ston pa la/ bstod pa mdzad pas/ bsil sbyor sgeg mo theg gsum bsgyur bshad kyi/ /snang ba ka tsa li ta'i gos klubs kyang / /gser zhal mngon du ma 'phyar de srid du/ /rig gnas rgyan gyi lang tsho'i gtam yang ci/ /rin thang che ba'i nor bu rig gnas bcu//khyod blo'i rdo rjes yang dag ma phug bar/ /gzhan rig srad bus 'jug pa thod min na/ /blo gsal mgrin pa'i rgyan du rngo gar thogs/ /de slad 'di na tha snyad shing rta'i srol/ /thog mar 'byed la ston pa gnyis pa zhes//gakhrig tu dkar ba'i snyan grags ā na ka /phyogs kyi mdzes mas brtan g.yo 'jig kyang brdung /61 /zhes gsungs pa yin no//de lta bu'i bka' drin gsab pa dang / rang nyid kyang dam pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir/ rje btsun sa paṇḍi ta'i gsung rab la thos bsam sgom gsum zhe thag pa nas gyis shig ces yang yang du snying nas gdams pa yin te/ de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis 'di phyi'i don thams cad 'grub cing bstan pa la phan pa'i thos bsam bgyis pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang yang bde blag tu thob pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang nyid kyi gsung las/ des na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa yi//bstan bcos la ni byin rlabs yod/ /'di 'dra nyan bshad byed pa la/ /thos pa zhes ni brjod pa yin//de don spyod pa bsam pa yin/ /nan tan gyis ni de sgrub pa/ /sgom pa yin par shes par bya/ /thos bsam

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 27sgom gsum de ltar yin/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/62 /zhes dang / 'di la dga' bas nyan dang sems rnams kyi/ /sems la 'jam pa'i rdo rje rjes zhugs nas/ /khyad par tshig gi don la mkhas pa yi//nges par byin gyis brlab par bdag gis shes/63 /zhes gsungs shing zhal gyis bzhes pa lags so//bar du sku drin che ba shong dpang yab sras ji ltar byon pa'i tshul/gnyis pa bar du sku drin che ba shong dpang yab sras ji ltar byon pa'i tshul ni/ de yang thog mar bdag nyid chen pos srol legs par btod pa de nyid rgya gar gyi gzhung phal mo che bsgyur ba dang /bshad pa'i rgyun ches cher dar bar mdzad pa po ni shong dpang yab sras rnams yin pas bod la bka' drin shin tu che'o// de yang thog mar shong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan ni la stod lho'i dpyad lung shar gyi bong ra zhes par sku zhabrungs/ gzhon nu la rab tu byung / go yul ba mdo sde dpal rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ dus 'khor chag lugs/ bde kye phreng ba skor gsum sogs mang du gsan cing / gar thig rtsis la mkhas par sbyangs/ gza' gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me sogs rtsis kyi bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ de nas tsha nar srag bde ba'i drung du phar tshad mngon sum la mkhas par sbyangs/ dus 'khor gyi skor shog ldebs bzhi bcu tsam phyag bris su bris nas yon du phul te/ 'bro lugs kyi dbang rgyud bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ 'phags pa rin po ches snga res sa skyar byon pa na bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa spel legs phul nas lo tsā slob tu 'gro bas rdzong bar zhu zhus pas/ de lta bu'i blo skye ba bzang / re zhig gzhung lugs gsar pa bsgyur ba'i nus pa ma byung yang / paṇḍi ta la slob gnyer dang dri gtugs legs par gyis shigakho bos kyang chos rje pa brten yun thungs pas/ sdeb sbyor me tog gi chun po dang / tshig gter sogs tshul bzhin mi shes par/ 'di dag shes pa zhig cis kyang gyis shig mkhas par gyur pa'i tshe nged la chos rje pa'i dgongs pa skong dgos kyi 'gyur 'dra yang dgos pa yod de rjes su byed do gsungs nas/ de dag gi dpe dang gser srang lnga/ dar yug bcu rnams gnang byung ste/ rten 'brel yod pas do nub rje btsun gong ma'i gzims khang dpe khang du nyol la song / slar 'bor ba na shog cig gsungs nas brdzangs so//shong gi thugs la skyes stobs kyi blo gros ni phun sum tshogs/ sbyor byung gi nan tan mchog tu gyur na legs bshad gsar pa mang du bsgyur ba cis mi nus snyam du dgongs te 'phags pa'i gzims

28 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/g.yog pa mdo smad pa blo gros rgyal po dang 'grogs nas bal yul du byon te/ paṇḍi ta sa dbang bzang po'i drung du sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor zlos gar mngon brjod la byang bar mdzad nas sa skyar byon/ 'phags pa rin po che'i drung du phebs/ shin tu dgyes par gyur/ nged kyi chos rje pa byang phyogs sprul pa'i sder sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshe/ tha ma'i gsung du bka' stsal pa la/ da ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang mchog tu dar bar byas/ brgal brtags kyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i srol bzang po dod/ tha snyad rig gnas kyi tshul 'di la yang lag rjes chen po byung bas sems la 'phreng ba cher med/ 'on kyang 'phags pa bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang / rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing ma 'gyur ba dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phreng 'dzin gyi tshigs bcad bzhin ma 'gyur ba gsum tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa zhig yod na'ang bsnyen par rdzogs zin/ 'gyur gnyis sngar ma byung bas da khyed kyis gyis shig de'i grogs dpon chen shākya bzang pos kyang byed pa yod do/ /zhes dgyes bzhin bka' stsal bas/ sa skyar dus 'khor rgyud 'grel shong 'gyur zhes yongs su grags pa'i mkhas pa thams cad 'gyur legs pa rang du mdzad pa 'di mdzad/slar rdo rje gdan du byon nas mahā bo dhi la mchod pa dang skor ba mdzad/ paṇḍi ta la: ka ra spyan drangs nas/ dpag bsam 'khri shing / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ snyan ngag me long / 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgya pa/ 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa bṛ ta ma la/ tsand+ra pa'i mdo sbyor ba'i rtsa 'grel/ bzlog pa bsdus pa rtsa 'grel/ slob dpon su pa rakṣi tas mdzad pa'i smra ba kun la 'jug pa rtsa 'grel/ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnam dbye'i le'ur byas pa la sogs pa sngon ma 'gyur ba bsgyur/ 'chi med mdzod la 'gyur mchan mdzad nas/ sgra snyan ngag gi bshad rgyun spel/ 'phags pa rin po ches kyang sde snod 'dzin pa shong lo tsā ba'i snyan du gsol ba zhes pa'i 'phrin yig mdzad pa na/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa rgya che la zab cing gting dpag par dka' ba/chig brling zhing sdeb sbyor byings che bas chen po rnams kyis kyang nyams su len dka' bas sngon byung gi lo tsā ba dag gis kyang ma 'gyur ba dang / log par bsgyur ba dang / rnam grangs gzhan dang phyogs re ba dang /thal bar bsgyur ba la sogs pa de dag khyed kyis legs par khong du chud cing nges te/ zhu chen mdzad pa'i glegs bam dang / klu rnams kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar mthong bas/ dge ba dang rjes su yi rang ba khyad par can skyes zhes rab tu bsngags/ sgra bsgyur rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur to//

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 29de nyid kyi dbon po shong lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pas gsan te/ de ni 'phags pa rin po che'i sras kyi thu bor gyur cing / se chen rgyal pos kyang bla mar bkur bas gzhi 'gyur dang 'gyur 'chos mang po mdzad/ gcen gyi yon tan bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mkhyen cing / khyad par du dus 'khor dang tha snyad rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i slob ma mang du thon/ de la lo tsā ba mchog ldan dang / sgra tshad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis gsan la/ lo mchog pa ni mang mkhar khra tshang du sku 'khrungs/ 'phags pa rin po che las rab tu byung / mtshan mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros dpung rgyan mdzes pa'i tog ces rang nyid kyis 'dogs par zhus pa bzhin btags la/ phyis lo mchog pa zhes grags// rbesnang sku mched las dbang rgyud man ngag gsan/ ka tsan la sogs pa rig gnas mtha' dag bslabs/ bod na 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dbang gdams ngag bka' bstan bcos phal mo che'i lung mnga' bas/ bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i bla mar gyur/de'i slob ma ni/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa ste/ la stod lho spyang lung gi 'o 'bu gyam du me pho byi ba la 'khrungs/ gdung dpang / yum snga mo nas grongs te lug gi 'o mas gsos pas lu gu zhes grags/ kho bo ba'i 'o mas gsos na legs pa la blun po rnams kyis lug gi 'o ma byin pas blo gros kyi phyed 'gribs su bcug gsung / grub chen 6rdzo rgyan pas bu chung de la dge bshes chen po zhig 'ong bas 'di byin gsung nas/ ja gsol 'phro zhig gsol zhal dang bcas pa bskur/ lo lnga pa la rgod tshang pa'i gdan sa/ byang gling pa las dge bsnyen nod/ mtshan blo gros brtan par btags/ bdun pa la mkhan chen gser khang pa dang / mes ston 'dul 'dzin pa las rab tu byung / bcu pa la mdo rtsa ṭīkka dang bcas pa khyi bdun gyis bdas kyang thon pa byung / sngon tshe sbyangs pas skye ba 'dir/ /gzhung rnams rtsed mo'i zhor la shes/64 /zhes gsungs/ grogs shig gis chu la khur bas khyed stobs ches sangs rgyas bstan pa rangs po khur bas theg 'gro ba 'dug gsungs pas/ des 'thab skad do/ /bcu gsum pa la tsha nar rtag bde ba'i drung du byon/ lo drug bar ma chad du bsten nas/ phar tshad mngon gsum/ dbu ma/ khyad par du dus 'khor la sbyangs pas/ bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mkhas par mkhyen/ phyi nang gzhan gsum don ston pa'i//rgyud 'grel tshig don rab bshad nas/ /rdo rje theg par blo phyogs mdzad/ /gsang ba'i don ston bla mar 'dud/ /bsams bzhin yang bla ma 'di bka' drin che/ /rtag bde ba 'di bka' drin che/ /bka' drin can gyi bla ma la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/65 /zhes sogs gsol 'debs kyang mdzad/

30 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/bcu dgu pa la rtag bde ba sku gshegs nas/ mang mkhar khra tshang du lo mchog pa la dus 'khor shong lugs/ ka tsan me long / rong pa shes rab seng ge la dus 'khor rwa lugs/ sa skyar 'jam skya ba la brtag gnyis/ rnam 'grel/ rig gter gsan/ nyi shu pa la gser khang pas mkhan po/ me ston pas las slob/ /byang ston pas gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ a tsarya byung tshad la phral skad bslabs/'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa dang / paṇḍi ta'i bar gyi lo tsā mdzad pas lo tsā bar grags/ nyer gcig pa la bal por byon/ ra ma ā tsarya dang / ma tha na ā tsarya la tsand+ra pa gsan/ sa skyar byon te/ ka lwa pa'i 'grel pa gnyis rags rim bsgyur/ shong ston legs bshad lde mig blangs/ /legs sbyar skad kyi gter ka phye//sna tshogs gzhung lugs rin chen blangs/ /legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed la dbang /slo /zhes gsungs/dge shing pa la bstod pa rgyas 'bring mdzad nas bskur bas/ dad de dngul bre chen phul ba bsnams nas/yang bal por byon/ paṇḍi ta snga ma gnyis dang / rgya gar shar phyogs kyi tsu ṭa paṇḍi ta rnams bsnyen nas ka lā pa sogs rig gnas phyi ma gsan/ dgongs rgyan sogs bsgyur/ slar sa skyar phebs dus 'jam skya bas gtso mdzad kyis ser sbreng dang / bkur sti chen po mdzad/ bal por lan bdun byon/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta phal che bas man snye dang dgongs rgyan sogs zhus/ sa skyar bzhi thog pa dang 'jam skya la lam 'bras sogs mang du gsan/ so gnyis pa la gung thang gnas po cher chos gzhis btsugs te gung thang pa bde blo sogs slob ma'i mchog rgya mtsho lta bu 'dus pa la/ dbyar dus 'khor/ dgun phar tshad mngon gsum gyi dus chos gsungs/ snyan pa'i grags pas rgya gar dang hor yul tshun khyab/ ya tshe dang hor rgyal pos gdan 'dren byung ba la bar chad du gzigs nas/ springs yig gong 'og can gyis ya tshe bzlog cad pu dgon gsar la seng ge gling du btags te der bzhugs pas hor bzlog sdig pa'i grogs po'i g.yo ba ring du spangs/ bdud kyi zhags pa'i 'ching ba che las grol/ /'jigs pa med pa seng ge'i khyim du slebs//dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa'i bsam pa 'grub/67 /ces gsungs/skabs der sa skyar byon nas/ lo mchog pa la mnga' ba'i bka' lung mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ shas cher gnas po cher bzhugs nas/ rtsom bshad bsgyur gyi sgo phye/ slar sa skyar byon/ chos mang du gsungs/ de'i skabs su bo dong e'i dge 'dun rnams kyis rgyal sras thogs med la gdan sar gsol ba btab pas/ bdag gis mi yong / nged kyis lung bstan pa ltar byas na de'i brgyud pa bdun gyi bar du lugs gnyis kyi sa sde 'di la phan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /de la dge 'dun

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 31rnams kyis kyang bka' bzhin bgyid pa zhu ba'i ngo chen phul ba na/ sems dpa' chen po des kyang dpang lo tsā ba'i drung du phebs te/ dpal e'i dge 'dun rnams ni nyid la mkhan por gsol ba 'debs kyis/bdag la yang ngo chen gyi las su bgyid pas na/ de ni mgon po khyed kyis mdzad par rigs par gyur cing /'jig rten gyi spyod pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pas/ gu ru thogs med thos pa'i gtam la snyan/ /nyid kyi zhal nas legs bshad ma gtogs pa/ /nyes par snang ba ga la srid pa ste/ /kho bo'i mkhan po chen po rtag bde pa/ /seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis kyang ma thob pa'i/ /gdan sa yin pas de ring rang la 'gro/ /'gyur na mi yong da lta rang la 'gro/68/zhes gsungs shing / khri thog tu phebs nas bstan pa'i bya ba yun ring mdzad/de nas dbus su byon pa'i lam du glegs bam mang po slob ma la bkye ba'i mnal lam byung bas zla ba bcu drug gi bar du dbus su bzhugs nas/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ gung thang / stag lung / rwa sgreng / gsang ne'u thog rnams su dus 'khor/ dgongs rgyan/ phar tshad mngon gsum/ dbu ma rgyan/ sgra snyan ngag zab mo'i mdo lnga sogs chos mang du gsungs pas/ dbus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal mo ches gsan/ da ni shi yang mi 'gyod do zhes gsungs/ de nas snar thang du mchims blo bzang pa sogs la dgongs rgyan snyan ngag sogs gnang / de nas e dang sa skyar byon/ si sogs kyi mtha' dpyad 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa tsand+ra pa'i yi ge'i mdo/ ting mtha'i bya ba/ slob dpon gtsang kha shas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa mdor bstan sogs gzhi 'gyur dang zhu chen mang du mdzad cing / dus 'khor 'grel chen gyi bstod 'grel/ ka lā pa snyan ngag me 'o1nga gi 'gre la pa/ tshogs gsum gsal ba sogs bstan bcos mang du mdzad nas/ re bdun pa chu pho rta'i nag pa'i tshes bcu gsum la bde ba can du gshegs so//lo chen 'di la ni slob ma 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan mched gnyis/ bu dol lo tsā ba ma ti rnam gnyis/ gung thang bde blo/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo sogs mang du byung zhing / bu ston rin po ches ni gtso bor thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan la sgra gsan no/ /mkhas pa 'di la rig gnas kyi dogs gnas mang du zhus nas/ 'grel pa dur sing yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba sogs dur sing gi 'grel pa spyan gsum 'bangs kyis mdzad pa phal cher bsgyur 'gyur mang po dang / ka lā pa'i 'grel pa yang mdzad/ slob ma'i gtso bo sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal sogs la gsungs pas/ rig gnas kyi bshad rgyun shin tu dar ba byung / sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyis ni ka lā pa'i 'grel pa shin tu rgyas par mdzad cing / rang gi slob ma sa bzang 'phags pa dang / lo tsā ba dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ge sogs la gsungs shing / 'phags

32 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/pas rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la yang sgra snyan ngag legs par gsungs so//gung thang pa bde blos mnga' ris su rig gnas legs par spel zhing / snyan ngag gi 'grel pa dang gtam rgyud gaṅgā'i chu rgyun sogs mdzad/ /slob ma'i mchog lo chen byang chub rtse mo ni zur tsho zhes par yab gzhon nu dpal bzang / yum dpang lo'i lcam mo ye shes sman ne gnyis kyi sras su shing mo yos la 'byungs/ bdun pa la dpang lor dge bsnyen nod/ shong gi dbon po chosaskyong dpal las rab tu byung /bcu drug pa la gung thang gnas po cher dpang lo la mngon tshad gsan cing sbyangs/ dpang lo e'i gdan sar bzhugs dus lo bzhir rig gnas phal mo che la sbyangs/ nyer gsum pa la 'jam dbyangs don rgyal bas mkhan po/ dpang los las slob/ chos rje bla mas gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyer lnga pa la lo tsā ba mkhas par mkhyen/ dpang lo zhi bar ma gshegs kyi bar phyi bzhin 'brengs nas dus 'khor sogs nyid la mnga' ba'i yon tan ma lus thugs su tshud/ de nas bu ston/ chos rje bla ma/ rgyal sras pa rnams la/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ nyams su bzhes pas/grub pa'i dbang phyug tu mnga' gsol/ rgyal sras pas/ lo chen 'di la zhal zas kyis bsnyen bkur na mu ge'i bskal pa las thar gsung ba'i snyan grags kyis rnyed bkur mchod pa'i mtsho brdol/ chu la mi 'bying /bug pa chung ngu la skus brtol/ khang chung du mi mang po la dbang bskur bas rdzu 'phrul bstan/ mngon par mkhyen pa mnga'/ dpal ldan bla ma'i bkas e'i gdan sa mdzad/ de'i phyag phyir dbus su byon/ stag lung ratna kā ras lo chen 'di'i nged kyi dbon po'i slob dpon du 'jog par zhus pas gnang ste/ stag lung pa nam mkha' dpal bzang la dus 'khor sgra snyan sogs gnang bas de'i bshad rgyun dbus su cher dar/slar dwags por chos rje bla ma'i drung du byon/ ka lā pa'i sa ris phul/ gtsang phyogs su bzhugs nas dgung lo mthon por gyur kyang / spyan snga grags 'byung bas gdan drangs nas/ yar klungs/ gdan sa thel/ gung thang rnams su dus 'khor sgra snyan gyi chos char phab/ mkhas pa kun tshim par byas/ e'i chab tshan la byon dus thugs mkhyen mang du gsungs/ stag tshang / shangs/ 'u yug nyang stod rnams su dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyud khrid mang du gsungs/ gsang chab 'thungs pas lkugs pa mang po smra shes/ zhal mthong ba/ gsung thos pa/ gsol ras zos pa tsam gyis nad thon pa dang / byin rlabs zhugs pa mang du byung / gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod nas ka lā pa'i 'grel pa slob phan sogs 'gyur du ma mdzad/ don brgyad pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo mchu zla'i nyer gcig la ngo mtshar ba'i rtags dang bcas te gshegs so//

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 33de'i slob ma'i mchog lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang po/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan shes rab dpal sogs mang du byon pa las/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang po ni sgra tshad dus 'khor rnams la mkhas par gyur nas/ lo chen gyi phyag phyi dang / gnas gzhan du yang / dus 'khor/ ka tsan/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor sogs la bshad pa mang du mdzad/ lo chen byang rtse'i phyag phyi mdzad nas ka lā pa'i 'grel pa slob phan yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i phyag rjes kyang shin tu che/ /lo chen byang chub rtse mo dang / lo chen nam mkha' bzang po gnyis char gyi slob ma ni/ bo dong pa sher rab dpal ste/ 'di nyid kyis ra ma tsand+ra'i 'grel pa rdzogs par bsgyur cing rig gnas bshad pa'i slob ma bo dong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis ka lā pa'i āṇa sogs kyi 'grel par durga sidhas mdzad pa dang / byings kyi mdo si sogs kyi mtha' dpyad bram ze'i slob dpon sarba dha ras mdzad pa sogs 'gyur mang po mdzad do//lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan ni lo chen byang chub rtse mo'i rus dpon yin zhing / nyid la ji ltar mnga' ba'i chos thams cad thugs su chud cing / e dang gyam gyi gdan sar bzhugs te mdo rgyud rig gnas kyi bshad pa rgya cher stsal bas/ slob ma mkhas par gyur pa grangs las 'das pa zhig thon/sras kyi mchog ni bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal te 'dis mkhyen pa la ni mtha' med cing / rtsod pa'i sgo nas kyang g.yag mi chos kyi bla ma/ rong ston shes bya kun rig rigs pa smra ba bsod nams skyabs/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal la sogs pa'i spobs pa bcoms/ rtsom pa'i sgo nas de nyid 'dus chen zhes bya ba ste/ bzhugs tshul yang 'jug pa'i sgo bzhi/ phyi nang gi gnas lnga/ bshad sgrub rin po che'i yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag brgya phrag rim par phye ba brgya drug cu/ le'u nyi khri chig stong drug brgya/man ngag bdun khri nyis stong / chos choms brgyad khri bzhi stong / po ti brgya dang bcu yod pa yin no// 'chad pa'i slob ma thon tshul yang / bzo rig nas bzung yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar/ /de dang de yi bka' babs nyi shu gsum/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje mi yi zlos gar mkhan/ /rnam dag 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rnam pa gsum/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i khyu mchog chen po gcig /nyi ma zla ba ltar grags mkhas grub gnyis/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mig gcig 61 chen gsum/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen drug /ces sogs mang du gsungs pa'i nang nas/ nyi zla ltar grags pa gnyis ni/ dang po mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po ste/ 'dis ni nags shod pa chos dbang grags pa sogs dge phyogs kyi rig gnas smra ba thams cad kyi rig gnas chu rgyun spel ba'i rgya mtsho mdzad pa yin la/ zla ba lta bu ni/

34 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gsung rab rgya mtsho chu gter gyi mngal las thon te/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa'i nam mkhar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi dkyil 'bor yongs su gang bas/ mkhas par btags pa'i ri bong gis sgeg cing /tha snyad kyi gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i 'od dkar gyi snang bas blo gsal ku mu ta'i tshogs rgyas par mdzad pa la mkhas pa dpang lo tsā ba chen po'i sku'i skye ba snye thang blo gros brtan pa bzhi par bod pa de yin te/'dis kyang dbus su rig gnas kyi bstan pa cher dar bar mdzad do//lo tsā ba thams cad gsum ni e'i lo tsā ba chen po bsod nams bzang po/ lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba thugs rje dpal lo/ /yang lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang po dang / lo tsā ba shes rab dpal gnyis kyi thugs kyi sras dam pa ni/ shab smad lo tsā ba thugs rje dpal te/ 'di ni rig gnas la shin tu mkhas pas tsand+ra pa'i 'grel pa dharma dā sa rdzogs par bsgyur/ ka tsan gnyis la 'grel pa shin tu rgyas shing mtha' mchod pa bzhugs tshogs chen po re mdzad cing / tha snyad rig gnas kyi bshad rgyun rgyas par spel ba las/ slob ma'i mchog gtsang du chos 'khor sgang pa shes rab rin chen/ zha lu pa gzhung brgya smra ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/ gnas brtan legs pa rgyal po/ snar thang lo tsā ba saṅga shrī/ bo dong shes rab bzang po/ cho 'khor lo tsā ba mañdzu shrī/ nyid kyi zhabs pad yun ring du bsten pa grags pa'i mtshan can/ dbus su rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje byams pa gling pa la sogs pa'i mkhas pa dpag tu med pa bskrun zhing / tha snyad rig pa'i tshul 'di shin tu rgyas par mdzad do//de yang snar thang lo tsā ba saṅga snyi ni ka tsan la sogs pa'i sgra mdo nyi shu tsam gyi sa ris la thogs pa mi mnga'/ ka lā pa la ṭīkka yongs su rdzogs pa legs pa phul du phyin pa yang mdzad/ snyan ngag me long gi ṭīkka bklags pas don thams cad 'grub pa don rgyan gyi dper brjod mi 'dra ba gnyis/ sgra rgyan gyi dper brjod shin tu legs pa/ sngags kyi klog thabs sogs yig cha'i rigs phul du phyin pa mang du mdzad cing bshad pa'i srol bzung bas tha snyad rig gnas mkhas pa'i slob ma mang du byung zhing / slob ma'i mchog ni 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal te/ 'dis ni dbus su rig gnas kyi srol rgya cher btod cing / slob ma'i mchog khrus khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho ste dpon slob 'di gnyis nas dus 'khor dang rig gnas kyi bshad rgyun 'phel ba ni gar 'brug gnyis sogs mtha' yas pa zhig yod pas bka' drin shin tu che ba yin no//slob ma'i mchog chos 'khor sgang ba lo chen shes rab rin chen ni/ yab don grub rgyal po

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 35dang / yum lha mo skyabs zhes bya ba'i sras su shing mo bya'i hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la 'khrungs/ mtshan dkon mchog skyabs su btags/ dgung lo bdun la yi ge thams cad mthar phyin/ slob dpon gzhan du byon pas yig phrug pa rgan gzhon bco lnga skor gyi slob dpon mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu'i bar du yab yum gyi dgongs pa bskang phyir rab tu byung rgyu ma byung yang / de'i lo thabs mkhas pos seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du rab tu byung / ka ri ka lnga bcu pa sogs mdo phyogs la sbyangs pa mdzad de bshad pa yang brtsams/ thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur/ gzhan yang chos 'khor ba yab sras kyi drung du mdo phyogs kyi chos thams cad legs par sbyangs shing / sngags kyi dkyil chog du ma dang / thig rtsa la sbyangs pas mkhas pa chen po rnams la yang dgag sgrub du ma mkhyen pa byung / de nas dbus 'bras spungs su 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan la mdo phyogs mang du gsan cing gra skor gzhung shin tu mang ba mdzad cing /gra skor gyi tshe yang chos 'brel zhu mkhan mang du byung /yar res rje byang sems pa'i drung du lam 'bras dus 'khor sogs gsang sngags kyi chos tshul mang du gsan/ dbyar shab dpal sding du sems dpa' chen po skad gnyis smra ba thugs rje dpal bzang po'i drung du phebs/ chos 'khor ba dang thugs 'brel che zhing / khyad par mtshan lam du dge slong chos gos ngur smig dang ldan pa khyad par can zhig dang mjal ba rmis gsungs nas shin tu dgyes par mdzad/ snga dro ka lā pa dang phyi dro tsand+ra pa'i bstan bcos tshugs/ rig gnas 'di la snga ma'i bag chags ma gtogs sku che 'dir thugs rtog ma chug cing / yig cha dkon pa dang / rnam rgyal 'joms/ dus 'bor sogs sngags du ma'i skad dod sbyor ba dang / yig rigs du ma mkhyen yang gar yang ma phyin pa lta bur song / yig cha thams cad thun bar la bris/ shog las mtshan mo byas/ tsha dre'i bar la gzhung bzung / srod tho rangs skyong ran mdzad pas shin tu bsnyel ba byung yang rags rim thugs su chud/ slar lo chen chos 'khor du spyan drangs/tha snyad rig gnas lnga char yongs su rdzogs par gsan cing mkhyen/ slob stong gsan rgya dpe mang po'i gnang sbyin dang bcas te rig gnas kyi bstan pa gtad/ de nas bo dong paṇa chen dang mjal/ gsung chos mang du gsan cing bsngags pa rgya cher mdzad/ de nas chos 'khor gyi gdan sar phebs/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pas yun ring du bstan pa bskyang zhing / nang du ting nge 'dzin zab mo la brtson par mdzad/ mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mang du mdzad cing rig gnas la yang / ka lā pa'i spyi don 'grel pa/ rig gnas kun shes kyi rtsa 'grel la sogs pa mang du mdzad cing / sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas sogs 'gyur

36 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/yang mang du mdzad/ bshad rgyun 'dzin pa'i slob ma yang / lug tshang rin po che/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin sngon mo/ rta nag rab 'byams pa shes rab chos 'byor/ slob dpon dka' bcu pa skyes mchog mgon bzang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan bzang po/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bsam 'grub 'od zer ba sku mched/ rta nag pa nor bzang rgya mtsho/ byams chen pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ se ra ba blo gros seng ge/ zha lu ba blo gros seng ge/ dgas po blo gros mtha' yas/ sgra dus la sbyangs pa kun dga' 'od zer sogs mang du byung zhing /khyad par slob ma'i mchog ni zha lu lo chen yin no //mthar bka' drin che ba zha lu lo chen ji ltar byon pa'i tshul/gsumapa/ mthar bka' drin che ba zha lu lo chen ji ltar byon pa'i tshul ni/ mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas zha lu gser khang zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du yab lung rtogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa 'gos kyi rigs sku zhang pa bsam 'grub dpal bzang po dang / yum bud med kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa rin chen chos 'dzom zhes bya ba'i sras su lcags pho byi ba'i lo la sku bltams/ mtshan chos skyong 'bum zhes bya bar gsol/ gzhon nu'i tshe yang sngon gyi bag chags kyi dbang gis/ dad brtson shes rab snying rje la sogs pa phun sum tshogs shing / sku rtsed kyi tshe yang chos 'chad pa dang / sgra bsgyur ba dang / yi ge 'bri ba la sogs pas dus 'da' zhing skabs 'gar ting nge 'dzin bzang po la snyoms par 'jug pa yang byung / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bkra shis rin chen pa la bod kyi klog yig bslabs pas sngar gyi bag chags chung ba la brten cung zad dka' ba tsam byung / de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis kyi bar du khyim pa'i tshul bzung yang /thos pa mang du mdzad/ nyer gnyis pa la mkhan po 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ slob dpon kun dga' dpal bzang gi drung du dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ nyer drug pa'i tshe/ mkhan po don grub grags pa dpal bzang / las kyi slob dpon bsod nams grags pa/ gsang ston bsod nams blo gros la sogs pa dad pa'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyes lhung gi dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas brtan chen por bzhugs pa yin no//de ltar gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas nas thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad tshul yang / sku zhang dge slong mkhan chen chos grub/ brag dmar rab 'byams pa bla ma don rin pa/ dka' bzhi thugs rje dpal ba/ bshes gnyen bzang po ba/ dge 'dun grub pa/ snye mo sku zhang pa/ ting 'dzin

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 37'od zer ba/ bsod nams grags pa/ gong ma kun dga' legs/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' dbang phyugago rams bsod nams seng ge bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rin dpal ba/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ sku zhang mkhyen rab mchoge grung / rab 'byams bde bzang pa/ kun bzang rtse pa/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa/ dka' thub pa stag lung nas bla ma rnam pa gsum/ kun mkhyen don yod dpal ba/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa/ dkon mchog tshul khrims/ snar thang ras chen la sogs pa'i yongs su 'dzin pa bcu phrag lnga bsten nas bod du 'gyur ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad dang / mdo phyogs kyi bshad lung mtha' yas pa/ sngags phyogs kyi dbang / byin rlabs/ rjes gnang / rgyud bshad/ snying po phyung ba'i don khrid la sogs pa mtha' dag thugs su chud cing / bsam pa'i sgro 'dogs rgya cher bcad pa yin la/ lhag par rig gnas kyi bshad rgyun nyams pa thams cad gso ba'i phyir du sgra rig pa chen po gnas brtan legs pa rgyal po/ dpal sdings sgra pa/ 'o1 chen grags pa rgya mtsho/ rgya ston lcags ri ba thar pa bzang po/ stag tshang ba lo tsā ba chen po shes rab rin chen/ chag lo bzhi pa rte'u ra pa rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ dgas po paṇa chen sogs mkhas pa mang du bsten nas tha na yig rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa nas bzung ste/ sgra dang / snyan ngag dang / sdeb sbyor dang / mngon brjod dang / zlos gar te tha snyad sde lnga po 'di dag la 'phags yul nas 'gyur zin pa'i gzhung chen po 'grel pa dang bcas pa mtha' dag dang /ma 'gyur ba mang po rgya dpe'i steng du gtan la phab/ mdor na thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs legs par bcad de/ ji snyed pa'i gnas thams cad ma 'dres par so sor 'chad pa'i nus pa thob/ rig pa'i gnas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i bdag po gcig pu par gyur pa yin no//lhag par stag tshang lo chen gyi drung du ka lā pa'i spyi ṭīka nyer mkho'i mdo so so 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ rig gnas phyi ma bzhi'i zab bshad/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mtha' dag gi bshad lung yongs su rdzogs par zhus/ thugs dgyes pa chen pos rjes su bzung zhing rig gnas kyi bstan pa gtad/ bshad rgyun dpag tu med par 'phel bar lung bstan pa yin la/ sems dpa' chen po thugs rje dpal gyi thugs sras mchog tu gyur pa/ lo tsā ba grags pa rgya mtshos tsand+ra pa'i mdo/ 'grel pa dharma dwa sa/nyer mkho'i mdo so so 'grel pa dang bcas zhib tu nan chags chen pos stsal zhing gsan pa yin no/ /de ltar rig gnas la mkhyen pa dpag par dka' bas/ dus 'khor 'grel chen/ dpag bsam 'khri shing la sogs pa'i bstan bcos brgya phrag tsam gyi rgya dpe dang bod dpe legs par sbyar te/ gzigs rtog

38 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/mdzad pa dang gzhan la 'doms par yang mdzad/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos sna tshogs gsal ba/'grel pa 'dod 'jo/ mu tig phreng ba/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa dbu ma la dga' bas mdzad pa la sogs pa'i gzhi 'gyur shin tu mang ba dang / byams chos lnga/ rgyud gsum/ me long / sdeb sbyor sogs gzhung shin tu mang po la 'gyur 'chos hor khongs gsab pa sogs kyi sgo nas ma 'gyur ba dang / log par bsgyur ba dang / 'gyur chad pa sogs mtha' dag gi dri ma bkrus nas/ bstan pa rin po che gsal ba las kyang ches shin tu gsal bar mdzad pa yin no//'gyur mdzad pa'i tshe ches shin tu myur ba yin te/ rje btsun nyid kyi rgya dpe rnams bod skad du bsgyur/ yi ge gcig kyang chad lhag med par gsung pa slob ma rnams kyis bod dpe bzung nas mnan pa na/ bod klog bzang ba kun gyis kyang non dka' bar gyur pa ni mngon sum du gsal lo/ /de ltar 'gyur mdzad pa'i tshul thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo chen gyi zhal snga nas gsung dngos las 'di skad ces gasdo/ngas te/bdag la yon tan skye ba dran pa sogs ma mchis/ rmi lam du sngar paṇḍi ta su rend+ra bo dhir gyur ces pa tsam rmi ba dran/ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis tshul khrims rin po che dang ma bral tsam dang /byang sems smon 'jug blo sbyong rim pas dran pa dang dad gus ma bral tsam du mchis/ lam rim gnyis yi dam lha dran pa dang / lam zab la dmigs rnam ma brjed ma dor tsam dang / lam gyi cha shas kyi nges shes 'dren pa lags/ skad gnyis smra ba'i lo stor gtogs tsam 'di snga ma'i bag chags dang / tshe 'dir mkhas pa bsten pas/ ka lā pa dang tsand+ra pa'i gzhung rdzogs pa'i sa ris slob sbyong dang / rgya dpe klog shes pas 'phags pa brgyad stong pa nyi khri dang 'bum gyi glegs bam dam dum/ sher phyin bdun brgya pa/ yi ge nyung ngu / sher snying / rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel chung dang bcas pa byams chos phyi ma bzhi/ rgyud bla 'grel chen/ dkon brtsegs/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod/ blo gros bzang pos zhus pa/ byams pas zhus pa sogs dang / 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ so thar mdo/ sum brgya pa/ me tog phreng rgyud/ las chog tshad ma rnam nges/ rnam 'grel/ gtan tshigs thigs pa/ rgyud gzhan grub pa/ 'grel brtag dbu ma rtsa ba/ 'jug pa/ bzhi brgya pa/ 'grel pa tshig gsal/ stong nyid bdun cu pa/ rig pa drug cu pa/ zhib mo rnam 'thag chos dbyings bstod pa/ byang chub sems 'grel/ don dam par bstod pa sogs bstod pa bzhi/ bshes springs rnams dang / gzhan yang slob springs/ spyod 'jug gzhon nu ma bdun

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 39gyi rtogs brjod/ rgyud sde las mtshan brjod 'grel pa phan yon dang bcas pa/ dus 'bor gyi dbang mdor bstan/ bsdus rgyud rtsa 'grel/ don dam snye ma/ rta 'dod mdor bstan/ dus 'khor sgrub thabs mai tri pas mdzad pa/ brtag gnyis/ gur/ saskru ṭi/ gur gyi 'grel pa lha'i rigs kyi blo gros/ kye rdo rje'i 'grel pa padma can gyi dka' 'grel/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ 'grel pa sgron gsal/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud phyag rdor bstod 'grel/ rdo rje snying 'grel/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi rgyud/ ārya de wa'i spyod bsdus sgron me/ rim lnga/ mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong rnams dang / bslab btus/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ mdo sde las brgya pa/ a bha ya'i phreng ba skor gsum/ dar paṇa ā tsarya'i kri ya sa mulga mngon pa mdzod rtsa ba/ rang 'grel/ de 'grel blo brtan/ sgra ka lā pa/ 'grel pa dur sing / u ṇa sogs kyi 'grel pa/ byings mdo/ tsand+ra pa/ 'grel pa chos 'bangs/ de'i 'grel bshad ratna ma ti/ mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod/ 'grel pa 'dod 'jo/ mngon brjod sna tshogs gsal ba/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas/ sman yan lag brgyad pa ste 'di rnams kyi rgya dpe dang bod dpe sbyar ba'i brda thog chig don la dpyod pa zhugs pas/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis chos bsgyur tshul/ rjes su dpag pa'i sgo nas rtogs par gyur pa lags/de dag gi skabs su sdig pa dag pa'i rtags khrus byas pa dang / chu'i gseb nas 'o ma 'thung ba dang /glegs bam rgya dpe bod dpe gser gyi ngos la padma rā gas bris pa dang / dar dang gos chen gyi ngos la lha dang yi ge spel te bris pa mthong ba sogs rmi lam du byung / mthi/69 zhes phyag bris ngo ma las byung bas/yid ches shing dad pas kun nas blangs te yongs su rdzogs par bris pa'o//rtogs pa'i yon tan yang gzhon nu'i dus su lha khang bskor du byon pa na/ mgon po beng gi skus rigs kyi bu khyod mngon par sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du kho bos bsrung ba dang / skyob pa dang / sba bar bya'o zhes gsung byon pas/ grong khyer gyi nad ngan pa bsrung ba'i thugs dam mdzad pa na/ gdugs mchog tu mdzes pa nyis rim phub pa'i sgrol ma'i sku dngos su bstan nas/ grong khyer bsrung ba'i tshul mdzad par gzigs pa dang / mnal lam du dpal ldan birnya pa la kye rdo rje'i dbang bskur gsan pa dang / khams pa brtson 'grus zhes bya ba'i mi ngan zhig gis rje'i phyag rdzas mang du brkus pa zin kyang slar gnang ba dang /bstan pa dang sems can la phan na dmyal ba'i g.yang sa la yang 'jigs par mi bya zhes gsungs shing /zhal gyis bzhes pa sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab/ de nas dbus su byon/ stag lung chos rje/ zhwa nag pa/ zhwa dmar ba sogs bla chen gsum la sgra dang snyan ngag gi gsung gi bdud rtsi yang yang stsal/ zhwa nag

40 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/cod pan 'dzin pa chos grags rgya mtshos spyan ras gzigs kyi sku shin tu legs pa sogs gnang sbyin dge rin twa sod ri ryā li rtan 'od khyi wī phro nā nas cir rnyi ko rnyi na rig ko sne'i rū da phro sde' zhu si ṭwā bas pa'i tha snyad rig gnas kun legs par slob pa'i bstan pa'i sgron mer bkas yang yang bskul zhing bsngags pa rgya cher stsal/ nga gsum pa la rgya ston lcags ri ba'i gdan sar phebs/ nga lnga pa la gra pa mngon shes can gyi gdan sar phebs/ don bzhi pa la bu ston rin po che'i gdan sar phebs te/ spyir mdo sngags gnyis dang / lhag par rig gnas la bshad rgyun yang yang spel/gsung rtsom kyang ka tsan gyi spyi don/ 'grel pa rnam pa gnyis/ byings mdo'i bsdus don/ ka lā pa'i sa bcad/ nyer bsgyur gyi 'grel pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa/ sdeb sbyor gyi gnad bsdus pa/ dag yig za ma tog ani'i byings sgrub pa sogs sngags kyi byings sgrub mang po/mtshams sbyor gyi 'grel pa gnyis sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad pas gangs ri'i khrod kyi blo gsal gzur gnas thams cad kyi bkur sti'i gnas dam pa dang / lhag par rig gnas kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa yin no//de ltar gsung las skyes pa'i thos pa 'dzin pa yang gangs ri'i khrod kyi mkhas pa dang grub pa thams cad kyi cod pan dam pa 'jam dbyangs pa lo tsā ba gnyis pa kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rje btsun sprul pa'i lo tsā ba ratna bha dra/ mthu stobs chos rje ngag dbang bsod nams mtshan can/ nyid kyi dbon po lo tsā ba chen po padma dkar po/ skyog lo tsā ba ngag dbang rin chen bkra shis/ ka tsan gyi don khong du chud cing / gangs can gyi brda'i tshul la ma rmongs pa'i g.ya' bzang pa mkhas btsun dbang po la sogs te/ mkhas pa chen po sa skya lo tsā sogs/ /lo tsā legs par shes pa rnam dgu dang / /gangs can khrod na tha snyad gtsug lag la/ /legs par bya ba'i mkhas pa du ma yod/70/ces gsungs pa ltar 'e1 tsā ba chen po dgu dang / tha snyad rig gnas la mkhas pa dpag tu med pas gangs can gyi ljongs thams cad khyab ste bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad cing / der ma zad rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po dpon slob 'di nyid kyi bka' drin las/ ding sang gi bar du bshad rgyun cher rgyas shing /slad nas kyang mi nyams pa bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du dar zhing rgyas pa ni thugs rje dang smon lam gyi mthu las so/ /gzhan yang sngags kyi bshad rgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma ni/ mkhas grub o rgyan rdzong pa/rtses thang 'bum rams pa/ mkhan chos grub song ge/ rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po sogs mang du yod pa

tha snyad rig gnas lnga byung tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ 41rnams kyis kyang dbang bshad khrid rgyun sogs rgyas par spel ba yin no//gya bdun pa la rang gi dbon lo tsā ba padma dkar po gdan sar bskos/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te bde bar gshegs/ dbon lo tsā bas phyi rten nang rten gshegs rdzongs dpag tu med pas dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad cing / gdan sa yun ring du bskyangs/nyid kyi gsung rgyun sngags dang rig gnas kyi bstan pa rgyas par spel/ nyid kyi zhal slob rnams kyi mchog rje btsun sa lo tsā ba ni/ lo chen nyid kyis kyang tshe 'dir lan re zung re thos tsam gyis gzhung lugs kun shes/ chos kyi rje sa paṇḍi ta dang nges par gnyis su med pa'o/ /zhes gus pa'i thal mo yang yang zum par mdzad cing / nyid kyi gsung las kyang / 'gos lo dharma pa la'i zhal snga nas/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur sa lugs dang / /jo zhal lugs kyi sbyor drug la sogs zhus/ /ka lā tsand+ra rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /sna tshogs gsal ba snyan ngag me 'e1nga dang / /dpag bsam 'khri shing la sogs tha snyad kyi/ /gtsug lag phal cher zhus shing nan tan byas/ /rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur la sogs pa/ /dus dang don la 'jug tshul cung zad shes/ /saṃ skṛta dang bod kyi klog tshul la/ /snga rabs 'chad tshul rab tu mang na yang / /skyon med 'dri dang brjod pa'i tshul shes pa/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan 'di nyid bka' drin las/ /gzhan la 'chad dam rang nyid nyams su len/ /ji ltar byed kyang lag nom mi dgos tsam/71 /zhes gsungs shing spyir mdo sngags mtha' dag gi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad cing / lhag par ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub sogs mkhas pa mang po la rig gnas kyi bshad rgyun rgyas par stsal zhing / ding sang gi bar ngu yang ngor phyogs na shin tu dar ba byung ngo //rje btsun sprul pa'i lo chen ratna bha dras kyang / spyir
