no༅༅/ /bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//zha lulo stob chos skyong bzang po/༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ subhaṇita ratna skaraṇḍasgyunya nā ma stoṭasu saṅgenya shā st+ra/ bod skad du/ bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba/1 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi gsung zer cha tsam gyis kyang seṅge khyab 'jug 'phrog byed dbang phyug nor gyi gnyen tshangs pa sogs kyi/ /gzhung lugs kun da'i tshal rnams zum mdzad gser mngal can tshangs pa dang dpal gyi mgrin la dbang phyug sogs brgya byin dang khyab 'jug dang smin drug bu dang lus ngan dang tshogasabadag sogs pa/ /'jig rten 'di na che bar rab grags lha mchog kun gyis gang gi zhabs pad la//gus pas btud pa'i lha mi'i bla ma zas gtsang sras pos rtag tu dge legs mdzod//de sras thu bo 'jam pa'i dpal/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag rdor sogs sogs pa'i/ /bstan pa sdud mdzad sems dpa' che/ /rnams la'ang gus pas phyag 'tshal 61/ /nges par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las pa/ /gangs can khrod pa'i bla ma mchog /sasto ṭa zhes rab grags pa'i/ /bstan pa sdud mdzad dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen khri nyis stong pa las sdud pa po rnams kyis theg pa gsum bod kyi yul du ni bod skad kyis bris zhes gsungs pas 'di sdud pa por bstan gsungs zhabs la 'dud/ /mkhan po 'di yis mdzad pa'i brda/ /gsung rab bde blag rtogs pa'i sgo/ /blang dor gsal bar ston pa'i tshul/ /'bad pa du mas bsgrub par rigs/ /mkhas pa du mas mang bshad kyang / /thams cad brjod par mi nus pas/ /'di ni 'khrul gzhi can gyi brda//'ga' zhig rang gzhan don du 'god/ /zhabrul gzhi med pa rnams kyang skad kyi 'jug pa shes pa'i phyir bstan na'ang skyon med mod kyang de dag ni go sla ba dang 'dir yi ge nyung ngur bya ba'i phyir ro//sdom la/ sngon 'jug dang mgo gsum med pa'i rkyang pa ga dang ba ma 'a'i 'phul can ra la sa'i mgo can no//re re'ang bod kyi lugs gsal byed tha ma a yig go dang / /i u e tse( ya ra la/ /wa yig rjes 'jug bcu yis brgyan//

116 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/1 rkyang pa'i brda bye brag tu bshad pa/dper na/ ka mig la sngon 'jug mgo gsum med pa/ gsal byed tha ma dang dbyangs bzhi dang ya ra la wa dang rjes 'dug gis phye ba'i brda sde/ ga) ka ba ka tan ka ra dang / /ka ma la padma dang ka pā la thod pa'i snod dang / /ka lā pa gnas gabla dus/ /dus kyi bskal pa la 'di ltar byed pa lo tsā ba ma ti shrīs jo nang lo stor grag skad sor bzhag yin pa'i dbang gis mdzad de 'gal ba med do/ /ke ke ru dang keng rus dang / /ka la piṅka ko ba dang / /glang chen thal gar yungs skar za/ /krog krog sgra skad lham krad dang / /'on kyang khyod kyis lcags kyus btab/ /kye kye kyal ka klan ka spongs/ /shing kun sman yin mang tshig kun/ /ko'u shi ka ko'u shi ka ste mkhas pa sogs mang po la 'jug go /sor bzhag sgra/ /kyi spyod kla klo dud 'gro klu/ /klad pa klad kor stod kor sogs kyang mtshon klad kyi don/ /'byam klas mtha' klas chu klung du/ /rus krang krong nger bsdad pa sogs skyil krung bcas klog 'don/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas/ /'dir ni kwa ye bod pa'i tshig/kha) khang pa khams bde khon 'dzin med/ /'di rnams sngon 'jug dang pha la ra btags spang bar bya'o/ /khong khro khron pa khra bo mdog /khrag khrig khri grangs sha khrag dang / /khrung khrung khral 'jal seng ge khri/ /go khrab ri mo'i khram kha dang / /sna khrid tshul khrims khris 'jags dang / /khru gang khrel yod khrun ring gos/ /khrums stod khrums smad 'di gnyis skar ma'o/ /khrag khrug dang 'thab krol dang dpe cha 'dzings pa/ /khrus bya khro bo dur khrod khros/ /chu khrems khrom nas khrol tshags nyos/ /lcags kyi sil khrol rol mo'i bye brag khre ni 'bru/ /'dir ni khwa ni 'dab chags so//ga) grong khyer grangs med grags pas khyab/ /chos grwar grul bum grib gnon bsrungs/ /grub thob rim gro gral rim bzhin/ /grib dang grib ma'i gnod las grol/ khuspyong po rig pa gros mkhas skar ma nam gru'ang ngo nang zhugs/ /grang ba'i nad med shin tu grims rig pa sha skud pa sogs/ /rtse mo'i gra ma shing gra ma 'bru yi gro/ /ngam grog gcong rong gron can zas gron che grod pa can/ /ral gri gos kyis gril zhes grag /grum bu'i nad kyis grongs pa med/ /glegs bam pu sti ka glu dbyangs gling bu dang / /glo bur gtam gleng gleng gzhi gleng mo sogs glang po che/ /gling gling bzhi sogs dang glo bur gzhogs kyi slo dang nang khrol glo ba dang nad kyi glo'am 'di dang tshigs don mthun no srog gi glud/ /g.yal ba'i glal seng ge rnam bsgyings/ seng ge glal zhes 'gyur gyi khyad do dang leb mor glebs/ /gla rngan gla ri dwags gla ba'ang ngo rtsi rig pa glen/ /gla gor shing gi sman zho sha glog 'khyug slong nam mkha'i

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 117grong chu'i rba slong zhesaso//ca) ca co thor cog mu cor dang / /cod pan be con cig car spang / /cang shes cong rol mo dang cang te'u brdung ḍa ma sda /sems can spyi cer skra med pa'o yin no cog cog bu'ang 'di'o/ /ga da ba yi rjes kyi cing rtag cing bshad cing zab cing sogs/ /ces dang rtag ces bsad ces rgyab ces lta bu 'dri ba'i tshig gi ci ci slad ci phyir lta bu//nyung ba'i cung zad kha cig dang / /skad cig la sogs sum cu drug cu bdun cu brgyad cu sogs/ /cig sgordzos dang ni gyur cig shog cig ston cig nyon cig shod cig sogs/ /dkon cog dkon mchog dang rin chen yang 'thad rin cen ce spyang dang // cha)'di rnams cha rkyang pa las gzhan du 'phul can dang phya byas na 'grul par ston chibs pa cha de chu zheng gab//chu bo dar gyi chun po dang / /rin po che dang 'bru yi chan/ /rgyal po'i chad pa myos 'gyur chang // ja) rdzo bo ja sigs ji snyed dang / /ji skad ji srid ji ltar dang / /je cher song nas jag pa byas// nya)'di rnams la ma mya spong bar ston nyon mongs can gyis nya sha nyos//ta) gtsug tor dkon cog ta la la sgron me dang ye shes sgron me zhes pa'ang 'jug/ /ting 'dzin rgyal po me tog dang / /mu tig chun po ting shags dang / /lo tog ta la'i 'dab ma til/ /sle tres tig tas nan tan du/ /yon tan rin chen tog phyir mchod/ /tug ring tug chom tog tog sgra/ /rtag tu nan tur shin tu byas/ /rgyab tu gal te pha rol tu/ /brtags te bstan te legs bstar te/ /stsal to gyur to phyin to sogs//tha) thig thig 'dul ba las 'byung lham gyi sgra skad ces//da) shing drung drang srong drang por bzhugs/ /ma dros klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa la'ang mtsho ru g.yung drung brnyes/ /phyi dro snga dro'i dus drug smin drug sogs tu/ /dri ba kun gyi dris lan 'debs/ /drag po drag shul nor gyis dregs/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog dril bu dang / /dri mchog dra ba dra phyed dang / /bka' drin dran dang dred lpags dang / /dre'u rngog dang dri mas sbags/ /drod dang dro ba sa la drud/ /khrims sogs dral lcam dral la'ang ngo dang zas drangs drongs/ /tshem drub dang ni thal ba'i drags/ /ya rabs dra ma la sogs pa/ /da yig ra btags can du bri//pa)pang pa'i par bu snod pa wa sangs/ /gcig pur pir gyis pi wang bris/ /pu shu'i mda' yab pu shud bya pi pi ling drod sman/ /pra phab me long sogs la stag gi pags pa rbesags// pha) 'di rnams la 'phul yig sogs spang phra ma phrag ngesag phrag pa lus kyi dang / /phran tshegs brgya phrag mi pham maboston/ /phra zhib rdul phran

118 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/phrug gu dang / /tshig phrad rgyan gyi phyang phrul phyal/ /phyang nge ba dang phru ma mngal gyi phru ma dang dmag gi phru ma btab ces pa'o dang / /phru ba shur bu phre'u ska rags kyi bye brag dang / /phyogs bcur tsan dan phye ma 'thor/ /gnas su phyin dang shugs nas phyung / /phyag dar 'gro don phyad par byed/ /phyag tu phyed phul nor gyis phyug /mi gtsang phyi sa phyi rol dor//ba) byin rlabs gnas su bla bre bres/ /byi brun sa yi dong du brubs/ /brag ri'i byang gi bram ze rnams/ /yi ger bris la bsod snyoms brims/ /byes nas byon la byug pa byin/ /byis pas bran gyi bya ba byos/ /brang lus kyi brang yang ngo 'gro'i dug rnams byams pas thul/ /bre yis bshar ba'i bye mas brab/ /byad dang byur rnams byabs pas byer/ /byol song byag mkhan shin tu brel/ /bro gar bro bor mna' bskyal ba'i ming bro nad nad kyi ming dang / /chu brug chu brug par snang pa dang bru ba tsha ltogs pa'o/ /thabs bral 'dam bying brang nger snang / /rin chen byu 〈co byi la dang / /bla ma'i bla dwags bde blag 'dir nges par zhes pa'am the tshom med pa'am zab mo zhes pa'i don dang / /blon po blo gros rna ba blags rna ba gtod pa'i don/ /blun po rin gyis blus kyang bla rung zhes rsā ma chog gam bzod ces pa'i don no/ /bla med bla gos bla gab steng g.yogs pa'o dang / /sman bla spyi blugs bla na gong na zhes pa'o gnyan/ /sos blad lan blan chu blud sogs/ /rig pa mi gsal ba'i blong blong dang tshon rtsi ba bla sogs ba yig ya ra la yis brgyan// ma/ myur bar ro myags 'dam las rgol/ /myang 'das ro myang bde ba myong / /nags myul myu gu'i chang gis myos//tsag tsug tsug zas za ba'i kha'i sgra mi bya tsog tsog pur/ /'dug pa de tsam de tsug lags/ /ne tso tsam pa ka me tog/ tsha) nags tshal skyed tshal tshon gyi bkra/ /lang tsho ldan pa'i sde tshan tshogs/ /lan tshwa'i chu sogs 'phul med can// wa) wa ni dud 'gro'i bye brag ste//zha) zhu zha mgo g.yogs yan lag nyams// za) zu ni sngo tshod tsher ma can/ /mkha' yi zla ba zla grogs dang / /dus kyi zla ba mya ngan zlo/ /sngags zlos zlos gar gzhan la zlo/ /zla gam zlum po zlas dbye dang / /'gran zla med dang zlog pa sogs// 'a) de'i rgyan tshig le'ur byas pa dag /ko'u shi ka go'u ta ma/ /dpal be'u rnge'u chung dud 'gro sprelu/ra/ rwa ni dud 'gro'i mgo la skyes/ /rlabs chen dba' rlabs byin rlabs rlobs/ /mngon rlom rlom sems rlom pa can/ /kha rlangs rlon pa rdul du rlog /rlung gis dgra bo rlag par byed/ /khung bu'i rlubs dang mdoms kyi rlig/

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 119sha) shar phyogs shel gyi gnas shig na/ /'dab chags shang shang shing khar shi/ khul du shing zan gyis shes 'dzer/ /shes ldan sham thabs shur bus bcings/ /shed bu shed bdag shed las skyes//shun lpags dang ni shub bus zlos//sa) 'di rnams kyang sa yig sngon 'jug med pa'i sde tshan yin sangs rgyas sor mo se mo do/ /sil sil sgra ldan sil snyan dang / /sen mo zangs mdog so rnams dkar/ /'od srungs sras bcas lam srang du/ /sra mkhregs srid pa srul po'i phyir/ /srin po lus srul tshe srog za/ /rnams la'ang srod dang sa sros tshe/ /drang srong lam srol brtse bas ston/ /dud 'gro sram dang sreg pa sogs/ /yid srubs 'di 'dod pa'i ming yin la srub shing srub thag sogs kyang ngo las byung sre nag rnams/ /ye shes mes sreg srab mor mdzad/ /ces pa rkyang pa'i brda bye brag tu bshad pa ste rnam par bcad pa dang po'o//2 ba yig gi 'jug pa bye brag tu bshad pa/rkyang pa bas 'asdo/la ba/na maḥsasto ṭā ya/ de yang 'jam dbyangs sprul pa yis/ /rtagasakyi 'jug pa las pho yi yi ge 'ba' zhig la/ /sde pa phyed dang brgyad gnas pa'ang / /sde tshan lnga ru dril byas la/ /pho dang ma ning mo dang ni//shin tu mo dang bzhi bzhi ru/ /sde pa bzhi pa yan chad dbye/ /lhag ma bcu bzhi gnas pa la/ /tsa sogs gsum ni tsa tsha dza dang ca sogs ca cha ja dang sbyar/ /wa ni ba dang sbyar bar bya/ /lhag ma drug ni zha za 'a ya sha sa dang mo ru sbyar/ /ra la ha ni mo gsham ste/ /ma ning mtshan medaces kyang bya/2 /zhes gsung de yang 'di ltar dbye//phyogs su lhung ba nyi shu dgu/ /a yig sum cu pa ni phyogs lhung med/ /ka ca ta pa tsa rnams pho/ /kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning / /ga ja da ba dza wa zha /za 'a ya sha sa rnams mo/ /nga nya na ma shin tu mo/ /ra la ha ni mo gsham mo/ /mo gsham dang ni shin tu mo/ /gnyis kyang mo las gzhan du min//yang de nyid las mo yi yi ge'i nang nas ni/ /'jug pa'i yi ge bcu dbyung bya/ /ga nga da na ba ma 'a/ra la sa rnams rjes 'jug go /'jug pa bcu yi nang nas ni/ /sngon 'jug yi ge lnga dbyung bya/ /ga da ba ma 'a rnams so/ /sngon 'jug yi ge lnga po la/ /pho dang ma ning mo dang ni/ /shin tu mo dang bzhi ru dbye/ /ba dang ga da 'a dang ma/ /rim pa bzhin du sbyar bar bya/ /de dag re re'ang bzhi byed de/ /gang la 'jug byed gang gis byed/ /ji ltar 'jug byed ci phyir byed/ /pho ni pho dang mo la 'jug /mo ni mo dang ma ning la'o/ /ma ning

120 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/yang ni pho mo la'o/ /shin tu mo ni ma ning dang / /mo dang shin tu mo nyid la'o/3 /zhes pa'i tshig kyang 'di ltar dbye/ /ba yig 11na 'i〈cog 'dir yang ka ga sa gsum rkyang brtsegs gnyis ka 'phul/ ra la gnyis brtsegs pa kho na 'phul gzhan rnamasarkyang pa kho na 'phul lo/ /mkhas pa dag gis kyang brtsegs pa 'phul ba ba lasamed ces bshad do 21 yin pas//ming gzhi'i pho yig ka ca dang / /ta tsa bzhi dang mo yig ga da zha/ /za sha sa na ra la'o dgu la'o/ /mo yig 'a ni ming gzhi yi/ /mo yig ga ja da ba dza/ /ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha/ /ma ning ga dang da gnyis ni/ /pho mo'i yi ge la 'jug ste/ /ga ni pho yig ta ca tsa/ /mo yig da zha za ya sha /sa nya na dang bcu gcig la'o/ /da ni pho yig ka pa dang / /mo yig ga nga ba ma la'o/ /ma yig 'phul byed shin tu mo/ /de ni ma ning kha cha dang / /tha tsha mo yig ga ja da/ /dza nya nga na bcu gcig la'o//mi 'jug pa ni 'di dag ste/4 /sngon 'jug pho ba yig ni ming gzhi'i ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha rnams la ni mi 'jug /sngon 'jug mo 'a yig ni pho ka ca ta pa tsa rnams la 'jug pa min/ /ma ning kha cha tha pa tsha rang ming gzhi'i ga da gnyis po sngon 'jug gi ma ning yin pas la rang mi 'jug /rang gi sde dang phrad pa na/ /sngon 'jug pho ba yig yang ming gzhi'i ma yig lta bu mo la 'i〈cog mi 'gyur/ /ga da gnyis po ma sngon 'jug gi ning yin pas ming gzhi'i pho mo la spyir 'jug kyang rang sde dang phrad pa'i tshe/ ka dang nga gnyis ming gzhi'i pho mo yin kyang gas mi 'phul/ ta dang na gnyis das mi 'phul ba sogs shes par bya'o mo yang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na/ /pho ni drag po'i tshul gyis te/ /ma ning ran par 'jug pa yin/ /mo ni zhan pa'i tshul gyis 'jug /shin tu mo ni mnyam pas so/ /sgra drag ༈ bar ma gsum dang sgra mnyam par 'byung zhes pa ste/ dper na bkas drag/ gda' ran/ 'ga' zhan/ mkha' mnyam zhes pa lta bu ci phyir 'i〈rgyag par byed ce na/ /pho ni ba yig 'das dang gzhan bsgrub phyir/ /gos bkab lam bstan lta bu'o ma ning ga da gnyis ka da ltar gzhon nu chos la gzhol/ dga' bas dgod ched/ /mo ni bdag dang ma 'ongs phyir 'byang bar 'gyur/ 'byung /'ongs phyir/ zhan tu mo ma yig ni mnyam mkhyen pa mnga' mnyam par gzhog mngon sum mjal phyir ro/ /zhes par sngon 'jug gtan la phab//bas rkyang pa'i yi ge 'phul ba/da ni de dag so so yi/ /brda yi 'jug pa bstan pa'i phyir/ /rim pa bzhin du spro bar bya/ /thog mar sngon 'jug gi pho bas 'phul bshad pa la/ /rkyang 'phul dang ni brtsegs 'phul lo/ /ka ca ta tsa ga da zha /za sha sa ༄ po rnams rkyang 'phul te/ /dper brjod rim bzhin bstan par bya//

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 121bka) gnang bkag 'gro ba bkag sogs ni 17da bkang thugs dam bskang sogasabakad sa zas kyi g.yo khang dang / /lag pa bkan dang gos sogs bkab/ /bka' bsgo 'o1gas su bkar ba dang / /khal dang khral dang srad bu bkal/ /dum bur bkas dang mdun du bkug /srog bkums pa dang mang pos bkur sogs bkur sti dang / /khu ba 'byid pa'i sman bku ba dang khu ba bton pa'i sman bkus te bor/ /bde la bkod dang zur du snod spyad sogasabakol ba bkol/ /bcings pa'i bkyigs dang sgyurta nya bkye sprul pa bkye 'od bkye lta bu/ /rnam bkra bkra shis bkrag mdangs can/ /rgyal pos bkrabs dang me tog bkram/ /khral sogs dgongs pa bkral bkral dang khrid pa'i bkri gzhan gyis bkri bar mi btub lta bu/ /khrus kyis bkru/ bkru/sa dbul ba'i bkren//ltogs pa'i bkres dang bsad pa'i bkrongs/ /mdud pa dgongs pa bcings pa bkrol/ /mdo sde bklags sogs bas 'phul ga'o//bca) bza' bca' dam bca' dang khrims bca' sogs zhabs kyis bcags pa dang / /lag tu bcangs nor bcangs pa sogs dang shing sogs bcad/ /nyes pa bcabs dang mig sogs bcar/ /nor bcol khrims bcas phyir bcil dang / /bcing bas bcings dang nang du bcug /bcad len ras nang du zas kyi bcud sogs nang du bcum pa dang / /bcu dang bzhi bcu lnga bcu dang / /dgu bcu bcu tshanabazhi po 'di la bas 'phul yod pa yin no dang ni chu bcu dang / /bco lnga bco brgyad bcom ldan 'das/ /dgra bcom bstan bcos ras bcos bu bcos ma la'ang ngo / /las bcol la sogs bas 'phul ca'o//bta) ming btags blos btang spyir btang dang / /ri bo btang bzung btang snyoms dang / /sa bon btab dang gdan btings dang / /sngags btu kun las btus dang btud zhabs lags sogs/ /rung ba'i btub dang dgra bo btul/ /sgom gyi btung ba byes su bteg /de sogs ba yis 'phul ba'i ta//btsa) dmar ba'i btsag dang tshags kyis btsags zhes pa'ang ngo bka' btsan dang / /lcags kyi btsa' dang nor sogs btsal/ /bu btsas ko btsas gru btsas la btsas kyang btsan dug dang / /'chir ba'i btsir dang shing sogs btsugs/ /nang du btsud dang btsun pa dang / /btsun mo mig btsums gos btsems dang / /btso blag mkhan chos mkhan no dang btso ma'i gser/ /ngan pa'i btsog rdeg btsog kyang dang sgog btsong dang / /tshos kyi btsod dang btson du bzung / /zong du btsongs dang tshos kyis btsos/ /de rnams tsa yig bas 'phul can//bag) lam bgags pa dang gad mo bgad/ /sad pa'i bgam dang gegs byed bgegs//

122 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/bgo ba bgos dang dus sogs brgyangs 'apyongs zhes pa'ang 'thad/ /bya ba'i bgyi dang byed pa'i bgyid/ /byas pa'i bgyis dang grangs kyi bgrangs bgrang phreng 'ang ngo / /mig sogs bgrad bsgrad bsgrad ces pa'ang 'thad dang rgan pa'i bgres/ /gros byed bgro sogs bgro gleng lta bu bas 'phul ga'o//bad) bdag gzhan bdag po bda' 'ded pa'i bda' ba dang bda' ded byed pa ba'i zas/ /mdun du bdar dang phyugs sogs bdas/ /bdug spos shug pa sogasabadud dang bdud rtsi dang / /grangs kyi bdun dang sim pa'i bde/ /bde gshegs bden gnyis bdog pa'i nor/ /gzhu bdungs zhes pa'ang bas 'phul yin no dar ba'i bdo sogs bas 'phul da'o//bzha) gnas su bzhag zin nang khrol bzhag kyang ngo gad mo bzhad/ /bzhugs nas 'gro dang bzhams bsgo byed/ /brlan pa'i bzha' bzher ba dang dang skra sogs bzhar/ /grangs kyi bzhi dang de bzhin nyid/ /skar ma me bzhi gro bzhin dang / /byi bzhin dpang po'i che bzhi grangs kyi bzhi min sno dang / /byad bzhin mar bzhu stan la bzhugs/ /'byon bzhud bzhun nor bzhun g.yog bzhun sogs dang stan las bzhengs//dgongs bzhed zas bzhes 'o ma bzho/ /bzhon pa rta sogs zhon sogs bas 'phul zha'o//bza) bza' ba bza' mi dang rgya mo bza' bal mo bza' sogs bzang po bzabs nas gzabs zhes kyang 'thad sbyin/ /zas bzas myos pa'i bzi ba dang / /gtum pa'i mi bzad lag pas bzung / /lhung bzed snod kha bzed pa'ang bzod zhal bzo bo dang / /bzod pa tshogs bzlums gcig tu bzlums/ /gzungs sngags bzla bzlas mya ngan bzla/ /mi bzlog pa dang g.yul bzlog sogs/ /za yig sngon du ba zhugs can//bsha) sdig bshags bshang gci chos sogs bshad/ /bkod pa bshams dang bre la bshar/ /chus bshal gsad bya'i bshas dang ni/ /mkhar sogs bshig dang ko lpags bshus/ /bsher mal byed dang mdza' bzhes dang / /bshes gnyen g.yo ba'i bgo ba dang / /g.yos pa'i bsgos dang lha bsgos dang //phyi bshol la sogs bas 'phul sha'o//bas) tshogos bsags dri mas sbags pa bsangs/ /sems can bsad dang drin lan bsabs//bsam pa bsam bya bsams pa dang / /bkag pa bsal dang dmigs bsal dang / /mdun nas bsu dang dri bsung dang / /ri dwags bse ru ko ba'i bse/ /nor bsogs bsod nams bsod snyoms dang // bsod pa'i zas sogs bas 'phul sa'o//

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 123sa mgo can bas 'phul ba/de rnams rkyang pa brtsegs pa yi/ /sa ra la rnams 'phul tshul ni/ /rim pa bzhin du dgod bya ste// bska)ro bska ba a ru ra'i ro lta bu dang kha bskangs ma tshang ba dang / /chu bo bskams dang yul gyis bskal bskal don sha za'ang / /bskal pa dus yin sbas pa'i bskungs/ /byug pa bsku bskus yan lag bskums//'phrin dang dbang bskur chos la bskul/ /drin gyis bskyangs dang bskyad du med dpag tu med/ /'jigs las bskyabs dang snod mi bskyam lhung bzed mi bskyam zhes pa lta bu/ /slar yang bskyar dang gnas su bskyal//'phos pa'i bskyas dang nor bskyi bskyis pa'ang dang / /bskyin pa 'jal dang 'khyil ba'i bskyil/ /gcom bskyungs pa dang bya ba bskyungs/ /brjed pa'i bskyud dang bya ba bskyur/ /sems sogs bskyed dang mi bskyod dang / /bskor ba gos bskon rgyal sar bskos/ /gnas nas bskrad dang zas la bskru/ /bskyed pa'i bskrun dang rta la bskyon/ /de rnams bas 'phul sa mgo'i ga'o//bska)mna' bsgags pa dang bya ba'i dngos gzhi bsgang / /bu ram bsgar dang 'phrang du bsgugs//bag chags bsgo bsgos bka' bsgo dang / /gcig tu bsgongs dang ting 'jin bsgoms/ /seng ge rnam bsgyings kha dog bsgyur/ /chog bsgrags chu bsgral phyogs gcig bsgrigs/ /bsgrin mi phod dang 'od sogs bsgribs/ /blo bsgrims bsgrub bya bsgrun mi nus/ /bya ba bsgrub pa rigs bsgre rgyal mtshan bsgreng //gzhan gyis mi bskul srad bu bsgril/ /gan rkyal bsgyel sogs bas 'phul sga'o//bsnga) sdug bsngal spang phyir dge ba bsngo/ /bsngags pa brjod dang kha dog rnam par bsngos pa'i 'du shes zhes bsngos//zhes pa bas 'phul sar btags nga'o//bsnya/ rgyu mtshan bsnyad dang phar la bsnyabs/ /phan tshun bsnya/mas dang thang la bsnya/la/ /lhung bzed bsnyigs dang phyir bskrad bsnyel/ /na ba'i bsnyun snyun zhes pa nad kyi ming yin la 'di ni tsha ba'i snyun gyis bsnyun zhes pa lta bu ste na ba'i ming ngo dang rjes bsnyegs dang / /'jigs pa'i bsnyengs dang bsnyen bkur dang / /dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas bsnyen rdzogs dang / /zas bstod bston tol bsnyon can bston dor can sogs kyang nas sogs bstor/ /zhes sogs yo byad bsnyangs pa zhes pa'ang ngo ba yis 'phul ba'i lha'o//bsta) bsti stang bstang mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstang bas yongs su ma bzung dang / /zhes pa'o bas ma bzung dang / /sna bstad pa dang 'gro chas bstad/ /bstan bcos dang ni gzhan la bstan/ /byin len bstabs dang bsti gnas ngal gso ba'i gnas dang / /thung ngu bstungs dang slar yang bsdud/ /gzhung dang

124 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/bstun bya ba stun pa sogs dang bzabs pa'i bstar/ /'phya ba'i bsting dang bstod pa byed/ /mngon par bstod dang mkhas pa bsten/ /de sogs bas 'phul sa ta'o//bsda/ stan la bsdad dang nyes pa bsdams/ /bsdu bya bsdu ba phan tshun bsdur/ /mdor bsdus pa dang phan tshun bsdebs/ /grabs kyi bsdogs dang nyer bsdogs dang / /phyogs gcig bsdoms dang srog dang bsdos/ /gzhan la bsdigs sogs bas 'phul sda'o//bsnan mang du bsnan dang phyag tu bsnams/ /gnad bsnun dang mtshon dang nu ma bsnun/ /srol sogs bsnubs dang brnubs zhes kyang ngo dus sogs gong 'og sogs bsnur/ /gong 'og bsnol dang bsnor ba sogs/ /bas 'phul sa la na btags pa'o//bsra/ bzod bsran yon po bsrang ba dang / /bsrabs pa'i sa dang bya ba'i mi blo bsras can zhesapa bsral/ /nor bsri ba dang yun du bsring / /bskur ba'i bsrings dang bsrung ba dang bgegs sogs/ /dul ba ma yin mi bsrun dang / /gcig tu bsre dang bsreg bya dang / /ring bsrel dang ni 'chang ba'i bsrel/ /me la bsro dang bsro khang sogs/ /bas 'phul sa la ra btags pa'o//bslad gyen du bslang dang slong mo bslangs/ /skyon gyis ma bslad bslab bya dang / /zla la bslan dang bslu ba med/ /la sogs ba yis 'phul ba'i sla//ra mgo can bas 'phul ba/brka) nor 'di bya ba dang 'brel bas bas 'phul yod brku ba dang brkus pa dang / /'dod la brkam dang sa bsko brkos bya ba dang 'brel/ /sra brkyang dang ni yan lag brkyangs/ /la sogs bas 'phul ra mgi'i ga'o//brgya) brgal lan brgal brtag kyang ngo brgya phrag brgyad cu brgyad/ /brgyud mar 'byung bla ma brgyud pa'ang ngo dang rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dran med brgyal dang dbyug pa brgyab/ /'o brgyal chu bo las brgal dang //'phreng sogasabargyus dang myur du brgyugs/ /smra ba'i khasabargya bar zad ces bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma las bshad cing /ding sang yang zhal brgya byas zhal brgyas zhes sogs 'phral phal skad la snang ngo brgya dang lam brgyags dang / spyo ba'i brgyad sogs bas 'phul rga'o/ /brngadi btsas ma brngas pa bas 'phul rnga'o//brja/ lhun po ltar brjid gzi brjid can/ /brjid chags brjed ngas dran pa mi gsal ba brjed

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 125byed dang / /mi brjed gzungs thob brjod bya brjod pa'ang ngo dang / /phan tshun brjes sogs bas 'phal rnga'o//brta) gzugs brnyan sgra brnyan brnyan pa'i bosgos/ /gzhan la brnyas thabs spangs pas bdud rtsi brnyes/ /g.yas pa'i brnyas sogs bas 'phul rnya'o//brta) kun brtags mtshan nyid legs par brtags/ /brtag dpyad gnas brtan mi 'gyur brtan/ /glerdzo bur brtad pa 'dul ba nas brtad pa las byung ba'i gos zhes dang brtad pa las byung ba'i spang lhung bshad lus sems brtas 'di gnyis la 'phul med rtas dang rtun zhes pa'ang 'thad/ /brtun rtun kyang 'thad pa bskyed dang brtul zhugs dang / /spyi brtol can dang snag sogs bu ga brtol/ /ljon shing yongs 'du sa brtol sogs/ /ba yis 'phrul ba'i rta yig go/brda/ go byed brda dang chal brdab dang / /gri sogs brdar dang chal mar brdal/ /brdung bya brdungs dang gzhan la brdeg /brdeg 'chos la sogs bas 'phul rda'o//brna) bsam pa'i brnag pa bkas bcad chen mo'i mjug tu rang gi brnag pa rdzogs par bya phyir dang zhesabashad do bzod pa'i brnag bzod dka' ba la brnag dka' ba zhes pa'ang yod/ /zas kyis brnangs dang nan tan brnan//brnab sems mdun du brdzu ba dang mdun du 'then pa'i ming / /sbas pa'i brnogs sogs bas 'phul rna'o//brtsa) brtsad cing brgal nas brtsam bya brtsams/ /mkhar sogs brtsigs dang snying brtse ba//khang brtsegs ha cang brtsengs rtsengs zhes pa'ang 'thad pa'i gos/ /bgrang ba'i brtsis dang legs par brtsis//brtson 'grus brtson pa brtse ba can/ /bas 'phul ra la btags pa'i tsa'o//brdza)nor gyis brdzangs dang srog chags zan brdzis pa dang rdog pas brdzis/ /gzhan gyis mi brdzi srin por brdzus/ /ral ba gyen brdzes brdzun tshig smra/ /de sogs rdza yig bas 'phul can//brla) bcom brlag yul du dgra bo brlag /rtsub tshig brlang po chu yi brlan/ /lus kyi brla sha byin gyis brlabs/ /gdon gyis brlams bskyod pa'i dang ya ma brla snying po med pa'i don/ /dul ba'i brling sogs bas 'phul rla'o//la mgo can bas 'phul ba/blta/ blta bya dang ni gos sogs bltab/ /sku bltams yon tan du mas bltams gang ba'i don te gtams zhes pa'ang 'thad/ /bltos sa bltos chos bltar rung bltas/ /bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i ta'o//

126 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/bldan bldag pa bldag dang mur ba'i bldad/ /la sogs lda yig bas 'phul bzhed/ /ces pa bod kyi brda'i bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa las/ ba yig gi 'jug pa bye brag tu pho ni 'das dang gzhan bsgrub phyir zhes pa'i 'jug pa gtso bor bshadapa ste rnam par bcad pa gnyis pa rdzogs so//3 ga dang da'i 'jug pa bye brag tu bshad pa/de nas ga dang da gnyis kyi/ /'jug tshul rim pa bzhin du ste/ /ca nya ta da na tsa zha/ /za ya sha sa'i yi ge rnams/ /gas 'phul bcu gcig tu bzhed dper//gsho) yid la gcags dang gcad bya'i shing / /gcan gzan sgra gcan la gcan pa/ /gcam bu'i tshig dang gcal du bkram/ /grangs kyi gcig dang gcin gci ba 'di gnyis dri chu'i ming / /yid gcugs khon gcugs spun zla gcung rjes skyes/ /gcud la bor dang rtsad nas gcun/ /phag tu gcur dang lag pa gcus/ /spun gyi gcen sngon skyes so dang gcer bu dang/ /gces 'dzin gces spras dum bur gcog /nad gcong shing gcod gros gcom dang / /gcom bskyungs la sogs gas 'phul ca'o//gnya) glang sogs gnya' ba'i gnya' shing dang / /bka' btsan pa'i gnyan sa bdag gnyan nad dud 'gro gnyan/ /grangs kyi gnyis dang gnyug ma gshis gnas lugs/ /bshes gnyen dpung gnyen rtsa lag gnyen nye du'o/ /spang bya'i gnyen po rdzas kyi gnyer bcol gnyer ba sogs/ /gnyid nyal khro gnyer nang khrol gyi//gnye ma la sogs gas 'phul nya'o//gta)gtang bya'i rdzas dang lag tu gtad/ /dus gtan du bsam gtan gtan tshigs dang / /go glegs sam sgo gto gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin dang / /brdung gtag dang ni gtang rag dang / /sbyin gtong gtor ma me tog gtor/ /gdams pa'i gtams dang nor gyi gter/ /grangs kyi gtams dang gleng ba'i gtam/ /nor gyi gta' ma gteng ba dang gta' zhes kyang zer te 'dul ba las gta' nyis rir blang bar bya'o zhes pa lta bu khrag gtar dang / /zabs kyi gting dang mun pa gtibs/ /zad pa'i de dag yongs su yags pa dang gtugs dang gzhan la gtugs/ /gtun bus gtun shing dum bur gtubs gas pa'ang / /khro ba'i gtum dang gtum mo hro dang / /se gol gtogs dang khongs su gtogs/ /lha chen gtogs 'dod gzhan la gtod/ /'bem la gtod dang dmigs pa gtod/ /ri bo'i gtos lto ba ri yi gtos tsam bkres pas nyen mnyam gas 'phul ta'o//gad) ming gdags gdags pa'i bstan bcos gdangs snyan gdangs can gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 127bsnyung ba gdangs/ /gdan la bzhugs dang sa bon gdab/ /gdam nga byed dang ding sang 'dam ka byed zer gdams ngag ston/ /skas kyi gdang bu gos 'gel gdang / /zhe sa'i gda' dang gding ba stan/ /gdug pa can dang gdung bas gdungs/ /sku gdung khang pa'i gdung zhes pa'ang mtshon par bya ste shes par bya'o gdung rgyud gdung 'dzin dang / /sor gdub gdub kor gdu bu dang / /mchod rdzas gdugs dang nyin mo'i gdugs/ /rnyed la gdu dang gdul bya gdul/ /srang la gdeg dang gdeng thob dang / /byad kyi gdong dang gdod ma nas//gdon bgegs gdol ba rigs ngan pa gdos pa 'dzin gru'i dar bo 'dzin pa'i ming / /de sogs da yig gas 'phul can//gan) bung ba ltar gnag gnang ba mdzad/ /chos kyi gnad dang mkha'i yi gnam/ /gna' dus gnas mal gnong mi bkur/ /gnod byed gnod sbyin grib gnon gdon/ /zil gnon la sogs gas 'phul na'o//gtsa/ khrag 'don gtsags bu gtsang sbra dang / /dri gtsang khang dang chu gtsangasogs/ /mche ba gtsigs dang gtsug lag dang / /gtsug tor spyi gtsug gtsubs shing dang / /gtsub stan gtsub las me 'byung dang / /gcer pas gtses dang gce ba dang / /gtso bo la sogs yul gtsang dang chu gtsang po dang mi gtsang ba dang gtsigs che ba sogs kyang ngo gas 'phul calha(//gzha) rnam gzhag dran pa nyer gzhag dang / /mnyam gzhag lus kyi cha shas gshad / /gzha na dag gzha' tshon 'ja' tshon no gzhar yang lta/ /gzhal bya gzhal med khang bzang dang / /kun gzhi rnam shes gnas kyi gzhi/ /brtag gzhig gzhibs pa khu ba 'jib pa bsgrigs pa'i ming / /nyon mongs gzhil slad chos la gzhug /gzhung lugs yid gzhudas gzhur med 'od zer can ma'i mdo las 'byung dang / /mda' gzhu pags pa'i g.yang gzhi dang / /'tsho zhing gzhes dus kyi gzhes kyang dang gzhogs slong sbo gzhogs dang / /lag na gzhong thogs shing gi gzhong pa sogs gzhon nu dang / /dgra bo gzhom dang chos la gzhol/ /la sogs zha yig gas 'phul can//gza) tsher ma gzang ring gcan gzan dang / /zas kyi gzan dang rngul gzan dang / /gzan stan gzan che stan gyi gzar phying gzar srin gzar sogs/ /dgang gzar byugs gzar gzar bu dang / /gzar thag gos kyi gdang bu'i ming bla gos phrag par gzar/ /ri gzar gza' skar gzi mdangs dang / /brdeg par gzas dang gzi brjid dang / /gzi 'od dang ni nor bu gzi/ /stag gzig spyan gyis gzigs nas

128 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gzims/ /gru gzings drang ba'i gzu bo dang / /gzugs can snying po gzugs brnyan dang / /gzugs su rung dang gzungs sngags dang / /gzungs btab dra'o drub bo gzungs bto bo zhes pa lta bu gzung 'dzin dge la gzung / /ma brtags bab col smra pa gzu lums gzegs gzegs ma'ang ngo zan dang / /gzengs bstod snod gzeb 'od gzer dang / /shing sogs gzer dang drin du gzo/ /rko ba'i gzong dang gzod ma'i dus/ /bsgo ba rnar gzon bslab bya la mi nyan pa ste 'dul ba'i brda byas chud gzon/ /de sogs ga yis 'phul ba'i za'o//g.ya) dud 'gro g.yag dang dpal gyi g.yang / /g.yan la dgab dang g.yab mos g.yabs//skyi g.ya' ba dang lcags sogs g.ya'/ /g.yar ngo bcol ba'i ngo g.yar khral g.yas phyogs dang / /drug dmar g.yu dang g.yung drung dang / /g.yul ni 'khrug dang 'bru yi las/ /g.yung mo rigs ngan pa rnam g.yeng log g.yem dang / /mi brtson g.yel dang g.yo sgyu dang / /sa g.yos g.yog 'khor g.yon phyogs dang //g.yang sa mi g.yo g.yor mo grul la btsugs pa'i shing dar dang bcas pa zhig gi ming sogs/ /ga yis ya yig 'phul ba'o//gsha) dum bur gshags dang yigs wod pa'ang ngo rol mo gshang / /'gab kyi gsham dang mo gsham dang / /chos lugs gsha' ma yin du gsha'/ /gshin rje gshed po zhing sa gzhin mnyes gshin pa zhes pa'ang ngo / /gshis lugs smod pa'i gshung ba dang/ /gshe bar byed kha 'thab pa dang song ba'i gshegs/ /brlan gsher 'dab gzhog shing gnog pa'ang dma' ba'i gzhong / /yur ba'i gshor brel gagor dang pong la gnor sogs kyang dang thong gzhol gzhol mda' 'dzin kyang ngo te/ /de sogs sha yig gas 'phul ldan //gas) kha gsag gsang sngags gsad bya dang / /snyan gsan 'bebs dang 11ga chags gsa'//gsar bu 'od gsal ral pa gsigs/ /ne'u gsing 'khar gsil dum bur gsil/ /gsung rab gnyis med gsung pas gsungs/ /gson lus gsog gsob gso dka' dang / /gsong por smra dang sba bya gsong //srog chags gsod dang gsog 'jog dang / /snyan du gson dang 'bibs byed gsor/ /gsol ba 'debs sogs gso ma'i ras/ /la sogs sa yig gas 'phul can//ka ga nga dang pa ba ma/ /das 'phul drug tu bzhed de dper// dka) lce rtse dkan rkan zhes kyang 'thad sbyar kha dog dkar/ /dkar chag tho yig dka' thub dka' tshegs dang / /dka' 'grel dku zlum dku skabs phyin/ /dri bsnam na rab dku dkon cog dkor rdzas kyi ming / /dkyil 'khor dkyil dang dkyus yas ma dkyus sogs ring dang / /kun nas dkris dang nyon mongs kyi ming gos kyis dkris/ /bstan pa dkrugs dang

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 129gong 'og dkrugs pa zho dkrugs sogs rol mo dkrol/ /dkrongs bskyed la sogs das 'phul ga'o//dag) dgag pa byed dang dgang gzar dang / /gos dgab 'gebs pa'i don dga' ba grangs kyi dgu /mang tshig dgu dang skye dgu yod dgu bzang dgu sogs dbyibs dgu pa/ /mdun du dgug dang mtshan mo'i dgong / /dus kyi dgun dang dge slong dang / /dge bshes dge ba dge legs sogs/ /dgongs pa bsam pa'i dang ni phyi dre'i dgongs/ /rgyan dgod bde la dgod gad mo dgod yi ge dgod dgon pa dgon dung dang / /ri dwags dgo ba dbyibs dgye ba/ /dga' ba'i dgyes dang mdza' min dgra/ /me tog dgram dang mdud pa da〈snal dgongs pa dgrol bcings pa dgrol/ /la sogs ga yig das 'phul can//dang) snyan dngags dang ni dngangs sngangs zhes kyang 'thad skrag dang / /rin chen dngul dang 'bab chu'i dngog chu ngogs/ /gri yi dngo dang dngos po dang / /dngos med don dngos dngos gzhi dang / /ro dngar mngar zhes kyang 'thad dngos grub la sogs pa/ /nga yig das 'phul can du bya//dpa) dpag tshad rjes dpag dpag tu med/ /che bzhi'i dpang po dpa' bo dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dpal ldan dang / /lus kyi dpung pa dmag gi dpung / /dpe byad dper na dpe cha dang //dpag bya dpog dang rje dpon dang / /rgyal po'i dpya dang dpyang thag dang / /g.yang sa'i dpyang dang rtag dpyad dang / /sta zur dbyi dang dus kyi dpyid/ /rnam dpyod la sogs das 'phul pa'o//dab) skyon gyi dbags dang dbang ldan dang / /dbang po lha'i dbang po dbang phyug dbang bskur dang / /ye shes dbab dang gtan la dbab/ /zhe sa'i dba' dang chu'i dba' rlabs/ /dbal ni tog dang rtse mo dang / sha nyam me yi drod la'o/ /mgo bo'i dbu dang chu'i dbu ba/ /bug pa dbug dang kha nang dbugs//dbung dang dbus ni dkyil gyi ming / /dbu ma'i don dang gdugs sogs dbub/ /bsod snyoms dbul bgyi bkren pa'i dbul/ /skar ma dbo dang chu sogs dbo/ /lung dbog nor dbog dbon po la/ /dbyangs snyan dbyar dus dbyig gnyen dang / /chos dbyings dbyibs dang dbye ba dang / /dbyig pa dbyug pa ber ga'i ming / /phyir dbyung ba dang ri mo dbyi sub pa'i don/ /'byed pa'i dbyen dang dbyu gu dang / /zha nye'i dbyar 'dab snod kyi stegs bu dang sems can gyi dbyi zhes pa la dbral bar dka' dang nor dbrog sogs sogs pa/ /da yis 'phul ba'i ba yig bo//dam) dmag dpon dmangs rigs dman pa theg dman sogs dang / /mtho min dma' dang kha dog dmar/ /dmigs med nyes dmigs dmigs pa zhes pa'ang blo dmun blun po'i rnam grangs 'dzum dmul te/ /dmu

130 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/chu 'dre srin dmu zhes pa'ang dmus long dme po rus gcig pa gsod pa po dang / /dmod pa 'dor dang dmyal ba sogs bu ga'i dmig ces pa'ang / /ma yig da yis 'phul ba can//zhes pa bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba las/ ga dang da'i 'jug pa bye brag tu bshad pa ste rnam par bcad pa gsum pa'o// 4 'a yig gi 'jug tshul bye brag tu dpyad pa/de nas 'a yig 'jug tshul te/ /kha ga cha ja tha da dang / /pha ba tsha dza 'as 'phul bcu'o/ /de dag rim bzhin bstan bya ste// 'kha) gzhan la 'khang dang 'khar rnga dang / /rten pa'i 'khar ba skud pa 'khal/ /blo 'khums pa dang gzhan la 'khu/ /zas kyi 'khur ba khur 'khur dang / /khral 'khul ba dang bya ba'i khyab pa lta bu'i don 'khobs/ /grang ba'i 'khyags dang yul gzhan 'khyam/ /gzhan du 'khyar dang ngag 'khyal dang / /bcing ba'i 'khyig dang nyi ma 'khyims/ /gdugs 'khyir chu bo 'khyil ba g.yas su 'byil sogs sogs/ /glog 'byug pa dang mgul nas 'byud/ /bskyur bas 'byur dang bros pa'i 'byus/ /gnas su 'byeradang brten pa'i 'khra/ /bro 'khrab gnas su 'khras pa dang / /khral sogs 'khri dang pho mo 'khrig /gnas su 'khrid dang bred nas 'khrims/ /'byud pa'i 'khril dang 'khris pa dang / /'khru spyongs 'thab zhabrug bltams pa'i 'khrungs/ /dri ma 'khrud dang nor ba'i 'khrul/ /khyim la 'bren dang rol mo 'brol//de sogs 'a yis kha yig 'phul//'ag) skye 'gag 'ga' zhig mi mthun 'gal/ /'gan 'khur shing 'gas g.yo 'gul dang //'chi ba'i 'gum dang thog ma'i 'go /'gog bden lam 'gor sems mi 'gong / /bde la 'god dang dus skabs 'gol/ /'go ba'i nad 'gos dus 'gyangs dang / /sems kyi 'gyu ba 'gyur ba dang / /'od 'gye 'gyed dang 'gyel ba dang / /'grod dang lto 'grangs phan tshun 'gran/ /'gram pa rtsig 'gram mi mthun 'gras/ /sbyar ba'i 'grig dang 'phel 'grib dang / /'grim 'grul byed dang thur du 'gril 'dril zhesapa'ang yid/ /brtson 'grus rigs 'gre 'greng ste 'dud/ /rkang pa 'gred dang chu sogs 'grems/ /phan tshun 'grel dang gzhung don 'grel/ /lam du 'gro dang grogs dang 'grogs/ /'chi ba'i 'grongs dang mdud pa 'grol/ /de sogs ga yig 'as 'phul can//'cha) zhabs 'chag 'chag sa lag tu 'chang / /chos 'chad nyes pa sped pa'i 'chab/ /gar

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 131'chams gnas 'cha' gtad med 'chal/ /nyi ma 'char dang srog 'chad 'chi/ /zhabs pas 'ching dang stobs kyis 'chun/ /'dod la zhen pa'i 'chums pa dang / /gnas su 'chur dang yo ba'i 'chus/ /zhen pa'i 'chel dang gros 'choms dang / /chu sogs 'chor dang las 'chol sogs/ /'a yis 'phul ba'i cha yig go/'ja) khris 'jags dang ni rtswa 'jag ma/ /ma tshor 'jab bu reg na 'jam/ /mkha' yi 'ja' tshon blo yis 'jal/ /'jig rten 'jig dang bred pa'i 'jigs/ /mchu yis 'jibs dang 'jib pa dang //'dam gyi 'ji ba 'jim pa dang/ /zhi 'gyur 'jil dang gos la 'ju/ /khung du 'jug pa dang ser sna'i 'jungs/ /smad 'tshong ming gi 'jud mthun dang / /srad bu'i 'jur ba lag pa 'jus/ /snyan pa'i 'jebs dang 'o ma 'jo/ /gnas su 'jog dang dbyibs 'jong dang / /yul 'joms byed sogs 'as 'phul ja'o//'tha)zhib mor 'thag dang 'os pa'i 'thad/ /nan tan 'than mi 'than po dang 'byug pa'i 'thab//grogs su 'thams dang mkhregs pa'i 'thas/ /smod tshig 'thing slad mun pa 'thibs/ /srab 'thug skom 'thungs chad pa 'thud/ /'thun pa zhes pa sngon gyi brda/ /dum bur 'thub dang blo 'thums dang / /du ba 'thul dang zas la 'thus/ /rkang pa 'theng dang thag pa 'then/ /gos 'theb yod dang nan chags 'thems//chu yis sha 'thog nang nas 'thon/ /bred 'thoms chu 'thor nyes pa 'thol mthol zhes pa'ang rung ngo / /la sogs tha yig 'as 'phul can//'ad) chu dbus 'dam dang 'gul ba'i 'dar/ /skyo ma 'dal dang dus kyi 'das/ /nye ba'i 'di dang gnas su 'dug /phyaga'atshal 'dud dang blo 'dun pa/ /bang 'dur 'dul sbyong gyen du 'degs/ /rjes 'ded gsol 'debs gnas su 'dong/ /blo la 'dod dang gnas nas 'don/ /phyogs gcig 'dzoms pa'i 'dom pa dang/ /bor ba'i 'dor dang mtshungs pa'i 'dra/ /khrims su bcas pa 'dral ba dang / /yi ger 'dri dang gleng mo 'dri/ /slu ba'i 'drid dang rul 'gyur 'dul/ /khung bu 'dru dang shing sogs 'dud/ /lha 'dre gcod byed 'dreg mkhan dang / /gnas nas 'dren dang phyogs gcig 'dres/ /de sogs da yig 'as 'phul can//'pha) smod pa'i 'phya dang phyag dar 'phyag /thur du 'phyang dang yan pa'i 'phyan/ /dar 'phya ra 'phyas smod dus 'phyi ba/ /gyen du du ba 'phyur ba dang / /lto 'phye rkang med 'phye bo ste/ /rang gar 'phyo dang springs pa'i 'phrin/ /'phrin las rnam 'phrul 'phreng ba dang / /'od 'phro nor 'phrog lag tu 'phrod/ /de

132 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/sogs pha yig 'as 'phul can//'ab) sgrib pa 'byang 'gyur rab 'byams dang / /sbyar ba'i 'byar dang 'dam du 'bying / /'gred pa'i 'byid dngami tshe 'byid/ /ma 'ongs 'byung dang sgo 'bye 'byed/ /bros pa'i 'byer dang rjes su 'brang / /bral ba'i 'bral dang dud 'gro'i 'bri/ /'grib pa'i 'bri dang bar ma'i 'bring / /lo tog 'bru dang skad chen 'brug /nad kyi 'brum bu sbrel ba'i 'grel/ /grong las thag ring 'brog gi gnas/ /dud 'gro 'brong dang rus kyi 'brom/ /de sogs ba yig 'as 'phul ldan//'tsha) 'dzom pa'i 'tshag dang lus stobs 'tshag /chu sogs 'tshag dang nang du 'tshangs/ /blo 'tshabs dus 'tshams long ba'i 'tshar/ /shes dang chog pa'i 'tshal zhes dang/ /mes 'tshig til mar 'tshir ba dang / /du ba 'tshubs dang gnod pa'i 'tshe/ /rgyal ba'i 'tshengs dang zas 'tsheng dang / /'od 'tsher srog 'tsho sman 'tshe byed/ /dud 'gro 'tsho dang brdeg 'tshog dang / /yo byad 'tshog chas tshong du 'tshong //nor 'tshol la sogs 'as 'phul tsha'o//'dza) chu 'dzag zad pa'i 'dzad pa dang / /bzlas pa'i 'dzab dang 'dzam bu gling / /'phyangs pa'i 'dzar dang 'du 'dzi dang / /phan tshun 'dzings dang lag pas 'dzin/ /zags pa'i 'dzir dang rang srol 'dzugs/ /snod du 'dzud dang bzhin gyi 'dzum/ /gzur ba'i 'dzur dang 'og tu 'dzul/ /gyen du 'dzeg dang rdo yi 'dzang / /snod du 'jed dang ngo tsho'i 'dzem/ /logs skyes 'dzer ba skad 'dzer dang / /'brugs pa'i 'dzag 'dzog bsags pa'i 'dzom/ /nor ba'i 'dzol ba la sogs pa/ /dza yig 'a yi sngon 'jug can//zhes pa bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba las/ 'a yig gi 'jug tshul bye brag tu dpyad pa ste rnam par bcad pa bzhi pa rdzogs so//5 ma yig gi 'jug tshul bye brag tu dpyad pa/de nas ma yig 'jug tshul ni/ /kha ga nga dang cha ja nya/ /tha da na dang tsha dza rnams/ /mas 'phul bcu gcig yin te dper// mkha) mkhan po nam mkha' mkhar du mkhas/ /nang khrol mkhal ma mkho ba'i nor/ /ser sna dpe mkhyud mkhyud spyad dang / /shes pa'i mkhyen pa sra ba'i mkhregs/ /de rnams ma yis kha 'phul ba'o//mag) bzo ba'i mgar ba mgal me dang / /mgal dum dang ni mgrin pa'i mgur/ /myur ba'i

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 133mgyogs dang dga' ba'i mgu/ /gul dang lus kyi mgo bo dang / /skyabs mgon sems can mgron du gnyer/ /de sogs ga yig ma yis 'phul//mang)bran gyi mngag gzhug lan mang mngags/ /thugs la mnga' dang mnga' thang dang / /mnga' ris mnga' 'og mnga' zhabs dang / /mngon pa mngon shes mnga' bdag dang / /mngon mtshan mngon sum mnga' mdzad dang / /lus kyimangal sogs mas 'phul ldan//mcha) dur gyi mchad pa yi ge'i mchan/ /'bru 'thag mchig mas g.yin dang mchi gu yas gtun dang //nor bu mching bu rgya mtsho mching dkyil gyi don/ /'bel ba'i bka' mchid nang khrol mchin/ /rus kyi mchims dang 'gro ba'i mchi skyabs su mchi sogs/ /yod pa'i mchis dang med ma mchis/ /'dzugs pa'i mchu dang skye mched dang / /me mched sku mched la sogs dang / /nang khrol mtsher ba rtsal gyi mchongs/ /bkur stis mchod pa la sogs pa/ /cha yi sngon du ma yig 'gro/mja) phrad pa'i mjal dang go ba'i mjal/ /lus kyi mjing pa mjug ma dang / /pho mtshan dngos ming mi mjed zhing / /de rnams ja yig mal 'phul ldan//mnya) rna bas mnyan dang mnyan yod gnas/ /mtshungs pa'i mnyam dang nyed pa'i mnyed/ /ko ba mnyes dang mnyen pa dang/ /dgyes pa'i mnyes sogs mas 'phul nya'o//mtha) smad kyi mthang dang mthang gos dang / /mtha' 'khob mtha' dang mthar thug dang / /mang tshig mtha' dag mtha' klas dang / /kha dog mthing kha mthon mthing dang / /lag mthil nus mthu mthun mi mthun/ /sor mo'i mthe bong mthe'u chung / /tshad kyi mtho dang dpangs kyi mtho/ /mig gis mthong rnams mas 'phul tha'o// mad) me mdag dang ni dus kyi mdangs/ /bkrag mdangs mda' gzhu dang ni mdung / mdun du bdar dang mda' yi mde'u/ /dpral ba'i mdongs dang mdud pa dang / /gsung rab mdo dang mdor bsdus dang / /'dun pa'i mdong gsol kha dog mdog /mig mdongs ldongs zhes pa'ang rung la sogs mas 'phul da'o//man) 'og tu mnan dang dri mnam dang / /mna' bskyal mnal gzims mno bsam gtong //zas mnog mnog chung man ngag mnos/ /las kyis mnar ba mnar med gnas/ /de sogs na yig ma sngon 'gro'o//

134 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/mtsha) skyon gyi mtshang dang ming gi mtshan/ /mtshan nyid mtshan ma phyogs mtshams dang / /dud 'gro mtsha' dang mdzes pa'i mtshar/ /ngo mtshar mtshan mo 'dra ba'i mtshungs/ /tshon rtsi mtshal dang dur mtshod mtshun/ /rus kyi mtshur dang kha mtshul dang / /chu bo'i mtsho dang mtshe'u dang / /gri sogs mtshon cha mas 'phul tsha'o// mdza) 'phrin las mdzad pa mthun pa'i mdza'/ /legs pa'i mdzes dang nad kyi mdze/ /ya rabs mdzangs pa dud 'gro mdzo/ /dkor mdzod las mdzod mas 'phul dza'o/ /zhes pa bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba las/ ma yig gi 'jug tshul bye brag tu dpyad pa ste rnam par bcad pa lnga pa rdzogs so//6 mgo can gyi brda bye brag tu dpyad pa/ra mgo ldan pa bcu gnyis/da ni mgo can bshad bya ste/ /ra la sa yi dbye bas gsum/ /dga' zhig bas 'phul skabs su bshad/ /lhag ma rnams ni 'dir brjod bya/ /ka ga nga dang ja nya ta/ /da na ba ma tsa dza rnams/ /ra mgo ldan pa bcu gnyis te// rka) chom rkun rkus shig rkang pa rkub/ /sa rko rkos mkhan rko bar byed/ /nad kyi rkong ba chig rkyang dang / /snod spyad rkyen dang rkyal pa dang / /rgyu rkyen chu'i rkyal ra rka'o//rgan na tshod rgan po rga shis gzir/ /rgud pas sdug bsngal blo rgod dang / /bya rgod dang ni sems g.yeng rgod bsam gto gyi skyon/ /dud 'gro rgod ma grung po'i rgod/ /rtsod pa'i rgol ba snga phyi rgol/ /rgya mtsho phyag rgya rgyas btab dang / /rgya che rgyang ring nor sogs rgyas/ /ri dwags rgya dang skyed byed rgyud/ /zas kyi rgyags dang rang rgyud dang / /gtam rgyud 'phreng rgyud rgyud mangs dang / /mdzes byed rgyan dang lus kyi rgyab/ /chu rgyun rgyu mtshan phan tshun rgyug /lus kyi rgyus pa rgyu ma dang / /brdeg pa'i rgyob dang rgyal po dang //mi pham rgyal sogs rar btags ga'o//rnga/ g.yag rnga'i rnga yab brdung bya'i rnga/ /gla rngan byin dang bkres rngab dang / /hams pa'i rngams dang lus kyi rngul/ /rngul gzan rol mo rnge'u chung dang / /dud 'gro rnga mo rnge'u dang / /dbugs rngub sdug bsngal zug rngu dang / /rta yi rngog ma nas sogs rjod/ /ri dwags gsod byed rngon pa dang / /rngam brjid che sogs rar btags nga'o//

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 135ja) rje dpon rje btsun lha rje dang / /rdo rje bkur sti'i rjed pa dang / /sha rjen rjes 'jug rgud pa'i rjud/ /de sogs ra la ja btags pa'o//rnyan nor rnyed pa dang so yi rnyil/ /sngon gyi nor rnying chu'i rnyog ma/ /ri dwags 'dzin pa'i rnyong dang rnyi/ /de sogs ra 'og nyal ba'i nya'o//rta) mi 'jig rtag pa bred pa'i rtab/ /dbang rtul rtogs ldan blo yis rtogs/ /rjes kyi rting dang rtul phod dang / /rkang pa'i rting pa mi gtsang rtug /'jig rten lha rten rnam rtog dang / /yid ches rton pa la sogs/ /ta yig ra yi mgo can bri'o//rda/ grong rdal thog rdib rdul phran dang / /bu ram rdog ma rdo rje rdo/ /la sogs da yig ra mgo can//rna) rul ba'i rnag dang zhing rnang ma/ /tshig phrad rnam par rnam pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor rtse rno rar btags nace(// rba) khyi rbad rbab sgril rbod gtong sogs/ /ba yig ra la btags pa'o// rma)'gram gyi rmang dang ngo mtshar rmad/ /rmad byung dang ni dris pa'i rmas brda rnying ste dri ba'o/ /lus kyi rma dang rmi lam rmi/ /dud 'gro'i rmig pa gnod pa'i rmugs/ /gnod sbyin rmugs 'dzin rmugs par byed//khyis rmur ba dang sun pa'i rmus/ /rmigs med bcom dang sga yi rmed/ /bal sogs rmel dang gnyer rmo mo//rmongs pa dbu rmog go cha'i rmog /zhing sogs rmo rmod rmon dor te/ /de sogs ma yig ra mgo can//rtsa) rtsa ba rtse mo tsher ma'i rtsang / /rtsad nas gcod dang btung ba'i rtsab/ /sngo yi rtswa dang lus kyi rtsa/ /rtsa lag rtsi shing rtsi mar dang / /tshon rtsi dang ni stobs kyi rtsal/ /zhing rtsing sbu yi rtsid pa dang / /rus pa'i rtsib ma 'bor lo'i rtsibs/ /rtsis mkhan rtsis byed reg bya rtsub/ /rtsed mo rtse dang rtses dang rtsen lngas rtsen dang sum rtsen sogs/ /'thab rtsod bya ba rtsom rtsoms shig /rtsol ba bskyed sogs rar btags tsa'o//rdza) snod kyi rdza dang 'dam rdzab dang / /dngos pa'i rdzas dang phyugs rdzi sogs/ /chu yi rdzing bu rdzu 'phrul dang / /mi bden rdzun dang zog gi rdzub/ /rdzus skyes brag rdzong 'bul ba'i rdzongs/ /bya ba zin pa'i rdzogs pa dang / /kun rdzob la sogs rar btags dza'o/ /zhes pa ra mgo can gyi brda bye brag tu gtan la phab pa ste le'u drug pa'i dang po'o//

136 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/la mgo ldan bcu/la mgo ldan pa rnam bcu ste/ /ka ga nga dang ca ja ta/ /da dang pa ba ha rnams so// ska) lus kyi lkog ma lkog gyur dang / /dud 'gro'i lkog shal lkugs pa sogs/ /la la btags pa'i ka yin no//lha) ldang ba sman sga sgyam tshwa (rgyam tshwa 'thad )la'ang / /'ga' zhig snga rabs pa'i bzhed de lar btags ga'o/ /lnga) grangs kyi lnga nyid lar btags nga'o//lca/ rin chen lcags dang lcang ma shing / /ral pa'i lcang lo lcam dral dang / /reg bya lci yang tsha lcibs dang / /mnyen lcug lcug ma gri yi lcugs/ /kha nang lce dang lce 'bab gnam lcags 'jigs/ /me lce 'bar dang 'chi phyir lceb/ /me tog mgo lcogs blo yis lcogs/ /sbal lcong la sogs lar btags ca'o//lja) zhal nas ljags brkyang kha dog ljang / /ljang bu sman ljongs yul ljongs dang / /ljon shing ljan ldin mi gtsang lar btags ja'o//lta/ grub mtha'i lta ba mig gis lta/ /ji ltar de ltar de lta bu/ /gnya' yi ltag pa ltad mo lta//gos sogs ltab dang mtshan ltas dang / /mdun gyi lto ba lte ba dang / /lteng ga lteng rgyas 'od srungs dang //lhung bas gos na mnar med lhung / lto 'phye ltos 'gro ltos pa dang / /mngal gyi gnas skabs ltar ltar sogs/ /ta yig la yi mgo ldan pa'o//ldan nyal las ldang dang 'bobs pa'i ldang / /yod pa'i ldan dang nam mkha' lding / /skad kyi ldab ldib 'brug sgra ldir/ /lde mig mchod rdzas lda ldi dang / /btung ba sdud dang snod du sdugs/ /ming gi lde dang me sogs lde/ /shing gi seng ldeng logs kyi ldebs/ /drang min ldem dang ldem dgongs dang / /sman gyi lde gu lder bzo'i lha/ /phyir mi ldog dang dris lan ldon/ /ldob skyen shes sla ba'i mi ro snyoms sdom bu dang //ldan pa la sogs lar btags da'o//lnga) sems can shun lpags lar btags pa'o/ /mgul gyi lnga ba chu'i lha ba/ /la mgo can gyi ba yig gordzo/lha) ri rgyal lhun po lho phyogs dang / /lha dang lhang tsher lhag ma dang / /lhag par lhan ne lhang nge dang / /lham me lhun grub lhad can dang / /lhan cig lhab lhub lham sgrog lhod/ /gzhan dang 'khrul gzhi med pa yin/ /zhes pa la mgo can gyi brda'i bye brag tu dpyad pa ste drug pa'i le'u gnyis pa'o//

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 137sa mgo ldan pa bcu gcigs mgo ldan pa bcu gcig ste/ /ka ga nga dang nya ta da/ /na pa ba ma tsa rnams so// ska)skar ma skag dang sgra skad dang / /'dzin spyad skam pa skal ba bzang / /lus kyi sku dang rgyal gyi skugs/ /sbas skungs snum skud skud pa 'khal/ /skur ba 'debs dang skul byed dang / /ska rags sked chings skem byed dang //rid pa'i skem dang skor ba byed/ /thugs dam skong dang re ba skong / /gos sogs skon dang zas skom dang //ja sogs skol dang kha dog skya/ /skyabs gnas skyabs 'gro chu skyar bya/ /bde skyid bya skyibs skyil krung bcas/ /zas sogs skyugs pa skyung gas zos/ /ro skyur ba dang skyu ru ra/ /sa nas skyes dang rtsis kyi skyeg/kha skyengs skyed byed mgyogs pa'i skyen/ /shing gi skyer ba kha dog skyer/ /gnas su skyel dang skyes pa sogs//sems skyo 'tsho skyong skul skyod dang / /nyes skyon las skyobs skyob pa dang / /skyobs shig chu sogs skyoms shig dang / /'dabs pa'i skyor dang sa skyor dang / /gnas su skyol dang skyos shig sogs/ /sa yig thod du bcings pa'i ga'o//ska) rta sga sa'i sgang blo sgam dang / /shing gi sgam dang lus sgal tshigs/ /sgul skyod mi bya sge'u gsher sman/ /sgo khang sgo srungs sgos kyi dpon/ /mdzes pa'i sgeg pa sgeg mo dang / /sgo nga sgog pa sgom chen dang / /gom par byed dang lha sgoms shig /zas sogs sgongs shig bu ram sgor/ /dbyibs kyi sgor mo skyid skyur dang / /sgyid lug rkang pa'i sgyid pa'ang gnyen gyi sgyug mo dang / /sgyu rtsal g.yo sgyu sgyu ma mkhan/ /'khor lo sgyur sogs sgyur byed dang / /snod phad skye'u tshugs thab skyed pu/ /skyel cig sgra skad cher sgrogs shig/phyogs gcig sgrig dang sgrigs shig dang / /mkhas pa'i smin po sdig sgrib dang / /yol bas sgrib dang bya ba sgrims/ /phyogs gcig sgril dang sngon rabs sgrung / /'gran pa'i sgrun dang bya ba sgrubs/ /sgrub thabs ji bzhin lha sgrubs shig /zos pa'i sgregs pa gcer bu'i sgren/ /bya sgro bshad sgros lcags sgrog dang / /chos sgrogs pa dang chu las sgrol/ /snang byed sgron me rus pa'i sgrom/ /sgrol ma sgrol mdzad la sogs pa/ /sa yig gtsug tu bcings pa'i ga'o//snga) snga ba'i dus dang snga dro dang / /zhal snga spyan snga snga sor dang / /rim pa snga ma snga phyi sogs//gzungs sngags mal gyi sngas stan dang / /mdun gyi sngun dang kha dog sngo/ /dge ba de ltar sngo bar byed/ /sngon tshe mdog sngon sngags pa sogs/ /nga yig sa yi zhwa can lags//snya/ tha snyad snyan tshig ji snyam sems/ /rna ba'i zhe sa snyan gtam snyan/ /reg bya snyi ba snyigs

138 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ma'i dus/ /snying po snying dang gnyen snyed mo/ /ri rtse snyil byed nad kyi snyun/ /nga rgyal snyems dang sngas la snyes/ /snye ma 'bru yi dog pa'o/ /sman gyi go stod btang snyoms dang / /bsod snyoms snyoms las sems snyoms dang / /sbu snyol chang snyol la sogs pa/ /nya mgo sa yis brgyan pa bya'o//sta) dud 'gro stag dang sgom pa'i stabs/ /lus kyi sta zur shing stag pa/ /mig gi lta stangs 'dings pa'i stan/ /dngul rdo stang zil 'phreng ba'i star/ /dgra sta sta re ste'u dang / /gom pa'i stang stabs bkur sti dang / /bsti stang 'dir skabs 'di'i brdar mi bzung dang ni 'thug pa'i stug /'phyar g.yeng gzhogs stegs steng gi phyogs/ /mkhas pa sten cig yon tan ster/ /stes dbang grangs stong stong pa nyid/ /zad pa'i stongs dang chos ston dang / /ston mo ston dus ston pa la/ /sbyin len stobs dang rtsal gyi stobs//zhal du stob dang bor ba'i stor/ /mi gtsang 'bab pa'i stor khung sogs/ /sa la btags pa'i ta yig go/sda/ zhe sdang sdang sems bred pa'i sdar/ /srog chags sdig pa dge sdig dang / /sdigs mdzub sdigs dang gnas kyi sdings/ /sdig to can dang sdug bsngal dang / /mdzes pa'i sdug dang nor sogs sdud//mang po'i sde dang sde tshan dang / /sdeb sbyor phyogs gcig sdeb pa dang / /snod spyad sder ma sder mo rno/ /ljon shing sdong po sdong bu dang / /gnas su sdod dang sdod cig dang / /sdom pa bsrung sdom srog dang sdos/ /zhos sogs da yig sa mgo can//sna)dri 'dzin sna dang 'ju ba'i sna/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sna mang dang / /snag tsha snang ba mthong snang dang / /mi gtsang snabs dang snam bu dang / /snam sbyar rgyab kyi snam logs dang / /gos rgyu snal ma 'bru mar snum/ /snar shig sgoms shig snrel zhi 'phreng / /skar ma ston dang skrubs la sogs/ /na yig sa mgo ldan par bri'o//spad mdzes pa'i spa ba gnas nas spags zas kyi spags kyang / /spang bya spangs dang pha spad dang //rngul gyi spabs dang go 'phang spar/ /lus kyi spu dang ba skru dang / /rin chen spug dang phung por spungs/ /rgyan gyis spud dang gnyen gyi spun/ /mkha' la bya sbur mkhar gyi speg /rtsi shing spen ma gza' spen pa/ /rgyan gyi spen tog nor sogs spel/ /spel mar byas dang gos sogs spo/ /mtho ba'i spo dang spang gzhongs dang //sred pa spongasashigazasakyi spong / /mkhas pa'i spobs pa gong du spor/ /bdun spos dngos spyad ce spyang dang //mig gi spyan dang lus spyi bo/ /du ma'i spyi dang snod spyi blugs/ /chu la spying dang 'byar byed spyin/ /rtswa yi spyil bo mtha' la sprugs/ /gshe ba'i spyo dang longs spyod spyod/ /tshur spyon dge ba sgrogs pa'i spyoms bdag nyid

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 139sgrog pa'o/ /dud 'gro spra dang nor med sprang / /lag tu sprad dang rgyan gyis spras/ /sprang po'i spar mor sba dbyug 'chang / /'phrin spring ba dang chu 'dzin sprin/ /spru ma sman spa ma shing rdul sprugs dang / /sprul pa 'gyed dang dud 'gro sgreg /sems spro ba dang 'thab mo sprod/ /mang du spros pa la sogs pa/ /sa mgo ldan pa'i yig go/sba/ gsang ba'i sba ba phyogs gcig sbrags/ /'dres pa'i sbags dang dud 'gro sbangs/ /chang gi sbang ma chu la sbangs/ /du ma phyogs gcig sbams pa dang / /me sogs sbar dang spor shig dang / /srog chags sbal pa sbal du 'jug /gter du sbas dang sbos shig dang / /stobs kyi sbungs dang me chas sbung //shun pa'i sbun pa khung bu'i sbubs/ /srog chags grog sbur chu la sbengs/ /mdzod du sbed dang gsus pa sbos//sbyor ba las bzlog sbom po dang/ /sbyang bya sbyangs dang legs par sbyar/ /nor sbyin gnod sbyin sbyin pa'i bdag /dge sbyong gso sbyong sbyor ba dang / /'bubs pa'i sbra dang nyis sbrag dag /sha sbrang sbrang bu sbrang rtsi can/ /gtsang sbra can dang sbrang ma dang / /grogs su sbran dang sa le sbram/ /g.yal ba'i sprid pa srog chags sprul/ /zan sogs sbrus dang thag pas sbrel/ /ra mda' spron sogs sa mgo'i ba'o//sma) mun pa'i smag rum lus kyi smad/ /nag gso'i sman dang sman pa dang / /zing min smar dang skar ma smal/ /chur 'khrul smig rgyu smin drug bu/ /skar ma smin drug 'bras bu smin/ /kha dog smug po sme ba dang / /'phya ba'i smod dang smon lam 'debs/ /ming nas smos dang sman byed dang / /shing gi spyig ma smyug ma dang / /zas bcad smyung gnas dus smyur te/ /sems 'khrul spyo ba smyon pa dang / /gtam smra ba dang smras pa dang / /gdong gi sma ra smin ma dang / /smreng 'don smre sngags ngur smrig sogs/ /sa yig thod du bcings pa'i ma'o//rtsi) bka' stsal ba dang dngos grub stsal/ /dngos grub stsol dang stsal du gsol/ /sbyin pa tshul bzhin stsal bgyi sogs/ /sa mgo ldan pa'i tsa yig go/zhes pa sa mgo can gyi brda bye brag tu dpyad pa ste drug pa'i gsum pa rdzogs te/ de ltar bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba las/ mgo can gyi brda bye brag tu dpyad pa ste rnam par bcad pa drug pa rdzogs so// //

140 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/7 snga ma'i ming shugs kyis phyi ma ji ltar thob tshul sogs dpyad pa/de ltar sngon 'jug lnga dang ni/ /ra la sa yi mgo can brda/ /nges par dka' ba rnams bshad pas/ /brda rnams phal cher de yis rtogs/ /da ni snga ma'i ming shugs kyis/ /phyi ma ji ltar thob pa'i tshul//dper brjod 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ /cung zad gsal bar bshad par bya//mkhan po thon mi sasto ṭas/ /sum cu pa las rjes 'jug gi /i dang mthun lugs 'di zhes bya//dang po gnyis la dang po mthun/ /gsum lnga bcu la kya dang sbyar/ /lhag ma rnams la gya dang sbyar/ /de dag i sbyar 'brel ba'i sa/5 /zhes gsungs de yi ngo bo ni//da ba sa kyi ga nga gi /na ma ra la gyi ste dper/ /bdag gi rkang gi khong nas ni/ /khyod kyi rgyab kyi g.yas kyi char/ /zhes dang / don gyi tshul dang gtam gyi gzi/ shar gyi phyogs dang dpal gyi bdag /ces pa lta bu'o/ /'a dang rkyang pa 'dogs can gyi/ /rjes su 'i thob tshigs bcad kyi/ /yi ge ma tshang mi thob dper//rtse dga'i dga' ba bde ba'i dpal/ /sa yi bdag po de yi bzhin/ /ga dang ba yi rjes su tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /sa su 'a dang 'dogs can dang / /rkyang pa ru ste dpe rim bzhin/ /rtag tu rab tu 'byung du re//snod du rgyun du zhim du zo/ /myur du mjal du 'ong dus su'ang / /bza' ru yod pa'i gnas 'di sa /kha ru zhim rgyu'i zas 'di sbyin/ /da de na ra la sa te/ /btud de bzlan te byin pa yis/ /bskyar te thul te 'dzag ste byung / /ga nga ba ma 'a rnams dang / /'dogs can rkyang mthar sa ste ste/ /skrag ste gsang ste gnas pa yis//thub ste 'dzum ste dpa' ste gda'/ /bde ste sha chang za ste snang / /ga da ba sa'i rjes su kyang / /skabs 'gar na yi rjes su'ang kyang / /bdag kyang 'bad kyang 'bras med kyang / /bya ba thob kyang des kyang ci//'on kyang 'phral gyi 'tsho ba 'byung / /nga 'a na ma ra la yang / /yang yang skyes bu 'ga' yang ni/ /byon yang nam yang ma phrad de/ /slar yang mjal yang spyan ma 'drongs/ /'dogs can rkyang mthar phal cher 'ang tsheg bar ma tshang yang ste dper/ /ci yang yod pa'i phyug po yang / /de 'dra bdag la 'byung du'ang re// ga da ba cing sa mthar shing / /phyug cing blun pa rgud cing 'gro/ /slob cing nus pa mkhas shing phyug /nga 'a na ma ra la dang / /'dogs can rkyang pa rnams zhig dper/ /drang zhig bde ba rab dga' zhing //snyan zhing 'gyur ba 'jal zhing mdzes/ /dar zhig rgyas par 'tshal zhing bdag /bde zhing skyid nas za zhing snang / /ga da ba ces nga 'a dang / /na ma ra la sa dang ni/ /rkyang pa 'dogs can zhes te dper/ /rtag ces bya ba'i bdag yod ces/ /smra ba zab ces 'byung zhes thos/ /gda' zhes 'di lta yin zhes pa'am/ /'di

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 141tsam zhes par 'khru/ra zhes par/ /95gral zhes 41na pas legs garna/ngas zhes/ /mi mkhas pa zhes smra zhes bshad/ /kha cig sngon gyi mkhas pa sa mthar shes zhes zer/ /mi 'thad par mthong lo chen blo ldan shes rab dang dpang los kyang bkag pasakho bos dor/ /ga da ba cig sa mthar shig /rkyang pa'i rjes su'ang cig 'thob dper//shog cig sod cig rgyob cig ces/ /gyis shig ces ni kha cig smra/ /nga 'a na ma ra la dang / /'dogs can rnams kyi mthar zhig dper/ /cung zhig sdod la 'ga' zhig la/ /'phrin zhig nam zhig bskur zhig ces//ngal zhig bsos la mdo zhig sgrogs/ /na ra la gsum rjes su ni/ /sgra bsgyur snga mas da drag bzhed/ /phyi ma rnams kyis da drag dor/ /des na na ra la gsum gyi/ /rjes su zhing zhes zhig yin na'ang / /da drag nges par thob pa der/ /da drag sbyor ram mi sbyor kyang / /cing ces cig ces legs te dper/ /mkhas par mkhyen cing yon tan gyis/ /brgyan ces thos kyi ston cig ces/ /zer ces mthong nas 'tshal ces te//zer ces mthong nas 'tshal ces te/ /bdag kyang 'di 'drar gyur cig ces/ /smon lam stsal cing slob par ni/ /'tshal ces zer gyis myur stsol cig /ga da ba mthar ce na dang / /sa mthar she na sbyar te dper/ /su 'dug ce na bla ma bzhugs/ /ci 'chad ce na gdams pa ste/ /gang zab ce na spros bral chos/ /sus thos she na bdag gis so/ /nga 'a na ma ra la dang / /'dogs can rkyang pa zhe na dper/ /gang byung zhe na hor 'dra ste/ /du gda' zhe na mang po'o/ /su yin zhe na dben pa ste/ /khrims kyis dben nam zhe na dben/ /ci bskor zhe na rgyal khams te/ /gang btsal zhe na nom pa'o/ /ci skye zhe na bu skye ste/ /su la zhe na ma la'o//ga da ba sa na ma pa/ /zag pa med pa'i bde ba ni/ /thob pa nyes pa las grol nas/ /'gro la phan pa'i bsam pa'i gnas/ /nga 'a ra la 'dogs can dang / /rkyang pa'i rjes su ba phyed war/ /'bod pa rnams la ba sbyar zhing / /gzhan la pa nyid sbyar te dper/ /btung ba bda' ba myur bar 'thungs/ /mjal bar zhu ba tsha ba 'dod/ /lung pa mda' pa 'byor pa che/ /yul pa phu pa bya ba mang //dri ba'am dgag tshig skabs su ni/ /mtha' rten rnams la ma sbyor zhing / /skabs 'gar ra la ta dang ni/ /'dogs can rkyang pa'am ste dper/ /'dug gam 'byung ngam yong ngam dang / /yin nam grub bam sgom mam dang / /dga' 'am 'gyur ram 'tshal lam dang / /shes sam zer ram go 'am dang / /kha 'am zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rdzogs tshig skabs su na ra gnyis/ /ma gtogs mtha' rten brgyad po la/ /rang la na ro sbyar te dper/ /khyod ni phyug go gshis bzang ngo / /gtong yang phod do chos grub bo/ /'bor yang 'dzom mo bzhugs gda' 'o/ /thugs kyang dal lo zhes thos so/ /na ra gnyis la na ro dang / /to zhes rnam pa gnyis

142 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/'gyur dper/ /bzhin no zhes ni ngas bstan to/ /ngo mtshar ro zhes gzhan 'dzer to/ /rkyang pa 'dogs can 'o ste dper/ sha ni za 'o skyid 'di'o/ /de dag rnams dang tshig rkang mthar/ /nyis shad le'u mtshams bzhi shad thob/ /ga yig rjes su tshig shad bya/ /shad gong phal cher nga yig ma gtogs phyi tsheg spang / /rkyang shad dang ni tsheg shad dag /thob tshul skabs dang sbyar la dpyad//gzhan yang 'phul dang mtha' rten dag /sbyar du rung dang mi rung ba'i/ /rnam par dbye ba'ang cung zad bstan/ /tshogs dang tshoms dang myos 'gyur chang / /mngon sum phun sum rim 'gro dang / /sku khams khros dang khro ba dang / /phra ma khon 'dzin phrag pa sogs/ /mang por 'phul yig spang bar bya/ /lha btsun bza' btung rje btsun dang / /lha rje nga rgyal bya rgod dang / /rdo rje rgya mtsho la sogs pa/ /mang por mtha' rten med phyir spang / /pus mo'i lha nga sgo nga dang / /sla nga sogs la nga mtha' spang / /yi ge lu gu rgyud dang ni//myu gu sogs la ga mtha' spang / /gsung rab mkhyen rab rig sngags dang / /mkha' spyod sa spyod go 'phang dang / /nyam nga nyam chung nyam thag dang / /lo tog sogs la sa mtha' spang / /lhas byin klus byin mis byin sogs/ /mang po zhig la med na nor/ /yi ge zhal ta tha dad dang / /la sogs da lta zhes rnams la/ /bar tsheg mi byed blun po'i lugs/ /de ltar dug la rma yi phyogs/ /bstan pa bzhin du mkhas rnams kyis/ /rgya chen gsung rab mthong ba dang / /rang gi rnam par dpyod pas brtag/ces pa bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba las/ snga ma'i ming shugs kyis phyi ma ji ltar thob tshul sogs gces pa sna tshogs pa thun mong du dpyad pa ste rnam par bcad pa bdun pa rdzogs so// //mjug byang /bod yul dbus kyi rgyal po mchog /gnam ri srong btsan yan chad la/ /bod la yi ge med ces grag /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /mkhan po thon mi sasto ṭas/ /kha che'i yi ge la dpe mdzad nas lha sa'i sku mkhar ma ru bya bar rje blon mtshams bcad nas brtsams par grags/ lāñdza'i yi ger dper mdzad nas/ /dbyangs yig isnga/ echus bzhi/ /gsal byed ka sogs sum cu mdzad/ /de las rjes su 'jug pa bcu/ /de las kyang ni sngon 'jug lnga/ /ra la sa yi mgo gsum dang / /ya ra la yi smad 'dogs gsum/ /da dang sa yi yang 'jug sogs/ /ston pa'i bstan bcos rnam brgyad mdzad/ /ces grags na'ang bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis

bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 143deng sang sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug gnyis las mi snang ngo bka' srol de nyid la brten nas/ /lo paṇa skyes mchog du ma yis/ /rgya gar rgya nag kha che dang / /li dang bal po'i yul sogs nas/ /thub pa'i gsung rab sna tshogs bsgyur/ /brda yang mi 'dra sna tshogs gyur/ /chos rgyal ral pa can gyi dus/ /ska cog zhad sogs mkhas mang gis/ /rgyal po'i bkas bskul gsar bcad kyi/ /skad kyis brda sbyar gtan la phab/ /slad nas rin chen bzang po dang / /blo ldan shes rab la sogs pa/ /mkhas mchog rnams kyang de la brten/ /kho bos mkhan po thon mi'i gzhung / /sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug gi 'di gnyis ka la ṭīkka re byas yod cing 'di yang de dag dbang du byas nas bshad pas tho/ /don yang legs par gtan la phab/ /ska cog rin chen bzang po dang / /blo ldan shes rab shong dpang sogs//mkhas mang legs bshad bcud myangs te/ / 'phags yul skad dang gangs can gyi/ /gsung rab brda la 'dris pa'i blos/ /don 'di legs par bkod pa nyid/ /gang zhig gsung rab rnams kyi don/ /gtan la 'bebs na smos ci 'tshal/ /'jig rten phal pa'i rnam gzhag cig /byed kyang tshig gi sbyor ba gces// 'di ni mkhas rmongs 'byed pa ste/ /don 'di khong du chud pa'i mi/ /mang po 'dus pa'i nang dag tu/ /mkhas pa'i stan la 'dug par dbang /6 /'di la nongs pa'i cha mchis na/ /mkhas pa dag gis bcos par gsol//legs par bshad pa'i dge tshogs kyang / /thub bstan gsal ba'i 'od du gyur//legs sbyar brda sprod ka lā tsand+ra pa ṇi ni/ /swā dhu kārti rab 'byor zla ba drag 'byor dang / /bgrod dka' seng ge chos 'bangs 'chi med seng ge sogs/ /rbesnang dpang brgyud pa'i bla mas legs bshad gang yin dang / /bod kyi mkhan po thon mi'i sum rtags bstan bcos dang / /ska cog sogs kyi gsar bcad sgra sbyor bam gnyis dang / /dag byed mkhan po'i gaṅga snye thang pa grags pa seng ge bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gtsang nag phug pa thugasarje seng ge'i dang / /stag ston gas nu dpal 'od zer brgya pa bu ston seng ge 'od sgra don rgya mtsho'i me long dang //rje byams pa gling pa'i smra ba'i brgyan dang bsam sdings pa kun bsam gyi 'khrul pa spong ba la sogs pa'i/ /legs bshad snying po gces so 'tshal rnams 'dir bsdus te/ /yi ger 'bri dang smra dang 'chad dang rtsom pa sogs/ /kun la phan phyir rnam dkar bsam pas 'di brtsams so//zhes pa bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos dag thos shing cha shas tsam rig la/gangs can gyi bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi bsgyur tshul rjes su dpag pa las rtogs

144 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gartes btus/shing brda gsar rnying gi rnam dbye legs par phyed pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong zha lu ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po zhes bya bas/ dngos po'i shing pho khyi ste rang lo don bzhi pa'i lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes nyer lnga la chos grwa grwa thang du grub par bgyis pa'o//'di ni gsung rab snang byed sgron me ste/ /gangs can skad smra spyi yi yid bzhin nor/ /skye dgu dga' byed yar ngo'i zla ba ste/ /mkhas rnams snying la 'babs pa'i tshig gi gter/ /legs sbyar rgya mtsho ri byi'i khyor chu bzhin/ /gangs can skad tshul nor 'dzin khyon yangs pa/ /rnam dpyod sgom gcig gis gnon sred med bu/ /mi shes stobs ldan sa 'og 'ching 'di su/ /zhes kyang smras so//slar yar stod rab brtan lhun po snang du par du bzhengs pa'i tshe/ chos la 'jug pa'i skad gnyis sbyor ba dang mchan bu 'debs pa'ang gyis shig ces bkas bskul te/ skad dod dang brda gsar rnying sbyor 'os sogs kyi mchan bu 'ga' zhig 'debs pa dang/ sngar gyi rtsom pa la snon 'brid dang bsgyur ba ci rigs pa'ang zha lu lo tsā ba rang nyid kyis/ mi zad pa'i me pho khyi ste rang lo brgyad cu rtsa drug pa'i lo la bsam grub sde chen dzña bgyis pa ni dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par du bsgrubs pa'o// //sarba maṅga lo/

ra༅༅/ /tshogs gsum gsal ba bzhugs rbes//dpang lotsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ra༅༅/ /oṃ swa sti si rnyir stu/ dpal ldan dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi yan lag tshad med pas/ /sna tshogs brjod pa ston mdzad kyang / /brjod med chos dbyings legs rtogs pa/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal te/ /tha snyad tshul la 'khrul ba 'ga'/ /mthong bas de rnams bsal ba dang / /don gnyer rnams la phan ched du/ /de tshul phyogs 'ga' bri bar bya//dang po/ yi ge'i tshogs rnam par gzhag pa/yi ge'i dbye ba brjod pa/'dir phal cher so: tadang 'brel ba'i yi ge dang / ming dang / tshig gi tshogs kyi rnam par gzhag pa rnga'ind par bya ba las/de la dang por yi ge'i dbye ba brjod par bya ste/ dbyangs ni bcu bzhi gsal byed ni/ /sum cu gsum du mkhas pas gsungs/ /sde pa lnga tshan lnga dang ni/ /mthar gnas bzhi dang dro ba bzhi/ /dbyangs rnams bcu bzhi ste/a ā/ i sī/ u u/ 22/ '-i lī/ e i/ o e'i/ /sde pa'i yi ge ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa rte ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma ste/ sde pa lnga tshan lnga dang / mthar gnas ya ra la wa dang / dro ba sha ṣa sa ha rnams te/ gsal byed sum cu rtsa gsum mo//'o na la yig ni so: ta la :lta zhes pa las gzhan na med cing / de yang mdo 1gzhan gyis bkag pas na mi dgos so zhe na/ lce mi bde bas ṛ yig '-i ru brjod pa la dpyas pa na/2 lo yig nye bar mkho'o zhes slob dpon chos 'bangs 'chad do/ /'o na tpa la ring po med pas bcu gsum du 'gyur ro zhe na/ slob dpon bgrod seng ges/ ji ltar rjes zlos byed pas dpyas pa la '-i yig thung ngu yod pa ltar de la ring po'ang yod do zhes 'chad do/ /gzhan du gsungs rnams rigs kyis na/ /'di rnams nyid du 'dus pa yin/ /bzhi bcu rtsa bdun po 'di las gzhan pa brda sprod pa dang sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung la sogs par gsungs pa rnams ni bzhi bcu rtsa bdun po 'di nyid du rigs kyi sgo nas 'dus so//

146 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gzhan pa'ang ci lta bu zhe na/ a isngani ṛ bzhi rnams la/ /thung ring sgruta gsum gsum ste/ /re re la yangasngagadata ta/ /a nu data ta swa ri ta'o/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bzhi po de la so sor re re la thung ngu dang ring po dang glu ta zhes pa'i shin tu ring por phye bas gsum gsum ste/ de gsum re re la'ang u data ta dang a nu data ta dang swa ri ta ste re re la gsum gsum du phye bas dgu dgu'o//de yang sna ldan sna med du/ /phye bas bco brgyad rnams su 'gyur/ /dgu po re re la yang sna ldan dang sna ldan ma yin pa gnyis gnyis su phye bas a la sogs pa re re yang bco brgyad du 'gyur ro//mtshams sbyor yi ge thung ngu med/ /'-i yig ring po med pas na/ /lnga po bcu gnyis bstoganyis so/ /e i 6tho au rnams mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge'i ming can yin zhing / de bzhi la thung ngu med la/ la la ring po med pas bcu gnyis re ste/ bsdoms pas brgya dang sum cu gnyis/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung che ba rnams su dbyangs brgya sum cu rtsa gnyis su bshad do//sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas su/ gsal byed rnams ni sum cu bdun/ /'di ni dbyangs yig nyi shu gnyis/ /'di rnams yi ge lnga bcu dgu/3 /zhes gsungs pas/ a i u ṛ bzhi la thung ngu dang /gsum yig gi ྅ rtags kyis mtshon pa'i shin tu ring po dang / bla la ring po med pas gnyis dang / e i o au rnams la thung ngu med pas gnyis gnyis te/ bsdoms pas dbyangs nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /gsal byed ni sngar bshad pa'i sum cu rtsa gsum dang rjes su nga ro'i ming can klad gor dang / rnam par gcad bya'i ming can tsheg drag dang / lce rtsa can gyi ming can ka dang kha'i steng du 'byung ba'i ḍa ma ru'i rnam pa can skokhozhes pa lta bu dang / mchu dang nye ba can pa dang pha'i steng du 'byung ba'i glang po che'i myos bum gyi rnam pa can pi dang phi zhes pa lta bu ste sum cu rtsa bdun no zhes bshad do/ /gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde 'ga' zhig tu gsungs pa dang / spyir yi ges rtsen pa rnams la e aḥganyis bsnan pas dbyangs bcu drug ces grags so/ /de rnams las brgya sum cu rtsa gnyis su phye ba ni rnam par phye ba tsam yin gyi rigs bcu bzhi po las gzhan pa med do/ /rjes su nga ro ni sde pa'i lnga pa rnams ji ltar rigs par 'dus shing / tshig drag ni ra dang sa nyid la yin/ de dag brjod pa'i rten a yig ni dbyangs dang po nyid yin no/ /gsal byed la yang kṣa ni ka dang sa 'dus la/ lce rtsa can dang mchu dang nye ba can tsheg drag nyid de/ de dag brjod pa'i rten ka kha dang pa pha 'og tu sbyar ba'o//smra sgo'i 'grel pa la sogs par bsdu ba'i tshul du ma ni yi ge nyer lnga dang bcu gcig dang bdun

tshogs gsum gsal ba/ 147du dbyangs rnams dang gsal byed thams cad 'dus shing / de yang u ru 'dus zhes 'chad pa ni snying po med pa ste/ci gsal byed dbyangs su 'dus zhes smra ba ni gyang ri mor 'dusazhesapa dang 'dra'o/ /gzhan yangade na dpyad mi bzod pa mang po snang ste rang bzos blun po mgo bskor ba'o/ /gang yang dpal dus kyi 2bor lor/ a i :u '-i zhes pa dbyangs thung ngu lnga dang / ā sī ā dṛ '-i zhes ring po lnga dang / de lnga'i rim pa bzhin gyi yon tan a e aru tse( as zhes pa dang / de lnga 'phel ba ā swe āru 61 āX zhes pa dang / de lnga'i ya ṇar bsgyur ba thung ba ha ya ra wa la zhes pa dang / de ring ba hā yā rā wā lā zhes pa ste/dbyangs sum cur gsungs pa ni rnam par gzhag pa gzhan kho na yin pas/ spyi skad dang mi mthun te/ yon tan dang 'phel ba'i a yig gsum dang / ā yig gsum rnams a'i yi ge ru 'dus shing / ra la dbyangs med dang ha sogs bzhi gsal byed yin pa'i phyir ro//yi ge'i rgyu brjod pa/da ni yi ge'i rgyu brjod pa/ /brjod 'dod dbang gis hro g.yos shing / /de yis gnas dang byed pa dang //rtsol ba bskyed de dbugs dbyung dang / /lhan cig yi ge gdangs rnams skye//slob dpon chos mchog gis/ ngag gi don snang ba'i sems pa las brjod 'dod skye la/ de las gnas dang byed pa phrad cing de las sgra skye'o/5 /zhes gsungs mod/ gnas phrad par byed pa la rlung yang dgos par gsal lo/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu'i dbang du mdzad nas/ slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mis yi ge'i mdor/ gnas dang byed pa dang rtsol ba rnams las yi ge rnams skye'o/6 /zhes gsungs so/ /de la gnas bshad pa'i ched du bshad pa ni/ a ku ha namagrin pa las/ /i tsu ya sha rkan las 'byung / /sīta eta ita rnams mgrin rkan las/ /ṛ ṭu ra ṣa spyi bo las/ /'-i tu la sa so las byung / /u pu pi rnams mchu dag las/ /uta ota ota rnams mchu mgrin las/ /wa ni mchu dang so las 'byung / /rjes su nga ro sna las te/ /sna dang rang gi gnas dag las/ /sde pa'i lnga pa rnams 'byung ngo / /'di rnams btsun pa zla bas gsungs/7/a'i yi ge dang / tsand+ra pa'i mdo la sogs par/ uta'i sde dang bcas pa'o/8 /zhes gsungs pas sde pa'i dang po la dbyangs3/ yig sbyar bas de'i sde pa go bar brda chad byas pa'i phyir/ ku ste ka sde dang / ha yig dang lce rtsa can gyis mtshon pa'i tshig drag rnam 'gyur dang bcas pa rnams ma yin pa las 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang sbyar bar bya ste sla'o/ /tsu ṭu tu pu rnams kyis snga ma ltar rang rang gi sde dang bcas pa rtogs par bya'o//

148 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/byed pa bshad pa'i don du brjod pa/ byed pa lce yi rtsa ba ni/ /lce rtsa can gyi yin par bshad/ /lce dbus rka las 'byur rnams kyi'o//lce rtse dang nye steng 'byung ba'i//solas 'byung ba'i lce rtse ste//lhag ma'i rang gi gnas nyid do/9 /zhes slob dpon tsand+ra go mis so/ /lce rtse can gyi byed pa lce'i rtsa ba dang / rkan las 'byung ba rnams kyi byed pa lce'i dbus yin zhesasbyar te/ phyi ma dag kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /steng las 'byung ba ni spyi bo las 'byung ba'o//dngos su bshad pa'i lhag ma rnams kyi byed pa ni rang rang gi gnas kho na yin pas logs pa med do//rtsol ba bshad pa/rtsol ba nang dang phyi rol te//nang gi phye dang btsum pa dang //phrad dang cung zad phrad pa'o //phyi rol sgra med sgra ldan dang / /srog chung ba dang srog chen dang / /dro ba zhes bya rnams su bshad/ /rtsol ba zhes bya ba ni byed pa rnams kyi nang du gtogs pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par te/ de yang nang dang phyi gnyis so/ /nang ni nang du 'jug pa'i byed pa'i nang du son pa'o/ /de las bzlog na phyi rol lo/ /phye ba zhes pa ni mgrin pa ma bsdams par brjod pa dbyangs rnams dang po ba rnams dang sde pa'i gnyis pa dang bzhi pa rnams kyi yin par gsungs shing / de rnams las lhag par phye ba yin pa ita kyi yin pa dang / de dag pas kyang lhag par ches cher phye ba tse(ta dang 61ta dag gi yin la/ de dag pas kyang lhag par phye ba yin pa ā yig gi'o//btsum pa ni mgrin pa ma phye ba'i brjod pa ste/ a yig thung ngu'i yin par rnam par gzhag par bya'o/ /phrad pa ni yi ge 'byung ba'i gnas de rnams rtsol ba chen pos btsir ba ste/ sde pa lnga'i yi ge rnams de lta bu las 'byung ngo / /cung zad phrad pa ni/ phrad pa las bzlog pa mthar gnas bzhi'i yin no/ /nang gi rtsol ba bshad zin to//sgra med ni mgrin pa phye bas sgra rjes su rtogs par 'gyur ba/ sgra zhes pa'i yon tan 'di rnams la med pa ste/ /sde pa'i dang po dang gnyis pa dang sha dang ṣa dang sa dang tsheg drag dang lce rtsa can dang nye ba can rnams yin no/ /de las gzhan pa'i gsal byed rnams sgra ldan yin par don gyis go ste/ yi ge'i mdo ru sde pa'i gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang lnga pa dang mthar gnas dang rjes su nga ro dang ha yig rnams te mgrin pa btsum pas sgra rjes su rtogs par 'gyur ba rnams yin par gsungs shing /10 'grel par sgra'am dbyangs zhes pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/11 /zhes 'chad do/ /srog chung ba ni sde pa'i dang po dang gsum pa dang lnga pa dang mthar gnas rnams te/ 'grel par srog ces bya ba'i rlung 'di rnams la chung zhing phra bas so/12 /zhes bshad do/ /de dag las cig phresas rnams srog chen po ste/ sde pa'i gnyis pa dang bzhi pa dang dro ba rnams yin zhing / 'grel pa snga ma las bzlog pas so zhes so/ /gang yang smra sgo la sogs par/

ཿṭāgs gsum gsal ba/ 149alpa sī ṇa gnyis gcig yin/ /mahā drwa ṇa gcig nyid yin/13 /zhes dang / srog chung ba dang che ba'i dper brjod phaṭa'i ṭa lta bu dang / sde pa'i zhes pa rnams la byas pa ni/ mi shes bzhin du rang bzo byas pa yin te/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mis gzhung dang 'gal bas so//da ni sngar gyi dbye ba 'ga'i ngo bo brjod par 'dod pas smras pa/ thung 6 phyi mo gcig pa ste/ /ring po phyi mo gnyis pa'o/ /pluta phyi mo gsum par gsungs/ /rim pa ltar yi ge gcig gi yun du brjod pa dang / gnyis kyi yun du brjod pa dang / gsum gyi yun du brjod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs mod/ plu ta rgyang ring po nas 'bod pa dang / ngu ba dang / glu len pa la sogs pa la byas pa la yi ge shin tu mang po'i yun du brjod pa'ang yod do/ /mthon po rnams kyi.u data ta/ /yi ge nga ro mtho bas brjod par bya ba de ni.u data ta zhes bya ba'o/ /dma' bas a nu data ta'o/ /yi ge gang nga ro dma' bas brjod par bya ba de a nu data ta'o/ /smra sgor/ u datta ni mtshungs gnyis gcig /a nu datta phyed cha yin/14 /zhes 'chad pa ni snga ma ltar 'khrul pa yin no/ /de dag bar ma swa ri ta'o/ /swa ri ta nga ro mtho dman ma yin par bar mas brjod par bya ba'o/ /rang gi gnas dang sna las byung / /sna ldan cig shos de las bzlog /yi ge rang rang gi gnas dang sna las byung ba ni rjes su sna ldan te/sna'i gnas dang bral ba ni rjes su sna ldan ma yin no/ /mthar gnas de ltar gnyis su dbye/ /rjes su sna ldan dang sna ldan ma yin pa gnyis so//dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i bklag thabs/da ni dbyangs gsal byed ci rigs pa'i bklag thabs brjod par bya ste/ 'greng bu can dang na ro can/ /ring cha can rnams gnyis yun bklag /shin tu ring rnams gsum yun bklag /lhag ma gcig yun thung ba'o//dbyangs rkyang pa'am ki nas kṣ-i llī zhes pa'i bar gsal byed la zhugs pa'ang rung ste/ e i tse( 61 rnams dang / ā yī 12 rnams ring po yin pas dbyangs yig thung ba gnyis kyi yun du bklag par bya'o/ /shin tu ring po glu ta'i rtags can rnams ni gsum gyi yun du bklag par bya zhing / la sogs pas sngar bshad pa ltar ches bsrings te klog pa'ang yod do/ /gzhan a isngag ṛ '-i rnams ring cha med pas dkyus mar bklag tre/ /i 67 dag ni e 6tshe dag /thung ba i3kyis brgyan par bklag /i skyes zhes pa rgya gar gyi yi ge la kai sha ral ba steng na yod pa dang / bodag yig la de mtshon pa'i ched du 'greng bu dang na ro gnyis brtsegs yod pa ni e ring cha med pa la es brgyan pa e3kyi zhes pa lta bu dang / tse( ring cha med pa la yus brgyan pa tse(snga/

150 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/zhes pa lta bur bklag cing gnyis yun nyid yin no//da ni gsal byed gyi bklag thabs bstan pa'i ched du smras pa/ gsal byed srog med phyi mo'i mgor//brtsegs pa'am tsheg med yar sbyar bklag /gsal byed dbyangs med pa yi ge phyi ma'i steng du brtsegs pa buddha zhes pa lta bu dang / snga ma'i yi ge dang tsheg gi bar ma bcad pa phaṭa
