thob pa rnams kyi mthar yang 'i nyid mthun pa'o/14/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di'i don gyis thob pa zhes pa la dgos pa yod de/ bkas bcad gsar pa la yi ge nyung ba'i slad du 'a mtha' dbyi ba yin gyi don thob la yod ces pa'i don no/ /de bzhin du bod skad 'ga' zhig gi brjod bya'i shugs la/ ya yig dang ha yig gi gdangs thon pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ de shes par bya ba'i ched du sngon gyi yig rnying rnams su/ mi la myi/ me la mye zhes ya yig btags pa dang / rnying ba la rnying ba dang / rdzogs so la rdzogs sbo zhes ha yig 'dogs par mdzad pa yang don med ma yin zhing /desam zad rgya skad 'ga' zhig 'don rbede ba'i slad du bod skad dang mthun par bzos pa yang snang ste/ dper na/ gu ma dzasbu prikṣa/ dzambha la/ go ta ma sogs legs sbyar gyi skad dngos yin yang / de rnams bod skad du 'a yig gis 'phul ba ltar klog dgos tshul shes pa'i phyir du/ de dag gi ming yig dang por 'gu nda/ 'dzaskru prikṣa/ 'dzambha lha/ 'go'u ta ma zhes 'a yig gis 'phul ba'ang mkhas pa'i brda' las byung bas dgos pa can du shes par byos shigabacu gnyis pa/ slar yang 'jug pa'i yi ge bshad pa la/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu las/ sa dang da gnyis la yang 'jug ces bya ste/ rjes 'jug gi yang rjes su 'jug pas so/ /de gnyis rjes 'jug gang gi rjes su 'jug ce na/ sa yig ni/ ga nga ba ma bzhi'i rjes su 'jug pa dang / da yig ni/ na ra la gsum gyi rjes su 'jug go /da yi yang 'jug 'di la da drag kyang zer/tshul ci ltar 'jug ce na/ ming la jug pa dang / byed pas bya ba byas pa'i 'bras bu la 'jug pa gnyis las/ ming la 'jug pa ni skabs thams cad du nges can du 'jug la/ byed pas bya ba byas pa'i 'bras bu la 'jug pa ni byas zin 'das tshig la nges can du 'jug kyang / bya tshig dang byed tshig la nges pa med do/ /de la sa yi yang 'jug ming la 'jug pa dper mtshon na/ 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyogs su gtogs pa yi/ /grangs med sangs rgyas tshangs dbyangs gsungs pa la/ /tshe rabs skabs su skyabs kyi thabs la bsten/ /sems can thams cad gdams ngag nyams len mdzod/ /ces pa lta bu ga nga ba ma'i rjes su sa mtha' thob pa rnams ming yin pas skabs thams cad du dgos shing / bya byed sogs kyi 'das

186 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/tshig la 'jug pa/ dper na/ klog byed bklag bya bklags byas na/ /skyong byed bskyang bya rab bskyangs so//skyob byed bskyab bya legs bskyabs nas/ /sgom byed bsgom bya bsgoms zin to/ /zhes pa lta bu ga nga ba ma'i rjesasu samatha' thob pa rnams 'das tshig yin pas thob kyang / bya tshig dang byed tshig la mi dgos so//dper brjod rgyas pa shes rab 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i sa mtha'i rnam dbye rab gsal sgron me las shes par bya'o//15de bzhin du da drag gi thob tshul la yang gnyis las/ ming la 'jug pa ni dper na/ phar phyind 'dzind cing mkhyen pa brtand/ /thard pa'i 'byord pa gyurd cig gu /bsald cing 'tshald to bka' stsold cig /ces pa lta bu da drag ni nges can dang / byas zin 'das pa la 'jug pa ni dper na/ 'don byed gdon bya legs btond cing / /sgyur mkhan bsgyur bya rab bsgyurd nas/ /sgrol byed bsgral bya bsgrald zin to/ /zhes pa lta bu yin pas gzhan la rigs bsgre bar bya'o/ /da drag 'di dgos pa ci'i phyir du 'jug ce na/ spyir yang 'jug rnams 'das pa ston phyir du 'jug pa mang zhing / yang sgos da drag ni bod skad kyi gdangs las kyang yin te/ phyind/ 'dzind/ 'byord/ thard/ rold/ 'phruld rnams sgra shin tu dag par klog pa dag gi sgra'i zur la phaṭa zer ba lta bu da yig gi gdangs nges par thon pas/ de shes pa'i ched du sgra bsgyur smra ba rnams kyis da drag gi srol mdzad do/ /deng sang phal che bas/ da ba sa kyi ga nga gi /ma na ra la gyi ste dper/ /lta bu sdom tshig gis tshim nas na ra la gsum gyi rjes su kyi sgra thob pa nges par med ces go ba ni/ da drag gi gtam 'di rna khung du 'dris par ma byas pa'i skyon yin te/ dpe dag pa rnams su ting nge 'dzin kyi yul/ rnam thar kyi sgo/ pha rol kyi mtha' zhes ka kyi yod pa dang / dag yig rnams su'ang gsal bar byung bas so//da drag shes pa shin tu gal che bas/ dper brjod cung zad bya na/ kun tu/ bstan ces/ ston cig rkyen kyi/ 'dzin kyang / lhan cig brgyan kyang / lan cig rten cing / shin tu/ gson cig smin ce na/zhen cing / mnan to/ brtan cing / bsgyur ce'o/ /zer cing / 'dzer to/ /rol cig mtshar tu/ sprul to//sol cig bstsal to/ /'tshal to/ /bsal ce'o la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /de lta bu na ra la gsum gyi rjes su/tu to cing cig ces kyang sogs thob pa da drag thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin la/ de las gzhan pa'i skabs su na ra la gsum gyi rjes su/ zhing zhig zhes yang sogs thob pa la rtsod pa med mod/ 'on kyang deng dus kyi mkhas pa mang po'i gsung rtsom du/ yin cing / yin kyang / zhes pa mang du byung yang yid

yi ge'i bshad pa mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ 187 rton dka' ste/ de dag ni/ zin kyang / 'on kyang / sogs la dpag pa yin na ches mi 'thad de/ zin kyang /'on kyang / sogs ni da drag gis ming mtha' 'dren tshul yin la/ gal te yin zhes pa da drag can yin na/yin ce na/ yin ce'o/ zhes thob dgos pa la de 'dra cher mi snang zhing / der ma zad da drag ni 'das tshig la 'os che bas/ yin to zhes thob dgos pa las dpe dag pa rnams su yin no zhes pa mang du byung bas/des na yin zhing / yin yang zhes bri na mdzes par sems so//rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa ming bshad pa/rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa/ yi ge las byung ba'i ming bshad pa la/ yi ge gcig tsam la brjod bya ston pa'i nus pa med pas yi ge du ma 'dus pa las ming byung ngo / /'o na kha zhes pa dang / nya zhes pa rim pa bzhin du gdong gi kha dang srog chags nya'i ming ma yin nam/ ci'i phyir ming la yi ge du ma 'du dgos zhe na/ ming du grub pa'i kha dang nya yig la'ang kha' dang nya' zhes 'a yig gi mtha' rten yod pas skyon de med do/ /'di ni sum rtags kyi dgongs pa yin pas nges par khas len dgos te/ sum cu pa las/ā li bzhi las gang ldan yang / /rjes 'jug bcu po ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan sbyor ba yod mi srid/16/ces dang / rtags 'jug las kyang / pho yig de dag rnams la yang / /'jug par bcas pa med na ni//ming dang tshig kyang gsal mi nus/17 /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i yi ge ma mthong ngo zhe na/ de yang skyon med de/ rnam 'grel las/ ma mthong phyir na med pa min/18/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/des na yi ge gnyis sogs 'dus nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra/ ming gi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o/ /de la dbye na/ dngos ming dang / btags ming gnyis/don de la thog mar brda' sbyar ba'i ming gang zhig khyod las don de 'khrul med du go bar nus pa'i sgra don de'i dngos ming gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ ri dwags kyi rgyal po la seng ge zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o/ /dngos ming du 'jug pa'i don de dang 'dra ba'am 'brel ba gang rung rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ gzhi de la phyis brda' sbyar ba'i sgra/ don de'i btags ming gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bram ze'i khye'u sna nyag la seṅge zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o/ /shes bya zhes pa'i sgra dngos po spyi'i ming yin yang dngos po'i ming ma yin pa dang / shes bya zhes pa'i sgra dngos po la 'jug kyang dngos po de'i 'jug yul dang brjod bya yang min/ dngos po la shes bya zhes ming du btags kyang shes bya zhes pa'i sgra dngos po'i btags ming min pa

188 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/sogs kyi khyad par shes dgos pa mang du yod do//rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa tshig bshad pa/rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa tshig bshad pa la/ tshig gi ngo bo/ tshig gi rnam dbye/ tshig sdud/ tshig phrad/ tshig rgyan/ tshig bri tshul dang drug go/dang po ni/ khyad gzhi khyad chos sbyar ba'am rnam dbye dang tshig phrad la sogs pa'i rkyen kyis don gyi khyad par ston pa'i sgra/ tshig gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa mi rtag go zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o//gnyis pa tshig gi rnam dbye ni/ ngag gzhan rnam dbye brgyad po gang rung gi gnas ston byed du rnam par dbye bar bya ba'i sgra de/ rnam dbye'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ dang po dngos po brjod pa/gnyis pa las su bya ba/ gsum pa byed pa/ bzhi pa dbosas ched/ lnga pa 'byung khungs/ drug pa 'brel ba/bdun pa gnas gzhi/ brgyad pa 'bod pa ste rnam dbye brgyad yod do//de rnams kyi mtshan gzhi gang zhe na/ gzhi gcig la macesan na/ bum pa 'di/ bum pa de dag bum pa de rnams zhes pa'i ngag ni/ gang du phye ba'i rnam dbye dang po'i gnas ston pa'i ngag yin/ gang 'byed byed kyi rnam dbye dang po dngos ni/ 'di sgra dang dag sgra dang rnams sgra rnams yin no/ /de bzhin du bum pa ru chu byugs zhes pa'i ngag ni/ gang phye ba'i rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i gnas ston pa'i ngag yin/ gang gis 'byed pa'i rnam dbye gnyis pa dngos ni/ ru zhes pa de yin no/ /bum pas chu skyor zhes pa/ gang phye ba'i rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa'i gnas ston pa'i ngag yin/ gang gis 'byed pa'i rnam dbye gsum pa dngos ni/pas zhes pa'i rjes 'jug gi sa yig de yin no/ /bum pa'i ched du stan bya zhes pa/ bzhi pa dgos ched ston byed du phye pa'i ngag yin/ de 'byed byed kyi rnam dbye bzhi pa ni/ du zhes pa de yin no/ /bum pa las bdud rtsi byung zhes pa/ lnga pa 'byung khungs ston byed du phye ba'i ngag yin/ de 'byed byed kyi rnam dbye lnga pa ni/ las zhes pa de yin no/ /bum pa'i kha dog ces pa/ drug pa 'brel ba ston byed du phye ba'i ngag yin/ de 'byed byed kyi rnam dbye drug pa ni/ 'i sgra de yin no/ /bum pa la bdud rtsi yod ces pa/ bdun pa gnas gzhi ston byed du phye ba'i ngag yin/ de 'byed byed kyi rnam dbye bdun pa ni/ la sgra de yin no/ /kye bum pa zhes pa rnam dbye brgyad pa ste/ kye zhes pas phye ba yin no//ming mtha'i su ru tu du na ra la ste yi ge bdun/ la lar rnam dbye gnyis pa dang mthun/ la lar

/ yi ge'i bshad pa mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ 189bzhi pa dang mthun/ la lar bdun pa dang mthun/ la lar de nyid dang / tshe skabs dang mthun zhing / dper brjod ni gzhan du byas zin to/ /'o na/ du ba yod pas me yod do zhes pa'i rjes 'jug gi sa yig de yang rnam dbye gsum pa yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ de ni rnam dbye bzhi par gtogs so/ /'on kyang dgos ched dang don gcig pa ma yin te/ las gcig la ltos pa'i snga phyi ba yin pa'i phyir te/ las gang gi rgyu mtshan ni las de'i snga logs su grub pa dang / las gang gi dgos ched ni las de'i phyi logs su grub pa yin no/ /rgya gar dang bod dang sog po gsum la rnam dbye brgyad med mi rung zhing / rgya nag la rnam dbye gtan nas mi dgos par/ tshig gong 'og brje ba'i khyad par tsam las ming thams cad brjod par 'dod cing / rnam dbye'i tshab tu phing / shang / chus/ bzhu'u shes pa bzhi 'dod cing / de yang dbyangs sam nga ro yin par mngon pas/ phing zhes pa dbugs cha snyom pa'i shugs kyis thob pa dang / shang zhes pa dbugs gyen du btegs pa'i shugs kyis thon pa dang / chus zhes pa dbugs thad dkar phyir 'phul ba'i shugs kyis thon pa dang / bzhu'u zhes pa dbugs thur du phyung ba'i shugs kyis thon pa dang / ming gang brjod kyang brjod tshul bzhi po 'di las ma 'das zer ro//gsum pa tshig sdud ni/ tshig gi bar gyi rnam dbye rnams bsdus nas ming snga phyi lhan cig tu sbyor bar byed pa ni/ tshig sdud kyi ngo bo/de la dbye na/ las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba/ ba gnyis pa'i bsdu ba/ de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba/ 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba/ zlas dbye ba'i bsdu ba/ mi zad pa'i bsdu ba dang drug yod do//de dag so so'i mtshan gzhi ni rim pa bzhin du/ khyad gzhi khyad chos gzhi mthun par bsdu ba la/las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba zhes bya zhing / dper na/ utpal yang yin/ sngon po yang yin zer rgyu la/ utpal sngon po zhes bsdu ba lta bu ste/ utpal khyad gzhi dang sngon po khyad chos gnyis gzhi mthun par bsdu ba yin pas so/ /khyad gzhi bgrang bya dang khyad chos grangs yinapa bsdus pa'i bsdu ba la/ ba gnyis pa'i bsdu ba zhes bya zhing / dper na lam yang yin lnga yang yin zhes pa/ lam lnga zhes bsdus pa lta bu'o/ /ming tshig gi bar gyi rnam dbye gnyis pa la sogs pa'i rnam dbye drug po gang rung bsdu ba la/ de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba zhes bya zhing / dper na rnam dbye gnyis pa bsdus pa ni/ grong la 'gro ba la grong 'gro lta bu dang / gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ rkang pas 'thung ba la rkang 'thung lta bu dang / bzhi pa bsdus pa ni/ 'byung po'i ched kyi gtor ma la 'byung gtor lta bu dang / lnga pa bsdus pa ni/ chu las skyes pa la chu skyes lta bu dang / drug pa bsdus pa ni/

190 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/rgyal ba'i sras la rgyal sras lta bu dang / bdun pa bsdus pa ni/ 'bras bu la gnas pa la 'bras gnas zhes bsdus pa lta bu'o/ /ming gnyis sam mang po yang rung ma bsdus pa'i skabs kyi brjod bya las don gzhan ston byed du bsdus pa'i bsdu ba la/ 'bru mang gi bsdu ba zhes bya zhing / dper na/ shar dang lho zhes pa shar lho zhes bsdus pa lta bu ste/ ma bsdus pa'i skabs su shar dang lho ston cing / bsdus na me mtshams ston pa lta bu'o/ /ming gnyis sam mang po yang rung bar gyi rnam dbye rnams bsdus nas thams cad kyi tha mar rnam dbye gcig sbyar ba'i bsdu ba la/ zlas dbye ba'i bsdu ba zhes bya zhing / dper na/ phyag 'tshal sangs rgyas la chos la dge 'dun la zhes pa/ phyag 'tshal sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun la zhes bsdus pa lta bu'o/ /tshig sdud gang gi snga mar mi zad pa'i rtags kyi brjod bya gtso bor ston pa'i bsdu ba la/ mi zad pa'i bsdu ba'am grangs med pa'i bsdu ba zhes bya'o/ /rnam dbye dang tshig sdud de dag ni/ tshogs sog pa blo bzang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i sum cu pa'i 'grel pa gsal byed sgron me las byung ba la/19 tshig gi phri snon cungazad tsam las don ji ltar ba bzhin du bkod pa yin no//bzhi pa/ tshig phrad ni/ kyang 'ang yang nyid kho na tsam ste te de shin tu sogs dang /cing ces ce'o ce na cig de bzhin du zhing sogs dang/ de'i tshe na lta bu rnams tshig phrad yin zhing / de rnams rang nyid tshig rkyang gis brjod bya ston mi nus par tshig snga phyi phrad par byas nas don ston pas na/tshig phrad ces bya ste/ tshad ma sde bdun yid kyi mun sel las/ kho na zhes pa'i tshig 'di la tshig phrad ces pa'i rgyu mtshan ni tshig gzhan dang phrad na don ston la ma phrad na don gang yang mi ston pas de skad ces bya'o/20 /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kyang sgra sogs kyi dper brjod la/ sum cu pa las/ tshig rgyan gnyis dang sdud par 'gyur/21 /zhes pa ltar/ mthun pa'i tshig rgyan dang / mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan gnyis dang /sdud tshig gsum la 'jug par bshad pa tsam las spros bshad byas pa cher mi snang bas/ de cung zad bshad na/ rtsa shes ṭika chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho las/ yang sgra ni gsum ste/ nges bzung dang / rnam par brtag pa dang / sdud pa'i don can no/22 /zhes don gsum la 'jug par gsungs so/ /de la nges bzung ni/ dper na bum pa mi rtag pa yang yin skad cig ma yang yin zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rnam par brtag pa ni/ 'on kyang zhes pa lta bu ste/ zla dga'i yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grel pa las/ 'on kyang ni rnam par brtag pa'o/23 /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sdud tshig ni go sla'o//yang / a mra ko ṣar/ smod sdud dri ba dogs pa dang / /srid pa rnams la a'i'o/24 /zhes pa ltar/

yi ge'i bshad pa mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ 191kyang 'ang yang ni mi zad pa'i nang tshan a'i zhes pa de yin zhing / de yang smod pa la 'jug pa ni/ po ti lnga la sbyangs kyang sngon rjes kyi yi ge tsam mi shes so zhes pa lta bu'o/ /dri ba la 'jug pa ni/ du ba yod na me yod mod du ba med kyang me ci ltar yod ces pa lta bu'o/ /dogs pa la 'jug pa ni/ gong bu 'di ba lang yin yang na ba men yin zhes pa lta bu'o/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grel pa las/ yang na zhes bya ba ni phyogs gzhan ston pa'i tshig phrad do/25 /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam pa gcig tu na 'di na sha za yod ces smos kyang ci dgos zhes pa lta bu ste/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ smos kyang ci dgos zhes pa ni som nyi ci zhig mchis zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go26 /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ srid pa la 'jug pa ni/ sngon chad mi srid kyang da srid ces pa lta bu'o/ /de yang dper na/ snyan ngag me long gi sarga dang po las/ sngon gyi rgyal po grags pa'i gzugs/ /ngag gi rang bzhin me long thob/ /de dag nye bar mi gnas kyang / /rang nyid nyams pa med la ltos/27 /zhes pa'i kyang sgra lta bu ste/ de'ang ci ltar zhe na/ me long phal ba ni gzugs brnyan 'char ba po nye bar yod pa la ltos shing / bstan bcos kyi me long ni de lta ma yin par/ bstan bcos rtsom pa po'i mkhas pa da lta mi bzhugs kyang / des brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi me long du bltas na/rtsom pa po mkhas pa yin pa'i tshul ji bzhin 'char bas na/ bstan bcos ni sngon chad ma byung ba'i me long gsar pa'o zhes 'ud chen pos brjod pa'o/ /de'i kyang sgra ni/ phul byung gi tshig ces dpang lo chen pos gsungs shing /28 rgyan dngos ni don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan zhes rin spungs pas gsungs so/29 /'di ni kho bo 'ga' zhig gi rnam dpyod kyi bang mdzod nas phyung ba'i nor bu yin pas/ shes ldan dag gis brjed ngas kyi chom po'i lag tu ma shor ba gal che/dang sgra 'ga' zhig yang sgra dang mthun par 'jug pa'i skabs kyang yod de/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod du/ yang dang dang la skad dod tsa yod cing 'byed sdud kyi tshig yin pas/nyan rang sogs de ltar 'khrungs par ma zad ces pa sdud tshig30 ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ snying rje sems dang gnyis su med blo dang /31 /zhes pa'i dang sgra dang po ni yang sgra'i don no/ /gang gi tshe na zhes pa rgyu mtshan la yang 'jug ste/ rtsa shes las/ gang tshe 'gro ba med pa yi/ /zhes pa 'grel skabs/ rtse shes ṭika chen las/ gang gi tshe ste gang gi phyir na 32zhes bkral 'dug pa dang / 'di ltar zhes pa ni/ 'di skad ces bya ba'am 'chad 'gyur gyi don 'di lta ste zhes pa'i don can te/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ 'di ltar zhes bya ba ni tshig phrad de/ gang gi phyir zhes bya ba'i don no/33 /zhes dang /

192 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/sgron gsal las/ 'di lta ste zhes bya ba ni tshig phrad kun 'byung ba'o/34 /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang zhes pa ni nye bar bstan pa'am yang bskyar gyi don te/ 'dul ba lung las/ de yang zhes bya ba ni nye bar bstan pa dang kun tu bstan pa'i tshig bla dgas so/35 /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ste zhes pa de ka zhes pa'i don yin par/ sgo mang 'dul ba'i mtha' dpyod du gsungs shing /36de ste na zhes pa snga ma las don gzhan du bsgyur ba'i don can du sum pa parnyi tas gsungs so/37 /ni zhes pa rgyu mtshan 'dren pa'i tshig yin par blo brtan bzhi pa'i tshig gter 'grel ba las bshad cing /38 go rim bzlog pa'i don la 'jug par dbu ma bden gnyis kyi 'grel par bshad do//39lnga pa/ tshig rgyan ni/ de la zhes pa lta bu ste/ 'dul ba lung las/ de la zhes bya ba ni tshig gi rgyan no/40 /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gong du bshad pa'i kyang 'ang cing ces sogs kyi tshig phrad kyang tshig rgyan yang yin pas spyir de gnyis 'gal ba min no/ /brjod bya lhag pa ston rgyu yod dam med kyang rung tshig mdzes par byed pas na tshig rgyan zhes bya'o/ /dper na/ yang dag kun tu rnam par rab tu yongs su la sogs pa lta bu'o//tshig rgyan bcug pa'i dgos pa ni grong tshig spong ba'i ched yin la/ grong tshig spong ba'i thabs kyang du ma yod de/ gzugs mdzes so sgra snyan no zhes pa tsam zhig grong tshig las ma 'das pas/ de spong thabs su dper na/ gzugs ni mig gi dpal du gyur/ /gzugs mdzes mig gi bdud rtsir shar/ /lta bu la rang bzhin gyi rgyan zhes bya'o/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /lta bu la dpe rgyan zhes bya'o/ /chos sku'i mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /ji ltar 'tshams pa'i gdul bya'i 'dzin ma la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi char pa dbab tu gsol/ /lta bu la gzugs can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o/ /rgyo la rgya rna ru zhes brjod pa lta bu gab tshig gi rgyan yin pas/ de bzhin du snyan ngag gi nyams dod pa'i tshig thams cad tshig gi rgyan yin zhing / gzhan yang zhe tshig gis brgyan pa dang / mngon brjod kyis brgyan pa la sogs pa yang tshig mdzes par byed pa'i ched yin no//gzhan yang / gcig la 'di/ gnyis la de dag gsum yan la de rnams zhes bya zhing / bya la bgyi/ byed la bgyid/ byas la bgyis/ byos shig la gyis shig sogs tshig gang mdzes bya'o//drug pa/ tshig bri ba'i tshul bshad par bya ba la/ yi ge 'dra min thob tshul spyir bshad pa dang /dka' gnas 'ga' zhig bye brag tu bshad pa dang / yi ge 'ga' zhig bri ba'i tshul dang gsum mo//

yi ge'i bshad pa mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ 193dang po ni/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung las/ legs pa bas kyang mgyogs pa gtso//mgyogs pa bas kyang snyoms pa gtso/ /snyoms pa bas kyang dag pa gtso/ /des na dag pa gtso bo yin/41/zhes gsungs pa ltar yi ge sdeb dag pa gal che'o/ /yi ge dag pa dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ yi ge la brten nas ming brda' sbyor dgos shing / ming brda' sbyar ba'i dgos pa yang brjod don 'brul med du go ba'i ched yin pas/ ming gi zur la lhag chad byung na don phyin ci log tu ston par 'gyur ba ni/ dper na brtse zhes pas snying rje ba'i don ston la/ rtse zhes pas 'phul chad na rtsed mo'i don ston pa lta bu dang / rjes 'jug gi yi ge gcig tsam chad na yang don chen po nor te/ dper na 'jigs pa dang 'jig pa lta bu dang /de bzhin du gug 'greng nor na yang mi rung ba dper na/ 'jig rten gleng na dang 'jig rten gling na lta bu'o//des na spyir ming la/ bum pa ka ba zhes pa dang / bce'on 'khru/sa mkhas pa zhes pa dang / dgag pa sdom pa zhes pa dang / dbyug pa spring yig ces pa lta bu mang du yod cing / de dag ming yin pa 'dra na'ang ming des brjod tshul la gsang ba'i gnad phra mo 'di ltar yod de/ bum pa ka ba snam bu re lde lta bu la bya byed sogs kyi rnam bzhag med pas rnam pa kun tu yi ge'i sdeb gcig par nges la/ brtson pa mkhas pa bstod pa lta bu la bya byed sogs kyi rnam bzhag yod kyang yi ge'i sdeb la 'gyur ba med de/ dper na brtson par bya/ brtson par byed/ brtson par byas so/ brtson par gyis shig ces bya byed sogs dang 'brel na yang 'phul dang mtha' rten sor bzhag byas pas chog pa dang / yang dgag pa sdom pa gding ba lta bu la bya byed sogs kyi rnam bzhag yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'phul dang mtha' rten la phri snon byed dgos pa yang yod de/ dper na/ dgag bya/ 'gog byed/ bkag zin/ khog cig dang / bsdam bya/ sdom byed/ bsdams nas sdoms shig lta bu dang / yang bya byed sogs kyis ma yinapar tshig grogs kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba yang yod de/ dper na/ dbyug pa dang / spring yig ces pa'i spring dang / dpyang thag gi dpyang /gtsub shing gi gtsub lta bu'i ming la yang 'jug med kyang / dbyug pa dbyugs/ spring yig springs/ dpyang thag dpyangs/ gtsub shing gtsubs/ zhes pa'i skabs su tshig tha ma la yang 'jug sbyor dgos pa lta bu dang /de bzhin du grogs dang tshogs la 'as 'phul med kyang/ grogs dang 'grogs/ tshogs la 'tshogs/ zhes pa'i skabs su 'as 'phul thob pa sogs tshig grogs kyi dbang gis yin pa dang / rgyan dang rlan dang mchod pa'i rngan sogs la 'phul mi dgos kyang / byed tshig dang 'brel na/ rgyan gyis brgyan/ rlan gyis

194 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/brlan/ rngan pas brngan/ zhes pas 'phul thob pa dang / de bzhin du sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs pa sogs shes par bya ba mang ngo //byed tshig dngos su med kyang don gyis sbyor dgos pa yang dper na/ gom pa spo/ zhes pa'i sgom pa la 'phul med kyang / gom pa bsgom/ zhes pa'i skabs la 'phul thob pa sogs gzhan yang mang yang pham pa dang thob pa dang dag pa dang dbul phongs dang sngon byung ba sogs la 'as 'phul med kyang / 'pham par 'gyur/ 'thob par 'gyur/dri ma 'dag par 'gyur/ 'phongs par 'gyur/ 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes 'a yis 'phul ba ni ma 'ongs pa go bar bya ba'i ched dang / de bzhin du dri ba dang zhu ba sogs la sa yi mtha' rten mi dgos kyang 'das tshig la/ dris song / zhus so/ /zhes sa yi rjes 'jug sbyor dgos pa'i skabs yod pa dang / gzhan yang ba yi 'phul dang sa yi yang 'jug gnyis ka yod phyin phal cher 'das pa ston pa'i tshul sogs shes par bya ba mang du yod pas/ dper brjod rgyas pa ma byas kyang dka' gnas mgo tsam smos pa 'dis mtshon te gzhan rnams rigs pas rjes su dpag par bya'o//gnyis pa ni/ dka' gnas bye brag tu bshad pa la/ dgag sgrub ces pa'i sgrub pa dang / don grub ces pa'i grub pa gnyis ming yin pa mtshungs shing / brjod don go bar byed tshul la yadabyad par med mod/ 'on kyang sgrub pa dang po brjod tshul la yi ge mi 'dra ba bzhi thob ste/ sngon 'jug yod la yang 'jug med pa/ yang 'jug yod la sngon 'jug med pa/ yang 'jug sngon 'jug gnyis ka yod pa/ yang 'jug sngon 'jug gnyis ka med pa ste bzhi thob bo/ /dpe ni rim pa bzhin du/ bsgrub bya/ sgrubs shigabasgrubs zin/ sgrub byed ces pa lta bu'o/ /don grub ces pa'i grub pa brjod tshul la sdeb mi gcig pa de 'dra thob tshul med do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ sgrub pa ni byed pa po'i rtsol ba la ltos te brjod pa'i ming yin pas/ 'di la bya byed las gsum dang 'das ma 'ongs sogs kyi khyad par sbyar rgyu yod la/ grub pa ni rang gi ngang shugs kyis grub pa'i ming yin pas 'di la dus gsum dang bya byed sogs sbyar rgyu med do/ /de'i phyir dang po la sa mgo thob pa dang gnyis pa la mi thob pa'i gnad kyang de yin no/ /de bzhin du/sgrol grol/ bsgreng 'greng / bsgrig 'grig bskyel 'gyel/ sgyur gyur/ zlog ldog zlum 'dum sogs sbyar tshul mtha' yas so/ /'on kyang byed pa po'i rtsol ba la ltos shing bya byed sogs brtsi rgyu yod kyang / bstod par bya/ bstod par byed/ bstod par byas so/ bstod cig lta bu sdeb mi 'gyur ba yang yod pas/ des na byed pa po'i rtsol ba la ltos pa'i ming la yi ge bsgyur dgos mi dgos gnyis yod pa yang shes par bya'o//

yi ge'i bshad pa mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ 195der ma zad bod skad kyis ming 'dogs tshul du ma yod de/ byed tshig gi sgo nas brjod tshul/las sam bya yul gyi sgo nas brjod tshul/ bya ba byas pa'i 'bras bu'i sgo nas brjod tshul/ skul tshig gis brjod tshul/ bya byed sogs gangadu yang mi gtogs pa'i brjod tshul sogs yod pa las/ byed tshig gis brjod pa'i ming ni/ sgrub thabs zhes pa'i sgrub dang / sgom chen pa zhes pa'i sgom dang / 'bogs chog ces pa'i 'bogs dang / chos srung zhes pa'i srung sogs byed tshig gi sgo nas btags pa'i ming yin te/ de rnams rim pa bzhin du/ bsgrub bya sgrub byed bsgrubs zin sgrubs shig dang / /bsgom bya sgom byed bsgoms zin sgoms shig dang / /dbog bya 'bogs byed phog zin phog cig dang / /bsrung bya srung byed bsrungs zin srung shig /ces pa'i byed tshig dang 'brel gyi gzhan rnams dang mi 'brel ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du sdom pa 'bul ba 'chad rtsod rtsom sogs la dpag ste shes par bya'o//bya tshig gis btags pa'i ming ni/ byin brlab ces pa'i brlab/ bstan bcos zhes pa'i bstan/bslab pa gsum zhes pa'i bslab pa la sogs pa lta bu yin te/ de dag kyang rim pa bzhin du/ brlab bya rlob byed brlabs nas rlobs shig dang / /bstan bya ston byed bstand to stond cig dang / /bslab bya slob byed bslabs so slobs shig /ces pa'i bya tshig dang 'brel gyi gzhan rnams dang mi 'brel ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du mnyam gzhag dang gding ba sogs la mtshon te shes par bya/bya ba byas pa'i 'bras bu'am 'das tshig gis ming btags pa ni/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo zhes pa'i bkod pa/ dgra bcom pa zhes pa'i bcom pa lta bu yin te/ de dag dgod bya 'god byed bkod 'tshar 'khod cig dang / gzhom bya 'joms byed bcom zin choms shig /ces pa'i 'das tshig dang 'brel gyi gzhan dang mi 'brel ba'i phyir/skul tshig gis ming btags pa ni/ yid srubs zhes pa'i srubs/ mgul chings zhes pa'i chings/zlos skyon zhes pa'i zlos pa rnams yin te/ de rnams/ bsrub bya srub byed bsrubs nas srubs shig dang //bcing bya 'ching byed bcings nas chings shig dang / /bzla bya zlo byed bzlas zin zlos shig /ces skul tshig dang mthun gyi gzhan rnams dang mi mthun pa'i phyir/ spyir skul tshig la sngon 'jug mi dgos so//bya byed sogs gang du yang mi gtogs pa'i ming ni/ byin rlabs zhes pa'i rlabs/ khang brtsegs zhes pa'i brtsegs/ dul ba zhes pa'i dul ba/ tshong pa zhes pa'i tshong dang / blo goms pa zhes pa'i goms rnams yin te/ de rnams/ brlab bya rlob byed rlabs zin rlobs shig dang / /brtsig bya rtsig byed brtsigs

196 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/'tshar rtsigs shig dang / /gdul bya 'dul byed btuld to thuld cig dang / /btsong bya 'tshong byed btsongs nas tshongs shig /sogs kyi gang du yang mi gtogs pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i yi ge yod pa la bston du med do/ /nor bsogs zhes pa dag yig za ma tog tu byung zhing / bsod snyoms bsogs zhes pa ngag sgron du byung bas bsogs zhes pa 'di gang du gtogs brtag /yang sa mtha'i rnam dbye rab gsal sgron me las/ grangs dang phreng ba lta bu la/ bsgrang bya sgrong byed bsgrangs sgrongs shig /ces dper brjod mdzad kyang brtag par bya ste/ gal te grangs dang phreng ba lta bu la thams cad sa mgo can thob na/ bgrang bya bgrangs zhes pa'ang gdon mi za bar yod pas/ de'i 'jug sa stongs par 'gyur ram snyam zhing / khyad par du bsgrangs zhes pa gang zag pha rol po la da dung grangs bsgrangs su bcug pa'i skabs la thob 'os kyi/ rang gi grangs 'dren pa'i skabs la 'os pa yin min yang dpyad par 'tshal/ gzhan yang / las sgrib lta bu la/ sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs nas sbyongs shig dang / blo dang sems bskyed lta bu la/ sbyang bya sbyong byed 'byangs nas 'byongs shig /ces khyad par 'byed dam snyam pas dpyad/de dag las byed tshig gis ming thob pa shin tu mang / bya tshig gis ming thob pa de tsam du mi mang / 'das tshig gis brjod pa nyung / skul tshig gis brjod pa shin tu nyung bar sems/ yang ming 'ga' zhig yul skad kyi dbang gis yi ge mi 'dra ba thob pa yod de/ dper na/ snga nyin la khar sang dang kha rtsang /mi gtsang ba la gtsog pa dang rtsog pa/ srab min la mthug dang 'thug tshad longs pa la ldang ba dang 'dang ba lta bu'o/ /de'i phyir de lta bu rnams la 'dam kha'am 'dam nga can zer to//gsum pa/ yi ge bri ba'i tshul la/ spyir gsung rab glegs bam du bris pa dus nam gyi tshe byung ba yin zhe na/ la las bka' bsdu gsum pa'i skabs su byung zhing / de yan du bka' yi ger 'khod pa med par 'dod/ kha cig gis/ sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rgyal po shar ba'i btsun mo sngo bsangs ma/ bud med kyi 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pas mtshan mo sgron me'i 'od las sangs rgyas kyi bka' bklags par 'dul ba lung las gsungs zhes 'dod pa gnyis las/ phyi ma 'thad par sems te/rgyal po gzugs can snying pos/ sangs rgyas la dngos su zhus nas ston pa'i sku brnyan dang / brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya/42 /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gnyis yi ger bris nas/ rgyal po u tra ya na la skyes su bskur ba'i gtam rgyud ltar sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su yang bka' yi ger 'khod pa yod do//

yi ge'i bshad pa mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ 197de lta bu yi ge bri ba'i tshul la/ thig can byung na shin tu legs shing / de min na'ang / ji skad du/thig btab gru bzhi sgrom btsal te/ /gru phyin snag ro med pa dang / /dkar che khongs yangs che snyoms drang //thams cad gru bzhi zur dod legs/43 /zhes pa ltar gyi gzab ma'am/ gshar ma la yang 'bru tsha/ cheg sgrig zlum bri sogs yi ge gang bri yang thams cad thob dag pa tshugs legs pa dgos shing / de yang / ka ga nya ta da na zha sha ha rnams las rkang pa can gyi yi ge dgu zhes grags pa ltar yi ge gzhan rnams las rkang pa cung ring ba dgos/ nga mtha' can gyi gcod mtshams su tsheg dang shad gnyis ka bri/ 'di la shad gong rnams su phyi tsheg spang zhes pa'i brda' sbyar ba mi legs/ spyir tshigs bcad la nyis shad dgos kyang /dmigs bsal ka ga sha gsum gyi mthar chig shad dgos/ gcod mtshams na ro can gyi mthar nyis shad thob/ 'di la slar bsdu'am zla sdud kyang zer/ le'u rdzogs mtshams su bzhi shad dang / sa bcad chen po rdzogs mtshams su sprul shad dang / thig mgor yi ge gcig lus tshe rin chen spungs shad dang / don tshan chen po rdzogs mtshams su le'u bya zhing / le'u dang / rab byed dang / skabs dang / sarga dang / dum bu dang / rtog pa dang / brtag pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs su yang 'jugayi ge 'ga' zhig gi dmigs bsal ni/ stag lpags zer ba lta bu rnam dbye drug pa dbyi ba'i skabs su la lpags thob la/ stag gi pags pa zhes rnam dbye drug pa dang 'brel tshe pa rkyang thob pa dang /de bzhin du sog tsha rgya tsha zhes tshig grogs dang bsdeb na 'og tu wa yig mi 'dogs shing / sog po'i tshwa rgya mtsho'i tshwa zhes pa'am tshwa ming tshig rkyang bri ba'i skabs su wa yig 'dogs pa mkhas pa'i lugs dang / skad cig thang cig lhan cig ces pa'i cig sgra grangs kyi gcig yin yang gas 'phul med/ de bzhin du sum cu sum brgya sum 'gyur sum brtsegs sum rtsen rnams kyi sum dang / nyis 'gyur nyis brtsegs rnams kyi nyis dang / drug cu bdun cu brgyad cu rnams kyi cu yig sogs la 'phul med pa bkas bcad sngon ma'i lugs dang / bzang ba dkar ba rgyal ba lta bu nga ra la gsum gyi rjes su ba phyed wa ru 'bod pa thob kyang /bzang po dkar po rgyal po zhes na ro sbyar tshe po yig thob pa mkhas pa'i spyi'i lugs yin/ rkang pa stong pa sogs dmigs bsal dang / yul pa zhes pa bdag po'i tshig gi stobs kyis pa yig thob pa yin la/ spyir sum rtags gnyis kyi nang nas rtags 'jug gi don dka'/ de'i nang nas kyang sngon 'jug gi skabs su/pho ni 'das dang gzhan bsgrub phyir/ /ma ning gnyis ka da ltar ched/ /mo ni bdag dang ma 'ongs phyir//shin tu mo ni mnyam phyir ro/44 /zhes pa'i pa'i tshigs bcad 'di dang / rjes 'jug gi skabs su/ snga ma

198 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/sngon 'jug lnga bzhin sbyar/ /pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drangs/ /mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drangs/ /ma ning gis ni ma ning ngo /45 /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di gnyis dka' zhing / khyad par du tshigs bcad tha ma'i don la/ snye thang ba grags pa seṅge'i dag yig gang gā'i chu rgyun sogs las/ na yig dang ma yig gi mtha' rten gyis mo yig drangs pa'i dper brjod du/ yin pa bcom pa 46zhes pa phyed wa ru 'bod pa bkod gnang ba rtags 'jug gi tshig zin dang mthun mod / deng sang sus kyang khas mi len pas dpyad par bya/dri ba dris pa dang rtsod pa 'dzugs pa'i skabs su ci ltar zhes/ sde pa gnyis pa'i dang po ca yig thob/ dper mtshon pa'i skabs su ji ltar zhes/ sde pa gnyis pa'i gsum pa ja yig thob ste/ dper na sgra rtag pa yin zer ba ci ltar yin/ de ci ltar 'gog ces bri dgos/ sgra mi rtag pa ji lta bar bum pa yang mi rtag go zhes bri dgos so/ /'di tsam gyi gnad shes mkhan yang srid mtha' ru snang ngo / /de ltar shes bya re la ming re/ ming re la yi ge mi 'dra ba re yod pas bod kyi yi ge la zad mtha' med pas zhib tu bslab dgos so/ /yi ge la mkhas par sbyangs pa'i phan yin ni/ zha lu lo chen gyi zhal nas/don 'di khong du chud pa'i mi/ /mang po 'dus pa'i nang dag tu/ /mkhas pa'i stan la 'dug par dbang /47 /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas mang tshogs pa'i dbus su smra la dbang ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro//smras pa/ tshogs gsum 'od kyis bkra ba'i sgron me mchog /dmigs med thugs rje'i phyag gis rab btegs te/ /mtha' 'khob mun stug bsal mdzad lo paṇa drin/ /shin tu ljid do mi skyud dran par rigs/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung po'i tshig /kā li sum cur bsdus la ngo mtshar ci/ /mtha' klas ming yig so sor 'jug pa'i tshul/ /bdag blo khab mig lta bur shong ba mtshar/ /mdo rgyud kun la nang byan chud stobs kyis/ /don ldan mkhas pa'i gral 'go ma thob kyang / /yi ge'i 'jug tshul ji bzhin shes tsam gyis/ /mkhas mang 'dun sar bag phebs sdod la dbang / /ming tshig yi ge'i shel gyi rtsig ngos la/ /sum rtags lang ga'i bdag po'i gzugs brnyan 'bum/ /dngos btags dbye bsres dka' ba dpyod mkhas pa'i/ /bdag blo ha nu mant+ra min pa su/ /ming gi 'jug pa'i rin thang bral ba'i nor/ /bdag yid mtsho ru spying na mi rung zhes/ /kun gyis spyad phyir gsar bsgrigs rgyal mtshan rtser/ /bkod nas ris med mchod sbyin spel bar 'dod/ /tshul 'di shes pa gal po cher mthong nas/ /yang yang zhib tu sbyangs pa 'i 'bras rtags su/ /dkar 'jam shog ngor sug pa'i 'du byed kyis/ /bstan bcos gsar ba'i phyi mo 'di bskrun to/ /rnam dag rtsom la gsar du 'jug pa dang/ /snga ma'i gzhung la zhus chen byed pa dang / /lung gi bstan

par gad gtsang bgyid 'dod na/ /legs bshad 'di la gzu dpang bsten kyang chog /tshul 'dir zhugs pa'i sgo gsum rnam dkar mthus/ /mtha' klas chos tshul du ma'i sgor zhugs te/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog spobs pa zab mo yis/ /don gyi snying po mchog la spyod par shog /tshad med bzhi yi dpung gi bkod pa yis/ /yid srubs g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /sku bzhi yid bzhin nor bu'i tog bkod de//'dzad med chos sbyin kun la stob gyur cig/ces yige'ibashad pa mkhas pa'ikha rgyan zhes bya ba 'dinilha ldan grwa skor ba a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar gyis bgyis pa'o// //sarba maṅga le/

༄༅༅/ /snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//a kyuyongs 'dzin dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros/ra༅༅/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rab chu gter che/ /bsrubs skyes nyin mor byed pa'i gzis/ /mun sel rnam dpyod mchog stsol ba'i/ /yab gcig mkhyen gter bdag skyongs shig /sgrib bral shes rab mchog gi khams/ /yid 'phrog mtshan dpe 'bar ba la/ /rnam sad bu mo stong dag gis/ /sgrun min dbyangs can lha mor 'dud/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i mtsho/ /blo bzang klong du 'khyil pa las/ /grags pa'i rba rlabs cher g.yo ba/ /kun mkhyen dpal ldan bla mar 'dud/ /'phags yul mkhas dbang daṇḍi yi//legs bshad tshig rgyan bang mdzod nas/ /gnad bsdus mu tig phreng mdzes 'di/ /skal bzang mgul ba'i rgyan du spel//zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis sngun bsus te/ 'dir las dang po pa dag la phan pa'i phyir snyan ngag gi bstan bcos me long gi don bsdus te cung zad 'chad pa la bzhi/snyan ngag shes pa'i phan yon/ ma shes pa'i nyes dmigs/ snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ gzhung dngos kyi don mdor bsdus te bshad pa'o//dang po ni/ snyan ngag legs par shes pa de gnas skabs su mkhas pa tshogs pa'i mdun sar 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa dang / rnyed pa dang / bkur sti dang / smra ba'i khri la 'dug pa la dbang ba sogs mkhas pa'i snyan pa dang / grags pa 'thob pa dang / dam pa'i chos gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos rtsom pa dang / yul dam pa dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa dang / de ltar bstod pas tshogs rlabs po che bsags te rang gi lhag pa'i lha yang mnyes nas dngos su zhal ston cing byin gyis rlob pa sogs 'byung ste/ dper na/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mis 'jam dbyangs dang / shrī badzra de was spyan ras gzigs dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis sgrol ma la tshig rgyan gyi sdeb sbyor phul du byung ba'i sgo nas bstod pa bgyis pas dngos su rjes su bzung ba'i lo rgyus lta bu'o/ /mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa yod de/ snyan ngag me long las/ snyan ngag chung ngu la yang ngal byas mi/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sa dag tu 'dug la dbang /1 /zhes dang / mdo las/ dam

202 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/pa'i chos gsal bar bya ba'i snyan ngag bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa bya'o/ /de las bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/2 /zhes dang / mdo sde bskal bzang las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni/ /snyan ngag mkhan de bde gshegs rtswa mchog la/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang / /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/3 /zhes gsungs shing / bdag cag gi ston pas kyang / sngon snyan ngag mkhan du gyur pa'i tshe sangs rgyas skar rgyal la snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod pas bskal pa bzhi khri'i tshogs bzlums par gsungs pa sogs shin tu mang ngo //gnyis pa snyan ngag ma shes pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ bstan bcos spyi dang khyad par snyan ngag gi bstan bcos la ma sbyangs shing mi shes pa des skyon yon gyi khyad par ji bzhin 'byed mi nus pa dang / nang don rig pa'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams kyang phal cher snyan ngag gi gzugs kho nar gnas pas na/de dag gi sgra don mi shes par dgongs pa phyin ci log tu bkral bas/ de la mkhas pa rnams kyis blun rmongs ba lang dang ne tso lta bur smad cing / snyan ngag dang mi ldan pa'i grong tshig tsam la brten pa la don bzang por rlom yang mkhas pa'i mdun sar rtsis med de/ dper na/ 'jig rten na lang tsho rgyas shing mdzes pa'i skyes bu zhig rgyan gos dang bral te gcer bur rgyu na skyes bu kun gyis 'phya smod byed pa bzhin no/ /de ltar yang me long las/ skye bo bstan bcos mi shes pas/ /yon tan skyon dag ji ltar dbye/ /gzugs kyi dbye ba dmigs pa'i skabs/ /long pa dag la yod dam ci/4 /zhes dang / de nyid nyes par sbyar na slar//sbyor bo ba lang nyid rjod byed/5 /ces dang / rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ mtshungs med rgyas pa'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa nyid ni ne tso'i klog dang mtshungs/6 /zhes dang / zur mkhar pas/rgyal po lang tshos dregs gyur kyang / /rgyan med pa na skye bos gleng / /de bzhin snyan ngag mi ldan pa'i//bstan bcos mkhas la rtsis su med/7/ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang tshig gi tha snyad la brten nas don zab mo 'tshol dgos pas snyan ngag la sogs pa'i tshig gi tha snyad la mi mkhas pa des/ gsung rab kyi dgongs don phyin ci log tu bzung zhing de ltar nyams su blangs pas rang gzhan thams cad 'phung bar byed pa sogs nyes dmigs mtha' yas te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ gang dag snyan ngag la sogs pa'i//tshig gi tha snyad mi mkhas pa/ /de yis gsung rab dgongs don yang / /phyin ci log tu bkral bas lhung /8/zhes sogs mang du gsungs so//mdor na grol ba don du gnyer ba rnams kyis shes bya rig pa'i gnas thams cad la phyogs

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 203ris med par sbyang zhing shes dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mi 'dod na skyur zhog thob 'dod phyin sangs rgyas yin min shes bya thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen mi mkhyen gyi sgo nas 'jog cing /sangs rgyas zhes pa'i sgra don yang ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs shing shes bya la blo rgyas pa la byed pas na/'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod du khas blangs nas de'i rgyu rig gnas thams cad shes mi dgos par smra ba ni 'gal ba ltag sprod rgyu 'bras kyi rnam dbye la rmongs pa'i 'chal gtam yin te/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos/ nyi tshe ba la nyi tshe dang / /mtha' dag pa la mtha' dag pa'i//'bras bu 'byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa su zhig phyogs res tshim/9 /zhes dang / rje sa paṇa gyis/rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring /10 /zhes dang /ma bslab pa la kun mkhyen du/ /'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden/11 /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/rig gnas rgya chen por thos pa bya long med pa'am sngon gyi bag chags srab pas skal ba med pa rnams kyis kyang rig gnas la sbyong mkhan dang shes mkhan rnams la rjes su yi rang bar byed/ shes pa'i smon lam 'debs/ tha na mgar pa dang lham mkhan sogs kyi bzo spyad lag tu blangs nas 'di lta bu la'ang mkhas par gyur cig ces smon lam 'debs dgos par chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis gsungs pa ltar bya'o/12 /mgar pa sogs kyi bzo de dag shes pa'i smon lam 'debs pa ma gtogs/ lag len du byed pa'i smon lam mi 'debs te/ shes tshad lag tu len ga la dgos/ des na rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis rig gnas spyi dang / khyad par snyan tshig gi rig pa 'di la bslab cing mkhas par bya dgos te/ snyan ngag ni rig gnas kun la lta ba'i mig lta bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag la lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs pa'i bshad par bya ba shin tu mang yang / 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhal nas/ don ldan tshig ni re res kyang / /shes rab can la don kun ston/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gis kyang / /rmongs la phan pa sgrub pa dka'/13 /zhes gsungs pa ltar dgos nus chung ba dang yi ge mangs kyis dogs nas ma spros so//gsum pa snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu ni/ skye stobs kyi shes rab che ba dang / tshe 'dir snyan ngag gi bstan bcos dang / sngon byung gi gtam rgyud dang / ming gi mngon brjod sogs la mang du thos pa'i shes rab dang / rig pa'i gnas rnams la nyan bsam goms pa la gus sbyor dang / rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus che ba ste gsum ni snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa shes pa'i rgyu yin te/ me long las rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa dang / /mang du thos pa dri med dang / /mngon par sbyor ba mi dman pa/ /snyan

204 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/14 /zhes gsungs/rgyu de gsum ga ma tshang yang mang du thos pa dang /snyan ngag gi rig pa la 'bad rtsol chen po bsten pa ste/ rgyu phyi ma gnyis yod na snyan ngag shes pa'i skal ba dang ldan te/ de nyid las/ galate sngon gyi bag chags yon tan gyi/ /rjes 'brel spobs pa med byung med pa la'ang //thos dang 'bad pa dag gis ngag bsten na/ /ci zhig ltar yang nges par rjes 'dzin byed/15 /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/snyan ngag shes dang ma shes pa'i/ /phan yon nyes dmigs legs bsams te/ /snod rung rgyu la 'bad nas ni/ /mkhas par slob pa shin tu gces/ /zhes pa'i bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o//gzhung dngos kyi don mdor bsdus te bshad pa/snyan ngag gi lus bshad pa/bzhi pa gzhung dngos kyi don mdor bsdus te bshad pa ni/ spyir snyan ngag ces par ni rna bar snyan cing yid 'phrog pa'i tshig la bya ste/ 'ga' zhig tu snyan dngags zhes 'byung ba'i dngags ni tha snyad ces bya ba'i brda rnying yin pas don la khyad med cing / de'i bstan bcos la snyan ngag gi mtshan nyid ston pa'i gzhung dang / gzhung de dang mthun par sbyar ba'i snyan ngag gnyis yod la/ dang po ni/ snyan ngag gi gzhung yin la snyan ngag ma yin te/ mtshan gzhi ni/ snyan ngag gi gzhung me long lta bu dang / gnyis pa ni/snyan ngag yin la snyan ngag gi gzhung ma yin te/ dper na/ skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing lta bu'o//zhes mkhas sdi/ba thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/16des na 'di la gsum/ lus bshad pa/ rgyan bshad pa/ zhan la skyon sel ba bshad pa ste/ snyan ngag gi gzhung gi brjod bya thams cad de gsum du 'dus pa yin zhing / de la gang mdzes par bya ba'i gzhi'am chos can la lus dang / de mdzes byed kyi chos la rgyan zhes bya la/ de dag gi zhar la spang bya'i skyon ngos bzung nas de spong dgos par bstan pa'i ched du skyon sel bshad do//dang po ni/ smra ba po'i brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gang dang gang yin de rjod byed kyi tshig gi phreng bar spel ba'i tshig sbyor ni snyan ngag gi lus yin la/ de la dbyen gsum/ tshigs bcad dang / lhugs pa dang / de gnyis spel ma'o//dang po tshigs bcad la sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas dbye na/ bṛtta dang / dzā ti gnyis yod/ rigs kyi

gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 205pa lha ba'i ming / /chu thigs thigs pa thigs phran dang / /chu 'thor chu zil chu yi zer/ /nyar ma chu yi zegs ma'i ming / /'gram dang 'gog byed chu ngogs dang / /pha rol tshu rol phan tshun ngogs/ /'gram ngogs 'jug ngogs chu 'gram ming / /'byin byed rdzab dang 'dam dang ni/ /'dam pa 'jim pa 'ji ba dang / /chu rnyog 'jim rdzab 'dam rdzab ming / /gru chen gzings dang gru gzings dang / /rdzings dang sgrol byed sgrol pa dang / /bskul 'gro 'phyos 'gro seng ge can/ /rta mgo can dang gru shan dang / /chu yi shing rta gru yi ming //gru mkhan gru bdag dbyug pa 'phen/ /gdos pa 'dzin dang skya ba 'dzin/ /rna ba 'dzin dang gru'i skyes bu//kha lo pa rnams mnyan pa'i ming / /gru skya g.yob byed gru'i rnga yab/ /gru'i gshog pa gru'i yan lag /gdos pa rnams ni skya ba'i ming //sgong skyes rnam 'phyog go cha can/ /'gro ldan rnam rgyu rnam par skyong / /bye ma la gnas bum par rgyu/ /gser mig can dang rgyab mtho dang / /mig mi 'dzum dang chus mi 'tshub/ /chu nyal chur tse nya spyi'i ming / /na kra nya mid ma ka ra/ /chu yi srin po kumbhi raḥ/ /bum pa'i mgo dang chus phag pa/ /'dzin khri chu yi zas can dang / /chu yi srin ring chu srin ming / /bul 'gro dal 'gro shubs ngan dang / /khog pa can dang 'gram rkyong dang / /dam por 'dzin dang spa kong dang / /kurmā rnams ni rus sbal ming / /garka ṭa dang ku lī ra/ /kha gyen phyogs dang 'phrog byed mig /'phar 'gro char skyes rma yi gnas/ /lce med bshang sbas sbal pa'i ming / /mu tig skye gnas mu tig phor/ /mu tig 'byung gnas mu tig ma/ /nya skyogs rnams ni nya lcibs ming / /za ma rtog can rus pa'i zer/ /cho lo'i sa bon mgron bu'i ming / /sham kha chu yi ka ri ka/ /sham kha dung dang chu srin gshed/ /khab kyi kha zhes dung dkar ming / /rgya mtsho 'khyil ba bkra shis dung / /de'i mchog dakṣi ṇa wa rte/ /brgya byin sham kha dung dkar mchog /skye ba lnga pa g.yas 'khyil ming //'dam skyes chu skyes mtsho skyes dang / /'dab stong 'dab brgya chu yi rgyan/ /chu yi lang tsho chu nyal dang / /sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan ge sar can/ /dri bzang khang pa 'dab ldan dang / /ge sar bzhad dang ze'u 'bru can/ /nyi mas bzhad dang dpal gos dang / /sbrang rtsi'i 'dzin pa padma'i ming / /padma'i ze ba padma'i skra//ke sa ra dang ze'u 'gru/ /padma'i gtsug phud ge sar ming / /sdong bu ngar ba chu ba dang / ā lu kā dang rkang pa dang / /rtsa ba snal ma yu ba'i ming / /chu skyes sngon po steng 'thung dang / /ind+ra ba ra stobs ngan dang / /rtsib 'bigs dang ni mig gi gnyen/ /sa yi gdu bu chu ram dang / /sa stobs sa 'ching utpal ming / /utpal

206 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/lhugs spel gsum la/ /snyan ngag lus su bshad pa yin/ /zhes pa bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de rnams ni rgyan gyis mdzes par bya ba'i gzhi lus kyi rnam par bzhag pa'o//rgyan bshad pa las/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan/gnyis pa rgyan bshad pa la/ gong du bshad pa'i snyan ngag gi lus de rnams mdzes par byed pa'i chos la rgyan zhes bya ste/ de yang lus sgeg pa dang / nyams kyi rol pa dang / rkang lag gi gar stabs sogs mig gi blta bya'i don gtso bor ston pa'i snyan ngag ni/ lta ba la sbyor phyir gtso bor zlos gar ston la/ blta bya'i don ma yin par rna bar snyan pa'i mnyan bya'i ro nyams gtso bor ston pa ni/ snyan ngag chen po yin pas na rgyan gyi sbyor tshul la de ltar lugs gnyis yod do//rgyan dngos la gnyis/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan dang / thun mong ba'i rgyan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lho phyogs bee darbha'i mkhas pa dang / shar phyogs go ḍā pa'i mkhas pa gnyis kyis rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bzhed tshul shin tu mi 'dra ba re yod pa'i rgyan yin pas na thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan zhes bya ste/ dbye na bcu yod de/sbyar ba rab dwangs mnyam nyid dang / /snyan dang shin tu gzhon pa dang //don gsal ba dang rgya che dang / /brjid dang mdzes dang ting nge 'dzin//18zhes pa ltar bcad lhugs spel ma gsum gang rtsom yang / lus kyi nyams yon tan bcu po 'di'i sgo nas skabs su gang bab kyi nyams 'don pa yin la/ nyams 'don tshul la dngos lho phyogs bee darbha dang /bzlog pa shar phyogs go ḍā wa'i nyams 'don lugs kyi lam srol gnyis su phye ba yin no/ /de las bee darbha'i bzhed pa ni/ tshig gi sbyor ba 'jam zhing mnyen pa dang / go ḍā wa'i 'dod pa ni/ tshig sbyor phal cher rtsub cing gyod ba lta bu zhig go/dang po sbyar ba'i yon tan la gnyis las/ bzlog pa go ḍā wa 'dod pa'i sbyar ba'i yon tan ni/sbyor ba lhod pa srog chung gi yi ge 'ba' zhig lta bu la yi ge gang yang rung ba zhig yang yang bskor ba'i rjes khrid cig yin te/ dper na/ltang ༷nga srid kyi yus nyid du/ /snyid 'ong stongs kyi skab gcig la//yun ring gzhol med ༷nga dag mos/ /yul yol ma mdzad snyad tsam dgongs//

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 207zhes ming gzhi srog chung gi yi ge 'ba' zhig tu yod pa la ya yig lan du mar bskor ba'i rjes khrid lta bu'o/ /dngos bee darbha 'dod pa'i sbyar ba'i yon tan ni sbyor ba lci ba srog chen gyi yi ge mang du yod pa'i chig sbyor zhig yin te/ dper na/sna tshogs shes bya'i chu gter la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i gru rdzings kyis//pha /thar drogrod 'dod skal bzang sheg /skre bral zlogs rjes skyong bar mdzod//ces ming gnye 'i khro ge la srog chen sa ༷dang ༷/ tsha dang / sha dang / ༵ dang / tha ༷dang / pha dang / za ste mang du tshogs pa lta bu'o//srog che chung ni/ rgya yig la sde pa'i dang po ka tsa ṭa ta pa dang / gsum pa ga dza ḍa da ba dang / lnga pa nga nya ṇa na ma dang / mthar gnas ya ra la wa ste bcu dgu ni srog chung dang / srog chen ni/ sde pa'i gnyis pa kha tsha ṭha tha pha dang / bzhi pa gha dzha rte dha bha dang / dro ba sha ṣa sa ha dang / mthar zad kyi yi ge kṣa ste bco lnga'o/ /bod yig ca cha ja gsum ni rim bzhin tsa tsha dza dang / zha ni sha dang / za ni sa dang sbyar te shes par bya la/ 'a yig ni a la 'dus shing srog chung dang / gzhan rnams rgya yig ltar ro//gnyis pa rab dwangs kyi yon tan la gnyis/ dngos lho phyogs pa'i 'dod pa ni/ brjod don 'jig rten la grags pa rab tu dwangs shing gsal bas rtogs sla ba zhig yin te/ dper na/rnyog bral dwangs pa'i mtsho nang du/ /skad snyan sgrog pa ngang mo dkar//'dod dgu'i gar gyis brel ba 'di/ /sred ldan mig gi dga' ston no//zhes brjod don 'jig rten la grags shing gsal bas brjod pa tsam gyis tshegs med du go nus pa lta bu'o/ /bzlog pa shar phyogs pa'i 'dod pa ni/ 'jig rten la grags mi che yang sgra bshad rgyu yod na go dka' ba zhig la'ang 'dod pa yin te/ dper na/dwangs gsal mtsho yi 'jug ngogs su/ /yid 'ong nag min gnyis skyes dag/mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol bzhin du/ /lang long rgyu 'dis gzhan yid 'gug/ces nag min gnyis skyes ni ngang pa dkar po'i ming du 'jig rten na grags pa min pas go dka' yang sgra bshad rgyu yod pa lta bu'o//gsum pa mnyam nyid kyi yon tan la gnyis/ dngos lho pa'i 'dod pa ni/ yi ge'i sbyor ba 'jam

208 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/rtsub cha mnyam pa zhig yin la 'jam rtsub kyi don yang srog che chung la byed de/ dper na/mar gad mdangs kyis byug pa yi/ /dbyar gyi dpal mo yid 'ong mar//chu khur cher 'khrigs sgra sgrog tshe/ /sar sgeg phal cher skad snyan 'khesal//zhes tshigs rkang dang po gnyis ming gzhi 'jam pa kho na dang / phyi ma gnyis rtsub pa kho na yod pas tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa 'jam rtsub cha mnyam pa lta bu'o/ /bzlog pa shar pa'i 'dod pa ni/ yi ge'i sbyor ba 'jam rtsub cha mi mnyam pa zhig la 'dod de/ dper na/yid 'ong dpyid kyi nor ldan ma/ /rtswa ljang 'dab ma'i gos gyon cing //tshang skyes phan tshun sgra snyan sgrog /yid can dga' bde'i dpal gyis brel//zhes rkang pa gsum pa rtsub cing gzhan rnams 'jam pas cha mnyam yang don dang rgyan gyi tshogs phun sum tshogs pa la ltos nas mnyam pa'i yon tan du 'dod do//bzhi pa snyan pa'i yon tan ni/ tshig don gnyis ka la sgra dang don gyi nyams khyad par can dang ldan pa zhig yin te/ de la sgra'i nyams/ don gyi nyams/ gnyis ka la grong tshig spang ba gsum las/ dang po la/ lho pa kho na 'dod pa'i tshig mtshungs nye ba'i sgra'i nyams ni/ tshig snga mar yi ge dang / skye gnas dang /phyi mo dang / brtsegs pa sogs gang sbyar ba de 'og ma rnams su'ang de dang mtshungs par thag nye bar sbyar ba zhig yin te/ dper na/dad gus gdung bas 'dud pa dag /kun la smra mkhas dngos grub stsol//dge mtshan bye ba'i mdzes sku de/ /rtag tu bsten cing snying nas bstod//ces tshigs rkang bzhi po la rim par da yig dang / skyes gnas 'greng bu ste phyi mo dang / brtsegs par mtshungs pa rnams sbyar ba lta bu'o/ /'di la ming gzhi'i gsal byed dang / skye gnas sogs mtshungs pa tsam gyis chog la/ sgra rgyan gyi zung ldan la dbyangs gsal sogs cha thams cad nas 'dra ba zhig nges par dgos so//lho shar gnyis ka ci rigs par 'dod pa rjes khrid kyi sgra'i nyams ni/ tshigs gong 'og tu ming gzhi la gsal byed kyi yi ge gcig yang yang gnig rjes su gzhag khrid pa ltar bzlas te 'byung ba ni rjes khrid kyi don yin te/ 'di la lto shar gnyis ka 'dod pa'i rkang pa la bskor ba'i rjes khrid ni/ dper na/rgya chen chos kyi dgongs don rnams/ /rgyab rten lung dang rigs pa bcas//

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 209rgyal ba'i bzhed pa ji bzhin du/ /rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa legs par ston//zhes pa ltar rkang pa so sor rgya dang rgyab ces sogs ra ma go can gyi rgya la bskor bas na rkang pa la bskor ba'i rjes khrid ces bya'o//gnyis ka 'dod pa tshig la bskor ba'i rjes khrid ni/ dper na/rab 'byams chos kyi rang bzhin rnams/ /ma lus ji bzhin ma nor gzigs//thugs rjes kun la rjes brtse ba'i/ /mgon po khyod la mgo bos 'dud//ces pa lta bu rkang pa'i tshig la rab dang rang / ma gnyis/ rjes gnyis/ mgon dang mgo zhes pa rnams bzlas te byung bas na tshig la bskor ba'i rjes khrid ces bya ste/ rjes khrid la bod skad kyi dbang du byas tshe ming gzhi'i yi ge mtshungs pas chog cing / 'phul dang mtha' rten sogs gcig pa mtha' gcig tu mi dgos so//ring bar thos pa'i rjes khrid ni/ dper na/dpal gyi 'dab ma'i bzhin ras la/ /bung ba'i mig gi dpal 'dzin cing //dri sbrel zhal gyi ge sa rar/ /ma la ya yi dri bsung 'thul//༷zhes dpal gnyis dang / dri zhes pa gnyis kyi bar bye yi ge shin tu mang pos chod nas rgyang ring bas na ring bar thos pa'i rjes khrid ces bya ste/ 'di rjes khrid du lho pas nam yang mi 'dod cing / shar phyogs pa'ang mtha' gcig tu 'dod pa ma yin no/ /zhes rin spungs pas gsung /19 dharma kirti ni/yul dbus pa 'ga' zhig dang / shar phyogs pa 'dod par bshad do//20shar pa kho na 'dod pa'i rjes khrid ni/ dper na/sgom sgrub chos sgras sgrib las sgrol/ /sgeg mo sgor sgug mchu sgros sgrib//gdong zlodzes 'do/ yo/ 'dod pa ༷dag /bdog pa'i don du mdo ru dong //zhes tshigs su bcad pa'i phyed snga ma zlob pa'i yi ge sa /go can sgye sga yigaX bskom zhing / phyed phyi ma 'jam pa da yig la o sbyar ba'i 'jam rtsub bsres pa'i rjes khrid lta bu'o//gnyis pa don gyi nyams ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i sgra'i nyams kyang snyan pa'i ro nyams phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan mod/ de las kyang rgyan mtha' dag la snyan pa dang sgeg pa sogs brjod bya'i don gyi nyams khyad par can 'don pa shin tu gal che ste/ sgra'i nyams rna bar snyan pa tsam pi wang dang gling bu'i sgra

210 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/la'ang yod pa'i phyir ro//gsum pa sgra don gnyis ka la grong tshig spang ba la/ dang po spang bya don gyi grong pa ni/ dper na/snying sdug mdzes ma khyod mthong bas/ /yid la chags pa lhag par rgyas//'o dang 'byud pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /'dod dgu'i rtsed 'jor rol zhig gu//zhes pa'i brjod don ngo tsha'i gnas su gyur pa tshogs pa'i mdun sar dbyung du mi rung ba lta bu ni don gyi grong pa dang / de spong byed kyi nyams ji ltar 'don pa ni/zla ba'i bzhin ras 'dzum 'od kyis/ /yid kyi chu gter ci yang rgyas//ku mu da yi dga' ston gyis/ /longs spyod gsar ba stsol cig kye//zhes pa lta bu ste tshig snga phyi gnyis kyi brjod don 'dod pa'i gtam du mtshungs kyang / snga ma ltar na btsog gtam du 'gyur la/ phyi ma ni btsog gtam de bsgribs te snyan pa'i ro nyams dang ldan par byas pa'o//gnyis pa sgra'i grong pa la/ tshig gi mtshams sbyor gyis zhugs pa ni/ tshig gi gcod mtshams nor na don log 'gro ba zhig yin te/ dper na/ma ma byas pa'i lus can ni/ /gang yang tshad mas ma dmigs phyir//pho mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yis/ /bdag gzhan mnyam par lta bar byed//ces pa ma dang pho zhes yar gcod dgos pa la/ ma ma dang pho mtshan zhes mar bcad na don log nas mi mdzes par 'gyur ba lta bu'o//ngag tshig gi don la zhugs pa'i grong pa ni/ tshig gcig yin na'ang don tha dad la 'jug pa'i dbang gis log pa mi mdzes par nor 'gro ba zhig yin te/ dper na/rab tu gdung ba 'phrog byed pa'i/ /yid 'ong padma can dag la//tshim med ci dgar rol pa yi/ /dga' bde'i snang ba yud tsam yin//zhes pa padma can ni mtsho dang bud med gnyis ka la 'jug pas/ tsha bas gdung ba mtsho la khrus kyi phyir rol ba'i don du bsam mod/ go lugs gcig la chags pas gdung ba bud med la rol ba'i don du go nas btsog gtam du 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /dmigs bsal skyon med pa ni/ dper na/mi brtan 'gyur ba'i chos can gyi/ /ma sring mo yi rang bzhin la//bu tshas byams shing dbang po ni/ /nam yang g.yo ba'i go skabs bral//

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 211zhes mo'i rang bzhin ni mo mtshan dang / dbang po pho mtshan la 'jug kyang / ma sring dang bu tsha smos pas btsog gtam du go thabs med pa 'di lta bu ni skyon yod pa ma yin no//lnga pa shin tu gzhon pa'i yon tan la/ dngos lho pa'i lugs ni/ 'jam pa'i yi ge shas che zhing mang ba'i tshig sbyor zhig ste/ dper na/yid 'ong 'dam skyes dga' tshul du/ /'dod dgur rgyu ba'i glu dbyangs mkhan//dregs ldan sbrang rtsi spyod pa rnams/ /sna tshogs gar gyis rtsen par byed//ces yi ge tsheg bar nyerjo brgyad zlos rtsub pa'i tsho/ par bdun dang 'jam pa nyer gcig yod pas shas che ba lta bu yin zhing / yi ge thams cad 'jam pa ni sbyor ba lhod pa'i skyon du bshad do/ /bzlog pa shar pa'i lugs ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i 'jam pa shas che ba de skabs 'gar sbyar yang phal cher rtsub pa'i yi ge mang zhing brjod dka' ba zhig la 'dod de/ dper na/legs skyes rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa'i tshal/ /snye ma phang phung chags pa'i rtser//skad snyan sgrog pa'i ko ki la/༷ /sgro gagog brkyangathe snye ga( staṅges bsgyur//zhes rtsub pa'i yi ske ma/ bas brjod dka' ba'i tshirge sbyor lta bu'o//drug pa don gsal gyi yon tan la/ dngos lho shar gnyis ka 'dod pa ni/ brjod bya'i don de sgra dang rtags las gsal bas gtan tshigs kyis brtag mi dgos pa zhig yin te/ dper na/bde 'byung gtsug rgyan zla tshes 'di/ /sum rtsen tshogs kyis nor rgyas sprul//lhun por dkris nas 'o ma'i mtsho/ /legs par bsrubs pa dag las byung //zhes dbang phyug gi gtsug rgyan zla tshes ni rgya masnang bsrubs pa las byung bar tshig zin la gsal bas brtag mi dgos par go nus pa lta bu'o/ /bzlog pa shar pa 'ga' zhig 'dod pa ni/ bstan don de rjod byed kyi sgras ma zin cing rigs pas kyang bsgrub mi nus pas mi gsal zhing go dka' ba zhig ste/ dper na/mtho ris gtso bo mgrin sngon gyi/ /gtsug rgyan gsar ba'i zla tshes ni//nag po brtsegs pa'i spun zla ste/ /chu gter chen po dag las byung //zhes pa'i brjod bya snga ma dang gcig kyang zla tshe sa rgya mtsho las ji ltar byung ba mi gsal bas/ brtags kyang go dka' ba lta bu'o/ /'di dang gong gi rab dwangs gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ rab dwangs ni brjod bya'i

212 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/don de 'jig rten la grags pa zhig nges par dgos la/ don gsal ni 'jig rten la grags ma grags khyad med cing sgra dang rtags las don gsal bar rtogs nus pa zhig yin/ shar pa'i lugs la'ang rab dwangs ni nges tshig la brtags pas go nus shing / don gsal ni de ltar ma yin par gtam rgyud ma shes na brtags pas go mi nus pa'o//bdun pa rgya che ba'i yon tan la/ dngos lho pa'i lugs ni/ don 'ga' zhig dngos su brjod pa'i shugs las brjod yul de khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan dang ldan par rtogs nus pa zhig yin te/ dper na/mtsho byung lha mo'i mtshan snyan ni/ /sgra 'dzin lam du lhung tsam gyis//mkhas pa tshogs pa'i mdun sa sto /smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs su mtho//zhes dbyangs can ma'i mtshan la byin rlabs che bar dngos su ma smras kyang / mtshan tsam thos pas mkhas pa'i mdun sar smra ba'i spobs pa che bar gyur par smos pa'i shugs kyis/ mtshan tsam la'ang byin rlabs shin tu che ba'i yon tan yod par rtogs nus pa lta bu'o/ /bzlog pa shar pa'i lugs ni/ bsngags par 'os pa'i khyad par gyi chos 'ga' zhig dngos su brjod pa'i shugs las chos de dang ldan pa'i chos can de ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan rgya chen po dang ldan par go nus pa zhig ste/ dper na/yid bzhin padma'i dga' tshal du/ /rnga yab thogs pa'i bu mo yi//gser gyi mgul rgyan las 'phyang ba'i/ /mu tig do shal sil sil sgrog/ces pad tshal dang mgul rgyan mu tig gi do shal sogs khyad par gyi chos dngos su smos pa na/ de ldan gyi gzhi chos can de 'byor ba'i yon tan rgya chen po dang ldan par shugs la go nus pa lta bu'o/ /'di dang 'og gi rgya che ba'i rgyan gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ 'di ni bsngags par 'os pa'i khyad par thams cad la sbyar du rung la/ don rgyan gyi rgya che ba ni bsam pa dang 'byor ba rgya che ba gnyis tsam du zad pas spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par yod do//brgyad pa brjid pa'i yon tan ni/ tshig sdud mang po can gyi sbyor ba zhig yin zhing / 'di la shar pa'i lugs ni/ tshig sdud mang zhing yi ge lci yang grangs mi mnyam pa'i tshig sbyor zhig la 'dod de/dper na/

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 213khyod gdong mdzes pa la gnas pa'i/ /brtan pa 'phrog pa mig gi 'phrul//chu skyes lte ba la g.yo ba'i/ /bung ba'i dpal la co 'dri byed//ces pa'i tshig sbyor tshig sdud can la lci ba bco brgyad dang yang ba bcu ste lci yang cha mi mnyam pa lta bu'o//lho ba'i lugs ni/ tshig sdud can gyi sbyor ba lci yang mnyam pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ku mu da kha bye ba bzhin/ /zhal dkyil rgyas pa dkar la mdzes//ma gcig sgra dbyangs lha mo yis/ /smra ba zla med spobs pa stsol//ces yi ge lci yang bcu bzhi re yod par mnyam pa'i tshig sdud can gyi sbyor ba lta bu'o/ /skabs 'dir bod yig la lci yang gi khyad par ni/ 'greng bu dang / na ro dang / mtha' rten can rnams lci ba dang / gu gu dang /zhabs kyu can dang / mtha' rten med pa rnams yang bar mkhas pa rnams gsung ngo //dgu pa mdzes pa'i yon tan la/ dngos lto pa'i lugs ni/ bstod yul de'i bsngags pa 'jig rten pa'i grags tshod ltar mchog dman bar ma kun gyi blo ngor 'tsham par brjod pa zhig yin te/ 'di la sbyar gzhi sngon byung gi gtam la sbyar ba'i dper brjod ni/sra mkhregs sa 'dzin bgrod pa dag /phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse brgya pas//'joms pa'i lha dbang grags snyan gyis/ /sum rtsen khyon kun dog por bgyis//zhes pa'i gtam rgyud sngon ri rnams 'gro 'dug byed pas sems can mang po la gnod pa na brgya byin gyis rdo rje bsnun nas ri'i rkang pa bcag ces pa'i grags pas lha yul gyi khyon thams cad 'gengs zhes ran pa'i tshul gyis brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bsngags pa la sbyar ba'i dper brjod ni/legs byas bye ba'i dpal yon can/ /lha cig 'di yi gtong phod kyis//'bangs rnams dbul ba kun btang nas/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par byed//ces rgyal po'i gtong ba'i yon tan 'jig rten pa'i blo ngor 'tsham par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bzlog pa shar pa'i lugs ni/ bstod yul gyi bsngags pa 'jig rten gyi grags tshod las 'das par blo yul du mi shong ba lta bur sgro btags te brjod pa zhig yin te/ 'di gtam la sbyar ba ni dper na/mkhar nyal gtso bo lha dbang gi /phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse brgya pas//sa 'dzin bgrod pa 'joms pa yi/ /grags snyan kun gsal khyon las brgal//zhes gtam rgyud snga ma ltar la brgya byin gyis ri rnams 'joms pa'i grags pa nam mkha'i mtha' las

214 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/brgal ces 'jig rten na mi srid par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bsngags pa la sbyar ba ni/ dper na/bsod nams bgo skal la spyod pa'i/ /sa gzhi skyong ba khyod kyi ni//phun tshogs dge mtshan yon tan 'di/ /lha dbang la yang yod re skan//zhes mi yi rgyal po 'di'i phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal lha'i dbang po la'ang med ces ha cang sgro btags te 'jig rten pa'i blo yul las 'das par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /shar pa'i mdzes pa'i yon tan 'di dang 'og gi phul byung gi rgyan gnyis zhabrul so che yang / phul byung gi rgyan ni/ 'jig rten na ji ltar gnas tshod kyi mtshams las 'das par gyur pa'i nyams kyis blo ngor 'tsham par brjod pa zhig yin la/ 'di ni ha cang 'ud che ba'i ngag gis sgro btags te phal ba'i blo yul du mi shong bar brjod pa zhig yin pas khyad par che'o//bcu pa ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan ni/ chos can gzhan la yod pa'i khyad par gyi chos dngos po gzhan zhig la btags nas bkod pa na 'jig rten pa'i tha snyad la mdzes shing rna bar snyan pa zhig yin te/ 'di la dper brjod gsum las/ spyir brjod pa ni/ dper na/tsha zer myos chu 'thung ba yis/ /ātpal gnyid du yur ba la//rgyu skar bdag po 'a〈com mu le/ /bsil zer bran pas sad par byed//ces 'ga' zhig chang 'thung nas ra ro ste gnyid du song ba dang sad pa'i khyad par gyi chos de chos can gzhan utpal dang zla zer la btags nas brjod pa lta bu'o/ /chos gcig bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/dper na/chu gter zla 'od zag pa rnams/ /'thungs nas rlabs phreng zag pa yi//rab g.yo'i kha las lha ba'i rgyun/ /yang nas yang du zag pa bzhin//zhes gzhan gyi chos zag pa gcig pu de dngos po gzhan rgya mtsho dang zla ba la btags nas bkod pas na chos gcig bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /chos du ma bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ dper na/snang byed 'od kyi lde mig gis/ /dri bzang khang pa kha phye tshe//ra yig gnyis pa gnyid sad nas/ /bag med rol rtsed ci dgar 'thung //zhes dngos po gzhan la yod pa'i khyad par gyi chos du ma de gzhan padma dang bung ba la btags nas bkod pas na chos du ma bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan zhes bya'o/ /'di dang don rgyan gyi bsdus brjod

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 215dang / rab rtog gi rgyan gsum gyi khyad par ni/ 'di ni gzhan gyi chos gzhan la btags nas bkod pa zhig yin la/ bsdus brjod kyi rgyan ni/ gzhan gyi chos gzhan la 'god dgos par ma nges shing mtshungs pa'i dngos po tsam brjod cing thams cad la sbyar du rung ba'ang yin no/ /rab rtog gi rgyan ni/ dngos po'i gnas tshul gzhan du sgro btags pa tsam las gzhan gyi chos gzhan la bkod pa'i nges pa med cing / dpe rgyan gyi mtshungs gsal bzhin rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra'ang nges par tshang dgos pa yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan 'di ni lam gnyis ga'i thun mong gi yon tan du dpang los gsungs pa ltar mkhas pa phal cher 'dod la/ snar thang lo tsā pas/21 yang na snga ma gnyis bee darbha'i yin la/ phyi ma gcig pu go ḍā wa'i yin par byas na'ang legs gsung ba/ thun mong ma yin pa zhes pa'i go don dang mthun pa sogs dgos pa du ma yod pas legs bshad du snang ngo //lho shar mkhas pa so so yi/ /thun mong min pa'i yon tan bcu'i/ /dper brjod go don dang bcas pa/ yid ngu rnam gsal tshul du bkod/ /snyan ngag me long las le'u dang po'i don bsdus pa'o// // thun mong gi rgyan bshad pa/don rgyan bshad pa/gnyis pa thun mong gi rgyan bshad pa ni/ lho shar gnyis kyi mkhas pa rnams mthun par thun mong du bzhed pa'i rgyan yin pas na thun mong gi rgyan ces bya'o/ /'di la dbye na gsum/ don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan dang / gab tshig gi rgyan no//dang po ni/ brjod bya'i don sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa'i rgyan yin pas na don rgyan ces bya zhing / dbye na so lnga yod de/ gzhung nyid las/rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni/ /gzugs can gsal byed skor ba dang //'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang / /ldog pa can dang srid pa can//bsdus dang phul byung rab btags dang / /rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim//dga' dang nyams ldan gzi brjid can/ /rnam grangs brjod dang kun tu phan//rgya che bston dor sbyar ba dang / /khyad par mtshungs par sbyor ba dang //gal dang skabs min bstod pa dang / /zol bstod nges par bstan pa dang //

216 bde dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/lhan cig brjod dang yongs brjes shis/ /rab spel de nas dgongs pa can//22zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//de las dang po rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ chos de'i gnas tshul las gzhan du sgro ma btags par rang bzhin gang yin drang por brjod pa'i rgyan cig yi na te/ dper na/mtshan dpe lang tsho rab rgyas sku/ /snyan 'jebs tshangs dbyangs ldan pa'i gsung //dri bral chos kun gzigs pa'i thugs/ /dbyangs can lha mos dge legs stsole//ces dbyangs can ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rnams sgro ma btags par gnas tshul drang por brjod pa lta bu'o//gnyis pa dpe rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor der dpe dang dpe can gnyis so sor phye ba'i sgo nas mtshungs par brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/mdzes sdug 'dzum ras rgyas pa'i zhal/ /ston zla bye ba'i dpal dang mtshungs//thags bzang tshems dkar phreng ba ni/ /mu tig star la brgyus pa 'dra//zhes dbyangs can ma'i zhal ras dang tshems phreng / ston zla dang mu tig gi phreng ba dang mtshungs par brjod pa lta bu'o// gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan ni/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis so sor ma phye bar dpe can de dpe'i gzugs su bkod nas brjod pa'i tshig sbyor zhig yin te/ dper na/mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor cha shas rdzogs/ /byin rlabs 'od brgya'i dra ba can//blo gros ku mud bzhad mdzad pa/ /smra ba'i lha mo mtshan mo'i mgon//zhes dpe can dbyangs can ma sogs dpe zla ba'i gzugs sogs su bkod de brjod pa lta bu'o//bzhi pa gsal byed kyi rgyan ni/ tshigs su bcad pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung na yod pa'i tshig gcig gis de'i don gzhan rnams gsal bar byed pa zhig yin te/ dper na/smon no lha dbang dpal 'byor la/ /'dod ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams te//khyod kyi yon tan phung po la'ang / /blo gsal thar 'dod rnams kyis so//zhes thog ma'i tshig smon zhes pa 'dis sred ldan lha dbang gi dpal 'byor la smon pa dang / thar 'dod kyis dbyangs can ma'i yon tan la smon pa gnyis ka gsal bar byed pa lta bu'o//

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 217lnga pa skor ba'i rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor de'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung du don dang tshig dang tshig don gnyis ka 'dra ba ci rigs bskor te brjod kyang zlos skyon med pa zhig ste/ dper na/mtshar sdug sku yis gzhan yid 'phrog /yid 'bab gsung gis som nyi bcil//byin rlabs rgyun gyis sdig lhung 'a 9spyod/ /thugs rjes blo mun ma lus sel//zhes 'phrog /bcil/ zhabrud/ sel sogs don 'dra ba bzlas te brjod kyang dbyangs can ma'i sku sogs khyad gzhi tha dad la sbyar ba'am brjod tshul tha dad pas zlos skyon mi 'byung ba lta bu'o//drug pa 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor der dgag bya'i yul gang yang rung ba la de 'gog byed kyi tshig brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na/ /gsung dbyangs drug cu ldan bzhin du//'jam mnyen phra ldem phyag zung gis/ /rgyud mangs sbreng ba'i ngal 'dis ci//zhes ngal ba 'dis ci bya zhes 'gog byed kyi tshig gis rgyud mangs sbreng ba 'gog pa lta bu'o//bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod kyi chos 'ga' zhig sngon la bkod nas de'i sgrub byed cig spyi khyab tu rjes su brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/thugs rje'i gter chen tshangs sras ma/ /'gro la ngag gi dbang phyug stsol//yid bzhin nor bus skye dgu yi/ /re 'dod rab tu skong bar byed//ces dbyangs can ma ngag gi dngos grub ster nus pa'i sgrub byed du yid bzhin nor bus re 'dod skong nus pa bkod pa lta bu'o//brgyad pa ldog pa can gyi rgyan ni/ brjod bya'i dngos po gnyis sngon la mtshungs par bstan nas slar mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad yod par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/mtsho byung ma dang bsam 'phel nor/ /re 'dod skong la nyer mtshungs mod//'di ni bem chos rang bzhin te/ /lha mo sgrib bral ye shes dngos//zhes sngon la mtsho byung ma dang bsam 'phel nor bu gnyis re 'dod skong ba'i sgo nas mtshungs par bstan te/ slar de gnyis ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin min gyi khyad par phye nas mi mtshungs par ston pa lta bu'o//dgu pa srid pa can gyi rgyan ni/ rab tu grags pa'i rgyu la ma ltos par 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo 'byung srid par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/

218 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ma bris mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkra/ /ma phyis dri bral zhal dkyil mjes//bcol med phan bde spel bar mdzad/ /ma 'dris mdza' bshes dbyangs can lha//zhes rgyu tshon gyis 'bri ba sogs la ma ltos par 'bras bu mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkra ba sogs 'byung srid par ston pa lta bu'o //bcu pa bsdus brjod kyi rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod kyi dngos po 'ga' zhig la bsams nas de dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan zhig dngos su brjod pa'i sgo nas brjod don dngos de go bar byed pa yin te/ dper na/shin tu snyan pa'i gre 'gyur dang / /ngo mtshar 'dab gshog zung 'brel can//yid 'ong ngang pa'i bu mo yis/ /bdag la rab tu brtse bar mdzod/ /ces brjod don dbyangs can ma la bsams nas/ dngos su de dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan 'dab chags ngang pa brjod pa lta bu'o//bcu gcig pa phul byung gi rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod kyi dngos po de la blo yul du mi shong ba ltar bsngags pa lhag par byas pa zhig yin te/ dper na/rgyal kun gcig bsdus yum khyod kyi/ /ngo mtshar yon tan phung po ni//dpag nus min yang 'dir 37nga ba/ /a ma khyod thugs shin tu yangs//zhes dbyangs can ma'i yon tan la bsngags 'dod kyi blos yon tan rgya che ba de shong ba ni thugs kyi khyon shin tu yangs zhes ha cang phul du byung ba'i rnam pas brjod pa lta bu'o//bcu gnyis pa rab btags kyi rgyan ni/ rab rtog kyang zer ro/ /dngos po de'i gnas tshul drang por mi brjod par rnam pa gzhan du sgro btags nas brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/dbyangs can lha mo phyag sor gyis/ /nor bu'i rgyud mangs sbreng ba 'di//ting 'dzin bde bas thugs sun te/ /'dod yon sgra la g.yengs sam snyam//zhes dbyangs can ma'i phyag mtshan pi wang sbreng ba la ting nge 'dzin gyis bde bas thugs sun nas sgra snyan la g.yengs par sgro btags nas brjod pa lta bu'o//bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod kyi dngos po de'i byed po'i rgyu'i rigs go bar byed pa'i sgo nas ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 219phul byung chu zheng gab pa'i sku/ /yid 'ong zhal dkyil 'dzum pa'i 'od//ga bur thigs phreng spro ba 'di/ /yid la dga' ba skyed pa'i rgyu//zhes dga' ba skyed pa'i rgyu khyad par ba dbyangs can ma'i sku'i yon tan ston pa lta bu'o/ /skabs 'dir skyed byed dang / nyams byed dang / sgyur byed sogs byed po'i rigs la rgyur 'jog pa yin pas skyed byed kyi rgyu kho nar ma nges/ de dag brjod byar byed pa'i ngag gi sbyor ba ni rgyu'i rgyan du bshad do//bcu bzhi pa phra mo'i rgyan ni/ lus kyi brda'i zur ram rnam 'gyur phra mo'i sgo nas don de go bar byed pa zhig yin te/ dper na/khyod kyi zhabs zung dran pa'i tshe/ /sor bcu snying ga'i ngos su zum//mkhas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sa nda/ /bzhin gyi mdangs kyang rab tu rgyas/ /zhes dbyangs can ma'i zhabs zung dran pa na thal mo sbyar ba'i brda dang / bzhin mdangs rgyas pa'i rnam 'gyur phra mo des nang gi dad pa dang spobs pa mchog tu gyur pa go nus pa lta bu'o/ /rgyan 'di la 'ga' zhigangag tu ye ma brjod pa'i snyan ngag tu 'dod zer ba ni brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi khyad par ma phyed pa ste/'dir ngag gi rnam 'gyur du ma thon pa'i lus kyi brda dang rnam 'gyur phra mo de brjod byar byed pa'i tshig phreng la bya dgos pas ngag tu ma brjod pa dang snyan ngag yin pa 'gal lo/ /des na dper brjod dang 'grel pa 'gar/ lus ngag sogs kyi brda dang rnam 'gyur zhes pa'ang ngag gi brdas don gzhan go bar byed pa ni bsdus brjod kyi rgyan tu gtogs la/ sogs kyi sgras kyang don gzhan bsdu rgyu med pas 'thad par ma mthong ngo//bco lnga pa cha'i rgyan ni/ dngos po'i rang bzhin gsal ba'i rnam pa de zol gyis sgrib cing sbed par byed pa zhig yin te/ dper na/sgra dbyangs lha mo'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rig gzhud thogs med smra ba la//sgyu ma lus kyi khams blershams pas/ /smra lce bde ba yin pa skad//ces 'phags ma'i mthus spobs pa thogs pa med pa de zol gyis sbed pa'i phyir khams snyoms pas smra lce bde ru song zer ba lta bu'o/ /skabs 'dir cha'i don la/ sgrib byed kyi cha la sbyar tshul dang / bsgrib bya'i cha la sbyar tshul gnyis yod do//bcu drug pa rim pa can gyi rgyan ni/ dngos po 'ga' zhig sngon la bkod nas de dang 'brel ba'i

220 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/don rnams rim pa bzhin du rjes su brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/'phags ma khyod kyi sku dang ni/ /gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba dag/rab tu mdzes dang zab cing snyan/ /dri bral chos kun gzigs pa lags//zhes dbyangs can ma'i sku gsung thugs rnams sngon du bkod nas/ rjes su de gsum gyi yon tan rim pa bzhin rab tu mdzes pa sogs brjod pa lta bu'o//bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i rgyan ni/ rgyu 'ga' zhig la brten nas dga' ba khyad par can skyes par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ma lus rgyal ba'i yum gcig pu/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo'i mtshan snyan 'di//de ring thos pas dga' ba la/ /bsam gtan bde bas mtshon nus min//zhes 'phags ma'i mtshan thos pas dga' ba khyad par can skyes par brjod pa lta bu'o//bco brgyad pa nyams ldan gyi rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod kyi dngos po de yid du 'ong mi 'ong sogs kyi nyams dang ldan par brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/dpag yas bskal par mjal dka' ba'i/ /'phags ma'i gsang gsum yon tan gyi//cha tsam mos pa'i skal ba 'di/ /bsam gyin dga' ba'i gar gyis rtsen//zhes 'phags ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan la cung zad mos pa'i skal ba thob pa 'di bsam bzhin yid la dga' ba cher rgyas nas lus kyis gar byed par brjod pa lta bu'o/ /gong gi dga' ba'i rgyan gyi dga' ba ni/ nang bsam pa'i 'gyur ba lus ngag tu ma thon pa dang / nyams ldan gyi dga' ba'i nyams ni/nang gi dga' ba de 'phel nas lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur du thon pa'i phyi rol gyi nyams yin no/ /'o na rnam pa'i phra mo dang khyad par ci yod snyam na/ de ni 'dod don dngos su ma brjod par phyi'i brda dang rnam 'gyur phra mo las go dgos la/ nyams ldan ni 'dod don de brjod pa la gsal bar yod do/ /le'u dang po'i snyan pa'i yon tan dang mi 'dra ste/ snyan pa'i yon tan ni sgra don gnyis ka la grong tshig spangs pa'i sgo nas ro nyams khyad par can gtso bor 'don tshul yin zhing / 'dir nyams ldan ni/ dga' ba 'phel ba sgeg pa'i nyams dang / khro ba 'phel ba drag shul gyi nyams sogs phyi lus kyi nyams brgyad kyi dbang du byas pa'o//bcu dgu pa gzi brjid can gyi rgyan ni/ shin tu nga rgyal ba lta bu'i tshig zil che ba brjod pa zhig

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 221yin te/ dper na/mthu stobs shugs kyis bdud sde'i dpung / /lhag med bsregs zhes 'jigs mi dgos//tshul ldan zhabs rdul bsten pa la/ /'phags pa'i thugs rje mchog tu bsil//zhes dbyangs can ma nus mthu shin tu che ba'i gzi brjid can du ston pa'i tshig sbyor lta bu'o//nyi shu pa rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ 'dod don de dngos su ma brjod par de 'grub pa'i thabs kyi rnam grangs gzhan brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/mi bzad duḥkhas mnar ba yi/ /mkha' mnyam yid can ma lus pa//'phags ma'i thugs rjes sgrol bar mdzod/ /bdag lta ji ltar 'gyur yang bla//'di ni bdag sgrol bar mdzod ces ma smras kyang / 'gro ba ma lus pa'i khongs su rang nyid yod pas rang sgrol ba'i thabs su gyur ba lta bu'o/ /rgyan 'di bsdus brjod dang / phra mo dang / cha rgyan rnams dang 'dres par mi 'gyur te/ bsdus brjod ni/ 'dod don dpe can dngos bsdus nas dpe brjod pa yin la/ phra mo ni/ bsam don de brda dang rnam 'gyur phra mos go dgos pa dang / cha rgyan ni/ don dngos mi mdzes pa lta bu zol gyis sbas nas rnam pa gzhan du brjod pa zhig yin pas mi 'dra'o//nyer gcig pa kun phan gyi rgyan ni/ bya ba 'ga' zhig rtsom pa la 'bad mi dgos par de la phan pa'i rkyen gzhan byung bar ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/lang long 'du 'dzis yid sun zhing / /bsags pa'i las la zhe 'tsher dus//'phags ma'i thugs rjes rkyen ngan rnams/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i grogs su shar//zhes 'du 'dzis sun zhing las ngan bsags pa rnams dran te 'jigs skrag nas chos byed 'dod 'byu nga ba'i tshe/ 'phags ma'i byin rlabs kyis rkyen ngan gang byung de la phan pa'i grogs su shar zhes brjod pa lta bu'o//nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba'i rgyan ni/ bsam pa'am 'byor ba rgya che ba blos gzhal mi nus pa lta bur brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/bgrang yas skye dgu rnams kyi khams/ /byang chub gsum la ma bkod pa//de srid gzhan don kho nar gzhol/ /e ma 'phags ma'i thugs bskyed med//ces skye dgu rnams nges legs gsum la ma bkod bar du de rnams kyi don kho na mdzad pa'i 'phags

222 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ma'i thugs bskyed ni rmad du byung zhes bsam pa shin tu rgya che bar ston pa lta bu'o//nyer gsum pa bston dor gyi rgyan ni/ chos de'i rang bzhin la de ma yin no zhes bston nas gzhan du ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ngag dbang lha mo'i zhal dkyil 'di/ /bzhin ras ma yin nya gang zla//dkyus ring g.yo 'di spyan min gyi/ /bung ba zung dag 'khor ba'o//zhes dbyangs can ma'i zhal dang spyan la de ma yin zhes bston nas gzhan zla ba dang bung ba yin par brjod pa lta bu'o//nyer bzhi pa sbyar ba'i rgyan ni/ rjod byed kyi tshig gcig brjod bya'i don gnyis la sbyar rung ba zhig yin te/ dper na/kun khyab dbyings la rab gnas shing / /dkar mdzes yid 'ong lang tsho can//gdung sel bdud rtsi ci yang spro/ /mtsho las byung ba gtsug gi rgyan//ces pa 'di dbyangs can dang zla ba gnyis ka la sbyar rung ste/ dbyangs can ma ni thugs kun khyab chos kyi dbyings la g.yo med du gnas shing sku mdog dkar ba sogs dang / srid zhi'i gdung ba sel
