ba'i gsung gi bdud rtsi spro ba dang / mtsho byung mar grags shing skal ldan gyi gtsug rgyan du 'os pa yin la/ zla ba ni kun khyab nam mkha'i dbyings la gnas shing tsha gdung sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'od dkar 'phro ba sogs dang / sngon lha rnams rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung bar grags shing lha dbang phyug chen pos gtsug rgyan du byas pa'o/ /gong gi dpe dang gzugs can gyi rgyan sogs kyi sbyar ba rnams kyang 'di'i bye brag go/nyer lnga pa khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ dngos po 'ga' zhig la chos de'i khyad par ma tshang yang de'i bya ba byed nus par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/zur mig 'byog pos ma btab la/ /yid 'ong 'dzum gyis ma bsus shing //mdza' ba'i tshig gis brid min par/ /bdag yid 'phrogs so tshangs sras ma//zhes dbyangs can ma yid 'phrog pa'i khyad chos zur mig gis lta ba dang / 'dzum gyis bsus pa dang /mdza' ba'i tshig gis brid pa sogs ma tshang yang yid 'phrog nus par ston pa lta bu'o//nyer drug pa mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan ni/ yul 'ga' zhig don la mi mtshungs kyang bstod smad ci rigs pa'i don du mtshungs par sbyor te brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 223zla zer byugs pa'i gangs kyi ri/ /dkar mdzes chu 'dzin lang long dang //yid 'ong ngang pa gzhon nu ma/ /dbyangs can lha rnams 'dren byed rgyan//ces dbyangs can ma la bstod pa'i don du zla 'od 'phog pa'i gangs ri sogs dang dbyangs can ma rnams phyogs gcig tu sbyar te brjod pa lta bu'o//nyer bdun pa 'gal ba'i rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor gang du bya ba dang las dang rdzas la sogs pa'i chos 'gal ba du ma rnams lhan cig tu 'grogs par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/bzhin ras rab zlum spyan dkyus ring / /dbu skra gnag cing tshems phreng dkar//nu 'bur mtho yang long bu dma'/ /'phags ma'i sku 'di ngo mtshar med//ces zlum pa dang ring ba/ gnag pa dang dkar ba/ mtho ba dang dma' ba sogs chos 'gal ba du ma dbyangs can ma'i sku la lhan cig tu 'grogs par ston pa lta bu'o//nyer brgyad pa skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan ni/ yul 'ga' zhig bstod pa'i 'os sam skabs min yang rang gi 'dod pa kho nas rang dgar bsngags pa zhig yin te/ dper na/dbyangs can sgom sgrub mchod bstod sogs/ /long med dka' spyad tshul 'di las//bag yangs spyod pa'i ro nyams mkhan/ /'du gsum pa 'di snang ba bde//zhes dbyangs can ma'i sgom bzlas la brtson pas rtags tsam yang ma byung bas/ yid skyo nas bstod pa'i 'os min pa bag med ci dgar byed pa la bsngags pa lta bu'o//nyer dgu pa zol bstod kyi rgyan ni/ yul 'ga' zhig la smad pa ltar byas te don la bstod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/'ching ba kun ldan bde 'byung yang / /'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol nus na//nyon mongs dri bral dbyangs can mas/ /mchog thun stsole la mtshar ci mchis//zhes 'ching ba dang ldan pa'i lha dbang phyug gis ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster nus na/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma spangs pa'i dbyangs can ma khyod kyis mchog thun gyi dngos grub stsol ba 'di la ngo mtshar rgyu ci yod ces smad pa ltar byas kyang don la dbang phyug las lhag par bstod pa lta bu'o//sum cu pa nges bstan gyi rgyan ni/ brjod bya'i don snga mas de dang mtshungs pa'i 'bras bu mchog dman ci rigs rjes su nges par ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/

224 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/'od ldan nyin byed shar ba na/ /mtshan mor spyod rnams ldong bar 'gyur//'phags ma'i ngo mtshar mdzad bzang dag /nag phyogs nyams pa gsal bar byed//ces nyi ma shar bas 'byung po'i bya rnams long par gyur pa des 'phags ma'i mdzad bzang dag gis nag phyogs pa rnams nyams par byed pa mtshon no zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /'di don gzhan bkod pa dang mi 'dra ste/ don gzhan bkod pa'i sgrub byed rjesasu dgod la/ 'di sngon du dgod dgos pas mi mtshungs so//so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ brjod bya'i dngos po de'i yon tan dang bya ba rnams lhan cig tu brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/tshangs sras dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal dang / /nya rgyas zla dkyil mnyam du shar//phul byung mtshan dpe gsal ba dang / /ri dwags mtshan ma lhan cig bkra//zhes dbyangs can ma'i dgyes zhal dang zla dkyil mnyam du shar ba sogs kyi yon tan lhan cig par brjod pa lta bu'o//so gnyis pa yongs brjes kyi rgyan ni/ brjod bya'i don rnams kyi yon tan dang bya ba sogs phan tshun brjes pa ltar ston pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ma smad thugs rje'i snang ba'i gzis/ /gdul bya'i blo mun kun 'phrogs nas//thogs med smra ba'i rnam dpyod dag /ris med yongs la ci yang sbyin//zhes dbyangs can mas gdul bya'i blo mun 'phrogs pa dang rnam dpyod stsol ba gnyis brjes pa ltar brjod pa lta bu'o//so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan ni/ mngon par 'dod pa'i don 'ga' zhig la smon pa zhig yin te/ dper na/bdag cag tshe rabs thams cad du/ /tshangs spyod dpal ldan rten brgyud de//lhag pa'i lha mos rjes bzung nas/ /dri bral chos mig 'thob gyur cig/ces 'dod don tshe rabs kun tu dri bral chos mig 'thob par smon pa lta bu'o//so bzhi pa rab spel gyi rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor gcig la rgyan tha dad pa mang po bsres pa zhig yin te/dper na/

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 225khyod sku mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis mdzes/ /gsung ni dri za'i dbyangs ltar snyan//med byung thugs rje 'od stong gis/ /'phrogs so bdag cag blo mun kun//zhes pa'i tshigs rkang dang po rang bzhin brjod pa dang / gnyis pa dpe rgyan/ gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan/ rkang pa bzhi pa ni gsal byed kyi rgyan te rgyan bzhi spel ba lta bu'o/ /'di la dpal sgang pa dang / rin spungs pa sogs rgyan gnyis bsres pas kyang chog par bzhed mod/ shong lo dang / snar thang lo tsā ba/ kun mkhyen lnga pa sogs mkhas pa phal cher gyis rgyan gsum phan chad bsres pa zhig dgos par bzhed pa ni gzhung rtsa ba'i don dang 'byor bar sems/so lnga pa dgongs pa can gyi rgyan ni/ snyan ngag mkhan gyi bsam don bcad lhug spel ma'i tshig sbyor ci rigs pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par zhig la byed pa yin te/ dper na/de ltar dbyangs can byin rlabs mkhar/ /don rgyan gsal ba'i dbyar skyes sgra//sgrog las skal bzang mdongs mtha' can/ /rab dga'i gar gyis rtsen par shog/ces dbyangs can lha mo'i byin rlabs la brten nas don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod go don bcas legs par bshad pa 'dis/ snyan ngag don du gnyer ba'i skal bzang rnams rab tu dga' ba'i gar byed par shog /ces brjod bya rnams mdor bsdus te bstan pa lta bu'o/ /de yang snyan ngag mkhan gyis bstan bcos de grub par ma gyur gyi bar du de'i tshig sbyor gyi rgyun sgrub pa'i bsam pa ni dgongs pa dang / bcad lhugs spel ma'i tshig sbyor gyi rgyun la gnas pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par de ni dgongs pa can gyi rgyan yin no//slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug gis/ de ni gzhung gi rgyun la yod pa yin pas/23 zhes dang /dpang lochen pos/ dang po dang bar dang tha ma rnams su rgyun la rjes su 'jug pa'o/24 /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ bod mkhas pa sogs kyis sho lo ka re re tsam gyi nyi tshe ba'i rgyan ma yin par bshad la/dpal sgang pa/ rin spungs pa/ kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po sogs kyis/ rjod byed kyi tshig dang brjod bya'i don nyi tshe ba ma yin par snyan ngag gi bstan bcos re re'i don yongs su rdzogs pa tshigs bcad gcig gnyis kyis kyang brjod nus pa dngos po nges bstan kho na'am/ shis brjod dang dngos po nges bstan lhan cig tu bshad pa lta bu dgongs pa can gyi rgyan du bshad do//don rgyan so so'i dbye ba la/ /rang bzhin brjod bzhi dpe rgyan ni/ /so gsum gzugs can nyi shu'o/ /gsal byed bcu gnyis skor rgyan gsum/ /'gog rgyan nyer gsum don gzhan brgyad/ /ldog rgyan

226 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/bcu dang srid rgyan gsum/ /bsdus brjod bzhi dang phul byung bzhi/ /rab rtog gsum dang rgyu rgyan ni/ /bcu drug phra mo'i rgyan la gnyis/ /cha rgyan bzhi dang rim rgyan gcig /dga' rgyan gnyis dang nyams ldan brgyad/ /gzi brjid rnam grangs kun phan gsum/ /re re nyid yin rgya che gnyis/ /bston dor gsum dang sbyar ba'i rgyan/ /dgu dang khyad par rgyan la lnga/ /mtshungs par sbyor gnyis 'gal rgyan ni/ /drug dang skabs min bstod pa gcig /zol bstod gsum dang nges bstan gnyis/ /lhan cig brjod gsum yongs brjes gcig /shis brjod rab spel dgongs rgyan gsum/ /re re dang bcas gzhung nyid du/ /dper brjod dngos su zin pa'i grangs/ /kun dril nyis brgya rtsa gsum ste/ /rtsa 'grel dag las shes par bya//de ltar don rgyan so lnga yi/ /mtshan nyid dper brjod go don bcas/ /mdor bsdus gsal bar bshad pa 'di/ /snyan tshig rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs yin/ /snyan ngag me long las le'u gnyis pa'i don bsdus pa'o// // sgra rgyan ngadzind pa/gnyis pa sgra rgyan bshad pa ni/ rjod byed kyi sgra sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa'i rgyan yin pas na/sgra rgyan ces bya zhing / de la dbye na gsum/ zung ldan gyi rnam gzhag bstan pa/ bya dka'i khyad par gzhan brjod pa/ dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' bshad pa'o//dang po ni/ tshig sbyor gang du dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge du ma tshogs pa zhig lan gnyis su bzlas pa'i zung dang ldan pa ni zung ldan zhes bya ste/ dbye na drug bya sla rkang pa'i thog ma na yod pa'i zung ldan/ bya dka' gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan/ mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan/ kun tu zung ldan/ 'dres pa'i zung ldan/ bzlog pa'i zung ldan no//dang po la gsum/ thog ma'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ bar du chod pa'i zung ldan/ chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan no//dang po ni/ rkang pa'i thog mar dbyangs gsal tshogs pa'i ming lan gnyis su bzlas pa'i zung gi bar du yi ge'am tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa zhig yin te/ dper na chigs rkang gcig la yod pa ni/lham lham gser gyi ri bo la/ /thun mtshams gsar bas 'khyud 'dra ba'i//yi| 'o/ mtshan dpe'i 'jo sgeg can/ /yab gcig rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter//

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 227zhes tshig rkang dang po'i thog mar lham zhes pa gnyis kyi bar du yi ge'am tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa lta bu dang / rkang pa gnyis la yod pa dper na/'dzum 'dzum zhal gyi bum bzang las/ /lhug lhug gsung gi bdud rtsi yis//blo mig dri ma kun bkrus nas/ /grol mdzad ༷thar khrodod yongs kyi mgon//zhes pa lta bu dang / rkang pa gsum la yod pa dper na/gsal gsal yid kyi me long ngos/ /mdzes mdzes khyod sku shar byas nas//lha/ lhang (ga gis gsol 'debs na/ /zlogs thos gzigs shig 'jam mgon lha//zhes dang / ṅgeng pre bzhi ga'i thog ma la yod pa ni/mang mang rgyal sras dbus nyid na/ /zab zab ngo mtshar rten 'byung gtam//snyasna snyasna gsung gis 'doms mdzad pre/ ༷/mkhas mkhas kun gyi gtsug rgyan rje//zhes pa lta bu gleg ṅge'i tshig 'dra ba gnyis kyi bar du chos rgezhan sgros bar ma chod pas na thog ma'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan zhes bya'o//gnyis pa thog ma'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/ rkang pa'i thog ma'i tshig gzugs 'dra ba gnyis kyi bar du chos gzhan gyis chod pa zhig yin te/ tshigs rkang gnyis tsam la yod pa dper na/rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes ni/ /rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i 'jo sgeg can//byen pa'i byin rlabs bsil zer gyis/༷/blo gros ku mud bzhad par mdzad//ces tshigs rkang dang po gnyis kyi thog mar rab ces bzung gi bar du tshig gzhan gyis chod pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du rkang pa gsum la yod pa ni/ dper na/rgyal kun mkhyen rab gcig bsdus pa/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i rol gar gyis//rgyazlo ba'i gsang gsum mdzad pa'i khur/ //degs mdzad 'jam mgon bla ma lha//zhes dang / rkang pa bzhi ga la yod pa dper na/rab mdzes yid du 'thad pa'i sku/ /rab 'jebs tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan gyis//khrob mang skal bzang gdul bya la/ /reb gsal rnam dpyod spobs pa stsol/ /zhes pa lta bu'o//gsum pa thog ma'i chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/ tshigs rkang so so la ltos te tshig gzhan gyis

228 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/bar du chod kyang rkang pa rang rang gi yi ge 'dra ba zung gi bar du gzhan gyis ma chod pa zhig ste/ dper na/'dzum 'dzum ge sar rangs pa ltar/ /'dzum 'dzum zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nas//snyan snyan zab dang rgya che'i don/ /snyan snyan rna ba'i bdud rtsir 'jo//zhes tshigs ṅgeng bang po'i 'dzum 'dzum dang / rgenyithe pa'i 'dzum 'dzum gyi bar du tshig gzhan gyis chod cing / rkang pa rang rang la ltos pa'i 'dzum gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gzhan gyis ma chod pa lta bu'o//gnyis pa bya dka' gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan ni/ rkang pa'i thog ma las gzhan du chod pa dang chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan de dag ci rigs byung ba zhig yin te/ dper na/rgyal kun mkhyen rab rab 'dus pa/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal rab rab 'bar lhas//rgya chen gsung ra( ra( 'byams la/ /thogs med shes rabaX rab rte stsol//zhes pa lta bu rkang bzhi'i /busaX na yod pa chod cing ma chod pa dang / rtsed traṃ ni dper na/med byung dpal ldan dpal gyi mchog /'jam pa'i dpul dang dpyal lha mo//mtshan dpe'i dpal 'chang dpal kun 'dus/ /dge legs dpal mnga' dpal gyi zhing //zhes pa lta bu'o/ /des marmen nas rkang bzhi'i mtha' dang / bar mtha' da( / thog bar /nga / thog mtha' dang / gnas gsum ga la yod pa rnams gnyis gnyis su shes par bya'o//gsu ma pa mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan ni/ rkang pa snga ma'i mtha' dang / phyi ma'i thog ma gzugs 'dra bar sbyar ba zhig yin te/ dper na/bgrang yas rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /yab gcig rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs//dbyangs can lha mo yab yum zlong / /zlong 'jug mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes pa lta bu'o//bzhi pa kun tu zung ldan la/ rkang pa bzlas pa/ tshigs bcad bzlas pa/ zung ldan chen po dang gsum/ dang po la tshigs bcad kyi phyed rkang pa gnyis bzlas te yang brjod kyang don tha dad pa ni yang dag sbyar ba zhes pa yin te/ dper na/rab 'bar 'jam dpal 'od kyis yongs bskor ba/ /yid 'ong mig gi bdud rtsi 'di//rab 'bar zla ba 'od kyis yongs bskor ba/ /yid 'ong mig gi bdud rtsi 'di//zhes phyed snga phyi bzlas te brjod kyang don tha dad pas zlos skyon mi 'byung ba lta bu dang / de las gzhan

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 229rkang pa bzlas pa ni/ rkang pa lan cig dang / lan gnyis dang / lan gsum gyi bar du ci rigs bzlas te brjod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/phul byung mkhyen rab gter mnga' ba/ /mtshungs med rgyal sras 'jam dpal dbyangs//phul byung mkhyen rab gter mnga' ba/ /rgyal ba kun dngos myong kha pa//zhes/ pa lta bu lan gcig bzlas pa dang / lan gnyis bzlas pa dper na/rab mdzes yid 'ong mig gi dpal/ /rab mdzes yid 'ong mig gi dpal//rab mdzes yid 'ong mig gi dpal/ /'jam dpal zla ba pad gzhon mjes//zhes pa lta bu'o/ /lan gsum bzlas pa ni/med byung 'jam dpal gyi sku 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed/ /rmad byung nyi ma'i dkyil lor 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed//rmad byung zla dkyil 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed/ /rmad byung nor bu 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed//ces rkang pa gcig lan gsum gyi bar du bzlas kyang sbyar gzhi dang don tha dad pas zlos skyon med pa lta bu'o//gnyis pa tshigs bcad bzlas pa ni/ tshigs bcad gcig lan gnyis brjod pa zhig yin te/dper na/gnyis skyes bram ze tshogs kyis nyer bsnyen cing / /kun gsal ngogs su rgyu ba yi//dkar mjes yid du 'ong zla ba ba 'di/ /lus can mig la dpal ster byed//gnyis skyes bya tshogs kyis nyer bsten cing / /kun gsal ngogs su rgyu ba yi//dkar mdzes yid du 'ong ba ngang pa'i rgyal po 'di/ /lus can mig la dpal ster byed//ces tshigs bcad gcig nyid bzlas te brjod pa don tha dad pas na zlos skyon med pa lta bu'o//gsum pa zung ldan chen po ni/ rkang bzhi'i yig gzugs rnam pa gcig pa zhig yin te/ dper na/'jam dpal mkhyen no 'jam dpal mkhyen/ /'jam dpal mkhyen no 'jam dpal mkhyen//'jam dpal mkhyen no 'jam dpal mkhyen/ /'jam dpal mkhyen no 'jam dpal mkhyen//zhes nan tan dang do gal che ba'i don la yang yang bldabs te brjod kyang dmigs bsal skyon med pa lta bu'o/ /'di lan gsum bzlas pa dang khyad par yod de/ rkang pa lan gsum bzlas pa tsam gyis mi chog par 'di ni rkang pa re re la yang zung ldan gzugs gcig pa snga phyi bar ma chod pa re dgos so//

232 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/'di la gsum/ dbyangs nges pa/ gnas nges pa/ gsal byed nges pa ste/ de re re la'ang bzhir nges pa/ gsum du nges pa/ gnyis su nges pa/ gcig tu nges pa ste bzhi bzhi yod do/ /dang po dbyangs nges pa ni/nyi bzhin gzi byin gyis brjid cing / /phul byung gzhung kun thugs su chud//ye shes zer 'gyed legs mdzes khyed/ /gsol mchod bstod do blo gros stsol//zhes dbyangs i3/ e tse( bzhir nges pa lta bu'o//gnyis pa gnas nges pa dper na/ ma smad spobs pa dpe med pas/ /'phral phugs rmad byung phan pa smras/ /mkhas grub kun gyi mgon po khyod/ /smra mkhas ngag gi dngos grub bsgrubs/ /zhes pa lta bu pa sde rnams mchu dang / ka sde ni mgrin pa'i skye gnas can te gnas gnyis su nges pa'o//gsum pa gsal byed nges pa ni/ dper na/ le los lang long las la lus la la lam la lag len log /'dod 'dun don du gdung gdung 'dong / /da 'di dad dad dul dul 'dug /ces pa lta bu ste gsal byed la dang da yig gnyis su nges pa'o//sgra rgyan bya sla'i zung ldan gyi/ /thog ma'i bar ma chod pa la/ /rkang pa gcig la yod pa bzhi///gnyis yod drug dang gsum yod bzhi/ /bzhir yod gcig bcas bco lnga dang / /thog ma'i bar chod bcu gsum ste/ /rkang pa gnyis rer yod pa drug /gsum yod gsum dang bzhir yod gcig /bzhi gar cha gnyis yod pa gsum/ /thog ma'i chod cing ma chod pa/ /gsum bcas thog ma'i zung ldan gyi/ /dbye ba sum cu rtsa gcig yin/ /bya dka' gnas gzhan zung ldan la/ /rkang bzhi'i dbus na yod pa dang / /de bzhin mtha' dang bar mtha' dang / /thog bar dag dang thog mtha' dang / /gnas gsum mnyam par yod pa la//bar chod chod cing ma chod pa/ /gnyis gnyis sbyar bas bcu gnyis yod/ /mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan gcig /bzhi pa kun tu zung ldan la/ /phyed bzlas yang dag sbyar ba gsum/ /rkang pa lan gcig bzlas pa drug /lan gnyis bzlas pa'i dbye ba gsum/ /lan gcig bzlas dang tshigs bcad bzlas/ /re re zung ldan chen po ni/ /gcig bcas dbye ba bco lnga'o/ /lnga pa 'dres pa'i zung ldan gcig /drug pa bzlog pa'i zung ldan la/ /rkang pa bzlog dang tshigs bcad kyi/ /phyed dang rangs po bzlog pa dang / /gsum bcas zung ldan dbye ba ni/ /kun dril drug cu re gsum mo/ /bya dka'i khyad par gzhan la ni/ /ba lang gcin dang phyed 'khor dang / /kun tu bzang po'i 'bor lo gsum/ /dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' la//

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 233dbyangs dang gnas dang gsal byed gsum/ /re rer bzhi gsum gnyis gcig tu/ /nges pa'i dbye ba bcu /nyis yod/ /de ltar sgra rgyan bya dka' sla'i/ /tshig don rab gsal utpal phreng / /gnad 'gag dri bsung sargyal ba 'di/ /blo gsal mgul ba'i mdzes rgyan yin/ /sgra rgyan gyi don mdor bsdus te gsal bar sand zin to// //gab tshig gi rgyan/gsum pa gab tshig gi rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor gang du brjod don dngos de gab nas gzhan zhig tu gabrul ba skyed par byed pa zhig yin la/ dbye na bcu drug yod de/kun tshogs slu byed rim pa bral/ /rab bcom mthun gzugs rtsub mo dang //grangs dang rab brtags ming du 'dus/ /bsgribs dang mthun sgra rmongs pa dang //yongs 'phrogs gcig bsgribs gnyis ka bsgribs/ /yongs 'dres dang bcas bcu drug go/dang po kun tu tshogs pa'i gab tshig ni/ tshig snga phyi tshogs nas mtshams sbyar ba'i dbang gis sring 'dres te brjod don sbas nas don gzhan du 'khrul bar byed pa zhig yin te/ bod skad la dper na/rigs ldan mchog tu bzhin bzang ba/ /de ni ma ma lags pas na//kun tu sred pa'i zhags pa yis/ /bdag yid 'ching phyir dga' ma yin//zhes pa'i brjod don dngos ni rigs ldan bzhin bzang ma de a ma min yang 'dod sred skyed phyir chung ma/ yin zhes pa la/ don de gab nas bzhin bzang ma de a ma yin pas na yid sred phyir bdag dga' ba ma yin no zhes par 'khrul pa skyed pa lta bu'o//de bzhin du don gzhan la grags pa'i sgra dag gis phyogs mthun gyi ming gzhan du 'khrul nas slu bar byed pa ni slu byed kyi gab tshig dang / tshig sbyor gyi gong 'og gi rim pa 'khrugs par byas te gzhan rmongs par byed pa ni rim pa bral ba'i gab tshig dang / brjod bya'i don rtogs dka' ba'i tshig sbyor gyis don de bcom pa ltar gyur pa ni rab bcom gyi gab tshig dang / phal ba'am btags pa pa'i don bkod nas brjod don dngos de bsgribs par byas pa ni mthun pa'i gzugs kyi gab tshig dang / sgra bshad rung tsam yod pa'i tshig rtsub mos brjod don dngos de bsgribs pa ni rtsub mo'i gab tshig dang / yi ge'i grangs kyis

234 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/kun tu rmongs par byas nas brjod don bsgribs pa ni grangs kyi gab tshig dang / brjod bya'i don de sbas nas rnam pa gzhan zhig tu rtog cing snang bar byed pa ni rab brtags kyi gab tshig dang / brjod bya'i ming gcig la sna tshogs pa'i don du mar brtags nas gab pa ni ming du 'dus pa'i gab tshig dang / bstan bya'i tshig de ni chos mtshungs gzhan zhig la 'jug pas de go zhing brjod don dngos de bsgribs pa ni bsgribs pa'i gab tshig dang / ming mthun pa'i sgra'i rnam grangs du ma bkod nas brjod don dngos de rtogs dka' bar byed pa ni mthun pa'i sgra'i gab tshig dang / brjod bya'i don mngon sum du bstan yang tshig de nyid 'brul ba'i rgyur song nas rmongs bar byed pa ni rmongs pa'i gab tshig dang / tshig sbyor mang po brgyud mar byas te snga ma snga ma'i don phyi ma phyi mas 'phrogs pa ltar gab nas go dka' bar byas pa ni yongs 'phrogs kyi gab tshig dang / tshig sbyor gang du rten lus lta bu gsal bar byas nas brten pa yan lag lta bu sbas par byas pa ni gcig bsgribs pa'i gab tshig dang / rten dang brten pa'i dngos po gnyis ka sbas shing bsgribs pa ni gnyis ka bsgribs pa'i gab tshig dang / tshig sbyor gang du gong du bshad pa'i gab tshig so so'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dres par sbyar ba ni yongs 'dres kyi gab tshig ces bya ste/ so so'i dper brjod 'dir mangs kyis dogs pas rtsa 'grel dag las shes par bya'o//gab tshig gi rgyan gyi dgos pa ni/ rtsed mo byed pa'i mdun sar bzhad gad kyi don dang / gab tshig shes pa rnams phan tshun tshogs su gsang gtam smra ba dang / pha rol po rnams blo rmongs shing 'khrul bar byed pa'i ched du yin no/ /gab tshig gi rgyan gyi go don rnams mdor bsdus te go sla bar brjod zin to// //snyan ngag gi skyon sel bshad pa/gsum pa skyon sel bshad pa ni/ tshig sbyor gang du sgra don gang rung nyams dang bral zhing mi mdzes par byed pa'i chos de ni snyan ngag gi skyon yin zhing / dbye na bcu yod de/don nyams don 'gal don gcig pa/ /the tshom can dang rim pa nyams//sgra nyams gcod mtshams nyams pa dang / /sdeb sbyor nyams dang mtshams sbyor bral//yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten dang / /lung rigs dag dang 'gal ba ste//skyon bcu de dag snyan ngag la/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyis spang bar bya/25 /zhes pa ltar ro//

snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos mu tig phreng ba/ 235de yang / chig tshogs pa'i rang bzhin la brjod bya'i don gyis stong pa se'u bcu pa'i ngag lta bu ni don nyams kyi skyon dang / tshig sbyor de'i don snga phyi 'gal ba ni don 'gal gyi skyon dang / sgra don gang yang rung ba gcig nyid dgos pa med par slar brjod pa ni don gcig pa'i skyon dang / brjod don de go ba'i ched du sbyar ba'i tshig gis de la the tshom skyed par byed pa ni the tshom can gyi skyon dang / bstan bya'i don snga phyi'i go rims nyams te gong 'og 'khrugs pa ni rim pa nyams pa'i skyon dang / tshig sbyor gyi rnam dbye dang 'phrad sogs sbyor tshul brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang mi mthun pa ni sgra nyams kyi skyon dang / tshig gi gcod mtshams ngal bso ni ming mthar bya dgos pa la thog ma'am dbus su ngal bso ba ni gcod mtshams nyams pa'i skyon dang / tshigs su bcad pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi yi ge chad lhag dang / lci yang sogs bṛtta dang dzā ti gang gi'ang mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa ni sdeb sbyor nyams pa'i skyon dang / tshig gi mtshams sbyor sgra'i bstan bcos las bshad pa ltar 'thob kyang rgyu mtshan med par mi byed pa ni mtshams sbyor nyams pa'i skyon dang / ri dang nags tshal sogs yul dang / nyin mtshan dang nam zla sogs dus dang / gar dang glu sogs sgyu rtsal dang / snod bcud kyi 'jig rten dang / rig byed sogs lung dang / rtog ge'i bstan bcos kyi rigs pa dang 'gal ba sogs drug po gcig tu byas pa ni yul sogs dang 'gal ba'i skyon yin pas na/ skyon bcu po de snyan ngag mkhan gyis snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor la spang dgos so//de las dang po don nyams kyi skyon ni/ dper na/ston ga'i zla dkyil rab tu tsha/ /sos gar nyin mo'i snang ba 'bar//ri skyes phru gu spang la rgyu/ /de ring skyo nas dga' ston myong //zhes tshig de tsam tshogs na'ang 'brel ci yang med pa lta bu'o/ /de 'dra shes pa rnal du mi gnas pas brjod pa ma gtogs/ gzhan gyis brjod pa ni skyon kho nar zad do//de la sdeb sbyor nyams pa ni skyon shin tu che bas dmigs bsal med la/ gzhan thams cad la rtsa ba'i gzhung du skyon re la dper brjod re dang / dmigs bsal skyon med kyi dper brjod re ste gnyis gnyis gsungs pas rtsa 'grel dag las zhib tu shes pa gal che'o//rjod byed rkang 'thung mdzes pa la/ /sgra rgyan yal ga rab tu rgyas/ /gab tshig rgyan gyi lo 'dab dkrigs/ /skyon bral dpag bsam ljon 'di rmad/ /snyan ngag me long las le'u gsum pa'i don bsdus pa'o// //

236 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/smras pa/ dbyangs can mgrin pa'i pad mtsho mā /dgyes dgur rol ba'i daṇḍi'i gzhung / /snyan tshig rin chen 'byung gnas las/ /legs 'ongs gnad bsdus mu tig phreng / /ma smad rnam dpyod dar la bab/ /bsngags 'os thos brtson rgyan gyis sbud/ /skal bzang don gnyer legs bris bu'i/ /mdzes byed mgrin pa'i rgyan du spel/ /tshig nyung rgyud las nyer drangs pa'i/ /gnad 'gag rdzogs pa'i nyams 'gyur glu/ /blo gsal rna ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ /sngon med dga' ston gsar ba sbyin/ /rig gzhung 'dab brgya bzhad pa la/ /don bzang zil dngar rab tu 'khyil/ /nyams brgya'i dri bsung 'phro ba 'dir/ /don gnyer rkang drug 'phur lding rol/ /macan 'dod mchog gi bzhin bzang zhing / /don sgra gab pa'i rgyan mdzes kyis//yang dag sbud pa'i me na gas/ /skyon bral yid 'ong gar dag byed/ /'di ni snyan tshig rig byed kyi/ /ngo mtshar don gyi bzhin ras 'bum/ /ma 'dres gsal bar 'char bzod pa'i/ /legs bshad 'phrul gyi me long ngo / /de ltar rig gzhung me long du/ /mtshar sdug lus rgyan skyon sel gzugs/ /lta 'dod don gnyer 'dus pa la/ /dag pa'i blo mig mchog 'di sbyin/ /'dir 'bad legs byas 'od stong gis/ /skal bzang blo mun kun 'phrogs te/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i bcud chags pa'i/ /rnam dpyod 'dab brgya bzhad gyur cig /dge mtshan gzi brgya'i snang ba 'bar/ /mi shis mtshan ma'i g.yul las rgyal/ /chos srid skye ba lnga pa'i sgra/ /phyogs kyi bu mos sgrog gyur cig /'di ni 'gal ba zhes bya'i lor/ /dbyar gyi lang tsho dar ba'i tshe/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis/ /nyi 'og mtsho bdun dgon par sbyar//zhes pa 'di ni mkhas pa'i dbang po zhe hor mkhan rin po che rgya rong chos mdzad lha ram pa ngag dbang rin chen pa'i zhal snga nas kyi gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/rgya nag pho brang chen por dbu brtsams te mtsho bdun dgon par mjug rdzogs par bgyis pa skal mnyam rnams la phan pa rgya chen por gyur cig/ //

ra༅༅/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi zhesan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs rbesta//rjetsong kha pa blobazang grags pa/༄༅tsho/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//gang zhig rtogs nas mtha' dag spros pa'i tshogs//'dab brgya'i gnyen gyis reg pa'i ba mo bzhin//ma lus drungs nas 'byin pa zab mo'i lam//brgya phrag dka' bas bsgrub la brtson rnams rgyal//sngon tshe sngon gyi rgyal ba du ma la/ /lhag bsam lhag par bskrun pa'i mthu rtas 1pa//rgyal ba'i rgyal sras dam pa rtag tu ngus/ /chos phyir chos 'phags bsten tshul 'dir bshad bya//gang yang lus dang srog la mi lta 2ba'i brtson 'grus kyi stobs bskyed na/ bgrang ba las 'das pa'i bskal par ming tsam yang thos par dka' ba'i bla na med pa byang chub kyang rnyed par mi dka' na/ mngon par mtho ba'i phun sum tshogs pa lta ci smos/ de'i phyir srid pa'i bde ba dbang po'i gzhu ltar g.yo ba'i ngang tshul can du rtogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis gtan gyi bde ba bsgrub pa'i phyir btson 'grus kyi stobs bskyed pa la 'bad par rigs so//de yang 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs mi zad par sgrog pa'i sras kyi thu bor gyur pa/ rgyal ba du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs po che bskrun pas 3rgyud dang dbang po yongs su smin pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i go cha chen po bgos pa/ nag po'i rtsa lag sde dang bcas pa gzhom pa la zhum pa med pa'i blo dang ldan pa'i dpa' bo chen po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu zhes bya ba des/ sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la spyod pa na rnyed pa dang bkur sti dang tshigs su bcad pa'i ngor mi blta zhing lus dang srog la gnod pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag khyad du bsad nas dge

238 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ba'i bshes gnyen las gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa btsal zhes thos so//dpag med bskal par gzhan dbang gyur pa'i snying rje shugs drag goms pa'i mthus//'gro ba'i don la rab tu brtson pa'i khur chen 'byer bar gyur pa yi//sems dpa' mchog rnams byang chub spyod las phyir phyogs gyur pa'i skabs med de//rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i gaṅgā'i rgyun ni su zhig gis ni bzlog par nus//de ltar bdag nyid chen po des shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa btsal ba'i slad du dben pa'i sa phyogs shig tu phyin pa dang / gzugs mi mngon par bar snang las sgra 'di lta bu zhig thos so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis lus ngal ba dang / gnyid dang rmugs pa dang / bza' ba dang btung ba dang / nyin mo dang mtshan mo dang / tsha ba dang grang ba yid la mi byed cing / phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su ma blta 4bar 'di nas shar phyogs su song zhig dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang /khyod kyis srid pa'i bde la ma chags shing / /kun tu rtog pa'i lam gzhan dor gyis la//rnam par mi rtog rtse gcig lam bzang la/ /legs par zhugs na 'dod pa'i don 'grub 'gyur/ /gang zhig mngon zhen dra bar tshud pa na/ /thar pa ring du gyur cing srid par 'ching /de slad kun tu rtog pa'i mun pa kun/ /mi rtog sgron mes bsal nas bgrod par rigs//de nas bdag nyid chen po des/ /mgrin pa'i sbubs dang mi ldan la//so dang rkan las byung min zhing / /ro 'dzin bskyod pa med na yang //legs lam legs par ston pa'i ngag /sgra snyan sgra 'dra de thos nas//ji bzhin ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul/ /de ltar de yi rjes su zhugs//'di yi brtson pa'i stobs kyis zab mo'i tshul/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas tshol 5bar mthong ba'i tshe//rang gi pha mtha' mthong bar dogs gyur nas/ /mkha' yis 'di la lam rgyus bsnyad pa snyam//yang sgra de las 'di skad ces kyang thos so//mtshan mo'i blo dang sdig pa'i grogasapo ring du bor/ /stong pa nyid dang dge ba'i bshes la nye bar bsten//'dod yon rnams dang me tog mda' can bcom byasan/ /pha rol phyin dang de ston chos smra mthong bar 'gyur//

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 239sgyu ma'i na chung lus la rol pa ltar/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i 'dod yon bsten pa yi//dge ba'i bshes la ma dad spang bya ste/ /zang zing med pa'i sems kyis bsten pa'i rigs//mkha' la chu 'dzin lang ling g.yo ba'i nang / /gsal zhing brjid pa'i 'brug gi sgra dbyangs ltar//snying la bab pa'i gtam bzang snyan pa'i sgra/ /ngo mtshar gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun de//thos pa'i lam las rab tu zhugs pa'i tshe/ /yid ni gdung ba'i rims nad dag las grol//de nas sems dpa' chen po des/ /dngos 'dzin gdon gyis spa bkong phyir//stong nyid rig sngags 6'tshol ba la/ /dgon pa'i lam du zhugs par gyur//de de ltar sgra de las rjes su bstan pa blangs nas shar phyogs ga la ba der song ba dang / ring por ma lon par 'di snyam du/ kye ma bdag gis sgra de la ji srid du 'gro bar bya ba ma dris so snyam du ngu zhing mya ngan byed de phyogs de nyid du 'dug go/yid la bud shing med na yang / /sdug bsngal me chen rab 'bar zhing //mig gi mkha' la sprin med kyang / /mchi ma'i char rgyun 'bab par gyur//de ltar tshul des dgung bdun gyi bar du ji ltar bu gcig pa 'chi ba'i dus byed pa na ma de la yid la byed pa gzhan mi 'byung ba de bzhin du/ bdag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par nam zhig 'gyur snyam pa ma gtogs pa yid la byed pa gzhan med par sa phyogs de nyid na 'khod do/ /de ltar zhag bdun 'das pa dang / de'i mdun na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs shin tu mdzes pa blta na sdug pa/mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa zhig bzhugs pa mthong ngo //nyon mongs dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /de yi yid kyi me long la//rgyal ba'i ye shes gzugs brnyan ni/ /sgyu ma bzhin du mngon sum snang //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs des/ de la 'di skad ces bka' stsa la to/ /rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /'di ltar khyod yi dam brtan pos dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang gdams ngag 'tshol ba ltar/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang yongs su btsal to/ /rigs kyi bu shar phyogs su

240 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/songs shig dang / 'di nas dpag tshad lnga brgya na grong khyer spos ldan zhes bya ba yod de/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'apags zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ de ni yun ring po nas khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin no/ /rigs kyi bu des kyang da lta khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa btsal ba ltar sngon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su btsal lo/ /de bas na khyod kyis yid la byed pa rgyun ma bcad par song zhig dang / ring bor mi thogs par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par stir ro//de skad ces bka' stsal ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu dga' ba dang yid bde bas lus sems khyab par gyur to/ /ji ltar mda' dug can gyis gnad du phog pa'i mi dag bdag gi sdug bsngal 'di las thar par byed pa'i zug rngu 'byin pa'i sman pa nam zhig rnyed par 'gyur snyam du/ yid la byed pa gzhan mi skyed pa de bzhin du/ 'jig tshogs su 4lta ba'i rtsig pa stug po drungs nas 'byin par byed pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje/ dmigs pa'i tshang tshing ma lus pa sreg par byed pa'i dus mtha'i nyin byed/ blo gros kyi mig sdongs pa rnams la shes rab kyi mig sbyin par byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags de/ bdag gis nam zhig na mthong bar gyur snyam du yid la byed cing / gzhan yang sa phyogs der chos thams cad la mi gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed pas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la dbang 'byor bar gyur to//de tshe de yi yid kyi mkha'/ /mtha' dbus spros pa kun gyis dben//kun rtog g.yo ba'i chu 'dzin zhi/ /lhag mthong snang bas lham mer gyur//de yid ting 'dzin chu gter la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i gzugs kyi sku//rgyu skar phreng ba shar ltar snang / /kun kyang zab mo'i de nyid ston//de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis kyang de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu legs so legs so zhes dbugs dbyung bar mdzad de/ nged kyang sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'tshol ba na yang de bzhin du btsal zhing / de'i tshe yang ting nge 'dzin 'di dag thob ste/ gang la mnyam par bzhag 7par bya ba dang / gang gis mnyam par bzhag par bya ba dang / gang mnyam par bzhag par bya ba'i chos de yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin te/ nged kyis kyang 'di la brten nas lus gser gyi kha dog lta bu mtshan dang dpe byad kyis

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 241brgyan pa dang / 'od 'dom gang ba dang / stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang gzungs dang / spobs pa la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs du ma mngon du gyur to/ /de bas na khyod kyis kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag par bsnyen bkur nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyi pa don du gnyer bar bya'o/ /zhes bka' stsal pa thos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ji ltar rab dang 8mtsho la zla gzugs ltar/ /dpag yas shes bya'i gnas rnams lham me ba//gang la brten nas srid pa mthar byed pa/ /bdag gi dge ba'i bshes su su zhig 'os//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis kyang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//bskal pa bskal par 'bad pas bsnyen bkur ba'i//chos 'phags chos smra'i mchog de nyin dang mtshan //rtag tu rtag tu ngu yis bsten nas su//yang dang yang du mchod pas mchod par gyis//de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis bdag nyid chen po de dbugs phyung nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu yang ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang nas byon pa dang gang du bzhud pa ma 'tshal te/ de dag ma mthong bas yid rab tu gdung zhing mi dga' bar 'khod do//de yid nub kyi sa 'dzin rtse/ /rgyal ba nyin mor byed pas bor//dga' ba nyams pa'i zla zer dang / /gdung ba'i ku mud mnyam du g.yos//'on kyang the tshom gnas de dag /mtha' yas yon tan gter gyur pa//chos 'phags smra ba'i dbang po la/ /slad nas bdag gis dri bar bya//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de 'di snyamadu sems te/ bdag ni shin tu dbul bar gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags la gos rin po che 'am/ gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang / byu ru dang / mu men dang / beeḍūrya la sogs pa'i rigs rsā ma/ spos dang / me tog dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / bdug pa la sogs pa de lta bu dag gis bsnyen bkur ba'i chas ni bdag la med na/

242 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/bdag 'di bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi drung du song na ni/ bdag gis tshul ma yin pa byas par gyur ta re snyam du bsams so/ /de de ltar yid la byed cing bla ma la gus pa nye bar bzhag nas mthar gyi grong khyer zhig tu phyin pa dang / de'i grong bar gyi dbus su 'di lta bu'i bsam pa zhig skyes par gyur to//bdag lta'i gzhi rtsa ches cher rab brtan gser gyi gzhir//ma rig chu gter las kyi mgyogs 'gros bsrubs las byung //sdug bsngal lhun po skye shi'i bang rim khyud mos bsdams//srid mtshor yun ring don med 'da' ba de mthong nas//phangs pa med par bdag gi lus/ /btsongs te de yi rin thang gis//dge ba'i bshes la bsnyen bkur bar/ /'dod nas grong du zhugs par gyur//stod smad lus 'di mdzod gyi sgo gsal te/ /mchil ma snabs dang bshaskyu ba gci la sogs//dri nga rgyun du 'bab par ston pa 'di/ /mi gtsang rul pa'i bang mdzod dag la ni//yid 'ong dngos po cung zad yod re zhes/ /'di yis mna' ni dor phyir bkod lta yi//lus kyi ngang tshul 'di 'dra rig nas ni/ /sems ldan su zhig 'di la sred par byed//de ltar bdag nyid chen po de lus btsong ba'i phyir grong bar du 'dug nas/ su dag kho bo'i lus 'dod ces yang yang sgrog pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la zhugs pa de bdud sdig can des rig nas 'di snyam du sems so//'di yis spyod pa'i lang tsho rdzogs pa na/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i ded dpon mchog gyur nas//'gro 'di sku gsum rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs su//lam bzang bdag med gru yis legs bsgral nas//rnam grol nor bu'i gling du khrid pa'i tshe/ /bdag ris sde dang bcas pa'i spyod yul las//shin tu 'das shing ci bgyir 9ma mchis pas/ /de phyir deng nas bar chad brtsam par bya//nyam chung sgron me myur du 'jig sla yi/ /stobs chen nags kyi me la de lta min//de ltar bsams nas bdag nyid chen po'i tshig /gzhan gyis thos pa'i lam las bskal par byas//

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 243de nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus bdag nyo ba ma rnyed pa de'i tshe/ rang gi mngon par 'dod pa'i don ma grub pas/ kye ma bdag ni skal ba dman pa zhig go snyam du sems shing mchi ma blags nas 'dug go/lha yi lam yang ma yin zhing / /chu 'dzin gos dang bral na yang //khyod kyi gdong la mchi ma yi/ /char rgyun rtag tu 'bab pa 'di//'jig rten char gyi rgyun dag gi /ya mtshan gzhom slad byas pa 'dra//de'i tshe de ltar bzhugs pa mthong nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i lhag pa'i bsam pa brtag pa'i ched du/ bram ze'i khye'u'i cha byad du sprul nas de'i mdun du 'dug ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod ci'i phyir du yid khong du chud cing mig nas mchi ma 'bab/ byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ bdag gi lus btsongs nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur sti bya snyam na bdag gi lus nyo ba su yang ma rnyed pas de'i slad du'o/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u des byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so//bdag gi rig byed las 'byung ba'i/ /mchog sbyin sbyin sreg sgrub pa'i rdzas//mi yi sha dang snying dang khrag /rkang dang rus pa 'tshol bar byed//gal te de dag gtong nus na/ /ji ltar 'dod pa rin du sbyin//de dus skyes bu mchog de yi/ /snying stobs rgya mtsho cher 'phel te//gtam snyan chu bos gang ba bzhin/ /yid ni kun tu dga' bar gyur//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des tsham tshom med par rang gi lus kyi brla g.yas pa'i sha btogs nas mtshon rnon pos lus phug ste/ khrag zag cing rus pa gcog tu rtsig pa'i drung du phyin to/ /de'i tshe tshong dpon gyi bu mo zhig sngon gyi rgyal ba du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa na 10gzugs mdzes shing blta na sdug pa/ lang tsho dar la bab pa/ mig utpal sngon po lta bu/ skra mthon mthing du 'dug cing nu ma rab tu rgyas pa/ dga' tshal gyi lha'i bu mo lta bu yod pa de/ rang gi pha'i khang pa'i yang thog gi steng na bu mo'i 'bor brgya phrag du mas yongs su bskor te pha la rol mo byed cing gnas so//skye ba gzhan du sbyangs pa'i bsod nams mthus/ /de yi lus ni shin tu mdzes gyur te//

244 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/'chi med bu mo mngon sum snang ba bzhin/ /chags ldan skye bo'i mig gi bdud rtsir gyur//de yi bzhin ras chu gter mdzes byed pa/ /mig gi utpal zung dag 'gran pa bzhin//brang gi dkyil 'khor nu ma'i khur gyis sgeg /ro smad rgyas shing skabs phyed yan lag mdzes//dul zhing yid gzhungs dbang po nyer zhi ba/ /de ni na chung tshogs kyis yongs bskor nas//dri za'i glu dbyangs lta bur snyan pa yi/ /pi wang sgra yis dga' bar rol zhing 'bod//de sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i mthus bskul nas khang pa'i ba gam zhig nas bltas pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus bram ze'i khye'u la rang gi sha dang khrag gtong ba la zhugs pa mthong nas myur ba myur bar babs te 'ongs pa'i tshe/ de rang gi lus dur khrod kyi ro la bya ba bzhin du chags pa med par mthong ngo /bdag gi lus la'ang chags med par/ /bram ze sha khrag 'dod pa la//gtong bar zhugs pa de mthong nas/ /bzang mo de yi lus dang sems//shin tu 'dar bar gyur pa ni/ /g.yo ba'i mtsho nang zla gzugs bzhin//de nas bu mo des byang chub sems dpa' bya dka' ba spyod pa de mthong nas lus shin tu g.yo ba'i rlung gis bskyod pa'i shing ltar 'dar zhing / mig mchi mas gang bzhin du 'di skad ces smras so//gang zhig lang tsho gsar ba'i me tog gis bkra zhing //mtho ris yon tan yal ga'i khyon yangs shin tu mdzes//dal 'byor yongs su mdzes pa'i lus 'di ci slad du//brtse bral bram ze 'di la de ring gtong bar byed//de skad smras tshe sems dpa' che/ /rab rgyas zhal gyi chu skyes mchog/ge sar so phreng gsal ldan pas/ /bzang mo la ni 'di skad smras//sring mo bdag ni bkren pa ste/ /dge ba'i bshes dang gdams ngag dag/don du gnyer la mchod pa'i rdzas/ /sgrub slad lus 'di 'di la gtong //de skad ces smras pa dang / bu mo des 'di skad ces smra so/ /khyod kyis de la bsnyen bkur bas yon tan

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 245gyi rnam pa ci zhig 'thob/gdong bzhi pa'am mig stong ldan pa'am/ /drag po'am dpa' mo'i gnyen nam mda' lnga pa// rnam thos bu'am nyi ma'am zla ba'am/ /'khor los bsgyur ram gang zhig thob par 'dod//ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpas smras pa/skye dgu gling bzhi'i rgyan du 'gyur ba dang / /gting zab stong nyid rgya mtsho gsal ba'i phyir//nyin mtshan sdod pa bcom pa'i brtson 'grus kyis//rnam grol pad tshal 'byed pa'i nyin byed 'dis//gzhan la lam ston 'gyur ba lta zhog gi /rang gi lus kyang gsal bar mi nus pa'i//me khyer 'od la smon par byed pa ni/ /'jig rten 'di na 'ga' tsam mthong ngam ci//de ltar sems dpa' chen po des bzhin gyi mdangs rab tu gsal bas don du gnyer bar bya ba'i gnas zab mo bstan pa de thos nas bu mo de'i sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i mthu rtas 11par gyur cing / bya dka' ba'i gnas gzhan du bdag gi lus la'ang ltos pa med par gtong ba de mthong nas 'di snyam du bsams so/ /kye ma skyes bu dam pa rnams ni chos kyi phyir bdag gi lus kyang rtswa ltar 'dor bar byed na zang zing gi longs spyod la su zhig chags par byed/ de bas na 'di la dgos pa'i yo byad nor bu dang / mu tig dang / gser dang / dngul dang / spug dang / rdo'i snying po dang / man shel dang / byu ru dang / mu men dang / beeḍūrya dang / gzhan yang gos dang / rgyan dang / bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / myang ba dang /bldag par bya ba rnams dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / phye ma dang / rol mo la sogs pa thams cad bdag gi pha tshong dpon gyi khyim nas blangs nas byin la bdag kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen de blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur ba'i slad du 'di'i phyi bzhin du 'gro bar bya'o snyam du yid la nges par gyur to//snying stobs tsha zer rab 'bar zhing / /chags med 'od stong 'phro ba can//rgyal sras spyod pa 'dab brgya'i gnyen/ /mthong bas bzang mo de yi yid//'byung ba'i mun pa rab btang ste/ /gtong ba'i snang bas gsal gyur cing //dang ba'i pad tshal cher rgyas nas/ /sems dpa' che la 'di skad smras//gang gis bdag nyid gdung byed pa'i/ /bya ba 'di las khyed thugs ldog/mchod pa'i yo byad mkho dgu dag /kho mos khyod la sbyin gyis long //12

246 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/bdag kyang khyod la brten nas ni/ /sems dpa' mchog de mthong bar 'dod//de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpas kyang khas blangs so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis sems dpa' chen po de'i lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo ba med par mkhyen nas/ sprul pa'i lus mi snang bar byas te/ rang gi gzugs kyis de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu nga la snying dang khrag dang rkang dang sha dag gis dgos pa med de/ ngas khyod nyams sad pa'i phyir du 'ongs so/ /rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /khyod kyi brtson pa 'di lta bu dang don du gnyer ba 'di lta bu dang ldan pa ni legs so//sngon gyi rnam 'dren rgyal ba de dag kyang / /spyod tshul zab mo'i lam bzang 'di nas gshegs//de dag gshegs pa'i lam bzang dam pa nas/ /ring por mi thogs khyod kyang 'gro bar 'gyur//de lta bas na bdag la dam pa stsole cig byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ brgya byin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bla na med pa stsol cig /brgya byin gyis smras pa/gang zhig srid las rgal 13ba yi/ /slob ma dang ni bse rus kyang //myong bar ma gyur gnas de ni/ /bdag gi spyod yul ma yin no//de lta bas na mchog gzhan stsole cig byang chub sems dpas smras pa/bdag lus nyams pa'i rma 'di yis/ /khyod yid gdung bar bya mi dgos//bden tshig rig sngags zab mo'i mthu/ /mngon sum nyid du bstan par bya//lha'i dbang po bden pa gang gis bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis lung bstan cing / bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo med par mkhyen ce na/ bden pa de yi mthus bdag gi lus sngon bzhin du gyur cig/de skad bden tshig brjod ma thag /de lus sgra gcan las grol ba'i//nya rgyas zla ltar mdzes mthong nas/ /grong 'joms mi smra'i brtul zhugs 'dzin//de nas brgya byin spobs pa med cing de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to//

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 247lang tsho 'i me tog mdzes pas rab tu spud pa'i lus kyi rdzing dag la//khrag gi rgya mtsho kun nas 'khyil zhing rus pa'i ku mud gsal ba 'di//rgyal sras ngang pa'i snying gi dga' ba lhag par skyed pa'i ched du 'am//rang gi bden tshig nus pa bstan pas lha dbang skyengs phyir bkod pa snyam//de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo des byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu tshur shog kho mo'i khyim du 'dong ngo / /kho mo'i pha ma la nor blangs te des chos dang chos smra ba la bkur sti gyis shig ces smras nas/ de gnyis 'grogs nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo'i khyim gal ba der song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo des bdag gi khyim du phyin nas pha ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab yum bdag la gser dang dngul dang / nor bu dang mu tig dang / byu ru dang man shel dang / spug dang rdo'i snying po dang / beeḍūrya dang mu men dang / gzhan yang gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang / phye ma'i phur ma dang gos rin po che dang / spos dang me tog dang byug pa dang / zhal zas dang / rol mo'i tshogs ches mang ba dag stsole cig pha mas smras pa/ des khyod la ci zhig bya/ bu mos smras pa/gang gis bya ba chung ngu yang / /rnam smin 'bras bu cher skyed pa'i//dam pa'i zhing mchog dag la ni/ /bdag gis bsod nams bya bar 'dod//pha mas smras pa/ bsod nams :zhing de ji lta bu zhig bu mos smras pa/bskal pa brgya phrag du mar yang / /mtshan tsam thos pa'ang rnyed dka' ba//sems dpa' mchog cig bdag gis ni/ /bsod nams mthu yis de ring mthong //byang chub spyod pa'i klong 'khor zab yangs ldan/ /snying stobs nor bu du mas kun nas gtams//brtson 'grus rba rlabs ldog par sla min pa/ /yon tan mchog gi rgya mtsho chen po zhig/mig stong sgyu ma'i sbyor ba ston pa la/ /rang gi lus kyang sog ma'i phung po ltar//chags med gtong la zhum pa ma mchis shing / /bden tshig grub pas lha dbang spobs pa bcom//de ltar bu mo des ji ltar gyur pa rnams pha ma la rgyas par bsnyad do//de nas bu mo de'i pha mas bu mo de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu mo/ de da lta gang na 'dug

248 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/smras pa/ da lta 'o skol gyi sgo drung na mchis so/ /pha mas smras pa/ de lta na khyod kyis skabs phye zhig dang bdag cag kyang khyod rang lhan cig tu 'gro'o//de nas bu mo des skabs phye nas bu mo de'i g.yog mo lnga brgya yang rgyan gyis brgyan te/ shing rta lnga brgya legs par brgyan par bkod/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu yang tshong dpon gyi bu mo de dang lhan cig tu rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa'i shing rta chen po gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa'i glang po che'i mchog gangs kyi dum bu 'gro shes pa lta bus drangs pa'i nang du zhugs te/ bu mo de'i pha ma dang bcas pa 'bor brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor nas shar phyogs logs su grong khyer chen po spos ldan gyi lam ga la ba der zhugs so//sngon spyad ma dros mtsho las legs 'ongs shing / /ngo mtshar spyod pa'i rlabs chen chal chil g.yo//brtson pa'i rba rlabs phreng ba drag tu 'khrugs/ /lhag bsam khur can rgyal sras gaṅgā'i rgyun//'jam pa'i lus mdzes dal ba'i 'gros dang ldan/ /snyan pa'i sgra sgrog mdzes ma'i chu phran 'khor//lnga brgyar bcas te shar gyi phyogs nyid du/ /spos ldan rgya mtsho'i ngogs su zhugs par gyur//de ltar mthar gyis song song ba dang / bdag nyid chen po des rgyang ring po zhig nas grong khyer spos ldan dang / de'i dbus na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags skye bo'i tshogs brgya stong du ma la legs par 'doms pa mthong bar gyur to//rgyu skar khrod na ku mud gnyen ltar mthong ba tsam gyis gdung ba sel//ri dwags khrod na seng ge lta bur 'khor du 'jigs pa kun dang bral//gling bzhi'i dbus na lhun po ji bzhin dge mtshan du mas kun nas brjid//ring mo zhig nas yang yang yid la gcags 14pa'i chos 'phags de yis mthong //de tshe de yi yid kyi mtsho/ /dga' ba'i rlabs kyis bskyod pa ni//yang dag 'jog gi bsam gtan gyi/ /bde bas dper yang mi bzod do//de nas sems dpa' chen po de shing rta'i nang du zhugs bzhin du bdag dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba ni tshul dang mthun pa ma yin no snyam du bsams nas rang gi shing rta la babs so/ /de babs pa dang dus mnyam du bu mo lnga brgya yang shing rta las babs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 249tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgyas bskor cing mdun nas bdar te/ bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa dang ldan pas grong khyer spos ldan ga la ba der song ngo //de ltar rim gyis song ba dang / rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i grong khyer chu dang zheng du dpag tshad bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa/ 'byor pa rgyas pa bde ba lo legs pa skye bo mang pos gang ba/ rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i rwa ba rim pa bdun dang / 'obs rim pa bdun dang / rta babs rim pa bdun gyis yongs su bskor ba/ mnyam pa'i srang bar lnga brgya lnga brgya dag gis ri mo bris pa bzhin du gtams shing / bar bar du zam pa btags pa/ grong khyer gyi khor yug tu rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i lcags ris yongs su bskor ba/ de'i mda' yab rnams ni 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las byas pa/ mtho zhing tshad dang ldan pa/ mda' yab thams cad kyi rtse mo las kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud pa skyes shing / de thams cad las kyang rin po che'i thi gu byung bas shing gnyis pa gzhan dang 'brel bar gyur pa/ grong khyer de dag thams cad gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha'i dra bas khebs te/ de la rlung gis btab pa'i tshe 'jam zhing snyan pa'i sgra yid du 'ong ba las stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la sogs pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs du ma byung bas sems can de dag gi yid 'khor ba las phyir phyogs par byed cing / stong pa nyid kyi sa bon kun nas rtas par byed la/ sems can de rnams rtse dga' bas dus 'da' bar byed pas dga' mgur spyod do/ /gzhan yang grong khyer de'i phyi rol tu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang ba'i 'obs yod pa/ chu de dag las kyang me tog utpal dang ku mu da dang padma dkar po gzugs mdzes shing dri zhim pa du mas yongs su khebs par g.yogs pa/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten na yod pa'i me tog gi rigs dag la de na med pa gang yang med do/ /chu de la sems can de rnams kyi sngon gyi bsod nams las byung ba'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gru dag yod de/ sems can de dag der zhugs nas rtse dga' bas kun tu rol bar byed do//'og gzhi nor bu'i phung po bdal ba bzhin/ /logs rnams ston ga'i 'ja' tshon bkra ba bzhin//ba gam sprin dkar thor cog bcings pa bzhin/ /kun gyi 15mdzes pa gcig tu bsdus pa bzhin//'di yi ngo mtshar med byung yon tan tshogs/ /mthong bar gyur tshe ches cher yid g.yo ba'i//beeḍūr sngon po bzhu ba 'bab 'dra yi/ /rgya mtsho chen pos lus kyi rlabs bskyod de//

250 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gang gi grong khyer mdzes pa skyed pa'i rgyan/ /gzugs mdzes yid 'ong dri ngad ldan pa yin//sna tshogs me tog gos bzang gyon nas su/ /lhun po dor te 'di ru 'ongs sam snyam//sngo bsangs lus mdzes rnyog pa'i dri ma bral/ /bzhin gyi chu skyes 'dzum pa'i ze'u 'bru can//gnag cing snum pa'i bung ba'i mig dkyus ring / /rin chen gru yi nu ma'i 'bur dang ldan//rlabs phreng do shal thogs pa yi/ /dga' bas 'di rnams rang gi lus//rin chen 'obs kyi khang bzang du/ /bskyod pa'i zlos gar mthong ba'i tshe//lang tsho'i lhun sdugagasal ba'i mdangs kyis bkra/thor tsugs 'bras bu'i khur gyis lhag par brjid//rin chen g.yer kha'i phreng bas mgul brgyan pa'i/ /mda' yab gser khri'i steng gi gzhon nu 'ga'//'obs kyi khang bzang phyogs su mngon phyogs nas/ /mnyen lcug yal ga'i lag pa'i rtse mo rnams//phan tshun sbrel te snyan pa'i glu len cing / /'dod pa bsten phyir lag pa g.yob pa 'dra//de lta bu'i grong khyer de mthong nas bu mo de dag shin tu ngo mtshar bar gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so//sngon chad 'di yi ming tsam yang / /thos pa'i yul du ma gyur pa//mdzes pa'i rin chen pho brang 'di/ /su yi lags pa bstan tu gsol//de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus bu mo de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo 'di ni bdag cag rnams gang gi mthus sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho mu med las sgrol ba'i mnyan pa chen po chos 'phags zhes bya ba de bzhugs pa'i grong khyer te/ da ni ring por mi thogs par rigs kyi bu des bdag cag rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'doms par 'gyur bas dga' ba dang yid bde bar gyis shig ces smras so//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'bor dang bcas pa grong khyer de'i sgo nas zhugs te dong ba dang / de'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i skyed mos tshal dbyibs mdzes la rnam par bkra zhing blta na sdug pa nee tso'i ga'u(ga pa ltar ljang zhing mnyen pa'i lo 'dab kyis klubs

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 251shing / me tog dang 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud pa'i tshal lnga brgya yod pa de dag gis mthong bar gyur to/ /de mthong ma thag tu tshal de 'di 'dra ba zhig go snyam nas bu mo de dag gis smras pa/ma rgad lo ma'i gos gyon cing / /me tog sar ba'i thod bcings te//bsir bus 16dal gyis bskyod pa na/ /mgrin pa cung zad bkug nas ni//shub bu'i sgra yis sngags zlo ba/ /'di dag sngon med rig sngags mkhan//de nas yang dong ba dang / skyed mos tshal de dag re re na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mos pa'i sems can de dag gi sngon gyi legs par spyad pa las grub pa'i rdzing bu khor yug tu rgyang grags kyi tshad tsam pa lnga brgya lnga brgya yod pa/ de la yang me tog kha dog sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po rnams tshad shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam sna tshogs kyis yongs su bkang nas mdzes par byas pa/ ngang pa dang ngur pa dang khrung khrung dang ka ran ta ga dang sa ra sa la sgra snyan cing spu'i mdog sdug pa'i bya du ma skad snyan pa 'byin pa/ skyed mos tshal dang rdzing de dag kyang bdag gi ba'i ris su chad pa med pa la sems can de rnams dga' mgur spyod pa mthong bar gyur to/ /de ltar mthong ma thag tu bu mo de rnams kyis rdzing gi yon tan bsngags te smras pa/ngogs rnams mdzes pa'i ljon shing du mas dkrigs/ /steng du spu sdug bya rnams dga' bas rtse//'gram na ldem ldem g.yo ba'i padre'i tshogs/ /rdzing gi yon tan mthong tshe rgod pa bzhin//'bad pas bsgrubs pa med na yang / /'dod dgu'i rin chen ljon pa la//bdag gir bzung ba med par spyod/ /lhun po'i bying du phyin pa 'dra//de nas yang mthar gyis dong ba dang / grong khyer de'i dbus kyi bzhi mdo na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi khang pa/ rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ khor yug tu dpag tshad kyi tshad tsam rnam par bkra zhing lta na sdug pa rwa ba rim pa bdun dang / shing ta la'i phreng ba rim pa bdun gyis yongs su bskor pa/ khang pa de na khang pa'i longs spyod du gyur pa'i skyed mos tshal bzhi yod cing /skyed mos tshal re re la'ang rin po che du ma las grub pa'i rdzing bu brgyad brgyad yod pa/ grong khyer chen po lta na sdug pa 'phos pa'am/ sgyu ma mkhan mkhas pa zhig gis sprul pa de lta bu de mthong nas bu mo de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so//

252 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gang gi bkod pa'i lcags kyu yis/ /dbang po'i gnyis 'thung 'dzin byed pa//nyams dga'i rin chen pho brang 'di/ /'chi med dbang po'i pho brang ngam//'on te su yi sgyu ma'i mthus/ /bdag cag mig lam snang bar gyur//rtag tu ngus smras pa/gang gis rang gzhan don gnyis theg pa'i sa srung mchog la legs gnas shing //bdag med rdo rje rab tu 'bar bas 'jig tshogs lta ba'i lha min 'joms//chos rnams ma lus stong par gzigs pa'i spyan stong rab tu gsal ldan pa//bshes gnyen lha dbang brgya byin gang de'i pho brang mchog de 'di yin no//rten 'brel sgyu ma thugs chud nas/ /chos kun sgyu ma ston mdzad pa//rgyal sras sgyu ma mkhan de yis/ /legs spyad sgyu ma las byung ba'i//bkod pa sgyu ma lta bu 'di/ /gdul bya sgyu ma'i sems can la// rnam 'phrul sgyu ma'i tshul bstan pa/ /bdag gis sgyu ma'i gzugs su mthong //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi skyed mos tshal dang rdzing bu de dag lta ba la zhugs pa na/ rtag tu dga' ba dang / mya ngan med pa dang / mya ngan dang bral ba dang / me tog sna tshogs pa zhes bya ba'i skyed mos tshal bzhi yod de/ skyed mos tshal de dag re re na yang /bzang po zhes bya ba dang / bzang mchog ces bya ba dang / dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / dga' mchog ces bya ba dang / bde ba ces/bya ba dang / bde ldan zhes bya ba dang / des pa zhes bya ba dang / mi 'bab ces bya ba'i rdzing bu brgyad brgyad yod pa mthong ngo / /rdzing bu'i ra ba thams cad kyang gser dang / dngul dang / baiḍūrya dang / shel las grub pa ngos bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa/ nang gi sa gzhi ke ke ru las byas pa gser gyi bye ma bdal ba/ rdzing bu de dag re re la yang phyogs dang mtshams rnams su them skas brgyad brgyad btsugs shing / de dag gi bar bar na 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las grub pa'i shing skyes pas mdzes pa/ rdzing gi chu rnams kyang me tog gi shing gis gtams pa/ de dag rlung gis bskyod pa'i tshe me tog rnams rdzing bu'i nang du lhung bas/ rdzing bu'i chu de dag thams cad kyi chu yang tsan dan gyi dri dang ldan par byed pa/ grong khyer de

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 253na yod pa'i skyes pa dang bud med rnams kyang skyed mos tshal dang rdzing der 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pas rtse dga' zhing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyang btsun mo drug khri dang bcas bskyed mos tshal der dus dus su 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas dga' mgur longs spyodapar byed do//'gro 'dod yid kyi rlabs 'brug drag po yis/ /gzhon nu'i chu gter mtha' ru bskyod pa'i tshe//rdzing gi lhun po'i na chung mdzes ma des/ /'di yis bdag la 'khyud pa 'dor snyam nas//kha dog bzhi yis bkra ba'i gzhon nu'i mtsho/ /blangs nas rang gi steng du 'khod pa 'dra//dwangs shing dri ma med pa'i chu gter steng / /gangs ri'i tog ltar dkar ba'i ngang pa'i tshogs//gshog pa zung gi 'dab ma bgrad byas nas/ /tshar du dngar bas khebs par snang ba 'di//ston dus lha yi lam ni mjes byed pa'i/ /sprin dkar phreng ba 'khrigs la 'gran pa bzhin//'tshe ba bral zhing padma'i rtsa ba za/ /gur kum mdog gi 'dab ma'i shugs bskyod nas//mdzes pa 'gran 'dra'i rdzing gi gnas rnams su/ /dga' bas phan tshun 'phur ba'i ngur ba 'di//ring nas dbang po thul ba'i drang srong 'ga'/ /nags tshal me tog ldan pa'i bsti gnas su//ting 'dzin mthu yis bsgrubs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rang gi lus la du mar ston pa lta//de ltar yon tan gyi rnam pa de lta bu dang ldan pa'i skyed mos tshal dang / rdzing de dag mthong bas bu mo de dag ches ya mtshan du gyur nas mig bgrad de a la la zhes sgrog par byed do/ /de lta bu'i bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa'i grong khyer gyi dbus kyi bzhi mdo na/ grong khyer spos ldan na 'khod pa de dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags chos ston pa'i khri/ gser dang dngul dang shel dang beeḍūrya las grub pa'i rkang pa bzhi btsugs pa/ de'i stong du stan nang tshangs can bting ba/ steng snying po can du byas pa 'phang du rgyang grags phyed yod pa bshams te/ steng gi bar snang la ka shi ga'i ras kyi bla bre la me tog gi chun po 'phyang bas brgyan pa bris shing / sa phyogs de'i khor yug thams cad kyang rin po che'i me tog du ma gcal du bkram pa spos kyi chus chag chag btab cing / bdug spos kyi snod du ma nas kyang spos kyi dri zhim pa du ma'i dud pa 'thul bar byed do/ /de ltar khri de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags bzhugs nas skye bo'i tshogs du ma la shes rab 7pha rol tu phyin pa ston no/ /sems can de dag kyang la la ni lung nod/ la la ni kha ton byed/ la la ni yi ger 'bri/ la la ni tshul bzhin du yid la byed pas so sor rtog par byed de/ de dag kyang 'jig tshogs la lta ba ring du dor ba/ bla

254 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa sha stag go/de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi pho brang de dang ha cang yang thag mi ring ba zhig na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bzhugs pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ tsan dan dmar po'i ka ba du mas spras shing mu tig gi dra bas g.yogs pa/ khang bu brtsegs pa de'i nang gi grwa bzhir rin po che 'od 'bar ba bzhi sgron me'i bya ba byed pa'i ched du bkod pa/ phyogs bzhir dngul las byas pa'i bdug spos kyi snod rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa bzhi'i nang na a ka ru nag po 'ba' zhig gi du ba rgyun mi 'chad du 'thul ba/ de'i dbus na rin po che sna bdun gyi seng ge'i khri chen po bzhi btsugs pa lha rdzas kyi gos kha dog rnam par bkra ba du mas mdzes par klubs pa'i steng du/ rin po che du ma'i 'ching ba rnam par bkra ba'i rin po che'i sgrom chen po bzhi bzhag pa mthong ngo //ka ba du mas legs dkrigs ka gzhu nor bu'i phra yis spras//kha khyer khyung brtsegs legs bskor kha pad pu shu spa zhing mtho//pa tra 'khyil bas kun nas legs brgyan pa la sha ltar yid 'ong brjid//ba gam mang pos kun nas legs spras ba mo'i mdangs ltar ches dkar gsal// de yi bkod pa'i ya mtshan la/ /skrag pas mig stong ldan pa'i grong //lha yi lam nas rab 'phags te/ /lhun po'i steng du bros pa lta//de ltar khang pa brtsegs pa de la lha'i dbang po brgya byin yang lha'i bu stong phrag du ma dang bcas te lha rdzas kyi me tog manda ra ba dang / manda ra ba chen po dang / lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / gser dang dngul gyi me tog 'thor/ lha rdzas kyi sil snyan du ma'i sgra yid du 'ong ba bzung zhing khang pa brtsegs pa de la bkur sti chen po sgrub pa mthong ngo / /de mthong nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so//gang gi lha brgya'i yan lag mchog dang lag pa'i padma mdzes byed pa'i//rna rgyan mchog dang gdub skor 'brol ba'ang myur du sa la lhung byed cing //rol mo'i sgra dang me tog 'thor la khyod kyang mngon par brtson byed na//khang bzang yid 'ong mdzes pa mchog 'dir tshangs pa'i dbang po bzhugs sam ci//

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 255brgya byin gyis smras pa/gang gis tshangs dbang mchog gi yang / /cod pan sa la lhung byed pa//srid pa gsum gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yum bzhugs so//sku gsum dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa/ /dug gsum mun pa'i tshogs 'joms shing //theg gsum partswa'i tshal skyong ba/ /mkhyen gsum nyin mo'i dbang phyug bzhugs//bden bzhi rtogs pa'i 'od dkar can/ /sku bzhi rgya mtsho 'phel byed cing //gling bzhi 'gro ba'i gdung sel ba/ /sbyor bzhi rgyu skar rgyal po'ang bzhugs//'gro ba'i skyabs gcig don dam sku/ /kun mkhyen nyag gcig kho na'i yum//chos sku ro gcig spros bral dbyings/ /rgyal ba'i yum gcig chos sku bzhugs//spros bral dbu ma'i mkha' la legs gnas shing / /mtha' brgyad mun pa'i dmag dpung nyams byed pa//ca rgyal yum nyin mo'i dpal 'di mthong ba'i tshe/ /pakhro'i gnyen 'di'ang skrag nas phros pa 'dra//stong nyid spros dang bral ba'i dbyings 'di yis/ /lha yi lam gyis khyab pa'i go phyogs shing //kun la rang nyid rjes su zhugs pa na/ /mkha' 'di'ang bskrad pas mig lam mi snang gyur//rigs kyi bu 'di'i nang na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam shes rab kyipha rol tu phyin pa ston par byed pa'i glegs bam bzhugs so//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ko'u shi ka dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de bdag la ston cig brgya byin gyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu zab mo'i gnas de ni smra ba dang bsam pa'i yul thams cad las 'das shing spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad nye bar zhi ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rgyas btab pa mtshan ma'i blo thams cad dang ma bral ba rnams kyis blta ba dang brtag pa'i gnas ma yin pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa kho na'i spyod yul du gyur pa nged kyis khyod la ming tsam yang ston par nus re skan/

256 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/rtag tu ngus smras pa/ de lta na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bdag la ston cig/brgya byin gyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de yang gser gyi glegs bam la beeḍūrya bzhu bas 17bris pa rnyed par dka' zhing don che ba nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis ska rags bdun bdun gyis shin tu dam par bcings nas mdud pa'i gnas bdun la rang ming gi rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab nas bzhag pas/ nged kyis khyod la shin tu bstan par dka'o//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dang / tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya po de dag thams cad kyis me tog gi phreng ba'i chun po dang / gos rinapo che dang mu tig gi do shal dang / me tog dang bdug pa dang phye ma dang gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / gser dang dngul gyi me tog khang pa brtsegs pa de la gtor zhing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la mchod par bya ba'i phyir cha shas kyis kyang bzhag go/ma lus sras bcas rgyal ba'i yum/ /mi gnas myang 'das ston de la//mu tig do shal rgyan rnams dang / /me tog sil mas mngon par gtor//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ga la ba der phyin nas chos la mchod pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / gser dang dngul gyi phye ma dang / me tog dag gis nam mkha' la gtor ro/ /de nas me tog de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi spyi bo'i steng na me tog gi khang bu brtsegs pa zhig tu gyur to/ /gser dang dngul gyi me tog dag kyang nam mkha' la gzhal med khang 'dra bar 'dug par gyur to/ /chos gos dang gos rin po che de dag kyang rin po che sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi dkyil 'bor 'dra bar 'dug par gyur to//'di yis chos 'phags bsnyen bkur phyir/ /phangs pa med par gtor ba rnams//mkha' yis rang la byin snyam nas/ /lag pas dam du bzung ba 'dra//gzhan gyi 'byor ba du ma rnams/ /ma byin par yang bdag gir byed//rdzas la sred pa'i brnab sems can/ /khyod las khrel ba gzhan su zhig/

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 257yang na mchod rdzas mchog 'di mthong ba'i tshe/ /shin tu ya mtshan ldan pa'i blo skyes nas//'di la sa yis gos na mi rung zhes/ /mkha' yis bar snang dbyings 'dir bkod pa bzhin//de mthong nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu dang / tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya po de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam 'phrul de dag mthong nas 'di snyam du sems so/ /kye ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na yang 'di lta bu'i cho 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul ba mnga' na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa na/'di las kyang ches khyad du 'phags pa'i rnam par 'phrul ba ci 'dra ba dag 'byung snyam du/ ngo mtshar skyes nas rab tu dga' ba'i rlung gi shugs drag pos bskyod pa'i smon lam gyi rlabs chen po bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs su gzhol ba ldog tu med pas 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag cag rnams ma 'ongs pa'i dus na stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / ma 'dres pa'i yon tan gyi gter chen po bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten thams cad kyi ston par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ji lta ba de ltar bdag cag rnams kyang chos zab mo ston pa la spobs pa 'jug cing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang 'di lta bu'i bkur sti byed par gyur cig ces smras nas de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur sti byas te logs shig tu 'khod do//gang gis rgyal ba'i sras po yis/ /byang chub spyod pa zab mo'i tshul//sngon med rnam 'phrul 'di mthong che/ /de dag dga' ba rgyas par gyur//de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dang / tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya po de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la yang mchod pa dang bkur sti byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi zhabs la mgo bos gtugs pa'i phyag 'tshal zhing thal mo sbyar te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do//phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen

258 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/po chos 'phags la sngar ji ltar gyur pa rnams bsnyad cing khyad par du don 'di dris so//'phags pa bdag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'tshol ba la zhugs pa'i tshe dben pa'i phyogs shig tu ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma mngon du gyur pa na bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bgrang ba las 'das pa mthong zhing / de dag gis bdag dbugs dbyung ba mdzad de/ legs par bstan nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bdag ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas 'di snyam du kye ma bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la gang nas byon pa dang / gang du bzhud pa ma dris so snyam du yid khong du chud par gyur to/ /de nas yang bdag 'di snyam du don 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la dri ba gor ma chag snyam na/ 'phags pa bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang nas byon pa dang bzhud pa'i don bshad du gsol/de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'di snyam du sems te/ skyes bu mkhas pa rnams ni dpe'i sgo nas don zab mo bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur bas/bdag gis dpe du ma'i sgo nas don de bsnyad par bya'o snyam nas/ thog mar smig rgyu'i dpes de bzhin gshegs pa de dag byon pa dang bzhud pa med par bstan par bzhed nas/ shin tu gsal ba'i bzhin 'dzum mul te 'di skad ces smras so//nyal 'gro'i rgyun rnams sgrog gi rgya las grol/ /ljon shing lo 'dab gsar pa'i gos ljang bgos//bkra ba'i me tog du ma'i rgyan gyis spud/ /khu byug myos pa'i ca co sgrog pa na//mkha' yang chu 'dzin gos kyis dor/ /pakhro'i gnyen yang gung la bab//de tshe g.yo ba'i smig rgyu ba/ /mthong ba'i mi mkhas skyes bu 'gas//gang la zhen pas bdag nyid ngal ba'i rgyu/ /kun rtog yid kyis med pa'i chur btags pa//de ni dang por 'jug ngogs gang nas 'ongs/ /mthar yang sa phyogs gang du gzhol bar 'gyur//de phyir 'gro dang 'ong ba'i tshul btags na/ khres ldan su yis de yi 'gro 'ong rnyed//yang rtogs par dka' ba'i don zab mo de nyid sgyu ma'i dpes kyang ston par bzhed nas/ bdag nyid chen po des skad kyi gdangs gsal bar 'di skad ces smras so//gang yang 'di na sgyu ma mkhas pa 'gas/ /ral ba gyen du bsgreng zhing mig rtsa dmar//'gyug cing dmar ba'i glog ltar lce g.yo zhing / /rngam pa'i shugs 'byin rno ba'i mtshon bzung ba'i//

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 259'jigs rung gshin rje'i skyes bu mang sprul nas/ /de yis skye bo 'ga' yi lto dral te//sgyu ma'i zhags pas rang gi mgul la brgyan/ /lus ni khrag gis kun nas gos par byas//lag pas mgo bo bzung nas klad pa ldag /'di dag mthong tshe byis pa rmongs pa 'ga'//mchi mas gdong g.yogs byin pa sgrog tu bcug /snying yang lkog mar sleb pa ltar gyur nas//sdar ba'i 'jigs skrag skyes nas 'bros mod kyang / /de yi ngang tshul rig pa'i mkhas pa dag/'dil 'jigs pa skye ba ga la zhig /'jigs pa'i gnas de nyid kyang dmigs pa med//de nas gnas zab mo 'di rmi lam gyi dpes kyang bsnyad par 'dod nas smra ba'i khyu mchog des yang 'di skad ces smras so//dbang po'i grong khyer yul lnga gsal ba'i nyin byed nub//mig gi ze 'bruchuskyes 'dab ma'i pags pas bkab//yid kyi skyes bu yul la rgyu ba'i go skabs bcom//yid kyi sa 'dzin gnyid kyi mun pas non pa 'gas//ngo mtshar rgyal ba'i tshogs mthong nas/ /sad tshe de dag mi snang 'gyur//'on kyang rmi lam rgyal ba rnams/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rab zhi na//de yi khyad par skye dang 'gag /su zhig gis ni dmigs par 'gyur//de lta bas na rigs kyi bu dpe de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa de dag byon pa dang bzhud pa med par khong du chud par bya'o/ /de ltar/sgyu ma'i skyes bu gshin rje smig rgyu'i chu/ /rmi lam rgyal ba ji 'dra de 'dra bar//chos kun rten dang bral bar rtogs pa des/ /thub rnams byon dang bzhud par mi 'dzin no//bde bar gshegs pa ji ltar bzung bas stong / /stong nyid yin phyir skye dang 'gag pa med//med pa snang ba zhabrul pa'i 'dzin stangs su/ /su yis rtogs pa de yi dmigs pa zhi//de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gdod ma nas skye ba dang 'gag pas dben yang / blo gros kyi mig ma rig pa'i ling tog gis ldongs shing / stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i mig sman dang bral ba'i mngon zhen can gyi ngor/ skye ba dang 'gag par snang ba'i tshul pi wang gi sgra yi dpes bsnyad pa'i phyir 'di skad ces smras so//

260 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/rin chen du ma'i phra yis mdzes pa yi/ /yid 'ong beeḍūr las grub khog pa ni//kha dog bkra ba'i rgyud kyis spras pa la/ /chags pa'i mig gis kun tu lta byed cing //gdu bu 'brol ba'i lag pas gzhu bzung ba'i/ /dri za'i na chung rnams kyis sbrengs pa na//sred ldan rnams la yid kyi dga' skyed pa'i/ /pi wang sgra dbyangs snyan pa 'byung mod kyang //mkhas pas khog pa rgyud dang lag pa gzhu/ /'di dag gang las 'ongs zhes brtags pa na//re re las min tshogs la'ang ma yin te/ /sgra 'di gang la'ang mi gnas ngo bos stong //'di yi rgyu yang de ltar btsal ba na/ /de yang ming tsam brda tsam btags pa tsam//nam yang smig rgyu'i rdzing gi chu/ /nam mkha'i pazle'i rgyu min ltar//rdzun pa'i rgyu yis bden pa yi/ /'bras bu 'ga' yang skyed re skan//'on kyang dmigs pa can gyi ngor/ /btags pa'i rkyen rnams yod pa dang // med pa nyid du snang ba na/ /pi wang sgra yang skye dang 'gag/de ltar rgyal ba dag gi sku rnams kyang / /rten 'brel rkyen rnams nye bar gnas pa na//skye bar snang zhing de dag med pa'i tshe/ /'gag pa lta bur dmigs pa can la snang //ljon shing rgyas pa'i rtsa ba chad pa na/ /yal ga lo ma 'phel ba'i gnas med ltar//gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa ma dmigs pa/ /de yis spros kun chos kyi dbyings su zhi//de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis chos thams cad 'gro ba dang 'ong ba bral ba'i don 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ sa chen po 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ bdud kyi gnas thams cad skrag cing spa bkong bar gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na rtswa dang shing gel ba dang nags tshal ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la mgo rab tu btud de steng gi bar snang la dus ma yin pa'i me tog gi char babs par gyur to//gang gi legs bshad 'chi med rnga yi sgras/ /bdag tu lta ba stobs ldan spa bkong nas//mtha' yas skye dgu lhun por gnas pa'i tshogs/ /srid pa lha min 'jigs las bsgral ba'i tshe//

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 261lus can 'di dag srid 'dir mi gnas na/ /bdag nyid gcig pu skyo bar gyur mthong nas//rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di yang lus bskyod de/ /pho nyar mngags pa'i rtswa dang nags tshal rnams//chos 'phags 'gro ba sgrol ba'i ded dpon la/ /mgo bo btud nas gsol ba 'debs pa lta//de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang 'jig rten skyong ba bzhis/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / lha'i me tog gis gtor nas 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyi drin gyis deng bdag cag gis kyang don dam pa'i gtam 'jig rten thams cad mi mthun pa 'jig tshogs la lta bar lhung ba thams cad kyis ma bstan pa thos so zhes 'dzer ro//de nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la sa g.yo ba'i rgyu dang rkyen dris pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon pa dang bzhud pa med pa'i don dris te bshad pa na/ srog chags brgya stong gis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob/ srog chags khrag khrig brgya stong gis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed/ srog chags drug khri bzhi stong gis chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba thob pa'i mthu yin no//de skad ces smras pa thos pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu 'di snyam du/ bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon pa dang bzhud pa med pa'i don dris pas sems can 'di snyed cig gi don byas pa ni bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis da ni bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu gdon mi za bar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro snyam nas dga' ba dang bde bas shin tu rangs par gyur to//18srid pa'i 'dam du bying ba'i sems can tshogs/ /grangs med srid las rgal bar mthong ba'i tshe//rgyal sras mchog de'i yid kyi bya lam der/ /dga' ba'i dri bzhon ches cher g.yos par gyur//de nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu dga' ba dang yid bde ba dang ldan pas shing ta la bdun srid du nam mkha' la 'phags te/ bdag nam mkha' la 'dug nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur sti bya'o snyam pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis de'i bsam pa rtogs nas lha'i me tog man da ra ba du ma byin te 'di skad ces/ me tog 'dis byang chub sems dpa' sems

262 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur sti gyis shig rigs kyi bu khyod kyi mthus srog chags brgya stong mang po'i don byas te/ rigs kyi bu ji ltar khyod gzhan don la spro bar byed pa 'di lta bus sems can thams cad kyi phyir bskal pa grangs med pa spro bar byed pa'i sems cad de dag ni rnyed par dka'o zhes smras so//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems chen po rtag tu ngus lha'i dbang po brgya byin las me tog de dag blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la gtor rab tu gtor/ mngon par rab tu gtor ro//rgyal sras spyod pa lha yi lam nas rgyu/ /gdul bya'i gling bzhi kun la snyoms pa can//shugs drag brtson 'grus rta ljang ljon pa zhig /chu skyes du ma'i 'od stong thogs nas su//gdul bya gser ri'i dbus na lham me ba/ /chos 'phags lhun po'i ngos la 'thor bar byed//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la rang gi lus kyis mngon par bkab nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa deng slan chad khyod kyi zhabs 19'bring bgyi ba'i slad du bdag gi lus khyod la 'bul lo zhes rang gi lus phul nas de'i mdun du thal mo sbyar nas 'dug go /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo dang bu mo lnga brgya po de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu bdag cag kyang khyod la lus 'bul gyi/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis khyod dang lhan cig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bkur sti byed cing chos zab mo 'di lta bu thos par gyur cig/de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus bu mo de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyed cag gis bdag la lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas par byed na lus bdag la byin cig dang / bdag gis dgos pa zhig gi phyir du blang bar bya'o/ /bu mo de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag bsam pa thag pa nas khyed kyi rjes su slob na ci'i phyir mi sbyin/ de bas ji ltar dgos pa dag mdzod/de nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus bu mo de dag rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te/ byang chub
