sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la phul lo//zab mo zab pa'i mthar thug 'di thos tshe/ /rab dang rab tu g.yos pa'i gtong sems kyis//mdzes ma mdzes ma'i shing rta de dag dang / /bdag nyid bdag tu bzung ba med par btang //

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 263de lta bu'i gtong ba chen po la zhugs pa de mthong nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis ched du brjod pa du mas ched du brjod nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang bdog pa thams cad yongs su btang nas bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrubs te/ thabs mkhas pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su btsal lo/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis kyang bdog pa thams cad yongs su btang 20bar bya'o//gtong ba 'di lta bus chos smra ba la mchod pa byas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang thabs mkhas pa mnyan par nus shing / myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya po de dag dang shing rta lnga brgya po de dag byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bskang ba'i phyir blangs te/ blangs nas rigs kyi bu rtag tu ngu la byin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags stan las langs te bdag gi khyim du zhugs pa dang nyi ma nub par gyur to/ /khyim de nyid kyi nang du lo bdun gyi bar du ting nge 'dzin gcig la snyoms par zhugs par gyur to//chos 'phags smra ba'i nyi ma yis/ /'gro blo'i pad tshal rgyas byas nas//bsam gtan khang bzang nub ri'i rtser/ /spros pa'i snang ba zhi bar gyur//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu bdag chos kyi phyir du 'ongs nas 'dug pa dang nyal ba ni tshul ma yin no snyam nas/ lo bdun gyi bar du 'dod pa dang gnod sems dang rnam par 'tshe ba'i rtog pa cung zad tsam yang med cing ro la brkam pa ma skyes te/ gzhan du na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ting nge 'dzin las langs nas bdag cag la chos nam ston snyam pa yid la byed pa 'ba' zhig la gnas te/ 'greng ba dang 'chag pa'i spyod lam gnyis kyis dus 'da' bar byed do/ /tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya po de dag kyang yid la byed pa de lta bu dang spyod lam de lta bu dang ldan par gyur to//na chung rgyu dkar tshogs kyis kun nas bskor/ /brtson 'grus 'od dkar lhag par gsal ba can//gnyid kyi mun pa dor ba'i zla ba zhig /nyin dang mtshan du sdod pa spangs par gyur//

264 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags da ste zhag bdun na ting nge 'dzin de las langs te grong khyer gyi dbus su chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bar snang la lhas bsgrags pa'i skad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus thos pa dang / yid rab tu dga' ba dang mgu bas khengs nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya dang bcas pas sa phyogs de byi dor byas nas/rin po che thams cad kyis spras pa'i khri bshams pa'i steng du bu mo de dag gis rang gi bla gos phud de/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags bzhugs pa'i gdan du bting ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus sa phyogs der chag chag gdab par 'dod nas phyin pa dang / bdud sdig can gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba nub par 'gyur ba dang / bkod pa de yang mi mdzes par bya ba'i phyir/ chu thams cad mi snang bar byas pas kun tu chu btsal yang ma rnyed do/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu 'di snyam du sa phyogs 'di ni rdul che ste/ rdul 'di dag gis 'phags pa chos 'phags kyi lus la phog na mi rung na/ bdag gi lus gdon mi za bar 'jig pa 'dis ci zhig bya/ lus 'di lan grangs dpag tu med par zhig kyang don med pa 'ba' zhig tu song zhing 'di lta bu'i bya bas ni ma yin no/ /de'i phyir bdag gi lus phug la khrag gis sa phyogs 'dir chag chag gdab bo snyam mo/ /de ltar bsams nas mtshon rnon pos rang gi lus phug dral te khrag gis sa phyogs de khor yug tu chag chag btab bo/ /tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya po de dag gis kyang / mtshon rnon pos rang rang gi lus las phyung ba'i khrag gis sa phyogs der chag chag btab bo/ /de ltar byas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu dang / bu mo de dag sems gzhan du mi 'gyur zhing / bdud sdig can gyis dge ba'i phyogs kyi bar chad bya ba'i glags mi rnyed par gnas so//de ltar khrag gi chag chag gis/ /sa gzhi kun nas bstar ba 'di//thun mtshams sprin gyi 'od dag gis/ /nam mkha'i ngos 'di khebs pa bzhin//gang gis 'bad pa rnam pa du ma yis/ /dpag yas bar chad rtsom la gzhol gyur kyang //yar ngo'i zla ba 'phel ba ji bzhin du/ /'di yi snying stobs ches cher 'phel ba'i tshe//bdud dpung ma lus mya ngan gyur nas su/ /phyogs 'dir rang rang mgul ba bregs pa bzhin//de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'di snyam du/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu 'di ci tsam du chos 'dod pa dang / ci tsam du yi dam la brtan pa dang / ci tsam du go cha chen po bgos pa dang / lus dang

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 265srog dang longs spyod la mi lta bar 21bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa las thar par bya'o snyam du lhag pa'i bsam pasazhugs pa ni ngo mtshar to snyam du bsams nas/ khrag de dag thams cad sa phyogs de'i khor yug tu dpag tshad brgyar dri ldang ba'i lha'i tsandan gyi chur byin gyis brlabs so//chos smra bsnyen phyir chos la brtson tshul 'di/ /mig stong ldan pa'i mig gis mthong ba'i tshe/khrag gi chag chag ma la ya yi ri'i/ /tsandan dri yis kun nas khyab par byas//de ltar lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so//rigs kyi bu khyod kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa 'di lta bu dang / brtson pa 'di lta bu dang / chos 'dod pa 'di lta bus sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyi rjes su slob pa ni legs so legs so zhes smras so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu 'di snyam du/ bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags bzhugs pa'i khri bshams shing sa phyogs 'dir chag chag ni btab na/ sa phyogs 'dir dgram par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la yang mngon par gtor ba'i me tog de dag gang nas rnyed par 'gyur snyam pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la me tog manda ra ba khal stong byin nas/ rigs kyi bu/ me tog 'di dag gis mngon par 'dod pa'i don sgrubs shig ces smras so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus/ me tog de dag las kha cig ni sa phyogs der bkram/ kha cig ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la gtor ba'i phyir bzhag go/manda ra ba du mas mjes pa yis/ /chos tshul zab mo sgrog pa'i mdun sa de//'od 'bar rgyu skar du mas bkra ba yi/ /sprin bral mtshan mo'i mkha' bzhin snang bar gyur//de nas lo bdun 'das pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas/ 'bor brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun nas bltas te/ rang gi seng ge'i khri ga la ba der bzhugs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus mthong bar gyur to/ /de mthong ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu / dper na/dge slong bsam gtan dang po thob pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba de lta bu thob nas dga' bas yid rangs

266 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis 'khor rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston par mdzad pa ni 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par nyid do/ /chos thams cad khengs pa med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khengs pa med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad ro gcig pa nyid pas shes rab phyin pa ro gcig pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad skye ba dang 'gag pa med pa nyid pas rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa skye ba dang 'gag pa med pa nyid do/ /nam mkha' mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid kyi don legs par bka' stsal to//srid zhi'i chos kun gdod nas mnyam pa nyid/ /skye 'gag spros pa mtha' dag nye bar zhi//mtshan mo'i blo yis 22ji ltar gzung bas dben/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin ci 'dra mu mtha' bral /rten 'brel rkyen rnams blo yis btags pa tsam/ /blo de nyid kyang rang gi ngo bos stong //de ltar rten dang bral ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ /'bor dang mya ngan 'das pa rab tu 'byed//ji tsam blo yis btags pa'i snang ba las/ /gud du gyur pa'i chos 'ga' dmigs pa med//yod med rtag chad skye 'gag blang dor sogs/ /ji snyed dmigs pa 'di yang blo yi chos//kun nas nyon mongs rnam par byang ba yang / /rang bzhin nyid nas rang gi ngo bos dben//de phyir spang bya rnam par zad pa dang / /gnyen po rnam par 'phel ba ci zhig dmigs// gang gis gdod nas smig rgyu'i chu bzhin du/ /chos rnams rdul tsam dmigs pa med na yang //mngon par zhen rnams skrag pa spang bya'i phyir/ /gzhan ngor rten 'brel tsam zhig khas len la//dngos por khas len bral ba de dag la/ /rtag dang chad pa'i chos rnams rgyang ring ste//ji ltar mo gsham bu ni ma dmigs na/ /de yi skye 'chi dmigs par mi 'gyur bzhin//snang bzhin med phyir snang bas stong / /stong pas snang phyir med bzhin snang //lam zab ches dka' rtogs pas mkhas/ /mkhas pas rtogs dka' ches zab lam//

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bas ma gyi ljon pa/ 267 mkhas pas rtogs nyid de bzhin gnas/ /gnas bzhin de nyid rtogs pas mkhas//rmongs rnams mthong ba log pas 'khrul/ /zhakhrul pas log pa mthong rnams rmongs//'di na zhen pas zhen na 'di/ /'khor bar myur ba myur bar 'khor//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus/ chos zab mo de dag thos ma thag tu sa phyogs de nyid las ma g.yos bzhin du/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya stong phrag drug cu thob par gyur cing / thob ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyis bltas te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston pa bzhin du mngon sum du mthong bar gyur to/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu de mang du thos pa rgya mtsho lta bu dang ni ldan par gyur cing / skye ba thams cad du yang sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral zhing / tha na rmi lam na yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to//thabs dang shes rab garjesag pa'i shugs bskyod pas//sdug bsngal rgya mtsho kun nas mthar byed cing //gtong dang brtson pa'i mchu sder rab bgrad nas/ /rgya chen spyod pa'i mkha' la brtson pa yi// rgyal sras mkha' lding dbang po khyod mthong tshe/ /bdud dpung klu yi tshogs rnams spa bkong 'gyur//de lta bas na skyes bu dam pa rnams ni/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho mu med pa las sgrol ba'i khur khyer nas/ bskal pa grangs med pa du mar yang lus dang sems la gdung ba'i gnod pas cung zad tsam yang skyo ba med par/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams me rab tu 'bar bas gang ba'i nang nas kyang bshes gnyen las gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa 'tshol ba'i brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /zhes brtson 'grus kyi bsngags pa la yang brjod par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ rang gi lus dang srog la ltos pa med par yang sha dang khrag dang rkang gis kyang chos dang chos smra ba la bsnyen bkur byed na/ zang zing gi longs spyod gtong ba lta ci smos/ zhes theg pa chen po ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la'ang bkur sti sgrub pa dang sbyin pa'i yon tan bsngags pa la yang brjod par bya'o/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu go bgos pa'i dpa' bo chen po rnams ni/ byang chub tu sems bskyed

268 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/nas ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug par ma gyur gyi bar de srid du nyan thos dang / rang rgyal gyi rnam par grol ba la smon pa'i blo skad cig kyang mi skye bar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas na/ lha dang mi'i dbang phyug la yid chags par byed pa lta ci smos zhes bla na med pa'i tshul khrims kyi yon tan bsngags pa la yang brjod par bya'o/ /bdag las gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i blo dang ldan pa rnams ni/gzhan gyi don du 'bor ba'i mtha'i bar du sems can dmyal bar gnas pa la spro na/ rang gi lus dang sems la gnod pa phra mo rnams bzod pa lta ci smos zhes bzod pa'i yon tan bsngags pa la yang brjod par bya'o/ /gang gis nyan thos dang rang rgyal rnams kyis ming tsam yang mi shes pa'i spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa la 'jug pa dang ldang bar yang nus na/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan gzugs med rnams mngon du byed pa lta ci smos/ zhes byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam gtan gyi bsngags pa la yang brjod par bya'o/ /stong pa nyid zab mo la mos pa rtas 23pa rnams ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa ming tsam du bstan pa la yang mi mthun par mi 'dzin na/ g.yo ba'i ngang tshul can gyi srid pa rang gi ngo bos dben par rtogs pa lta ci smos/ zhes shes rab kyi che ba bsngags pa la yang brjod par bya'o//byis pa 'ga' zhig rang nyid gnas skabs kyi mngon par mtho ba tsam don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ sdug bsngal du mas lus gdung bar byed pa yang dka' ba spyod pa yin no/ /zhes skye bo rnams ngo mtshar du 'dzin par byed na/ gang gis mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral te/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i gling du phyin par 'dod pas/ bdag nyid kyi bde ba dang lus dang srog la yang ma chags par gtong ba la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la su zhig gus par mi byed/ ces byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan bsngags pa la yang brjod par bya'o/ /de lhar na dka' ba du mas bsgrubs pa'i dam pa'i chos dang phrad par dka' ba yang khong du chud par byas nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi dam pa'i chos mnyan pa la skyo ba spangs te yang dang yang du gus pa chen po nye bar bzhag nas thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa la yang 'bad par bya'o//gang gi ngal brgyas bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul/ltas5 bzhin rgyal bas gsal bar bstan pa 'di//'di yi dgongs pa ma nor ji bzhin du/ /du ma'i rgyan ldan sdeb legs tshig gis spel//

byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa/ 269lhag bsam rnam dag lhun po'i khyon las zhabrungs/ /sgra don rgyan gyi me tog rnam par bkra//mngon brjod yal ga'i rnam grangs du mas phyug /rtogs brjod snyan dngags dpag bsam ljon pa 'di//thub dbang mig stong ldan pa'i rjes zhugs nas/ /thar mchog lta na sdug tu 'jug pa yi//skal ldan 'dod lha'i re ba bskang phyir brtsams/ /'gran 'dod sreg za'i bud shing ched du min//smra ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan dpa' bo yis/ /sngon dus rgyal ba kho na'i mdzad pa rnams/ /legs par bsngags nas rgyal sras mchog 'di yi//rtogs brjod re shig btang snyoms bzhag pa na//snyan dngags rgya mtshor yang yang son pa'i mkhas pa'i ded dpon bral ba rnams//rlabs chen spyod pa zab dang rgya che'i chu gter ngam nag 'di mthong tshe//shin tu 'jigs nas yun ring dor ba 'di yi blo yis ma bzod nas//dpa' bo zhes grags ded dpon mchog de slar yang tshul 'dir zhugs par gyur//rgyal sras rgyal ba'i med byung rnam thar la/ /rgya bod snyan dngags tshul la sbyangs rnams kyis//blo gros thogs pa med par 'jug pa brdzun/24 /bden na 'di yi rtogs brjod med pa ci//rgya chen shes bya'i gnas rnams kun nas gsal/ /mkhas pa'i legs bshad paṅge'i tshal brgya 'byed//thub bstan bya lam mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig pu/ /kho bo'i blo gros nyin byed shar ba na//blun rmongs rgyu skar khrod na 'od gsal zhing / /phrag dog ri dwags mtshan mas spud pa yi//mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can gyi zla ba dang / /ngan rtog 'byung po'i bya yis bzod par dka'//'di la 'bad pas bsod nams gangs ri'i gos/ /byams brtse'i tsha zer 'od kyis bzhu ba'i rgyun//skye dgu'i yid kyi rdzing bur zhugs gyur nas/ /thar lam pad tshal kun nas rgyas gyur cig/bdag kyang srid par le lobacom pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /lus kyang btang nas lam bzang zab mo stong pa nyid//'gas kyang sngon chad 'khor bar ma myong gnas 'di la//kun kyang bkod nas rgyal ba'i chos tshul 'dzin gyur cig/rgyal dang rgyal sras spyod pa ma lus pa/ /srid nas srid du spyad pas mi ngoms shing //kun la kun nas brtse ba'i rtag tu ngus/ /ji lta ji ltar spyad ltar bdag gyur cig/

270 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/bdag gi legs bshad nyin mo'i dpal 'di yang //mtha' yas gdul bya'i mig tu gnas gyur te//log rtog bdud dpung ku mud zum byas nas//bstan pa'i lhun po ring du gsal byed shog/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i rtogs pa brjod pa snyan dngags dpag bsam gyi ljon pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dal 'byor gyi lhun po bslab gsum nor bu'i yon tan du mas brjid cing / lung dang rigs pa bstan pa rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen byang chub bla mas bskul nas/ mtho ris kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan zhing / tshul khrims dang thos pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam dpal gyis mthun rkyen nye bar sbyar te/ mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag nyid don gyi slad du mtshan nas smosate/ chos kyi rje don grub rin chen gyi zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos len cing / skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po nam mkha' bzang po dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan sa skya pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi drin las/ snyan dngags dang tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos las blo'i snang ba thob pa/ shar myong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis chos grwa chen po bde ba can du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo gros kyi bang mdzod sngags dang mtshan nyid du ma'i nor bus gtams pa'i snyan dngags mkhan tshwa kho ba ngag dbang grags pa'o// //

ra༅༅/ /gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud las btus pa/1mdo mkhar zhabs brung tshe ring dbang rgyal/ra༅༅/ /de nas khang bzang ba gam rgyan gyis spras shing / bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas shis par byas pa la spyan drangs te rin po che'i khri bshams pa la/ mtshungs med sa yi dbang phyug rgyal po gzhon nu zla med thams cad dga' de nyid/ gser gyi lhun por nyi 'od kyis 'khyud pa ltar gzi sbyin gyi phung po lham me/lhang nge / lhan ner 'khod pa'i 'dun sa la ni blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor zhing mdzes par byas pa/ khyu ma chog ba lang gi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ nyi ma 'od zer stong gis bskor ba lta bu/ zla ba rgyu skar gyis bskor ba lta bu/ brgya byin sum cu rtsa gsum pas bskor pa lta bu/ tshangs pa tshangs ris kyis bskor pa lta bu/ spyod pa dang spyod lam ma 'khrugs pa/ glang po che'i rgyal po ltar dregs pa dang bral ba/rin po che'i ri bo ltar kun tu bzang ba'i ngo mtshar gyis thams cad ya mtshan du gyur cing / yid la dga' ba 'bum gyis khengs pa'i rnam 'gyur ci dang ci yang byung ngo / /de nas byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi 'byor ba dbyar bsdus pa dang mtshungs pa'i longs spyod rnyed bkur phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston la yongs su rol bar byed do/ /de'i tshe yid 'ong ma de yang tshong pa khe spogs rnyed pa dang / zhing pa lo tog 'byor ba dang / dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang / nad pa nad las thar pa'i dga' bas kyang mtshon du med pa'i yid dga' ba dang / bde ba'i ros gang bar gyur pa na/ 'bangs mo rnams kyis rgyan gos kyi khyad par rin thang bral ba rnams nyer bsdogs 2byas te/ snag snam li ba'i 3sgra'i zar bu phyed ltag par bcings pa la/ nor bu'i rin po che mthon ka chen po dang / ind+ra nī la dang / padma ra ga dang / multi ka dang / byu ru dang / spug la sogs pas 'phra tshoms su spud pas mdzes par byas shing / skra'i lhag ma sil bur grol bas stod kyi cha shas yongs su khebs pa/ dpral ba dbyes che ba zla ba rgyas pa lta bu'i bye brag kha dog mtha' yas pas me tog kha 'bus pa'i rnam pa can dbyibs legs su brgyus pa'i bar rnams mu tig gi za ra tshags kyis mtha' mdzes par byas pa ni legs par dpyangs/ smin pa 'byog cing ri mor bris pa'i rnam pa yid du 'ong ba ni

272 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/bung ba'i tshogs ltar gnas pa'i yid 'gugs shing / rdzi ma sdug cing mngon par g.yo ba'i skyibs na utpa la'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i dbyibs can mig dkyus ring zhing bkra ba ni zur mig khu ba dang ldan pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis kun nas mdzes pa dang / sna'i gzengs cung zad mtho zhing gtsang la dbyibs legs pa ni skye bo ma lus 'dud pa'i mchod sdong ltar drang por gnas/ mkhur tshos nyi ma 'char ga'i mdangs 'dzin pa la chags pas myos pa'i khrag gi ri mo'i thig le ni mdzes par byas la/ brgyu dzi ba ga'i 4mdangs 'phrog pa'i mchu sgros rtag tu 'dzum pa'i bar nas rab dkar mu tig mtshar du dgod pa'i so'i phreng ba ni thags bzang snyoms par gsal/ dbyibs legs med byung thos 'dzin zung la ni rin chen kunā'i phon po lta bu/gser g.yu mu tig gi 'phra tshoms dang 'phyang 'phrul ldan pa/ khyad par 'phags pa'i rna cha mdzes pa'i ni legs par spras/ mgrin pa sbom phra'i go skabs snyoms shing / dung ltar 'khyil ba ni rin chen rin thang gzhal du med pa/ kernya ta dang / margad dang / ind+ra rnyil dang / sbur len la sogs pa'i do shal mu tig gi 'phyang 'phrul/ rin po che du ma dang ldan pa'i mgul rgyan ni mdzes par dpyangs/ rab dkar 'jam gnyen gzhon sha chags pa'i lag pad la ni rin po che sa le sbram dang kharadzu ram la sogs pa'i gdu bu 'phra tshoms can dang / mnyen lcug sor mo'i gdu bu la sogs pa'ang yid du 'ong bar spud/mdzes sdug gi sgeg chos yongs su rdzogs pa'i lang tsho'i stod cha la ni rab dkar du kū la'i bla gos srab mo mdzes par bklubs pa las nu ma dkar zlum mtho la mkhrang ba'i dbyibs gsal bar dod pas skye bo 'dod ldan ma lus chags pa'i gdung ba bskyed pa ltar byas/ sked skabs phra zhing sta zur ldem pa la ni dzam bu la ri'i 'og pag dang rin chen du ma'i dra ba dang dra phyed la sogs pa g.yer dril sil khrol gyi dbyangs snyan par sgrogs pa ni go rim nges par byas te spud/ 'jo sgeg rnam 'gyur med du byung ba'i lang tsho'i smad cha la ni pañtsa li ga'i smad gos kyis bklubs pa las rab dkar mkhrang la zlum pa'i brla'i 'khri shing gi dbyibs 'char bas chags ldan ma lus 'dod pas spyo ba ltar byed/ byin pa dbyibs sdug cing byin gyis phra ba can bgrod byed zung la ni rin po che'i mardzi ras 5mdzes par byas pa las g.yer dril gyi sgra dang bcas te ngang pa'i 'gros ltar gom stabs sgyur bzhin par song nas/ rgyal sras blon por bcas pa'i mdun sa khang bzang ba gam can ga la ba der lhags pa na/ der 'khod pa'i skye bo ma lus 'di snyam du bsams pa/ e ma srid pa'i mdzes sdug kun gyi snying po byed po gcig tu byas pa/ gzugs dang lang tsho mdzes pa dang / g.yer ba 6dang / sgyu rtsal gyi yon tan dang ldan pas nags tshal me tog rgyas pa'i nang na

gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud las btus pa/ 273nags tshal gyi lha bzhin 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mdzes pa'i phul du byin pa/ de'i gzugs dang lang tshos 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i drang srong dag kyang yid kyi brtan pa rab tu 'phrog par byed na/ thog ma med pa nas nyon mongs pa la sgoms par byas/ 'dris par byas/ de'i dbang du gyur pa rnams ni lta smos kyang cig dgos zhes phan tshun gcig gis gcig la smra zhing / 'dod pa'i dga' ston la nye bar chags pa'i 'ching zhags ring pos nye bar bcings/ mdzes ma de'i bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor lta bas mi ngoms pa la mig g.yo ba med pa ri mor bris pa'i rnam pa dang mtshungs par rtse gcig tu lta bar byed do//de nas yid 'ong bzhin bzang ma/ /ngo tshas bzhin ras dud gyur kyang //mig zur 7mdzes pa'i zur mda' ni/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu dpal der zug/sgrin po'i 'dren byed g.yos gyur pas/ /rgyu skar tshogs dbus zla ba'am//padma tshal na pad dkar ltar/ /mthong na de yi mdzes sdug rgyar//ri dwags mo bzhin bcings par gyur/ /gzhon nu des kyang zla bzhin ma//yid 'ong mdzes pa'i phul gyur de/ /'dren byed lam du 'phos ma thag/shin tu brtan pa ltar bcos kyang / /chags pa'i rlung gis ring zhig 'dar//mngon sum mig gi spyod yul du/ /gyur pa'i lang tsho'i mdzes pa 'di//yid kyis sprul par mi nus shing / /bzo bo mkhas pa'i lag sor gyi//'du byed kyis kyang bsgrub tu med/ /'di ni rin chen brtsegs pa'i khrir//bzhag nas dang po kun gyis ni/ /btud byas mchod par 'os pa ste//mi las 'das pa'i khyad chos mang / /zhes bsam mngon 'dod rtse dga' la//chags pa'i bsam gtan g.yo med gyur/ /de che mchog tu sgeg ma des//rjes chags zur mig g.yo bzhin du/ /snyan pa'i 'gyur bag stong ldan pa'i//glu dbyangs gsar pa 'di skad byas//e ma ho/ de ring lha lam yangs pa'i dkyil 'bor du/ /'chi med bu dang bu mo zlos gar mkhan//mgrin las snyan 'gyur 'bum phrag bkye ba yi/ /shis brjod dbyangs kyi nga ros sa gsum khyab/ /rnam bkra dbang po'i gzhu yi sham bu dang / /nyin byed 'od stong 'bar ba'i tog ldan pa/ /rab mdzes sprin sna

274 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/mdzes pa'i gdugs dkar gyis/ /khor yug yongs su khyab pa'i dge mtshan dngos/ /mdzes pa'i gar dang snyan pa'i glu dbyangs can/ /'jo sgeg nyams ldan yid 'ong lha mo lnga/ /gzugs mdzes dri med rin chen mi long 'phyar/ /sgra ldan pi wang stong phrag rgyud ldan sgreng /8/dri bzang dpal gyis dum bu'i bsung zhim 'thul//ro ldan bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis tshim pa ster/ /reg bya srab 'jam yang ba'i lha yi gos/ /legs bstar snga na med pa'i bkur stir byed/ /me tog bsil ma'i gru char rdul bcil cing / /sna tshogs rol mo'i bye brag kun nas 'khrol/ /glu dang gar gyi 'gyur bag yid 'ong gis/ /yid la kun dga'i ri mo ci yang bris//skal bzang sa gzhi yangs pa'i thig le'i dpyid/ /lte ba snang ba 'bum ldan rgyal po'i khab/ /nor bu'i ba gam brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang / /lta na nyams su dga' ba'i bsti gnas 'dir/ /bdag gis ring mo nyid nas las smon 9gyi/ /mtshams sbyor gcig tu grub pa'i rgyal ba'i sras/ /gzhon nu zla med ces bya mtshan tsam gyi/ /sgras kyang yid la sngon med dga' ba'i ros/ /myos pa'i mngon 'dod gsar pa la chags kyang / /dngos dkyil longs spyod skal bas phongs pa yi/ /sdug bsngal bzod dka'i tshor bas nyam thag mthar/ /deng 'dir rin chen sa zla'i lhun po la/ /'bum phrag nyi ma'i snang bas 'byud pa ltar/ /mthong na mngon dga' gzi byin phung po'i gter/ /mngon sum longs su spyod pa'i dga' ston 'di//'bor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid dpal thob kyang / /'di yi brgya stong char yang phod ma yin/ /'brug stong tshangs dbyangs gdong lnga'i gad rgyangs kyis/ /mtshon par nus min kun dga'i dpyid 'jo ba/ /zab gsal gsung gi gsang ba thos 'dzin gyi/ /bdud rtsi'i bang mdzod 'dzin pa bdag skal bzang / /mi phyed mdza' ba'i bag chags snying nyid la/ /sgoms pa bkod las brtse chen thugs rje'i spyan/ /ring por g.yo la rtse gcig smon byas pa'i/ /re ba bsam pa ji bzhin de ring rdzogs/ /bdag ni dang por khyod zhal blta ba la/ /gcig tu smon pas gnyen 'bor longs spyod sogs//phun tshogs kun gyi snying po yongs dor nas/ /khyod zhabs gtsug tu bsnyen slad chas gyur kyang / /'dod pa'i me tog ma rungs ser ba yis/ /nyams byas mya ngan mun pas dkrigs gyur mod/ /da ni bkra shis snang ba dkar po yis/ /yongs khyab bskal bzang 'di ko e ma nda/95//ces bya ba la sogs pa snyan pa'i ngag gis gsol ba na/ rgyal bu gzhon nu de ni ngang pa'i khyu mchog ngogs kyi padma'i tshal nas mgrin pa cung zad btegs nas 'bab chu lhung lhung gi sgra la gus pas nyan pa ji 'dra ba de 'dras/ sems rtse gcig pas mnyan te yid dga' ba dang bde ba'i ros myos par gyur kyang / re

gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud las btus pa/ 275zhig bgam par bya ba'i slad du gzhon nu ma la smras pa/nang gi kun rtog 'char sgo'i gzugs brnyan zla//phyi rol tshul 'chos sprin gyis bsgribs byas nas//snyan pa'i tshig gi sbyor ba bdud rtsi'i char/ /'bebs la nu rgyas ma khyod mkhas gyur kyang / /rang bzhin mi drang kun tu g.yo ba'i phyir/ /g.yon can zhes bya ming du ma grags sam/ /gang yang skyes pa bud med phal cher ni/ /nyams nyes mthong na ri bya ltar 'bros shing / /phun sum tshogs pa rig na khyi bzhin du/ /bskrad kyang de nyid la ni 'du ba bzhin/ /sgeg mo khyod kyang ring nas mdza' ba'i grogs/ /bgo skal dang por thob pa lha rigs las/ /phul byung de ni mchil ma'i thal ba ltar/ /dor nas bdag la 'dud 'di rigs min pas/ /g.yo sgyu'i tshig gi spros pa bskyungs byas te/ /gna' bo'i gzhung bzang ring du skyong bar gyis//zhes bsgo bar byas pa las/ yid 'ong ma de ni 'di snyam du/ bdag gis yun ring de snyed kyi bar du mchi ma'i btung ba dang / mya ngan gyi zas la brten nas rgyal sras gzhon nu kho na la rtse gcig tu smon par bya ba las gzhan du sems pa skad cig tsam ma mchis kyang / rje'i sras 'di yang bya rog bzhin du rang gi grib ma la'ang yid ma ches par dogs pa ngan pas bcings par snang mod/ 'on kyang rang gi gnas lugs gang yin pa drang por brjod do snyam nas smras pa/sa bdag gang gis ma brtags 'khyog po'i tshig /bdag la phan pa 'doms pa ltar snang ba/ /khyod thugs rang bzhin yongs dag dwangs shel khams/ /dogs ngan dri mas yongs su bslad byas pa/ /'di na gzu bor gnas pa bdag lta la/ /'thing slad sun byin bya ba'i gnas mchis sam/ /bud med rang bzhin mi drang g.yon can zhes/ /mtha' gcig kho nar smad par rigs min te/ /mchog dang dman pa'i bya byed khyad par chos/ /skyes pa la yang mtshungs par mthong phyir ro/ /bdag ni rnam pa kun tu lha khyod las//gzhan du sems pa'i go skabs ma mchis te/ /gcan gzan gtum po'i mdun sar rtswa ljang gi /bdog pa spungs la dga' ba skyed 'gyur ram/ /de phyir 'dod pas spyo ba'i rgyal bu des/ /chags gdungs lus kyi 'khri shing 'dar ldan pas/ /mdza' ba don du gnyer la 'bad zhugs kyang / /thabs mkhas tshig gis brid de 'khrul bar byas/ /'dzum dkar zla ba'i ngo mtshar gsal ba las/ /snyan 'jebs tshig gi bsil zer spros pa yis/ /chags ldan snying gi ku mud bzhad na yang / /mdza' gcugs gsang gtam grol ba nam yang med/ /'dren byed log par blta bas gzhan gyi sems//bsregs min kun gyi mig snga mdzes byas kyang / /chags pa'i rol la zhen pa'i mig zur mda'/ /su zhig la yang 'phen pa'i yul ma mchis ngo

276 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/zum mi gnag bzhin bzang mthong na dga'i/ /ngang tshul 'dzin pas ma lus skye rgu'i yid/ /'gugs pa'i lcags kye'i brtul zhugs rdzogs gyur kyang / /padma gsar ba'i reg bya ma rnyings mdzes/ /gzugs dang lang tshos sgeg cing g.yer ba dang / /sgyu rtsal yon tan rdzogs pas 'dod ldan kun/ /chags pa'i me yis rab tu gdungs byas kyang / /bsil byed 'dod chags chu las ring du brgal/ /bdag ni rigs ldan ya rabs dra ma'i brgyud/ /lhag bsam mu tig 'khri shing dar babs pas/ /'khyog po'i tshig gis gzhan mgo rmongs byed pa'i/ /gya gyur sbyor ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /khyad par blta ba'i mig dang nyal ba'i sngas/ /rtse gcig yid kyi brten pa khyod kho na/ /re ba'i ba dan drang por btsugs byas kyang / /'byog por brjod pa'i gsung 'dis bdag yid gdungs/ /gzhan du khyod las mi sems skal ngan bdag /brtse chen thugs rje'i zhags pas ring btang ste/ /phyogs 'dir rgyal sras mchog zhabs 'bror lo'i 'gros/ /bskyod pa yun gyis bskal pa'i bar dag tu/ /nyin dang mtshan yang thun brgya ldan pa bzhin/ /mi 'dzad nyin re la'ang lo'i 'du shes/ /skyes gyur gdung pa'i khur gyis lci ba yi/ /skyo shas yid 'byung kho nas dus 'da' tshe/ /nam zhig pho brang rtser 'phags yun ring por/ /ngus pa'i mig 'bur mtho ldan 'dren byed kyis/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun la had kyis bltas/ /de tshe srid pa'i rgyan gyi mkha' lam nas/ /sbyangs pa'i gser gyi mdangs 'dzin ngur pa zung / /brtse bas 'grogs shing dga' ba'i 'phur lding bcas/ /khyod kyang 'di ltar grogs dang mdza' 'am zhes/ /bzod med mya ngan slong ba'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /mthong bas rnam par shes pas yongs bor ba'i/ /lus ni drungs nas bcad pa'i shing bzhin 'gyel/ /de tshe tsan dan gyis bgos bsil pa'i chab/ /legs bran rnga yab g.yob pas dran pa byin/ /de lta na yang mya ngan gdung ba'i shugs/ /'gog tu med pa mchi mas bzhin khebs shing / /ngu ngag snyan 'gyur bral ba'i cho nge bton/10/rdo bas gnad du 'phog pa'i byi ba ltar/ /zas la sred bral sdug bsngal bye ba brgyas/ /gzir ba'i lang tsho'i gzi mdangs yongs nyams shing / /sha bri mig ni had kyi blta bar gyur/ /gzhan gyi dogs pa sel slad 'dzum dkar gyis/ /snang ba mu tig 'bras bur mtshar byas kyang / /bzod med mig nas 'bab pa'i mchi ma'i rgyun/ /dngul chu'i thigs phreng 'dzags pa 'gog tu med/ /de tshe bcu drug cha rdzogs lang tsho'i dpal/ /mdzes sdug bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis legs gtams pa/ /nyes brgya nag po'i phyogs kyis dbang gyur pas/ /nam zhig tshes gcig zla ltar cha phrar gyur/ /de ltar rgyal sras khyod sku'i ngo mtshar gzugs//yid kyi me long gtsang mar sgrib med du/ /'char ba'i bsam gtan la chags gang gi mtshan/ /bzlas

gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud las btus pa/ 277brjod mgrin pa 'dzer la zhugs gyur kyang / /rang nyid bde ba'i ro la chags gyur pas/ /gzhan gyi gdung ba'i ngang tshul mi shes bzhin/ /snying tshig 11rnam pa du mas bdag nyid la/ /smad pas mdzad 'di dam pa'i tshul ma lags/ /gang zhig dogs pa'i sprin phung 'bum brtsegs nas/ /yid kyi zla ba snang min byas gyur pa/ /de la nyams su bde ba'i 'od dkar gyi/ /phreng ba spro ba'i mthu ni yod ma yin/ /bdag ni rang bzhin mda' ltar drang ba la/ /g.yon can 'khyog po'i gzhu zhes sgro btags kyang / /gzu bor gnas rnams gcig tu khrel ba dang / /ngag gi nyes pa lci bas nongs min nam/ /de slad gang thugs som nyi'i 'ching zhags kyis/ /lan brgyar bcings te brtag dpyad zab mo'i mtshon/ /'bar bas bcad byas rjes su chags pa'i spyan/ /ring por g.yo bas rtag tu skyong bar mdzod/ /bdag ni bsod nams 'chi med lha'i ra bar/ /legs bskrun skal bzang yongs 'du'i 'dab stong rtser/ /phun tshogs re ba'i 'bras bus yongs lci ba/ /de ring longs su spyod pa'i dga' ston myong / /sngon bsags dkar min gcig tu gnag pa'i las /bsags 'bras duḥkha'i mun chen gyis gtibs kyang / /skyabs 'os thugs rje'i nyin byed gzi 'bar bas /dge legs mchog gi snang ba dam pas khyab/ /sngon las smon lam bzang pos mtshams 'brel zhing //mthong na yid 'phrog mig gi dbang po chags/ /ma 'dris mdza' ba'i bshes gcig lha khyod dang / /mjal ba skal ba bzang ngo rjes brtser 'tshal//zhes mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i 'dab brgya rnam par grol ba las byung ba'i tshig snyan cing 'jebs pa/ mkha' 'gro dkar po'i khyu tshogs padma'i rdzing bur 'gro 'ong byed pa'i dbyangs dang rjes su mthun pa legs par gsol ba na/ rgyal bu gzhon nu zla med de ni bzhin bzang ma de'i gzugs dang lang tshos sgeg pa'i ngo mtshar dang / sbrang rtsi ltar ro myang bar 'os pa'i snyan 'jebs tshig gi phreng ba thos pas yid kyi dbang po gzhan du mi g.yo bar 'di snyam du bsams pa/a ho/ 'chi med bu mo stong phrag gi mdzes pa ma lus pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus kyang / 'di'i brgya stong gi cha yang bsgrun du med pa'i mdzes sdug yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa/ bud med mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can gyi ma 'dres pa'i chos lnga dang ldan pa/ skyon lnga spangs pa/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa/ bud med kyi sa dam pa lnga gang yin pa ni/ rigs mthon po'i bag mar len pa dang / khyim phun sum tshogs par 'dug pa dang / khyim bdag kyang de'i dbang du 'gyur ba dang / bu dang ldan pa/ sbyin par byed pa la sogs pa'i yon ༅ gyi khyad par dpag tu med pa/ yid du 'ong zhing lta na sdug pa/ lus ngag kha sgro nas ha ri tsan

278 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/dan gyi dri bsung rab tu ldang ba/ gang gi reg pa la bde ba'i mchog ster ba la sogs bud med rin po che'i dge mtshan ma lus tshang ba 'jig rten mi'i yul du byung ba 'di ni bdag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du gyur pa rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa'o snya/ma du yid dga' ba dang bde ba'i ros gang zhing / dang por tshod bgam pa'i slad du sting tshig smras pa la cung zad skyengs pa'i sgo nas lan smras pa/'jig rten mes po gser gyi mngal can 12dang / /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i rigs las byung min zhing //mi'am ci mo'i mched zlar ma bltams kyang / /lha dang dri za'i bu mo las rgyal ba'i/ /mdzes sdug kun gyi snying po sa gsum na/ /mtshungs pa'i dpe zlas dbul ba khyed mthong tshe/ /srid na mtshar ba'i dper 'os zla ba yang / /nyin byed 'od zer 'bar ba'i phag tu yibs/ /rigs brgyud dpag bsam 'dod 'jo'i 'a khri shing mchog /mdzes sdug me tog bzhad pas rnam mdzes shing / /rmad byung spyod tshul shis pa'i 'dab stong dgod/ /grags pa'i dri bsung g.yo ba khyed lta bu/ /lha dang ljon pa'i zhing la gtam tsam ste/ /mi yi 'jig rten 'di na sngon ma byung / /bdag gis bskal mang rgya chen bsod nams tshogs/ /bsags pa'i 'bras bu nyams su myong ba las/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i yo byad rin chen bdun/ /ldeng ba'i btsun mo'i phul khyod skal bas rnyed/ /'jo sgeg lang tsho'i pad sdong ldem pa la/ /'dod pa'i myos bum sbrang rtsi'i bcud du chags//bzhin bzang zla ba gsar ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dkyus ring ri dwags mig gi mtshan mas mdzes/ /mkhur 'dzum dkar dmar phye ba'i ngo mtshar des/ /thun mtshams sprin gyi mdzes pa pham par byas// gnag snum zur phud khyogs la 'phyang 13ba'i rtser/ /rin chen rtse phran gtsug rgyan 'od rab 'bar/ /bim pa'i 14snyems pa 'phrog pa'i 'dzum zhal las/ /ga pur gsar pa'i bsung zhim kun las ldang / /'khrud rgya'i gar du rtse ba'i mgrin pa dang / /mchog tu phra ba'i sked 15skabs rin po che'i/ /do shal 'og pag 'phyang 'phrul gyis mdzes pa/ /mig la bdud rtsi'i char chen 'bebs pa bzhin/ /de ltar snying gi thig ler 'khyil ba'i bcud// bskal pa mang pos goms pa'i ro las bzhin/ /mdza' ba mi phyed dam bca' brtan bkod de/ /khyod la brtse ba'i 'jug pa mi lhod kyang / /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i gser sbyang khams// 'gal rkyen g.ya' yis gos sam ma gos zhes/ /bgam pa'i slad du khyod la sun 'byin gyi/ /tshig tu brjod pa de ni ji bzhin min/ /las kyi 'brel zab ldan na nam du yang / /mdza' ba'i 'ching ba lhod pa'i skabs med phyir/ /bdag kyang khyod don gnyer slad yul phyogs 'dir/ /bgrod pa'i dam bca' gsal bar bkod pa na//yab yum 'bangs 'khor snying la zug rngu yis/ /zug pa'i cho nge gsang por 'don byed cing/ /bzhin ras

gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud las btus pa/ 279mchi mas brlan gyur bshol 'debs kyang / /gang brtsams thog ma'i bya ba mi 'dor ba// brtun pa bskyed de yul khams 'dir lhags nas/ /zhi dul thabs mkhas spyod pas gdul bya zhes/ /yid dam brtan por bcas kyang skyes bu'i las/ /myong bya ldog tu med phyir dgra sde'i tshogs/ /ming gi lhag mar byas pa'i sdig lhung khur/ /lci bas 'khor bar skyes pa'i sa gzhi bzhin/ /byas mod 'on kyang bden pa'i mthu ma nyams//bzhin bzang ma khyod sngon chad sdug bsngal gyi/ /tshor ba dgun gyi reg byas bcom gyur kyang / /da ni bskal bzang dbyar dpal dar ba yis/ /dga' ston spyod par phyogs so mdzes ldan ma// rigs mchog dri ma med pa'i chu mtsho las/ /lang tsho'i pad dkar bzhad pa mi mthun gegs/ /zla bas nyams kyang ring nas mdza' ba'i grogs/ /nyin byed snang bas skyong ngo lus phra ma/ /legs par spyad pa'i zhing sa gshin po la//re ba'i lo tog phun sum tshogs che ba/ /bar du gcod pa'i ser bas 'joms brtson kyang / /mthu rtsal rlung gis stor ro gzhon nu ma/ /mi 'dod 'bras bu nyams su myong 'gyur ba/ /tshul min rngon pa'i rgya yis phyogs rnams kun/ /'bros byas mdzes ma'i ri dwags don gnyer kyang / /sdug bsnga rgya las grol lo nu rgyas ma//rnam dag bsam pa'i zla ba legs byas kyi/ /mkha' la 'gog med rgyu ba mi mthun sprin/ /stug pos nam zhig mog por byas na yang / /sprin bral 'od ris dngom mo phra rgyas ma/ /zla ba grogs med mkha' la 'char ba dang / /kunda sa gzhir spyod pa rgyang ring yang / /las smon gcig tu dkar bas re ba'i 'bras//bde blag 'grub bo ri dwags mig can ma/ /bcu drug lang tshor ldan pa'i sgeg mchor la/ /brtse bar 'dod pa'i skye bos re ba'i lam/ /bkag kyang gzhan dbang ma gyur yid bzhin du/ /'grogs pa'i skal par ldan no sgeg 'chang ma /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i dga' ba'i gtam mnyan par 'os pa 'dod dgongs snying po can ci dang ci yang smras te/ za 'og gi gdan khri brtsegs pa la 'khod du bcug go/ //

༄༅༅/ /ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/dpal khang lo stob/ra༅༅/ /na maḥ swa ra swa wī/ ming gi mngon brjod padma dkar po'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ shes byar rmongs mun kun zos lang tsho'i gzi/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes 'od stong du/ /rab 'bar smra ba'i nyi mar phyag bgyid nas/ /mngon brjod pad dkar bzhad pa'i phreng ba spel//rnye1na pa kun mkhyen kun gzigs dang / /thams cad gzigs dang thams cad mkhyen/ /rgyal ba bde gshegs de bzhin gshegs/ /thub pa thub dbang thub pa che/ /kun tu bzang po bcom ldan 'das//skyob pa 'gro mgon 'gro ba'i bla/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo rkang gnyis mchog /drang srong chen po dge sbyong che//chags bral chags 'joms sku gsum pa/ /thams cad rtags dang lusamed thul/ /chos kyi dbang phyug dran pa'i dgra/ /mkha' mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa/ /bdag nyid chen po thams cad sgrol/ /gnyis med gsung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mngon shes drug ldan stobs bcu pa/ /dpal stug bdud 'dul 'jig rten 'dul/ /skyes bu'i khyu mchog mi'i seng ge /'jig rten mgon po dus gsum mkhyen/ /rnam 'dren chos rje chos kyi rgyal/ /legs gsung rtogs ldan sku gsum pa/ /'di rnams sangs rgyas spyi yi mtshan//shākya'i rgyal po shākya'i tog shwakya seng ge go ta ma/ /bu ram shing pa nyi ma'i gnyen/ /zas gtsang sras dang sgyu 'phrul sras/ /rdo rje ldan pa don kun grub/ /lha yi lha sogs shāka thub mtshan/ /mi pham mgon dang mi pham pa/ /rgyal tshab sa bcu'i dbang phyug dang / /dga' ldan bzhugs pa lha'i bla ma/ /byams chen la sogs byams pa'i mtshan//'jam mgon 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / /rdo rje rnon po seng ge rtsen/ /ye shes sku dang shes rab sku//blo mchog stsol dang ngag gi rgyal/ /'jam dpal blo gter blo yi bdag /ngag gi dbang phyug smra ba'i rgyal//shesarab 'khor losmra ba'i lha/ /gshon nu'i sar gnas gtsug phud lnga/ /brtan pa'i 'bor lo seng ge rtsen//zur phud lnga pa ral gri can/ /ye shes me long 'jam dbyangs mtshan/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'jig rten mgon/ /phyagan padma chu skyes can/ /thugs rje chen po snying rje'i lha/ /mnar med gzigs dang brtse ba can//gru 'dzin dgyes sogs spyan ras gzigs/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje dbang phyug rdo rje can//

282 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/mthu stobs bdag po gsang ba'i rgyal/ /phyag na rdo rje gsang ba 'dzin/ /lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin rgyal//gsang ba'i bdag sogs phyag rdor mtshan//oṃ mdzad ma dang myur skyob ma/ /zhi ma 'jig rten dbang sras mo/ /dpal chen mo sogs sgrol ma'i mtshan/ /zhal gsum phag gi shing rta ma/ /rnam gtsug 'od zer can ma'i mtshan/ /ngag dbang lha mo tshangs sras mo/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo dpal mo dang / /rgya mtsho'i lha mo zla sring mo/ /shes rab lha mo blo gter ma/ /dri za'i na chung dkar mo dang / /ston sbyin mo dang mtsho ldan ma/ /rdo rje dbyangs kyi dbang phyug ma//gzhan yang swa ra swa sti sta/ /smra ba'i lha mo dbyangs dbyangs can mtshan/ /rmugs 'dzin chu yi dbang po dang //chu yi thub pa nor bu bzang / /sngon gyi gnod sbyin gter 'chang dang / /gnod gnas dzambha la yi mtshan//sangs rgyas chung ngu thos sgrog dang / /gsung skyes dang ni brtul zhugs dbang / /theg chung skyes bu sangs rgyas 'khor/ /sbyangs yon la gnas nyan thos mtshan/ /nyi tshe'i sangs rgyas sangs rgyas 'bring //bsde ru lta bu zhi la sred/ /rang zhi don gnyer zhi ba 'tsho/ /pra ta ka buddha dang ni/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis don la rtogs/ /sgra med chos ston rkyen cig rtogs/ /theg 'bring skyes bu rten 'brel sgom/ /rang byang chub rnams rang rgyal mtshan/ /blo ldan gsal mchog sems dpa' che/ /rgyal byed rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gzhi//'phags mchog ded dpon brten pa dang / /rgyal ba'i myu gu byang sems mtshan//mtho ris gnas bzang skabs gsum gnas/ /rol pa bde ldan dpal 'dzin dang / /sdig med gnas dang skyo med gnas/ /bde 'gro lhas rtsen lha yi grong / /steng gi 'jig rten sum rtsen gnas/ /grub pa'i gnas sogs lha gnas ming / /tshe ring rgas med 'chi med dang / /bdud rtsi zas can bdud rtsi skyes//bcud ldan rnam sad rmi lam med/ /yid bzang tshigs bzang tshogs bzang dang / /mkhar nyal sum rtsen skabs gsum pa/ /tshig mda' ngag gi mtshon cha dang / /sbyin sreg za dang me yi zhal/ /me sbyin skyes dang raṃ yig bu/ /sī dī'i bu dang legs bris dang / /mkha' spyod mkha' gnas mkha' la 'gro/ /mchod sbyin zas dang mig mi mdzum/ /sbyin skyes dgra sogs lha spyi'i ming //gzhu rgyal sbyin skyes sbyin ma'i bu/ /sngon gyi lha dang dbang po'i dgra/ /pa sangs slob ma sa 'og gnas/ /bcud mi ldan dang lha la dmod/ /mchod sbyin dgra sogs lha min ming //lha mo phag gi shing rta can/ /'og gi phyogs skyong brtan ma'i ming / /rang byung byed po mes po dang //'jig rten dbang phyug skye dgu bdag /mi mjed bdag po dbyig gi snying / /chu skyes mngal dang gser

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 283mngal can/ /bdag skyes pad skyes lha las rgan/ /gdong bzhi rna ba brgyad pa dang / /sna tshogs bsgrub byed gnyis skyes dbang / /ngang pa'i shing rta rig byed gdong / /rig byed drag po tshangs pa'i ming //nā ra ya ṇaḥsred med bu/ /sbrang rtsi'i bu dang sbrang rtsi'i dgra/ /rdul mo'i bu dang tha gu'i lto/ /mkha' lding rgyal mtshan rwa gzhu can/ /glang rdzi gos ser pad dkar mig /lag pa bzhi pa 'khor lo'i lag /padma'i lte ba nor bu yi/ /nye dbang sde can gom gsum mnon/ /sbyin byed dgra dang sgra gcan gsod//mkhar ba'i dgra dang 'og dbang skyes/ /dpal be'u mtshan dang go brnyi/ /a shwa the thos dpal gyi lags//mi yi seng ge mi'u thung / /nag po mi 'jigs khyu mchog lto/ /dbyig gi lto ba nabs so skyes/ /zla ba'i snying po mthon po'i lha/ /'phrog byed thig le drug pa dang / /'jug pa bcu pa dga' byed dang / /'gro skyob rdeb byed stobs ldan 'joms/ /ser skya zhi ba khyab 'jug ming //mi 'dzag sngon skyes rab 'phyong gsod/ /nam gru dga' byed stobs bzang dang / /gtun shing can dang ha las mtshan/ /'dod skyong legs mgul stobs ldan rnams/ /khyab 'jug gi ni phu bo'i ming //myos byed yid srubs yid las skyes/ /me tog gzhu can me tog mda'/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan nya ya'i tog/dga' byed lus med dga' ma'i bdag /dregs byed tshangs 'joms dka' thub dgra/ /na tshod skyes dang mda' lnga pa/ /sbrang rtsi'i kha lo mi zad mtshon/ /rtse dga'i 'khri shing rgyal dka' dang / /sred byed chags bde yid la nyal/ /dga' rab dbang phyug stobs 'phel dgra/ /dran pa'i shing rta 'gro rtsen sogs/ /khyab 'jug bur gyur 'dod lha'i ming / /sna tshogs tog dang 'gro ba'i tog /nyag phran bdag po ma 'gag pa//tshangs pa skyes dang gos sngon can/ /'dod lha'i bu yi ming yin no/ /ka ma la can 'phrog byed yum/ /padma'i gnas can 'phrog byed dga'/ /dpal mo dpal gnas padma can/ /khyab 'jug gi ni chung ma'i ming //'khor lo legs mthong dung lnga skyes/ /dbyug pa sa mos nor bu ni/ /sa brtan byed dang sa rings dang //ral gri dga' byed la sogs pa/ /khyab 'jug gi ni phyag mtshan ming / /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug skar ma'i bu/ /khyab 'jug shing rta klu mthar byed/ /'dab bzang gser 'dab dug 'joms dang / /skya rengs nu bo rdo rje'i mchu/ galpa li gnas gser gyi lus/ /'dab chags seng ge rnam 'dul skyes/ /lto 'gro'i zas can 'dab chags rgyal/ /khyab 'jug shing rta mkha' lding ming //khyu mchog rgyal mtshan u ma'i bdag /gangs ri'i bdag po ral khur can/ /drag po 'phrog byed bde 'byung dang / /gtsug na zla ba sna tshogs mig /mig gsum pa dang thod pa 'chang / /dpal mgrin

284 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/mgrin nag mgrin sngon can/ /dgra sta'i dum bu me'i khu ba/ /grong gsum mthar byed gaṅgā 'dzin/ /ga las g.yos dang lha chen po/ /ri khrod pa dang phyogs gos can/ /skye med gzhu can long ba'i dgra/ /grong 'joms phyug bdag dpa' mo'i dpal/ /ha ming can dang khri rkang cig /mchog dga' mdung thogs dbang ldan dang //sim byed bde byed 'byung po'i dbang / /pags pa'i gos can 'chi las rgyal/ /mig mi bzang dang g.yon phyogs lha/ /nam mkha'i sgra can mchod sbyin 'joms/ /dran pa'i dgra dang rtse gsum can/ /sngon dmar can sogs dbang phyug ming //dkar mo ri sras ri skyes dang / /ka tya'i bu mo dka' bzlog ma/ /rdzong ma nag mo ma mo'i ma zhi ba'i sring mo skra 'dres ma/ /khyab 'jug sring mo gtum mo dang / /zhi ma drag mo ser skya ma/ /sim byed ma dang ri khrod ma/ /gangasaldan bu mo lo ma med/ /dpal mo seng ge'i shing rta ma/ /dbang phyug gi ni chung ma'i ming //mche ba gcig ma glang po'i gdong / /bgegs kyi rgyal po log 'dren dang / /lto 'phyang lus gnyis ma gnyis ma/ /ha la gnas dang dgra sta can/ /dbang phyug bu che tshogs bdag ming / /gzhon nu skem byed sa ga skyes/ /khrung khrung 'joms dang gdong drug pa/ /gaṅgā skyes dang 'dam bu skyes/ /gtsug phud can zhon lha'i dmag dpon/ /ri sras dga' 'byed ma drug pa/ /bya gag rgyal mtshan mang po skyes/ /sde can me skyes mdung thung can/ /dbang phyug bu chung smin drug ming //legs bris dbang po skabs gsum bdag /bde sogs bdag po mig stong can/ /dbang po 'phrog byed rdo rje 'chang / /mchod sbyin brgya pa stobs ldan dgra/ /gtsang byed mgon po mtho ris rgyal//gzhan snyems bzod dang sprin la zhon/ /ko shi ka shis brjod nyan/ /gang po 'bod dang smin pa gsod//rgan las thos dang rta ljang ca na/ /ri 'joms legs skyob dbyig ldan dang / /khyab stobs kun 'joms bzod dkas rengs/ /pu lo ma'i dgra bcud ldan bdag /ha ri'i rta can brgya byin ming //'chi med dbang po bde sogs dang / /sha rtsi dang ni legs brjod ma/ /nor sbyin ma dang lha'i btsun mo/ /brgya byin gyi ni chung ma'i ming / /sum cu rtsa gsum lta na sdug /brgya byin gyi ni grong gi ming //rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang / /rnam par rgyal byed ba dan can/ /brgya byin gyi ni pho brang ming / /lha yi 'dun sa chos bzang dang / /dga' tshal shing rta sna tshogs tshal/ /rtsub 'gyur tshal dang 'dren pa'i tshal//brgya byin gyi ni tshal gyi ming / /'tsho skyes dang ni sa srungs bu/ /sgra sgrog sgra 'byin sprin gyi glang / /sprin sgrol ma yi khyo la sogs/ /brgya byin zhon pa glang po'i ming / /ma ta li ni kha lo pa/ /'thor thos brgya byin rta yi

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 285ming / /'bigs byed lag nyal rtse brgya pa/ /sgra gcan za byed bsgyings 'gro dang / /gnam lcags bde byed ri bo 'joms/ /skabs gsum mtshon cha rdo rje'i thog /sgra sgrog sgrogs zhum ri 'gems rnams/ /brgya byin mtshon cha rdo rje'i ming //'chi med btung ba 'chi med bcud/ /btung byed tshim byed ro brgya pa/ /gdung sel lha yi bdud rtsi'i ming / /nam mkha'i gang gā mtho ris klung / /bcud ldan ring po lha'i rdzing ring / /dal 'bab lha yi chu bo'i ming / /'tsher byed lhun po gser :ri/ /rin chen rdul brtseg lha'i ri bo/ /ri rab ri rgyal ri yi dbang / /lha gnas ri bo mchog rab ming / /de ba da ru lha'i ljon pa/ /dpag bsam yid mos rgya mtsho skyes/ /yongs 'du sa brtol manta ra/ /ha ri tsan dan bsil byed dang / /ko bi da ra la sogs pa/ /lha yi ljon shing rnam gyi ming / /kun byed gzhon nu rnam 'byed bu/ /mtho ris sman pa tha skar skyes/ /rgod ma'i bu dang nad sel dang / /sna skyes lha yi sman pa'i ming / /til mchog ma dang pad dkar ma/ /lag gzang dga' ba'i shing rta ma/ /mu ñdza skyes ma legs brgyan ma/ /me na kā dang skras rtsen ma/ /glog 'od chu shing brla can ma/ /skad snyan ma dang skra 'dres ma/ /rab tu myos ma dbang mo che/ /lha yi smad 'tshong rnams kyi ming / /sngon gyi glu dbyangs len pa dang / /sgra ngan spangs pa'i glu dbyangs can/ /glu snyan dbyangs snyan mgrin snyan rnams/ /lha yi glu mkhan dri za'i ming //byin za rnyed za rten za dang / /mtshun za srog za sna tshogs za/ /za byed za phod rlung gi grogs//dag byed gtsang byed 'byog 'grodang / mang 'phel 'bar byed gtsug phud can/ /nyer zhi rta dmar 'od nor can/ /'od bkra sreg byed chu'i skye gnas/ /lha zhal mtshun zhal nor las rgyal/ /smin byed gser gyi thig le dang / /gyen 'gro 'od 'grib snga dro 'bar/ /gsar gyi khu ba 'od bdun pa/ /gsal byed lam nag chu mkhris dang / /skems byed 'phrog byed 'bar ba'i skra/ /mun sel mun 'joms du ba'i tog /'tsho byed lus 'phel rtse mo can/ /me dang me lha'i thun mong ming / /brang skyes rgod ma kha yi me/ /lto yi me dang rgya mtsho 'thung //me ri rta gdong me yi ming / /'phro byed 'byug byed yal me dang / /me'i yan lag me lce'i ming / /'phros 'gros me yi zeg ma dang / /rab 'phro me skar me stag ming / /shin tu gdung dang yongs su gdung / /tshad pa can dang tsha gdung can/ /rngul byed me yi reg bya'i ming / /sprin gyi bzhon pa skra yi phreng / /me 'bras nam mkha'i ta ma la/ /me yi gtsug phud me'i rgyal mtshan/ /gyu gyur 'gro dang me yi skra/ /me mang skyes sogs du ba'i ming //

286 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/chos kyi rgyal po mtshungs 'jug dang / /pha yi bdag po dbyug pa can/ /dbyug 'dzin be con 'chang ba dang / /'chi bdag lnga pa'i bdag dang ni/ /'phrog byed dus 'dzin yi dwags bdag /mthar byed grangs can nyi ma'i bu/ /ma he'i rgyal mtshan mtshan gyi lha/ /ya mu na spun ma mo'i rgyal/ /lho phyogs bdag po gshin rje'i ming / /gdong bcu mgrin bcu laṅka'i bdag /sgra sgrog ro zan sha rjen za/ ga za khrag 'thung mtshan mo rgyu/ /'jigs byed bden bral mtshan mo spyod/ /gsod bdag skyes dang za byed dang / /sna tshogs mdog can srin po'i ming //mchog sems mchog sbyin zhags pa can/ /chu bdag char 'bebs 'brug sgra can/ /nags tshal canadang chu ldan dang / /bsil ba 'jin sogs chu lha'i ming / /dbugs 'byin 'gro byed yang dag rgyug /nam mkha'i srog dang nam mkha'i dbugs/ /dri bzhon dri len dri'i shing rta/ /rtag 'gro myur 'gro mgyogs 'gro dang / /'phrog byed reg ldan 'gro ba'i srog /reg 'dzin reg byed kun tu rgyu/ /kun byed 'gro ba'i ngang tshul dang / /dag byed mkha' bdag rta dmar can/ /rta khral ngal med bsil byed dang / /g.yo byed gnas med ma mos 'phel/ /rlung dang rlung lha'i thun mong ming / /srog 'dzin thur sel mnyam gnas dang / /gyen rgyu khyab byed las kyi rlung / /rlung gi bye brag so so'i ming //gnod sbyin rgyal po gsang ba'i bdag /mi gsum grogs po lus ngan dang / /mi'am ci dbang nor sbyin rgyal/ /mi la zhon dang rkang gsum pa/ /dmar ser mig dang bsod nams skyes/ /e la'i rgyud dang ngal gsos po/ /ku be ra dang nor sbyin bu/ /nor gyi dbang phyug gnas srung po/ /gter gyi bdag po rnam sras ming / /shing rta sna tshogs de yi tshal/ /lcang lo can ni de yi grong / /gar mkhan mchog ni de yi bu//mi'am ci dang ci'i skyes bu/ /rta yi gdong can 'gro mgyogs 'khor/ /de yi gter ni dung can dang / /pad chen padma chen po dang / /chu srin can dang rus sbal can/ /rnga yab can dang dga' ba can/ /sngon po 'dzin byed la sogs dgu//lha lam rlung lam sprin gyi lam/ /bya lam mkha' lam khyab 'i〈cog gnas/ /mtha' med kun gsal sgra sgrogs dang / /kun khyab lus med rgyu skar lam/ /mur khyab rgyas byed bar snang lam/ /lhas rtsen rol gnas skye med gnas/ /kun khebs go 'byed chu mthongs dang / /lha yi rdzing ring nam mkha'i ming //kun khyab 'phrog byed nyi mas ston/ /gsal gnas phyogs sgo phyogs kyi ming / /dbye na phyogs bcu de yi ming / /tshangs pa dbang po lto 'phye me/ /gshin rje bden bral chu dang rlung / /lus ngan dbang ldan phyogs

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 287rim bzhin/ /mtsho skyes pad dkar g.yon phyogs dang / /sa mos gsal byed me tog so/ /sa steng grags dang cha mdzes rnams/ /phyogs kyi glang po brgyad kyi ming / /sprin grol ma dang ser skya ma/ /dmar ser ma dang dpe med ma/ /zangs sna can dang so legs ma/ /yan lag mdzes ma mchod ldan ma/ /phyogs kyi glang mo brgyad kyi ming //khor yug mu khyud lcags ri'i ming / /tshad 'joms dga' byed chu khur can/ /chu 'dzin rgyun 'dzin rlan 'dzin dang / /chu 'bebs chu 'gyed mkha'i rgyal mtshan/ /du ba'i skyes gnas nam mkha'i gling / /sgrol byed chu yi bzhon pa dang / /glog ldan nam mkha'i ta mā la/ /chu yi lcid ldan chu mang 'dzin/ /myos byed nam mkha'i du ba dang / /char ldan chu skyed nags tshal skye/ /nam mkha'i glang po sgra sgrogs dang / /chur nyal bsil byed mkha' gso can/ /ka dam pa can sprin gyi ming / /sgra sgrogs sgra can sgra brgya pa/ /sgra 'gyed sprin skyes lha'i rnga dbyangs/ /nam mkha'i rnga chen rnga gsang dang / /sprin gyi sgra dang sprin gyi rnga/ /dbyar skyes rnga sgra 'brug gi ming / /sprin lce 'khyug byed skad cig gsal/ /bde 'byung rnam gsal g.yo ba'i 'od/ /rnam bkra 'jug pa brgya pa dang / /lcug ma'i 'od dang se gol 'od/ /sprin gyi lcug ma glog gi ming / /sprin gyi bcud dang mkha' las babs/ /rgyun 'babs yongs lhung sprin las byung / /dgung char gru char zim bu'i char//sprang char char rgyun char zil dang / /sprin zegs chu zegs bde zil can/ /sprin gyi me tog char pa'i ming //dbang po'i shing bal dbang po'i gzhu/ /dbang po'i mtshon cha brgya byin mtshon/ /lha yi tshon ri sa rgan po'i thig /rlung 'bras rlung 'byog ro hi ta/ /sos ka bzhad dang chu las 'bar/ /bde sogs bdag po'i mda' stan dang / /'ja' 'od 'ja' ris 'ja' gur gzha'/ /sprin gyi 'od zer 'ja' tshon ming //'phrog 'joms ri 'joms lce 'beb pa/ /rdo rje'i zer 'phro 'bigs byed dang / /'gems byed chad nyams thog gi ming / /rdo rje'i char dang sdang byed dang / /'joms byed me char ser ba'i ming / /zhod 'gags char med than chen dang / /gdung byed drod 'bar than pa'i ming / /mi gsal mi snang 'thibs po dang / /mi mngon smag rum mun rum dang / /kun khebs sgrib byed mun pa'i ming //sim byed bsil byed 'od dkar can/ /ri bong 'dzin pa bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /bdud rtsi'i dbang po gnyis skyes dbang / /bde 'byung gtsug rgyan bsil zer can/ /tshes bdag mtshan mo'i nor bu dang //cha shas gter dang rgyu skar bdag /chu shel dbang po'i ri dwags mtshan/ /ga bur 'dzag dang ku mud gnyen//bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas padma'i dgra/ /'grib byed phyed can rtag can dang / /shar gyi thig le ri bong can//

288 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/cha byed mtsho skyes kha ba'i 'od/ /nam mkha'i rna ba snar ma'i bdag /rgya mtsho skyes dang chu las skyes/ /steng 'phur chags skyed rgya mtsho dga'/ /chu gter mun 'joms ga bur dbang / /bsil sbyin mkhan dang thos ldan dbang / /rgya mtsho'i mar gsar bdud rtsi spro/ /rgyu skar mu khyud cha shas can/ /bcu drug cha ldan mtshan mo'i mgon/ /'od lus kun phan zla ba'i ming //rol 'gro sa skyes lus dmar dang / /pa sangs bu dang sa las byung / /'od zer dgu pa sa yi bu//bkra shis rtsibs ldan mig dmar ming / /zla ba'i bu dang snar ma skyes/ /sngo bsangs lus dang gser ldan dang / /tshim byed skyes rnams lhag pa'i ming / /tshig gi bdag po lha'i slob dpon/ /lha yi sgra mkhan smra ba'i bdag /dbyangs bdag 'tsho byed gtsug phud bkra/ /dum skyes pha bdun phur bu'i ming / /dal 'gro dal rgyu nyi ma'i bu/ /'od zer bdun pa gos sngon can/ /gshin rje'i ba dan spen pa'i ming / /sbyin byed bla ma snyan ngag bu/ /ngan spong bu dang 'od can dang / /khu ba mdog mdzes bhe gu'i bu/ /lha min bla ma dkar po dang / /bcu drug 'od ldan pa sangs ming / /mtho ris gsal dang seng ge can/ /skabs gsum 'dzin byed nyi zla za/ /drag po'i gzugs can mig sman mdog /srid gsum rnam rgyal bdud rtsi za/ /mgo zlum seng ge mo yi bu/ /sha za lam nag zla ba 'joms/ mun can gza' yi rna ba 'dzin/ /sprin las rnam rgyal sgra gcan ming //nam mkha'i nor bu rta ljang can/ /khyim gyi bdag po bcu gnyis bdag /gza' yi bdag po me sbyin skyes/ /snang byed nyin byed 'od stong can/ /'od bkra 'od gsal rta bdun pa/ /dbyig gi khu ba pad ma'i grogs/ /bla med 'od 'byin mun pa'i dgra/ /'od kyi nor can tshangs pa'i rta/ /nam mkha'i tog dang mkha' lam pa/ /chu yi chom rkun gdung byed dang / /srid pa'i mig dang padma'i gnyen/ /khyab gsal 'od ldan 'od nor can/ /rta dmar can dang snang ba'i bdag /padma'i rtsa lag tsha zer can/ /sgrol byed mchod 'os char 'bebs pa/ /bdun gyi bdun pa bdud las rgyal/ /'gro ba'i sgron ma 'phrog byed dang / /dus kyi byed po nyi ma'i ming //gsod byed dmar ser dpyad ldan dang / /gtum po 'od skor nyi ma'i 'bor/ /nyi ma'i kha lo khyung sngon skyes/ /'od dmar brla med 'od srungs dang / /nyi ma'i pho nya skya rengs ming / /'od kyi dkyil 'bor 'od khyim dang / /'od kyi gur khang yongs su bskor/ /'od kyi lding khang 'ja' yi gur/ /nye ba'i nyi ma nyi ma'i thog /nyi ma'i rna cha nyi khyim ming / /tsha zer gdug byed mtshan mo 'joms/ /skems byed chu 'thung gdung

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 289ldan 'od/ /kun gsal kun snang 'od chags dang / /nyi zer gnyi zer nyi 'od ming / /snang ba gsal ba 'od kyi tog /mun sel rab 'phro phyogs su 'gro/ /snang byed gsal byed snang gsal dang / /'od byed 'od mdangs srin bu 'joms/ /mdangs 'od zer mdangs zer phreng dang / /'od zer 'od phreng 'od spyi'i ming //'gro byed 'od can sgrol byed dang / /'phur byed rnams ni rgyu skar ming / /gya gyu'i ri mo ri dwags sred/ /khrag khrig snang ba g.yo ba'i 'od/ /'chir 'jug rgyang ring chu bo dang / /bar snang chu rlabs smig rgyu'i ming / /bgrang bya nyer 'gro yang dag 'gro/ /tshod dang gnas dang tshig dang ni/ /bstan bya 'dor byed dus kyis ming / /'phel ba 'grib pa cha shas dang / /gral tshes tshe grangs tshes kyi grangs/ /mun bsal mun bral nyi bcas gdugs/ /skabs yod rtsen dus snang ba ldan/ /nyi ldog bya mang nyin mo'i ming / /nub mo bya bral phra 'jug dang / /mun can rdul ldan thun gsum pa/ /snang med zhir 'jug thun tshod can/ /sngo bsangs ma dang mel tshe ma/ /dal byin ma dang gnyid ldan ma/ /gnas dus 'khrig dus yi dwags rgyu/ /dgung dang nges nyal bsam gtan ma/ /zla 'od can ma mtshan mo'i ming / /bde dus mi sgrib rab rib sel/ /nyin mo'i thog ma nyin mo'i sgo/ /nam langs nyi shar snga dro'i ming / /nyi rgas dgong mo nyin mo'i mtha'/ /dgong thun nyin mjug phyi dro'i ming / /nyin dkyil nyin gong nyin mo'i dbus/ /nyin phyed dgung tshig nyin gung ming //mtshan mo'i dang po mtshan mo'i sgo/ /nam stod yi dwags glag lta'i dus/ /sa rub nam rmus srod kyi ming //byang chub dus dang mtshan mo'i mtha'/ /mtshan mo'i mjug dang nam smad dang / /skye rengs ldan pa tho rengs ming / /nam phyed mtshan phyed nam gyi dbus/ /mtshan mo'i dkyil rnams nam gung ming / /mel tshe zhes pa thun mtshams ming / /snga dro phyi dro nyi ma gung / /nyin mo'i thun tshod dag gi ming / /srod dang nam gung tho rengs rnams/ /mtshan mo'i thun tshod dag gi ming //'dod pa'i dus dang tsha ba'i dus/ /myu gu'i dus dang sbrang ldan dus/ /me tog dus dang bde byed dus/ /drod ldan nges sreg tsha gdung can/ /tshad zla so ga dpyid kyi ming / /char dus char ldan chu ldan dang //sprin 'byung sprin skyes dbyar gyi ming / /'bras ldan 'bras bu smin pa'i dus/ /gser ldan ma ni ston gyi ming //kha ba'i dus dang grang ba'i dus/ /bsil ldan ma ni dgun gyi ming / /lo yi cha shas lo'i yan lag /nyin zhags tshogs pa lo yi mdzod/ /phyogs can 'jal byed dus zla'i ming / /dkar phyogs 'phel phyogs phyogs snga ma// /cha shas rim rdzogs cha shas dar/ /gang phyogs zla stod yar ngo'i ming / /nag phyogs 'grib phyogs phyogs phyi ma/ /cha shas 'dzad dang cha nyams dang / /dmar phyogs zla smad mar ngo'i ming / /dga'

290 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ba bzang po rgyal ba rnams/ /stong pa rdzogs pa 'di dag rnams/ /ngo gnyis dag la lan gsum re//phyogs kyi dang po tshes dang po/ /phyogs kyi thog ma tshes kyi thog /phyogs kyi rtsa ba tshes kyi rtsa/ /'di rnams tshes gcig dag gi ming / /zla ba gang ba zla ba nya/ /dkyil 'khor gang ba cha rdzogs dus/ /nya gang ri bong can gyi zhag /mngon byang chub dus bco lnga'i ming / /zla ba zad pa cha mnyam dang / /nyi zla kha sbyor lhan cig gnas/ /rjes 'du nam gang gnam stong ming / /zla tshes zla ba gzhon nu'i dus/ /zla ba mthong ba'i dus kyi ming //nyi bsgyur sgra gcan gyis zos dang / /spyang gis zos dang me tog ldan/ /nyi zla gcig sbyor sgra gcan zhugs/ /nyi zla gza' yis bzung ba'i ming / /mig 'dzum gcig gam se gol gcig /drug cu rtsa bzhi phye ba'i cha/ /dus mtha'i skad cig mig 'dzum kyang / /bco brgyad mthar gnas de sum bcu/ /cha shas sum cu de skad cig /de ni bcu gnyis yud tsam ste/ /de sum cu la nyin gcig /nyin zhag bco lnga la phyogs te/ /phyogs gnyis bsdoms pas zla ba gcig /mgo zla la sogs gnyis gnyis la/ /dus tshigs de gsum bgrod pa gcig /lho byang bgrod pa gnyis la lo/ /zhor la nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i ming / /thad gar bgrod pa 'phel 'grib med/ /nyin mtshan mtshungs dang dus mnyam mo/ /mgo dang zla nya 'dzom pa'i zla//ming ni mgo can rgyal la sogs/ /lhag ma bcu gnyis kyang de bzhin//zla ba de dag so so'i ming / /ju'i yol phag gi zla ba dang / /dgun zla ra ba smal po'i zla/ /rga shi'i zla ba kā ma na/ /'dod pa'i zla ba mig 'byed pa/ /lo mgo sa yi dbang phyu zla/ /mṛ ga shi ra ri dwags mgo /mgo can gyi ni zla ba'i ming / /zhu'i yol byi ba'i zla ba dang / /nyi zlog zla ba dgun zla 'bring / /ma rig zla ba ro hi ta/ /rgyu skar bzang po'i zla ba dang / /'phel ba'i zla ba su n+ya rnams/ /rgyal gyi zla ba yi ni ming / /ne'u yol dang ni glang gi zla/ /'du byed zla ba dgun tha chung / /mo hi ta dang gti mug zla/ /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba dang / /dka' thub zla ba mā ga rnams/ /mchu can gyi ni zla ba'i ming / /la'u yol dang ni stag gi zla/ /dpyid zla ra ba khra'i zla ba/ /rnam shes zla ba gdung byed zla/ /bha tra'i zla ba bzang po'i zla/ /'bras zla phal gu niḥka rnams/ /sbo 'am dbo yi zla ba'i ming / /thur yol dag ni yos zla dang / /dpyid zla 'bring po byi'u zla/ /khyu mchog zla ba bri ṣa bha/ /ming gzugs zla ba 'dod dus zla/ /tsi tra nag pa zla ba'i ming //lung yol 'brug gi zla ba dang / /dpyid zla tha chung rnam mthong zla/ /skye mched drug gi zla ba dang / /kurma dang ni rus sbal zla/ /me tog ldan dang sbrang ldan dang / /mgu byed dang ni bee sha kha/ /sa ga can ni zla ba'i

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 291ming / /zhe'u yol dang ni sbrul zla dang / /dbyar zla ra ba gdu bu'i zla/ /reg pa yi ni zla ba dang / /ma ra ka dang chu srin zla/ /'dod 'phel dga' byed zla ba dang / /thu bo'i zla ba khu ba'i zla/ /tsaṣṭha snron gyi zla ba'i ming / /ma yol rta yi zla ba dang / /dbyar zla 'bring po bre phul zla/ /tshor ba yi ni zla ba dang / /daṇḍalugs sa ma'i zla ba/ /nyi 'od ldan zla mi bzod zla/ /a ṣa dha rnams chu stod zla/ /yang yol lug gi zla ba dang //dbyar zla tha chung bya sto'i zla/ /sred pa yi ni zla ba dang / /mi ki ra dang sme ba'i zla/ /nam mkha'i sgra sgrogs zla ba dang / /chu 'dzag zla ba shra ma ṇaḥ/ /gro bzhin can gyi zla ba'i ming / /hu ru yol dang sprel zla dang // ston zla ra ba len pa'i zla/ /'gugs pa'i zla ba bhi tri ka /sprin bzang khyu mchog rkang pa dang / /ba lang zla ba ba lang rkang / /bha tra pa dwaḥkhrums zla'i ming / /kyi yol bya yi zla ba dang / /dbyug gu'i zla ba ston zla 'bring / /srid pa yi ni zla ba dang / /bya ku la dang 'phyo ba'i zla/ /ston mo'i zla ba a shrī ni/ /tha skar can gyi zla ba'i ming / /ga'u yol dang ni khyi'i zla ba/ /nya drug zla ba ston tha chung / /swasna dang ni rmi lam zla/ /mang ster zla ba spro dga' can/ /skye ba'i zla ba garti ka /smin drug can gyi zla ba'i ming //mgo rgyal gnyis ni dgun stod dus/ /mchu dbo gnyis ni dgun smad dus/ /nag pa sa ga dpyid kyi dus/ /ston dang chu stod so ga'i dus/ /gro bzhin khrums stod dbyar gyi dus/ /tha skar smin drug ston gyi dus/ /rang skyob 'dor byed bgrang bzhi dang / /dus kyi tshigs dang zla ba'i phreng / /bgrang bya dus kyi cha shas can/ /mi zad pa rnams lo yi ming //zhan la lo ni so so'i ming / /byi blang stag yos 'brug sprul rta/ /lug sprel bya khyi phag bcu gnyis//shing me sa lcags chu khams lnga/ /pho mos bsgyur ba drug cu ste/ /rab byung me mo yos rnam byung sa pho 'brug dkar po sa mo sprul dang / /rab myos lcags pho rta skyes bdag lcags mo lug aṅga ra chu pho sprel/ /dpal gdong chu mo bya dngos po shing pho khyi na tshod ldan shing mo phag/ /'dzin byed me pho byi dbang phyug me mo glang 'bru mang po sa pho stag/ /myos ldan sa mo yos rnam gnon lcags pho 'brug khyu mchog lcags mo sprul dang / /sna tshogs chu pho rta nyi ma chu mo lug nyi sgrol byed shing pho sprel/ /sa skyong shing mo bya mi zad me pho byi thams cad 'dul me mo phag/ /kun 'dzin sa pho byi 'gal ba sa mo glang / /rnam 'gyur lcags pho stag dang / /bong bu lcags mo yos dga' ba chu pho 'brug rnam rgyal chu mo sbrul nyid/ /rgyal ba shing pho rta myos byed shing mo lug gdong ngan me pho sprel dang / /gser 'phyang me mo bya rnam 'phyang sa pho khyi bsgyur byed sa mo phag dang / /kun ldan lcags pho byi 'phar ba lcags mo glang dge byed chu pho stag dang / /mdzes byed chu mo yos khro mo shing pho 'brug sna tshogs dbyig shing mo sprul/ /zil gnon me pho rta spre'u me mo lug phur bu sa pho sprel dang / zhi ba sa

292 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/mo bya thun mong lcags pho khyi 'gal byed lcags mo phag dang / /yongs 'dzin chu pho byi bag med chu mo glang kun dga' shing pho stag dang / /srin po shing mo yos me dang me pho tsog dmar ser can me mo sprul/ /dus kyi pho nya sa pho rta don 'grub sa mo lug drag ltags pho sprel/ /blo ngan lcags mo bya rnga chen chu pho khyi khrag skyug chu mo phag dang / /mig dmar shing pho byi khro bo shing mo glang zad pa'o me pho stag/ /yongs 'joms bskal pa'i ming rab thim rab nub dang / /zad pa dang ni mthar phyin byed/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtha' dang / /zad dus dang ni lo'i phung po/ /dus bzhi rdzogs pa bskal pa'i ming //rab bsngags 'dzin pa yang dag sbyor/ /bde skyed bde ster legs byas dang / /legs ldan dge legs mtho ris gnas/ /rab zhi zhi ba bde legs dang / /bde ba'i 'byung gnas dge ba'i ming //nyes pa nyes spyod nag nog dang / /nyes byed lhung ba rnyog pa dang / /smad bya mun pa zug rngu dang / /smas byed dngos sdig sdig lta dang / /nyams byed rigs 'phel ngan 'gro'i lam/ /lhung byed spang bya sdig pa'i ming //bsngags 'os phan 'thob mchog sbyin dang / /legs byas khyu mchog yid bzhin 'grub/ /re skong dge ba'i cho ga dang / /lhas bskos gnam bskos skal pa'i phul/ /lhas bstan bsags rgyab sngon bsags mthu//bgo skal kha rje bsod nams ming //grol ba rnam grol zhi ba dang / /nges legs dbugs 'byin mya ngan 'das/ /ma 'dres tshangs pa nges 'byung dang / /bdud rtsi rab tshim bsil ba'i dngos/ /rdul med rdul bral rdul spang ba/ /rnam byang byang chub mi gnas pa/ /dga' ba che dang yang srid med/ /byang grol bde ldan thar pa'i ming / /blo dang rnam dpyod rig pa dang / /blo gros yid gzhung rnam rig byed/ /don sems don rtogs don rab mthong rab tu rnam 'byed khong du chud/ /go ba dpyod pa shes rab ming / /yid dang dran pa sems pa dang / /blo dang rig pa snying dang ni/ /shes pa nang gi byed pa dang / /rnam shes kun gzhi sems kyi ming / /yang dag rtog dang kun tu rtog /yid byed sems byed rjes su dpag /sems kyi longs spyod mno bsam dang / /brtag dpyad 'jal byed don bgrang ba/ /yid la byed pa rtog dpyod ming //skye dgu skye 'gro 'gro ba dang / /skyes bu gang zag sems pa can/ /tshe ldan sems ldan yid ldan dang / /skye ldan srog ldan 'tsho ba can/ /lus can srog chags sems can ming / /smra ba brjod pa gleng mo gtam/ /gleng brjod smra brjod mngon brjod dang / /rjod byed mgrin skyes ngag tshig ming / /nges sgrogs grags pa lhag tser dang / /ding 'ur 'ur ting 'ar 'ur sgra/ /ca co ku co klag cor dang / /dbyangs dang sgrog

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 293 sga sgra tsam ming / /rab gus nyer sems rtag tu sems/ /rab dad rab mos dad dang mos/ /gcig tu sems dang snying nas sems/ /mgu byed mnyes byed gus pa'i ming / /brnyas dang kun brnyas brnyas byed dang / /'tshe sems 'gran sems phrag dog sems/ /gnod sems zil gnon zhum byed dang / /zhe 'gras zhe 'khon ma gus ming / /bsngags dang rab sngags bstod bsngags dang / /yon tan sgrog dang yon tan brjod/ /legs sgrogs legs brjod bstod pa'i ming / /nyes brjod spyo dang nye bar spyo/ /smad dang nges smod yongasasmod dang / /gshe dang phyar kha g.yas gdags pa/ /sun 'byin skyon brjod bskur 'debs dang //mi bsngags brjod pa smad pa'i ming / /yid gnyis som nyi snyam sems dang / /rnam nur dogs pa 'phyang mo nyug /'dra ba cig min the cesam ming / /gtan la phebs dang dpyis phyin pa/ /the tshom bral dang som nyi spang / /nges shes mngon gyur yid ches ming / /bzhin dud dmig dma' zhum byed dang / /'dzem dang khrel yod ngo tsha'i ming / /zhe 'khon khong khro khong nas 'brugs/ /gdung sems mnar sems mi zad sems//bzhin bsdus mig g.yon smin 'khyog dang / /mi bzod sdang sems khro ba'i ming / /zhi ba dul ba nyer zhi ba//mi 'khrugs khro bral brtan pa dang / /ngang tshul bzang ba bzod pa'i ming //ku re kyal ka ga zha dang / /'dod gtam dgod bag bzhad gad ming / /mchod dang dus ston dga' ston dang / /dgod dang nyer dga' dngos po dang / /rang bzhin rang gzugs ngo bo nyid/ /'dres pa la sogs dga' ston ming / /'og phyogs rkang 'og stobs ldan gnas/ /bcu 'og 'og gnas klu'i 'jig rten/ /lto 'phye che gnas sa 'og ming / /khung dang glo bug skar khung dang / /khung bu bu ga pad mig dang //gsal mthongs rlung 'byung sa yi mthongs/ /dong bu bug sgo bu ga'i ming / /mun sdug sdongs pa snang med dang //rab rib smag dang mun nag dang / /mun 'thib mun 'khrigs she mun dang / /mun can mun rum nyin mthar byed/ /nam mkha'i pags pa mtshan mo'i pags/ /nyin mo'i sgo nga mun pa'i ming //ri gnas ka dru'i bu rnams te/ /de yi gtso bo mtha' yas dang / /lhag ma 'jig pa nor rgyas bu//sprul gyi rgyal po yul 'khor skyong / /gdengs ka bdun pa nor las rgyal/ /gdengs can bdag po lag 'gro'i mgon/ /phyugs bdag gdengs can 'dren pa dang / /klu yi dbang phyug klu rgyal lo/ /ba lang sna dang thig le'i lus/ /dong gnas nyal byed rlung zas can/ sa/na pa brje dang go cha grol/ /sa la 'byog dang sa la 'phye/ /lag 'gro myur 'gro gya gyur 'gro/ /'byogs 'gro brang 'gro lto 'gro dang / /dug 'dzin lto 'phye 'khor lo can/ /'khyil ba rkang sbas mig gis thos/ /mche ba'i dug can gzer bu mgo /rgyab ring zas

294 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ngan khung du nyal/ /gdengs can lce gnyis rkang mi 'gro/ /bum sna can rnams sbrul gyi ming //kā ko la shun pa'i dug kyang zer dang nag po brtsegs ka la ku ṭa/ /ha la ha la rtsa ba'i dug kyang zer brtan pa'i dug /soni ke ya 'bras bu'i dug kyang zer tshangs pa'i bu/ /rab tu gsal dang 'joms lo ma'i dug kyang zer byed ster/ /be'u'i lto ba sdong po'i dug kyang zer lta bu ste/ /dug gi dbye ba dgu yi ming / /dug sel dang ni dug 'joms dang / /sprul khas 'tsho dang dug nad gso/ /sprul 'joms dug gi sman pa'i ming / /ngan song ngan 'gro ngan 'gro'i mthil/ /'dod bral bral dang dga' med dang / /tshe ring po dang bzod dka' ba/ /na ra ya ṇaḥdamyal ba'i ming / /rgya bcas chu 'dzin zla bas 'phel/ /pha rol 'grib dang chu klung bdag /chu srel chu gter dug can gnas/ /rin chen 'byung gnas chu bdag dang / /chu srin 'byung gnas chu srin bdag /chu yi phung po ti ma'i mdzod/ /zla ba'i ma ma ro ldan ma/ /gaṅgā 'dzin dang sintu'i bdag /chu dbang mtsho dang mtsho chen dang / /rus sbal che ldan rlabs phreng can/ /ri yid thod can tri mi'i grong / /chu srin rgyal mtshan rgya mtsho'i ming / /gzhi can thur 'bab thur du lhung / /'dod byed 'bru phan nor ldan dang / /btung bya 'chi byed mi 'chi dang / /'tsho byed 'byung byed brten gnas dang / /lus 'ching 'dzag ldan gso byed dang / /rgyas par byed dang sgo kun 'gro/ /sprin gyi me tog sprin gyi bcud/ /sprin gyi myu gu gzhol 'gro dang / /skyong byed 'ju byed gnyan byed dang / /skom sel btang 'gro chu yi ming / /chu klung chu bo 'bab ldanam/ /dal 'bab gling ldan klung ldan ma/ /nyan 'gro rgyun ldan nya lcibs can/ /dba' rlabs can ma skyod ldan ma/ /sgrogs ldan dang ni gzhol 'bab dang / skya nar ldan ma zla ba'i lag /chu rgyun dang ni gya gyur 'gro/ /gtsang po ngogs ldan g.yo ldan dang / /gser ldan ma rnams 'bab chu'i ming //khyab 'jug rkang pa lha'i chu bo/ /skal ldan shing rta lam gsum 'gro/ /dza hu'i bu mo gsum 'bab dang / /'jigs sde skyed ma rgyun gsum pa / /nam mkha'i chu bo gaṅgā'i ming / /nyi ma'i bu mo kā lini/ /zhi ba'i sring mo ya mu nā/ /e ra ba ti lo hi ta/ /pakṣu yi ni ming yin no/ /re bā dang ni narma dā/ /zlas byung ri bo'i bu mo dang / /lag pa'i chu bo rtag tu 'bab/ /sindha yi ni ming yin no/ /dpung pas byin dang dkar 'bab ma/ /shi ta duḥdang brgyar gyes dang / /zhags pa grol dang bi pa ṭaḥ/ /si tā yi ni ming yin no//dba' rlabs dba' klong rlabs 'phreng dang / /rba rlabs rba klong chu'i 'khri shing / /dba' chen urmi rba dang klong / /steng 'phar steng 'phyo rab 'khrug dang / /chu rlabs chu 'khrug mchil sgrol dang / /chu gnyer khrem gnyer chu rlabs ming / /dbu ba dbu phreng lha phreng dang / /chu yi gad mo chu yi 'dzum/ /phe na zhes

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 295pa lha ba'i ming / /chu thigs thigs pa thigs phran dang / /chu 'thor chu zil chu yi zer/ /nyar ma chu yi zegs ma'i ming / /'gram dang 'gog byed chu ngogs dang / /pha rol tshu rol phan tshun ngogs/ /'gram ngogs 'jug ngogs chu 'gram ming / /'byin byed rdzab dang 'dam dang ni/ /'dam pa 'jim pa 'ji ba dang / /chu rnyog 'jim rdzab 'dam rdzab ming / /gru chen gzings dang gru gzings dang / /rdzings dang sgrol byed sgrol pa dang / /bskul 'gro 'phyos 'gro seng ge can/ /rta mgo can dang gru shan dang / /chu yi shing rta gru yi ming /gru mkhan gru bdag dbyug pa 'phen/ /gdos pa 'dzin dang skya ba 'dzin/ /rna ba 'dzin dang gru'i skyes bu//kha lo pa rnams mnyan pa'i ming / /gru skya g.yob byed gru'i rnga yab/ /gru'i gshog pa gru'i yan lag /gdos pa rnams ni skya ba'i ming //sgong skyes rnam 'phyog go cha can/ /'gro ldan rnam rgyu rnam par skyong / /bye ma la gnas bum par rgyu/ /gser mig can dang rgyab mtho dang / /mig mi 'dzum dang chus mi 'tshub/ /chu nyal chur tse nya spyi'i ming / /na kra nya mid ma ka ra/ /chu yi srin po kumbhi raḥ/ /bum pa'i mgo dang chus phag pa/ /'dzin khri chu yi zas can dang / /chu yi srin ring chu srin ming / /bul 'gro dal 'gro shubs ngan dang / /khog pa can dang 'gram rkyong dang / /dam por 'dzin dang spa kong dang / /kurmā rnams ni rus sbal ming / /garka ṭa dang ku snyi ra/ /kha gyen phyogs dang 'phrog byed mig /'phar 'gro char skyes rma yi gnas/ /lce med bshang sbas sbal pa'i ming / /mu tig skye gnas mu tig phor/ /mu tig 'byung gnas mu tig ma/ /nya skyogs rnams ni nya lcibs ming / /za ma rtog can rus pa'i zer/ /cho lo'i sa bon mgron bu'i ming / /sham kha chu yi ka ri ka/ /sham kha dung dang chu srin gshed/ /khab kyi kha zhes dung dkar ming / /rgya mtsho 'khyil ba bkra shis dung / /de'i mchog dakṣi ṇa wa rnye/ /brgya byin sham kha dung dkar mchog /skye ba lnga pa g.yas 'khyil ming //'dam skyes chu skyes mtsho skyes dang / /'dab stong 'dab brgya chu yi rgyan/ /chu yi lang tsho chu nyal dang / /sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan ge sar can/ /dri bzang khang pa 'dab ldan dang / /ge sar bzhad dang ze'u 'bru can/ /nyi mas bzhad dang dpal gos dang / /sbrang rtsi'i 'dzin pa padma'i ming / /padma'i ze ba padma'i skra//rke sa ra dang ze'u 'gru/ /padma'i gtsug phud ge sar ming / /sdong bu ngar ba chu ba dang / ā lu kā dang rkang pa dang / /rtsa ba snal ma yu ba'i ming / /chu skyes sngon po steng 'thung dang / /ind+ra ba ra stobs ngan dang / /rtsib 'bigs dang ni mig gi gnyen/ /sa yi gdu bu chu ram dang / /sa stobs sa 'ching utpal ming / /utpal dkar po sa smos dang / /zla ba'i dri dang zla bas dga'/ /ku yud da dang kun da dang / /mtshan mo bzhad

296 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/rnams ku mud ming //brtan pa 'dzin ma nor 'dzin ma/ /nor ldan nor gyi blo gros ma/ /sa gzhi nor 'dzin mi g.yo ba/ /dbyig gi blo gros ma gling 'dzin/ /dbyig ldan ma dang dbyig 'dzin ma/ /mi g.yo rgya mtsho'i ska rags can/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can zhag ldan ma/ /kun bzod ma dang sna tshogs 'dzin/ /bcud ldan mtha' yas yangs ldan dang / /skyed byed srun byed rten byed na/ /gser ldan ma dang 'od srungs byin/ /chu skyob ri yi rna ba can/ /gser gyi snying po sa gzhi'i ming / khul lam bgrod bya grod byed dang / /'jug bya 'jug ngogs 'gro sa dang/ /bgom bya bcad bya lam chen dang / /bgrod lam lam srol lam spyi'i ming / /lam mchog lam zab yangadag lam/ /lamagasang bde lam lam gyi snying / /myur lam thar lam thabs lam dang / /'khrul med lam dang 'chug med lam/ /rnam 1stol lam 〈snal lam bzang ming / /lam 'o1gas lam 'chug lam gol dang / /'khrul lam dman lam g.yang sa'i lam/ /ngan 'gro'i lam rnams lam ngan ming //rten gnas skyong byed rgyal lam dang / /'bab gnas dang ni tshong brdal dang / /'jigs med gnas dang mi bskyod gnas/ /grong khyer grong brdal yul ljongs dang / /grong khyim mi khyim grong spyi'i ming //dga' mgur spyod gnas rtse dga'i gnas/ /skye bo kun 'jug 'khrig gnas dang / /g.yem gnas smad 'tshong gnas kyi ming / /tshong pa tshong 'du tshong tshong lam dang / /zong lam srang dang tshong khang dang / /rgya 'grem pa rnams tshong gnas ming / /ra ba bskor dang mtha'i mu khyud/ /'obs dang tshal dang phyi ra dang //khor sa khor yug lcags ri'i ming / /khyim dang khang khyim sdum bu dang / /gnas dang 'dzugs bya gnas gzhi dang / /gnas khang phibs 'og 'dun gnas dang / /rten gnas rten gzhi bla gab can/ /khyim dang khab dang khang khyim dang / /'dug gnas khang pa spyi yi ming / /gzhal med khang dang pho brang dang / /khang mchog khang chen khang brtsegs dang / /ba gam can dang ba gam brtsegs/ /rgya phibs can dang bya 'dab can//rgyal mtshan can dang tog can dang / /rta babs can rnams khang bzang ming / /garnyo la dang dri gtsang khang //dri 'dzin byang chub snying po'i gnas/ /gtsug lag khang dang lha'i khang pa/ /kun dga' ra ba 'du khang rnams//dkon mchog gsum gyi bzhugs gnas ming //chu skyob char skyob steng gab dang / /bla gab phibs rnams thog gi ming / /brten pa 'gyur med steng 'dzin dang / /gdung 'degs 'degs byed ka ba'i ming / /'dzul byed srung byed sgo mo dang / /'jug byed glang rgyab glang pa'i sen/ /sgo 'phar sgo glegs sgo snam dang / /rta babs 'dzin rnams sgo yi ming //

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 297snang gsal dkar gsal skar khung dang / /glo dkar glo bug snang ba'i khung / /dra mig rnams ni sge'u khung ming / /dkar mthongs bla mthongs bla bug dang / /rgya mthongs steng sgo mthongs khung ming / /them skas 'dzeg skas gdang bu can/ /ya gad gru skas skas ga'i ming / /pu shu mda' yab lan gan dang / /kra ma shīrṣa myos srung dang / /phug ron skyong rnams kha bad ming//sa 'dzin rdul brtsegs rtse mo can/ /gyen brtsegs gyen 'phyur sa gzhi 'chang / /tshigs can sa skyob rdo ba brtsegs/ /mi g.yo 'gro med chu skyob dang / /sprin gyi so can sa'i phur bu/ /brten pa can dang mgrin pa can/ /sprin 'dzin 'dzin byed ri spyi'i ming / /gling bzhi'i lte ba gling bzhi'i spo/ /lhun po nyi zla'i ska rags can/ /ri yi dbang po ri yi rgyal/ /bang rim can rnams ri rab ming / /kai la sha dang kha ba'i ri//kha ba'i rdul brtsegs gangs ldan dang / /hi ma la ya bsil ba'i ri/ /ga bur rdul brtsegs gangs ri'i :sgoskyung //rdo ba sbed byed gor ma dang / /tsog po ju bo gtun bu dang / /sra mkhregs rnams ni rdo yi ming /ri rtse ri zom rwa rtse dang / /lhung gnas g.yang sa ri gzar dang / /ri bo ri ngogs ri'i bya skyibs/ /ro zhol ri shod ri yi steng / /ri khrod
