ri sul ri yi khug /bang rim ri ljongs ri yi 'dabs/ /ri sdings sman ljongs ri yi spo/ /ri yi khyad par rnams kyi ming / /'brog dang dgon pa dben pa dang / /nags ri dben gnas nags tshal dang / /nags klung nags mthong drang srong gnas/ /dka' thub gnas dang bsti gnas dang //dgon pa chen po nags stug po/ /nags tshal spyi yi ming yin no/ /khyim gyi tshal dang skyed mos tshal nye 'khor tshal dang byas pa'i nags/ /nye ba'i tshal dang nye spyod tshal/ /bza' shing ra ba sdum ra dang / /me tog ra ba yid mos tshal/ /rtse gnas rol gnas rol rtsed gnas/ /sgyu rtsal tshal dang dga' ba'i tshal//skyo bsang gnas dang yid bde'i gnas/ /grong khyer mtha' yi skyed tshal ming /ljon pa sa skyes yal ga can/ /'dab ldan rkang 'thung chur mi lhung / /'gro 'gog 'gro med 'dab ma can/ /sdong po duḥm steng skye dang / /rtse mo can dang mgo ling can/ /ljon shing rnam rgyal shing spyi'i ming / /'bru ldan 'bras ldan shing tog can/ /snye ma can dang bza' shing rnams/ /'bras bu can gyi shing gi ming / /'dab ma yal 'dab lo ma dang / /phyogs su rnam rgyal sgrib byed dang / /gdung skyob tshad skyob shing gi gos/ /lhung byed yal tshogs mgo ling dang / /mar gad lo ma lo 'dab ming / /rab rgyas kha bye yang dag rgyas/ /sbugs grol rnams dbye 'phro ba can/ /phulla swaXku sa ma/ /rgya grol yid dga' ze'u 'bru can//

298 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ge sar can dang shing gi tshon/ /rab shar 'dzum ldan bzhad ldan dang / /shing gi lang tsho me tog ming //gang bu snye ma mañdza ri/ /dog pa the'u 'bras ldan dang / /shing 'bras shing tog 'bras bu'i ming / /stodhi dru maḥ'adab ma bskyod/ /pispa la dang glang po'i zas/ /a shwatho dang klakṣa dang / /mchod rten shing dang 'dab ma snum/ /mchod sbyin lo ma khyad par gnas/ /bo dhi brikṣa byang chub shing / /sa ha ka raḥ.a mra zhim/ /tsu ta ro ldan sbrang shing dang / /shin tu ro zhim a mra'i ming / /dri zhim dkar po dri zhim btags/ /go shirṣa dang ba lang mgo/ /ha ri tsan dan me'i srub shing / /sa mchog tsan dan dkar po'i ming / /til mar can dang 'dab ma'i lus/ /tshos byed snum ldan sa'i tsandan/ /tsan dan dmar po'i ming yin no//gdong lnga pa dang kha lnga pa/ /ri dwags rgyal po ri dwags dbang / /gcan gzan dbang po gcan gzan rgyal/ /sder chags rgyal po nags kyi bdag /ri dwags dgra dang glang po'i dgra/ /ri dwags 'tshe dang glang po 'tshe/ /ri dwags zas can gnya' ral can/ /ral can 'phrog byed 'phrog byed mig /stag za dred za gung za dang / /gtsug phud lnga pa seng ge'i ming / /steng rkang can dang sgra sgrogs dang / /rkang pa brgyad pa gyen mig can/ /mdangs sgo ka dang bsre kha sgo/ /ru ru sha ra bha yi ming / /spos kyi glang po thal dkar dang / /mche ba drug pa glang po'i mchog /gnyis 'thung yan lag bdun pa dang / /so gnyis sna yi zhags pa can/ /lag ldan glang chen spyi yi ming / /rwa gcig pa dang gcig pur gnas/ /bse dang khatpa bse ru'i ming //chur 'dres sa nyal rta yi dgra/ /ma harnyi rnams ma he'i ming / /rdo yi sna can sa slog dang / /sa rko rlong mche ba can/ /sna ring spu long sgra ldan dang / /mang skye spu rengs khab spu can/ /gtsang byed sa 'joms sa 'byed dang / /ngur sgra can rnams phag pa'i ming / /byi ba gsod dang byi ba za/ /byi la khrus mkhan g.yon can dang //bshang ba sped pa zhum bu'i ming / khyug mchong mchong byed marka ṭa/ /yal ga'i ri dwags gnyer ma'i gdong //nags gnas rnams ni spre'u ming / /'phrog byed sa lus rlung gi srog /mig mdzes smṛ ga nags su spyod//pags pa'i skye gnas ri dwags ming / /ri dwags 'tshe dang ri dwags dpyod/ /ri khrod pa dang sha ba ri/ /rgya yi 'tsho ba rngon pa'i ming //mkha' 'gro mkha' spyod mkha' la 'phur/ /'dab spyod bdab rkyang 'dab gshog can/ /mkhar nyal sgro ldan 'dab mas skyob/ /'dab ldan gshog ldan nam mkha'i rta/ /sgong skyes gnyis skyes 'dab skyob dang / /steng 'gro shing gnas me yi mgrin/ /yan lag drug pa sha ku ni/ /tshang skyes 'dab chags srin bu za/ /'dab ma'i shing ta bya spyi'i ming / /dpyid kyi pho nya ngag snyan dang / /gzhan gyis gsos dang nags na

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 299bde/ /ku hu'i mgrin ldan ko ki la/ /'phrog byed gtam dang ku hu 'don/ /'dod pa'i pho nya sbrang rtsi'i mgrin/ /dbyangs snyan ngag snyan sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs/ /sbrang rtsi'i sgra ldan bya rog gsos/ /dpyid kyi dbyangs snyan khu byug ming / /sa 'gro gar mkhan sprin gyi sgeg /mdongs ldan sgeg ldan mdongs mtha' yas rna rgyan can dang sen mo'i gar/ /lag 'gro'i zas can mgrin sngon can/ /sprin la dga' dang 'brug sgra'i gar/ /ke ke'u sgra ldan mjug sgro can/ /gtsug phud can dang gtsug ldan dang / /legs bris sgro dang rtse mo can/ /zlos gar mkhan rnams rma byi'i ming / /zangs kyi gtsug phud zangs ze can/ /byi ru'i lkog shal bya gag can/ /rkang mtshon can dang kukka ṭa/ /skad ring khyim gyi gtsug phud can/ /dus tshod smra dang nam tshod 'dzin/ /kuklu'i sgra sgrog khyim bya'i ming / /mar gad gshog pa mar gad 'dab/ /gshog ljang 'dab ljang sum phreng can/ /bya lce gnyis pa ne tsho'i ming / /'khor lo'i yan lag rkang dmar dang / /sgra sgrog chur sgrog ma dros gnas/ /mkha' lding dkar po yul 'khor 'dzin/ /mgrin pa'i rdza rnga lus dkar dang / /'gros mdzes dal 'gros zhi 'gro can/ /sgra 'byin chen po ku ra ta/ /bya khyung dkar po mgrin rnga can/ /ston gyi dbyangs snyan ngang pa'i ming / /bya khyung dmar po dbyangs snyan dang / /ngur ba ngag gi 'khor lo dang / /shing rta'i lus dang 'dod pa can/ /ko ka rnams ni ngang ser ming/ /chu sreg chu skyar ka dam pa/ /nya yi zas can skyar mo'i ming / /bzhad dang bya dkar swa ra ha/ /ha ha sgrog pa bzhad bya'i ming / /kru༈ mgrin ring khrung khrung ming / /mthing ril chu bya nag mo'i ming / /zla 'od zas can ku mud zas/ /ku mud bcud 'thung ku mud dga'/ /tsa ko ra ga'i ming yin no/ /char sdod bya dang chu nyung dang / /tsā ta ka rnams khug rta'i ming / /kā ka khā ta gtor mas rgyal/ /'chi med sgra ldan gzhan gso dang / sgra sgrog dang ni lan cig skyes/ /grong khyer spyod dang 'khrig pa sbed/ /ka gnyis pa dang tsher ma'i tshang / /gtor ma'i 'tshag ldan bya rog ming / /sna ring hūm̐ sgrog bya rog dgra/ /gos ser can dang mig ser can/ /mun pa'i mig can 'byung po'i bya/ /sram gyi mchod pa lug pa'i ming / /nyin mo yib dang nyi mas long / /mig sngon rnams ni srin bya'i ming / /g.yo chen pags 'dab pha wang ming //sgro dang gshog pa 'dab ma dang / /'gebs byed lus skyes 'dab gshog ming / /tshang rtsi can dang sgo nga skyong / /tshang mal bya khyim bya tshang ming / /gnyis skyes sa bon aṇḍaka/ /sbubs dang mdzod rnams sgo nga'i ming / /bya 'dzin bya skon skon pa dang / /rnyi dang bya rnyi bya rgya'i ming / /sbrang rtsi'i zas can sbrang rtsi spyod//sbrang byed sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs dang / /bung ba rkang drug sbra ma ra/ /:jiḥdang ni me tog 'thung / sbrang rtsi

300 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/myong dang sbrang rtsi skyong / /ra yig gnyis pa me tog 'jug /me tog zas can me tog rtse/ /sbrang rtsi skyes rnams sbrang ma'i ming / /me tog rdul dang me tog bcud/ /mngar ba'i rdul dang sbrang ma'i zas/ /ge sar bcud dang sbrang chang dang / /me tog rtsi dang bung rtsi dang / /rdul zhim bcud ldan sbrang rtsi'i ming /'dus pa bkod pa yang dag 'dus/ /bsags pa rab bsags 'phung ba dang / /spungs pa tshogasadang yang dag tshogs/ /phung po don mthun sde dang dpung / /'bor gyi dkyil 'khor tshogs pa'i ming //shed bdag skyes bu shed las skyes/ /yid skyes yid ldan ma nu'i bu/ /shes ldan sprin mgrin ta la'i rkang //tshe ldan gang zag rkang gnyis pa/ /nus ldan rnams ni mi spyi'i ming/ /mi pho lnga skyes skyes bu dang / /stobs ldan brtul phod mtshon cha can/ /skyong byed rnams ni skyes pa'i ming / /mi mo sbyor byed stobs med dang //'ching byed g.yo byed mtshams ldan ma/ /dga' ba'i sa gzhi g.yon ma dang / /na chung nā ri'i skyes ba dman//nu ldan bud med spyi yi ming / /dpal mo yan lag mchog ldan ma/ /'jigs can 'dod ma g.yon mig ma//rab myos sgeg mo yid 'ong ma/ /mdzes ma dga' ma dga' byed ma/ /smad rgyas ma dang khro med ma/ /rab skyes ma dang lus mchog ma/ /mtshan dang ldan pa sdug gu ma/ /rigs ldan ma dang bu mo dang / /lang tsho ma dang gzhon nu ma/ /bzhad ma bud med mchog gi ming / /bag ma lag pa 'dzin ma dang / /khyim 'dzin ma dang gnyen 'dun ma/ /'gog byed ma dang skyed byed ma/ /bden ma bdag po'ibartul zhugs ma/ /gnyen byas khyim gsar bag gsar dang / /rdul can ma dang rigs skyong ma/ /khyim bdag ma dang khyim gnas ma//chos bcas ma dang dbang bskur ma/ /mchis brang dang ni rdul mthong ma/ /khyim bdag byan mo chung ma'i ming / /gzugs 'tshong sprul mtshong 'jud mthun dang / /g.yon ma 'phyon ma skra 'dres ma/ /'dod ldan ma dang chags ldan ma/ /mo gsham 'dod 'gro rigs myur ma/ /grong khyer ma dang tshogs can ma/ /'phrin skyel res ma khyo mang ma/ /byi mo grong khyer spyod ma dang / /dus byas ma rnams smad 'tshong ming / /rdul ldan bud med chos ldan ma/ /rked nad can ma khrag ldan ma/ /dus ldan ma dang me tog can/ /rdul 'bab zla mtshan can ma'i ming / /mngal chags ma dang mngal ldan ma/ /phru gu chags dang mig blo langs/ /bu che bu chags lus mi bde/ /sbrum ma bu che ma yi ming //btsas ma thag dang skyes ma thag /zho 'thung 'o 'thung nu ma 'dzin/ /khye'u byis pa byis bu dang //bus pa se'u can shes ma byed/ /pang gnas gog 'gros gzhon nu dang / /rtsed mos 'tsho ba bu tsha'i ming //shed ldan dar bab lang tsho dar / /lang tsho bdo dang shed bdo dang / /rtsal ldan 'tshag bzang yan lag

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 301rgyas/ /stobs ldan dregs ldan dar ma'i ming/ /smin dang yongs smin na tshod yol/ /lo yi khur can lo mang po/ /mgo skya 'dar ldan gnyer ma can/ /rgas pa 'khogs pa rnying ba can/ /'khar ba'i mdza' bo rgan po'i ming / /yab dang yab rje bkur 'os dang / /skyed po bslab ston gos ba po/ /skyed byed skrun byed pha yi ming / /yum dang ma ma 'byung byed ma/ /mchod sbyin 'don ma 'dzin ma dang / /skye byed ma dang lus skyed ma//skyed ma skyong ma ma yi ming / /khyim thab gtan grogs bza' zla dang / /bza' tshang bza' tsho steng zhal dang //khyo shugs gnyis sdebs bza' mi'i ming / /sngon skyes rgan shos dang por skyes/ /gcen dang dral po phu bo'i ming / /rjes skyes gting skyes phyi nas skyes/ /gzhon shos gcung po nu bo'i ming / /sha med nyam chung rid pa dang / /lus rid lus skems lus steg pa/ /keng rus lus can skems pa'i ming / khrin rgyas 'tshag ldan yan lag rgyas/ /lus sbom lto 'phyang gsus po che/ /gsus brjid can rnams tsho ba'i ming //bro dang bro 'tshal bro nad dang / /gdung ba zug rngu nyams mi bde/ /mnyel dang snyun dang snyung ba dang / /nad dang nad gzhi khams mi bde/ /mnar dang gcong nad nad kyi ming / /nad gso nad 'tsho gso dang dpyad/ /rtsi dang sman dang rkyen sman dang / /nad sel 'tsho byed o ṣa dha/ /skyon shes tshe yi rig byed ma//bde byed nad 'joms phan pa dang / /nad kyi gnyen po sman gyi ming / /rig byed pa dang gso rigs 'dzin//lha rje tshe yi rig byed pa/ /'tsho byed 'tsho mdzad gso dpyad mkhan/ /gso dpyad pa rnams sman pa'i ming //zla ba bdud rtsi thig le dang/ /sa bon stobs ldan dbang por 'gro/ /ri bong 'dzin pa thig le'i ming / /khyab gnas mi lhung ru ldi ra/ /rakta rma skyes rgyun ldan dang / /rang skyes lus skyes sha'i khu ba/ /rma las 'dzag pa khrag gi ming / /phung po tshogs pa 'dus pa dang / /gzugs po khog pa yan lag can// dbang po'i skye mched lus kyi ming / /rgyu byed 'gro byed 'dor byed dang / /yug pa bgrod byed rkang pa'i ming //'jug byed gcod byed len pa dang / /glang po'i sna 'dra dpung pa'i 'dab/ /yal ga lnga pa sug pa dang //byed po sor ldan lag pa'i ming / /mgo stegs mgo 'dzin ri mo gsum/ /mgul ba mgrin pa dpal mgur mgur/ /dung ltar 'khyil ba ske yi ming / /yan lag dang po yan lag mchog /rus pa'i rgyal po skra 'dzin dang / /dbu dang mig 'dzin klad pa can/ /dung chen shi ra mgo yi ming / /slar skyes 'khyil ba yang srid can/ /mgo spu mgo skyes mgo nyal dang / /thor to lhas ma ke sa ra/ /ral pa 'dor byed skra yi ming //thor tshugs do ker skra cog dang / /ral pa'i cod pan thor cog ming / /lus skyes pags pa'i myu gu dang //pags pa'i me tog ba spu'i ming / /lta byed mthong byed 'dren byed dang / /dbang po dwangs ma lha'i sgron me//

302 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gzigs byed khyab byed snang byed dang / /gsal byed tsakṣu mig gi ming / /mig 'dzum zur mig yon por blta/ /khra mig gdong mig mig bgrad pa/ /smin bsdus smin 'khyog smin ma bsgyur/ /khro gnyer bzhin bsdus khro bas blta/ /mig gi rnam 'gyur so so'i ming / /skra lo skra zhags lhas ma dang / /lan bu lan tshar bud med skra yi ming / /sgra 'dzin thos 'dzin sgra yi gnas/ /nyan byed thos byed sgra len dang / /snyan dang gazlo rna ba'i ming / /sna bug dri len dri 'dzin dang / /dri skyong dri 'bab snom byed shangs/ /dri yi gnas rnams sna yi ming / /ro myong ro 'dzin ro can ljags/ /ro shes ro ma bdud rtsi 'dzag /babyud kyi ma rnams lce yi ming / /gcod byed ldad byed gnyis skyes dang / /rus pa'i me tog so yi ming / /smar byed za byed zhal dang gdong / /kha sgo ngag 'don kha yi ming / /pho mtshan pho dbang liṅgā rtags/ /bde byed myos byed lcags kyu dang / /myos byed 'khri shing rdo rje dang / /dran pa'i ka ba pho rtags ming / /nyer gnas skye gnas gnyis dga'i khyim/ /bha ga padma gaklo la/ /dran pa'i khron pa 'bor ba'i lam/ /skye ba 'dzin dang mo dbang dang //dga' ba'i bu ga mo mtshan ming / /brang skyes sta na ku tsa dang / /'o 'dzin bcud 'dzin 'o ma 'dzag /logs skyes dkar 'dzin nu tog dang / /nu rgyas nu 'bur nu ma'i ming / /'og sgo srin zhal srin po'i sgo/ /'phongs dang bshang lam rkub kyi ming //bgo ba g.yogs ma gcer skyob dang / /gos bzang na bza' gos kyi ming / /rgyan cha rgyan cha'i legs byed dang / /mdzes ma mdzes rgyan rgyan gyi ming / /ha ri tsan dan kha cher skyes/ /me yi rtse mo gdu ma//bde byed 'thung byed yang dag 'khums/ /dri zhim lus dmar me ldan dang / /tshim byed dmar po gur gum ming / /sprin gyi snying po gar bu dang / /kha ba'i phye ma 'od dkar can/ /rdul gyi snying po zla ba'i thal/ /shing gi snying po ga bur ming / /ri dwags lte ba ri dwags 'chang / /ri dwags myos byed dri yi thod/ /ri dwags rtsi dang sprul skrag byed/ /gasdu ri rnams gla rtsi'i ming / /dmar po sprin skyes rgyal mnyes byed/ /thal ba'i snying po tsandan ser/ /dri zhim shing dang shin sha sa/ /nus ldan a ga ru yi ming / /ma la yar skyes dri'i snying po//tshad skyob tshad sel bsil ba'i dri/ /dri zhim dri yi snying po dang / /sprul gyi snying po bzang po'i dpal/ /tshim byed bsil byed gdung skyob dang / /dpal gyi dum bu tsandan ming //mi dbang mi bdag mi skyong dang / /spyi bor dbang skur dpung las skyes/ /lha gcig dang ni jo bo dang / /sa srung 'dzin pa sa yi bdag /sa skyong sa bdag sa spyod dang / /sa yi tshangs pa sa'i brgya byin/ /sa 'tsho gnam bskos skye dgu'i bdag /'jigs pa sel byed rgyal po'i ming / /bka' las gtogs dang

ming gi mngon brjod pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 303bka' las dbang / /nang blon dbang blon zhang blon dang / /gros dbang can pa mdun na 'don/ /gtso bo sna chen kha lo pa/ /phying sang 'phrul blon blon po'i ming / /pho nya mngag pa bya ma rta/ /'phrin pa ci bgyi zhing ka ra/ /gtam skyes khyer rnams bang chen ming / /'bangs dang mnga' 'bangs lha 'bangs dang / /bka' 'bangs mnga' zhabs mnga' 'og dang / /chab 'bangs chab 'og mngag gzhug bran/ /rtse rgod phyag brnyan 'khor g.yog ming / /gnyis skye sngon skyes sa yi lha/ /tshangs pa'i bu rnams bram ze'i ming / /zhi ldan dul ldan 'dul khrims can/ /nyer zhi sdom can dbang po sdom/ /brtul zhugs can dang tshangs spyod can//bslab ldan sdom brtson khrims ldan ming / /dben pa gnas dang ri khrod pa/ /spong ba pa dngarnal 'byor can/ /bya ba bral dang bya ba btang / /yo byad nyung dang drang srong dang / /bsam gtan pa rnams sgom chen ming / /rig ldan rnam gsal nyes pa shes/ /blo bzang blo ldan blo chen dang / blo gros chen po kun rig dang //smra mkhas smra dbang smra yi rgyal/ /rtogs ldan dpyod ldan shes ldan dang / /thos mang thos ldan parnyi ta//mkhyen ldan mkhyen bzang mkhyen pa yangs/ /mkhyen rab can dang gnas lnga pa/ /bstan chos rig rnams mkhas pa'i ming / /brda sprod dbang po brda sprod pa/ /skad gnyis dbang phyug skad gnyis smra/ /'jig rten 'dul dang 'jig rten mig /mchan bu'i gnas 'dug sgyur byed dang / /zhus chen pa dang lco tstsha dang //legs sbyar smra ba smra mkhan ming / /tshig rgyan smra dang tshig rgyan mkhan/ /dbyangs can dga' byed dbyang sa can ngag /dbyangs can mgrin par byas pa dang / /snyan tshig smra dang snyan ngag mkhan/ /rgyan mkhan snyan ngag smra ba'i ming //dpung gi khyu mchog rtul phod dang / /dpung gi ru 'dren dgra las rgyal/ /rgyal byed 'phrog byed 'joms byed dang / /pha rol gnon dang g.yul na brjid/ /thub dka' gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /khro ldan rtsal chen sgyu rtsal can/ /dpal chen gtum chen dpa' bo'i ming / /mgo khebs tshem zhwa rmog zhwa dang //rmog zhu lcags zhwa rmog gi ming / /lus skyob khrab dang ya lad dang / /lcags kyi bgo ba 'khrug gos dang //mtshon skyob warma go khrab ming / /mda' 'phen mda' stan mda'i zhabrul 'khor/ /dha nu gnam ru gzhu yi ming / /sgro ldan ring 'gro rtse mo can/ /drang 'gro mkha' 'gro myur 'gro dang / /nyag phran nag phran 'bigs byed dang / /sha ra gshog ldan mda' yi ming / /stobs ldan so ldan lag ldan dang / /mche ba gnyis pa mche ba can/ /mang po skyong dang gnyis 'thung dang / /dbyug 'dzin glang chen sa lud nyal/ /nags tshal dga' dang thig le can/ /khyu yi mgon dang khyu yi bdag /chang dregs po dang chang gis myos/ /gom tshugs

304 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/kyis 'gro glang po'i ming / /'dren byed chu 'thung myur 'gro dang / /'gro mgyogs mgyogs 'gro rngog pa can//'gro byed bzhon pa rgya mtsho skyes/ /bang ldan cang shes gyi ling dang / /legs 'gro bzhon pa rnam par dul//skal ldan ldag rgyug par sig skyes/ /rgyab ldan bgrod byed rta yi ming / /ka na ka dang pu warṇa/ /gang gā skyes dang ri las skyes/ /mdog bzang zong mchog sa le sbram/ /tshong 'dus 'grim dang bum brgya skyes// lcags mchog me yi sa bon dang / /sa yi zla ba sa'i snying po/ /rin chen chen po gser gyi ming //de ltar mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod rtsa 'grel dang / /sna tshogs gsal ba mu tig phreng ba sogs rgya gzhung dang / tshig gter rtsa 'grel dang / /gser phreng rol pa la sogs bod gzhung rnams dang / gzhan yang bka' dang bstan chosaci rigasanasanyer mkho btusate/ dpal sa'i steng gi mdzesargyan gcig po lha 'jig rten dbang phyug dgyes pa'i zhal ngor rkarma phrin las gnyis pas bris so// //

no༅༅/ /rol mo'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba bzhugs so//sa skya paṇḍita kun dga' rgyal mtshan/no༅༅/ /rol mo'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung gi rnam 'phrul las/ /byung ba'i rdo rje dbyangs can la btud nas/ /rol mo'i sbyor bas gzhan la phan pa yi/ /dri med gzhus 'di bdag gis bshad par bya//dang po/ dbyangs kyi lelādad ldan rnams kyi mchod pa dang / /bkren pa rnams kyi 'tsho ba dang / /chags can rnams kyi yid g.yo ba/ /de kun rol mo mkhas las 'byung ///1) blo ngan gzugs kyis phongs pa'ang rung / /rigs ngan nor dang bral kyang bla/ /rol mo'i cha la mkhas gyur na/ /tshogs kyi nang na rgyan ltar mdzes//(21 gang na thod dang skra gsar dang / /gar dang rol mo'i sgra yod pa/ /de na mya ngan yod min pas/ /des na rol mo bsngags pa yin///3)'ga' zhig 'ga' la mi mjes shing / /la la gzhan la mdzes ma yin/ /mkhas rmongs skyes pa bud med sogs/ /kun ma dzesapa rol mo yin//(4) dkon mchog mchod phyir 'dus pa dang //phan tshun blta phyir 'dus pa dang / /phun sum tshogs pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /mkhas pas rol mo brtsam par bya///51(dang po dbyangs kyi rnam gzhag rol mo'i dbye ba spyir bstan pa/)1 lhan cig skyes dang rkyen gzhan las//'byung ba'i rol mo gnyis su 'dod/ /de dag rnam pa tha dad pa'i/ /dbye bas dpag med 'gyur bar bshad//(61(lhan skyes kyi rol mo bye brag tu bshad pa las/ 1 nga ro'i sgo nas zhib tu dbye ba/ mdor bstan/) de la lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /nga ro rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /'dren pa dang ni bkug pa dang / /bsgyur ba dang ni ldengs nyid do///7) (so sa'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa/) de dag 'dren pa'i dbye ba yis/ /tha dad 'gyur ba'ang bshad par bya// drang po bsgrengs dang bkug pa dang / /bstod dang smad pa'i nga ros drang / /khugs la rkyang dang brtsegs pa ste/ /de la gnyis gsum bzhi sogs so//(8) bsgyur la mgrin lce sna ldan te/ /de la ring dang

306 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/thung gnyis sbyar/ /ldengs la ring dang thung ba ste/ /de la khyad par thog mtha' rags//(91(2 sbyor ba'i sgo nas gnyis su dbye ba/) mda' gzhu yi ni zhabrul 'khor ltar/ /rang sgra rkyang pas mi nus phyir/ /de dag tshogs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rna ba bde bar byed pa yin//(101 de la rkyang pa ma 'dres pa//tshogs pa spel ba'i sbyor ba ste/ /de yang sbyor dang dngos gzhi dang / /mjug la gnyis gsum bzhi po spel//(11) so sor spel dang bsres spel bas/ /spel ba de yang gnyis su 'gyur/ /so sor spel ba tha dad de/ /bsres spel tha dad gnyis gcig 'gyur///12)drangs nas bkug dang bkug drangs la/ /bsgyur ldengs ldengs bsgyur sbyar ba dang / /drangs nas bsgyur dang bsgyur drangs la/ /bkug ldengs ldengs bkug sbyar ba dang //(13) drangs nas ldengs dang drangs pa la/ /bkug bsgyur bsgyur bkug sbyar ba dang / /rang sgra rkyang pas drangs pa la/ /gzhan sgra brtsegs pa sbyar ba dang //(14) rang nyid yongs su brtsegs pa la//gzhan sgra rkyang pa sbyar ba dang / /rang nyid yongs su drangs pa la/ /rang nyid yongs su sbyar ba dang / / rang nyidabartsegasapa de nyid las/ /brtsegs pa'i don gzhan sbyar bar bya//(151 de ltar sbyar ba de dag la'ang //rang ngam gzhan nam bsres pa dag /gnyis gsum bzhi sogs ci rigs par/ /de dag rnams kyi rjes su blang ///161(3 dbyangs tshig gi sgo nas gnyis su dbye ba/) de yang dbye na rnam gnyis te/ /bstan bya med pa'i nga ro dbyangs/ /dbyangs dang ldan par 'gyur mod kyang / /don ldan ston pa tshig yin te//(17) 'di yang so so'am spel ba yi/ /tshul la bzhi pa'i blo yis dpyad/ /dbyangs kyis drangs la tshig gi dgug /dbyangs kyis bsgyur la tshig gis ldengs//(18) dbyangs kyis drangs la tshig drangs dang / /dbyangs kyis bkug la tshig bkug dang / /dbyangs kyis bsgyur la tshig bsgyur dang / /dbyangs kyis ldengs la tshig ldengs dang //de dag bzlog ste blang ba'o//(19)de la mtshams sbyor dbyangs nyid dam/ /yang na tshig gis sbyar bar bya//yang na mtshams sbyor med pa ru/ /rang nyid sbyar te blang bar bya//(201 /de yang rim dang cig car dang //myur dang bul ba'i rtsol ba dang / /bsgrims dang klod pa'i nga ro dang / /bteg pa dang ni bcum pa rnams//pho mo ma ning 'dren pa la//(211 rkyang pa'am spel bas nga ro drangs/ /de la pho sgra brjid pa ste/ /mo yi sgra la snyan pa 'byung / /ma ning sgra ni btsun pa yin//(22) de bzhin pho sgra gsal la ngar/ /mo yi sgra ni phra zhing 'dar/ /ma ning 'gyur zhing mnyen pa dgos/ /de lta'i sgra sbyor de dag nyid//(23) sbyor ba'am dngos gzhi mjug rnams la/ /so so ba'am spel ba las/ /med ces mkhas rnams nges par bya///241 /de lta'i dbye

rol mo'i bstan bcos/ 307ba de dag kyang / /'dren pa'i dus su 'drongs pa dang / /bsgyur tshe 'gyur dang 'gugs pa yi/ /dus su khugs dang ldengs la 'jam//(25) thams cad du ni mnyen pa dang // pho mo la sogs sgra dag la/ /rang sgra legs par phyin pa dang / /tshig gi dus su tshig gsal zhing //(26) dbyangs la dbyangs nyid gsal ba dang / /de dag bsres che legs 'dre la/ /'dres nas so sor gsal ba'o//(27)(4 dbyangs kyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa/) dbyangs mkhan rnams kyis thams cad du/ /gang las 'dren dang gang du dgug/ gang du bsgyur la gang du ldengs/ /gang du 'jog dang gang gis sbyor//(28) gang bstod gang du smad par bya/ /gang bsgrims gang du klod par bya/ / gang du dbyangs yin gang du tshig /gang du myur dang gang du dal//(29) gang zhig pho sgra gang du mo/ /gang du ma ning sgra drangs dang / / gang du bsres spel bya ba rnams/ /tshigs bcad rim pa gang len pa/ /de la sa mtshams mkhas par bya//(30) de ltar shes nas rkyen la brtag /'dren pa'i rkyen du a a rbe1gas/ /bsgyur ba'i rkyen du la 31 sogs/ /bkug pa'i rkyen du a'i sogs/ /ldengs pa'i rkyen du a a sogs///31) 'dren pa la sogs de dag la/ /ring ba dang ni thung ba dang / /rkyen dang sa mtshams gcod pa dang / /drag zhan la sogs nges pa dang ///32) ma nges pa yang shes par bya/ /de ltar shes nas slob ma la'ang / / 'di dag 'di yi gnas yin zhes/ /so sor phye la bslab par bya//(331((( dbyangs spyi'i spyor ba dpe dang bcas pa bshad pa/) de ltar so so'i dbyangs shes nas/ /spyi yi sbyor ba nyid bshad bya/ /mchod dbyangs bsgyur ba gtso bo ste/ /glu la 'dren pa gtso bo yin//(34) rtog brjod la ni bsgyur thung ngo / /rjes su brjod la bsgyur 'dren thung / /spyir ni kun la kun 'jug kyang / /'di dag gtso bor 'dren par mthong //(35)de ltar dbyangs sbyor shes rnams la/ /mtshon par byed pa'i dpe gzhan bshad/ /mda' gzhu lcags kyu 59|la mda' dang / /gdugs dang bse ru rdo rje nas///36) rba rlabs 'khor lo 'dra ba ste/ /gang zhig 'dren pa'i dbyangs rnams la/ /dpe 'di bden par kho bos mthong //(371de ltar bsdus te rgyas bshad pa/ /'di las spros pa gzhan med do/ /rnam par spros na mtha' yas te//rnam par rtog pas 'byed phyir ro///38) des na blo gros ldan pa yis/ /dang por slob dpon mkhas bsten te/ /phyi nas rang gis legs brtags na/ /dri za'i dbang po lta bur 'gyur//(39)rol mo'i bstan bcos las dbyangs kyi le'u ste dang po'o//

308 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gnyis pa/ tshig sbyar ba'i lelā(gnyis pa tshig gi rnam gzhag las/ 1 bstod sogs yul bzhi'i rnam gzhag bshad pa las/ yul bzhi ngos gzung nyan par gdams pa/) de nas tshig gi sbyor ba yang / /khyed la brtse ba'i bsam pas bshad/ /chen po rnams la bstod pa dang / /dman pa rnams la smad pa dang //(11 mnyam pa rnams la 'gran tshig dang / /kun la dga' ba'i glur blang ngo / /de dag so so'i rnam gzhag kyang / /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad pas nyon//(2)(rim bzhin rgyas par bshad pa/) yon tan shes rab bslab pa rigs/ /na so nor gyis che ba drug/rim bzhin khyad par zhugs pas na/ /bkur ba'ang tha dad yin zhes gsungs//(3) yon tan can la dad pas bkur/ /shes rab can la lugs dris pas/ /bslab pa rgan la phyag gis te/ /rigs kyis rgan la zhe sas so//(4) na sos rgan la bsnyen bkur gyis/ /nor gyis rgan la ngo dgas bkur/ /che la yon tan med gyur cing / /dregs pa can la blo med pa//(5) rab tu byung ba bslab pa nyams/ /skye bo'i bdag po rigs dman pa/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo lo grangs gzhon/ /phyug po ser sna'i dbang gyur pa//sa mang po'i na nga na gnong ba'i gnas/ /gzhan la brnyas na smad par bya/ /bdag dang yon tan mtshungs pa yi/ /rang phyogs bstod na 'gran pa'i gnas/ /tshul min brjod na bzlog ste brjod/ /de la smad sgra mi 'jug go/(7) shes bya'i gnas la rab mkhas shing / /lam gyi dmigs pa ma 31ga pas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob 'gyur ba/ /'di ni mkhas rnams dga' byed yin///8) rgyal po srid dang mdzangs la lugs/ /dpa' la g.yul ngo bud med rgyan/ /tshong pa zong dang zhing pa zhing / /tshul bzhin min pas rmongs pa dga'//(91mdor na so so'i bya ba la/ /blo dang ldan pas mthun 'jug brjod/ /thub pas kyang ni de skad gsungs//sems can rten par byed pa'ang yin//(101(2 bstod tshig gi gnad nyid dbye ba dang bcas pa shad pa las/ ngo bo'i sgo nas gnyis su dbye ba/) de ltar bstod sogs yul shes nas/ /ji ltar bstod dang smad pa dang / /'gran dang dga' bar byed pa yi/ /tshig sbyor gnad kyang nga yis bshad//(11) de yang dbye na rnam gnyis te/ /ngo bo 'am ni dpe yis so/ /rang dang rang gi chos bshad pas/ /ngo bo de yang gnyis su 'gyur//(12) rang gi ngo bo lus ngag dang / /yid kyi yon tan brjod pa tsam/ /lus ngag yid las gzhan pa yi/ /'byor dang dbang thang rigs yon tan/ /brtse dang snyan par smra la sogs/ /bstod par byed na rang gi chos// (13)(dpe la bco brgyad nyid du dbye ba las/ spyi'i sgo nas mdor bstan/) phyogs gcig gam ni phal cher gyis//

rol mo'i bstan bcos/ 309'dra ba'i yon tan legs brtags te/ /de 'dra khyod nyid yin no zhes/ /mtshungs par sbyor ba dpe yin no///14) de dag bzlog pas smad pa dang / /'gran pa'ang bde blag shes par 'gyur//(1519du sor phye ste rgyas par bshad pa/) de yang sa gser rgya mtsho klu/ /rlung dang rnam thos bu la sogs//gzhan ni khron steng chu bur 'dra/ /gisa'i 'bras bu tho yor bzhin//(16) ne tso byi ba 'dra bar 'dod/ /de bzhin nyi zla gser dang dngul/ /dge sdig snang mun g.yas dang g.yon/ /rgyal blon la sogs 'gran zla las/ /cig shos lhag pa'i dpe brjod bya//(17) de ltar de dag so so'am/ /thams cad so sor sbyar bar bya/ /de ltar sbyor ba de dag kyang / /thog mar bstod sogs yul brtags te/ /de rjes tshig la brtag par bya//(18) gzhan du gzhi ma grub pa yi/ /khyad par brjod pa rab tu dka'//(3 de dag snyan ngag sogs dang sbyar ba/) de ltar shes pa'i mkhas pa yis/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba yin pas na/ /mchod pa la ni snyan ngag sbyar//(19) phal cher rmongs pa 'du bas na/ /glur blangs pa la 'dod rgyal tshig /sgom chen sbyangs pa chung bas na//(20) 'dod rgyal sbyar ba rtog brjod la/ /gzhan gyi rjes 'jug yin pas na/ /rjes su brjod la gang snang sbyar//(21) rkang pa gnyis nas drug pa'i bar/ /ngag don 'brel na tshigs bcad gcig /de la rjes su bsngags la sogs/ /ji ltar bde ba'i rnam gzhag bya//(22)/ dbyangs dang bcas la phal cher ni/ /yi ge mnyam mam mi mnyam yang / /tshigs su bcad pa'i rnam gzhag 'jug /bde 'jam don la tshigs bcad dam/ /yang na rkyang pa ci bder sbyar//(23)kun gyis go zhing brjod pa bde/ /don dang mthun pa dpes 'grig la/ /snga phyi mi zlos mi 'gal zla/ /dbye bsdu shes na mkhas pa yin//(24) de 'dra gang gis shes pa de/ /sbyangs pa'i stobs las 'byung ba snyam/ /'dir ni tshig sbyor mdor bsdus yin//(4 rgyas par gzhan du gdams pa/)rgyas par kho bos gzhan du bshad///25) blo dang ldan pas de bsten te/ /'bad pas nan tan byas nas kyang / /phyi nas rang gis legs sbyangs na//kun dga' lta bu'i mkhas par 'gyur//(26) rol mo'i bstan bcos las tshig sbyar ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o//gsum pa/ rjeXr ba gtan la phab pa'i leg(gsum pa dbyangs dang tshig sbyar ba'i tshul las/ 1 lus kyi 'dug stangs kyi tshul bcas bshad pa/) dbyangs dang tshig gi don shes pas/ /phyi nas sbyor ba rab tu brtsam/ /rang dang rjes su 'tsham pa yi/ /grogs po nye bar gzhag par bya//(1) glu ni kun du bsgyings tshul gyis/ /langs la lag pa 'gram par bzhag /mchod la

310 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/khrus byas mig phab ste/ /dang bas skyil krung bzang po bca'//(2) rtog brjod lag pa'i brda spros pas//tsog pu'am bzang po'i 'dug stangs yin/ /bshags pa kun tu gnong tshul gyis/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar te 'dud//(31 de bzhin bstod la spro ba'i tshul/ /smad dang 'gran la thigs pa'i tshul/ /rtog pa brdzed la go ba'i tshul/ /rjes su gdams la man ngag tshul///41 bshags la nyam thag tshul yin te//dga' la dga' ba'i tshul yin no/ /rkang pa la sogs rjes bstun la/ /de dang rjes mthun dbyangs nyid do//(5) de ltar brjod na 'jig rten dang / /rjes su mthun zhing mdzes par 'gyur//(2ngag gi bye brag dbye ba bcas bshad pa/) spyir ni 'jig rten 'di na yang / /yul dang dus kyi bye brag dang //9) rgan dang gzhon nu'i dbye ba dang / /skyes dang bud med la sogs pa'i/ /khyad par nyid kyis mi 'dra ba'i/ /dbyangs kyi sbyor ba du ma mthong //(7) dbus pa rnams kyis ldir zhing 'gyur/ /gtsang pa 'tsher zhing gsal ba yin/ /gtser zhing mdud pa mnga' ris pa/ /khams pa rnams kyi brjid cing gyong //(8) de ltar de dag rnams la yang / /so sor phye na rnam pa mang / /mdor na skad gdangs bye brag gis/ /rang la lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /'gyur gyi bye brag shes par bya// /9) slob dpon gzhan gyis bsgyur na ni/ /tshon rtsi bzhin du bsgyur du rung / /sngon gyi dbyangs mkhan tshig la mkhas//(10) da lta rnams ni dbyangs la sbyong //phyi ma'i dus kyi dbyangs mkhan rnams/ /mi mkhas blo chung glu la dga'/ /ci yang med kyang mtsher 'gyur snyam//(111 gzhon nu'i tshe na 'gyur khugs bde/ /dar la bab na mgrin pa bzang / /rgan par gyur nas tshig la mkhas/ /phal cher bud med rnams kyi phra// (12) skyes pa rnams kyi sbom pa yin/ /gzhon nu'i tshe na phra ba ste/ /dar la bab na sbom par 'gyur/ /rgan pa rnams kyi mgrin pa zhum//(13) ba tsha can gyi chu 'thung zhing / /snum bag can gyi kha zas za/ /lhags pa can gyi gnas 'dug pa'i/ /mi rnams phal cher mgrin pa sbom//(14) de las bzlog pa phra ba yin/ /rna bar snyan par 'gyur khugs dang / /gcod mtshams dang ni ngag mnyen pa/ /'debs mkhas pa las 'byung ba yin/ /de yang sbyangs pa'i stobs las 'byung ///151mdor na thog ma'i slob dpon gyi/ /rjes su phyi ma 'jug par 'gyur//(3 dpe bstan pa rnams kun la 'tshams par bshad pa/) de nas dbyangs kyi sbyor ba rnams/ /dpe yi ming gis bshad par bya//(16) 'dren pa dpag bsam ljon shing ste/ /bkug pa me tog 'khri shing yin/ /dbus zhan chu klung dal 'gro ba/ /'gyur khugs rgya mtsho'i zla bar bshad//(17) tshogs su seng ge'i nga ro ste//dben par bung ba rol ba'i tshul/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar ne tsho'i dbyangs/ /rma bya'i 'jo sgeg rmongs nang

rol mo'i bstan bcos/ 311du//(18) skyo tshe dang ba kun 'dren pa/ /rjes su dga' ba 'dod lha'i mda'/ /mchod la dge ba'i me tog ste/ /ba tsha'i chu klung sdig sbyong la//(19) rang phyogs bstod na lha yi rnga/ /pha rol smod na 'khor zil gnon//kun du snyan pa dri za'i dbyangs/ /spel ba me tog phreng ldan yin//(201 de la sogs pa'i rnam pa yis/ /'dren pa'i khyad par legs brtags te/ /dbyangs kyi sbyor ba gzhan la yang / /ji ltar 'tsham pa sbyar bar bya//(211(4 mkhas pa kun 'jug pa'i gdams ngag bshad pa/) de ltar shes pa'i mkhas pa la/ /kun tu 0〈cog pa'i gdams ngag bshad//(22) dal ba la ni mi 'tsham zhing / /myur ba la ni ma brdabs la/ /'brel ba'i tshe na ma 'dres pa/ /dbugs 'jam ma zhum spobs pa'i gnad///23) dbyangs sbyor mang na don go chung //bde 'byam mang na tha mal skyo/ /ha cang thal na mkhas pas khrel/ /ran par spel ba dus kyi gnad//(241kun la mkhas pas rang nyid ྅rto/ /'gyur khugs 'dredangs pas ngag la byams/ /tshig sbyor legs pas gzhan la snyan/ /'jam zhing 'phrod pa sbyangs pa'i gnad//(251ha cang rgod dang thims pa dang / /don ma rtogs dang mi spro ba/ /gzhan du yengs pa blo yi skyon//(26) zur ma phyin dang zlos pa dang / /tshig lhad can dang mi gsal ba/ /gcod mtshams nor ba tshig gi skyon//(27) dbyangs la 'phel 'grib rtabs pa dang / /ha cang mgyogs bul btsir nas 'don//bcos shing smra ba gdangs kyi skyon///28) rnam 'gyur ya yo bzhin sdud dang / /mi lta ba dang phyugs ltar blta/ /gzir dang 'tshab pa lus kyi skyon//(29)sngon la 'gro dang phyi nas 'then/ /che dang chung dang mi bsre dang / /mkhas 'dod byed pa grogs kyi skyon//(30) kun tu g.yengs dang phan tshun smra/ /ched cher mi 'dzin ma rangs dang / /don go med pa nyan pa'i skyon//(31) tshig la rmongs la brnyas pa'i rgyu/ /dbyangs sbyor med na bzhad gad rgyu/ /dus tshod med na skyo ba'i rgyu//dgos pa med na sdig pa'i rgyu//(32) mkhas pa 'dus shing mang pos bskor/ /grogs po ngan 2zhing 'gran zla mang / /sbyangs pa chung zhing spobs pa zhan/ /blo gros ngan pa sdug pa'i rgyu//(33) de ltar mi mthun phyogs mang na/ /ji ltar gyur kyang dor bar bya/ /gal te thams cad phun tshogs gyur//mkhas pas dge ba spel phyir blang //(341(5 zhar byung rkyen gzhan rol mo bshad pa/) de ltar shes nas rkyen gzhan las/ /byung ba'i rol mo rnams la 'bad/ /gling bu pi wang rdza rnga dang / /khar rnga rnga zlum rnga bo che///35) rnga phran cha lang ka ṇa ḍi//dung dang rgyud mangs la sogs pa/ /ji snyed sil snyan sbyor bshad pa/ /de snyed la ni mkhas par bya///361

312 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/phyi nas rol mo kun 'dus pa'am/ /so so nyid kyis rnam par rtsen/ /dbus 'gyur tshal na gtam rgyud kyi//zlos gar byed pas thams cad sbyor//(37) mtha' 'khob 'di na de lta bu/ /byed pa'ang lta zhog thos pa'ang dkon/ /'dir yang gzhung mangs dogs pas na/ /sil snyan sbyor ba ngas ma bshad/ /gal te don du gnyer rnams la/ /phyi nas gzhan du bshad par bya//(38) 'di ni kun tu g.yeng ba dang / /kyal ba'i rgyu phyir rgyal bas bkag /'on kyang dkon mchog mchod pa dang / /gzhan gyi don la nyes pa med///39) des na mgon med zas sbyin gyis/ /zhus tshe dge slong rnams la gnang / /rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bslab pa//de ni gang yang yod min gsung //(401(6 rgyas par mi 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa/) drug las skye rbedugs glu'i spyor ba/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa du ma mthong / /gal te khyod kyang glu'i sbyor ba/ /de nyid khyad par rigs she na//(41) skad dang gdangs kyi khyad par gyis/ / bod kyi sgra la 'jug pa dka'/ /des na drug las skyes sogs kyi/ /glu yi sbyor ba 'dir ma bshad//(42) lkog ma nyed pa la sogs pa/ / thub pas ji snyed gsungs pa gang / /bod kyi sgra dang mthun pa rnams/ /'di yi nang na 'du shes byos///43) rol mo'i bstan bcos las sbyor ba gtan la dbab pa ste le'u gsum pace(//de ltar shes bya kun la sngon sbyangs mthus/ /'dir ni blo gros rnam par gsal thob pa/ /dpal ldan dge bsnyen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis/ /grogs po dga' ba spel phyir bkod pa yin/ / rong blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring / /de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang de sras kyis/ /shes bya'i gnas kun sbyangs zhes legs par gsungs/ /gang dag ma 'ongs dus na 'gro ba yi/ /sgron ma lha mi'i bla mar bya'o zhes/ /brtson pa dam pa'i gnas la khas 'che ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras des mchog tu shes bya sbyang / /sngon chad gzhan gyi yid la ma shar ba/ /'di 'dra gang gis shes de blo gros ldan/ /rgan po rnams kyis yang yang rnam dpyad pa'i/ /don de rtogs kyang de la ngo mtshar med//de ltar gzhan don la dgyes rgyal ba yi/ /sras kyi 'jug yul phyogs tsam phye ba las/ /bsod nams grub pa gang yod de yis bdag /'gro la phan mdzad chos kyi rgyal por shog/ rig pa'i gnas kyi bye brag gsal bar byed pa rol mo'i bstan bcos mdo tsam bshad pa zhes bya ba shes bya'i gnas yongs sugrags pa phal mo che la blos yul dubyas pa'i paṇḍita lo gzhen yang blo gros rgan pa shākya'i dge bsnyen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis rig pa'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skya'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// //

ra༅༅/ /rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las sku'i phyag tshad kyi skabs zur du phyung ba bzhugs /stag tshang lotsāb shes rab rin chen/༄༅༅/ /gnyis pa tshad ldan dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / des na rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ mi ldan pa'i nyes dmigs dang / ldan pa'i phan yon no//dang po ni/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi rgyud las/ kos ko mgrin pa byin pa rnams/ /gsum po ring na skyon chen po/ /sngags pa bdag nyid nges par ni/ /gnas las nyams shing bskrad par 'gyur//shangs dang snyan dang phyag sor rnams/ /gsum po thung na skyon chen po/ /dngos grub nges par 'joms pa dang / /de bzhin dpal yang nyams pa 'gyur/ /byin pa zhal dang mkhur tshos te/ /gsum po sbom pa skyon chen po/ /sgrub po bdag nyid nges par yang / /dpal las ring zhing bdud bgegs 'byung / /'gram pa brang dang rtsib log ste/ /gsum po zhom na skyon chen po/ /don ni nyams par 'gyur ba dang / /'dir ni bgegs 'byung the tshom med/ /nu ma snyan dang dpral ba rnams/ /gsum po yo na skyon chen po/ /sgrub pa po nyid myur ba ni/ /dgra'i rtsod pas gdung bar 'gyur/ /brla dang dku dang nam tshong gnyis/ /gsum po nyams na skyon chen po/ /chom rkun rnams kyis 'jigs pa dang / /'chi bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /snyan dang mchu dang dpral ba dang / /shangs nyams spyan ni yo gyur na/ /sngags pa bdag nyid nges par yang sna tshogs bgegs dang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gyen du gzigs shing dbugs skyod tshul/ /gdan las yo zhing bskyod lta bus/ /rang gi gnas las rtag 'pho zhing / /don rnams 'joms pa nyid du 'gyur/ /mgrin pa nam tshong la sogs sku'i/ /skyon ni grangs med zhig tu grags/ /'dir ni spyan sogs yo ba'am/ /phyag rgya phyag mtshan nor gyur na/ /mya ngan sdug bsngal gyis rab gdung / /sna tshogs skyon sogs brtag par bya/ /rgyab yol gdugs dang gdan rnams te/ /gsum po chung shing dog pa'i skyon/ /mdza' bos mi snyan brjod pa dang //dpal nyams 'chi bar 'gyur pa yin/ /skyon ni 'di dag skyon chen po/ //mkhas pas legs par blta bar bya 1

314 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/gnyis pa (tshad dang ldan pa'i phan yon )ni/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /gzugs mdzes cho ga mthong ba ste/ /dul ba gzo rnams thams cad la/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag pas bri/ /zhi ba la ni zhi ba'i gzugs/ /drag cing 'jigs rung drag po ste/ /dpa' zhing nga rgyal sku dpa'o/ /bzhad pa'i zhal ni sgeg pa ste/ /'di ltar mtshan nyid mtshon byas nas/ /sngags pa rnams kyis thang sku bri/ /las dang po yi sngags pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs bya ba ste/ /thang sku sgrub bya rgya chen gyi/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/2 /zhes sdom 'byung le'u sum cu par gsungs shing / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du yang / bris sku'i phan yon rgyas par gsungs so//3gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )ni/ sdom 'byung 'grel pa la rten pa zhig gzhan du bshad zin mod kyi/ 'dir yang dus 'khor sdom 'byung rtsa 'grel dang / kṛ ya sa mutstsha dang / bod snga ma dag gis sha ri'i bus zhus pa'i mdo la brten pa'i phyag tshad mang du bshad pa rnams bsgrigs te rgyas par bshad par bya'o//de yang zhal phyag spyan la sangs rgyas kyi sku so so dang / 'gro ba gzhan gyi lus so so'i dbang gis lus kyi sor grangs dang / mchu zheng la sogs pa shes dgos te/ dus 'khor 'grel chen du rgyal ba'i longs sku la rang sor brgya nyer lnga mchu zheng mnyam pa dang / mi phal pa la/ zheng du rang sor go drug mchur gya bzhi las med pas mchu zheng mi gab pa dang / de gnyis kyi bar byang sems gzhan la yod par gsungase pa cung zad zhib tu sbyar na/4 mi phal pa la las rlung stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gcig 'gags/sa dang po thob na brgya dang brgyad/ de nas dgu po re re la sor gnyis gnyis 'phel te/ brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa la sor gcig 'phel bas brgya nyer lngar gsal bas mi mkhas pa dag /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs pa'i tshad/ gdong pa dgu las 'gyur ba med/ /zhi ma khro la zhal tshad brgyad/ /shin tu khros la zhal tshad drug /ces pa 'di kha don byed cing zhal re la sor bcu gnyis mar bzhag nas/ zhal dgu la brgya dang brgyad yod pa 'di ring dar byas te/ dus 'khor nas sor mo brgya nyer lnga dang / sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs su zhal bcu gnyis ma yang gsungs pa rnams rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i drang don du 'dod pa dag ni tshul 'di lta bu khongs su ma chud pas nongs so//yang kha cig phugs kyi zhal grangs la khyad par med kyang zhi khro rnams kyi sor mo la sbom phra yod pas/ zhal gang la sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum ma dang / bcu gnyis ma/ phyed dang bcu gcig ma/shin tu khros pa sor mo shin tu sbom pas zhal re re la rang sor dgu mar byed pa yin no/ /zhes kyang zer

rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las sku'i phyag tshad kyi skabs zur du phyung ba/ 315mod kyi/ de ni mi mthad de/ shin tu khros pa de sor mo sbom pa tsam du zhal gyi 'bor yang shin tu che ba'i phyir dang / zhi ba la zhal dgu dang / zhi ma khro la brgyad/ shin tu khros pa la drug la sogs par rang gis khas blangs pa dang yang 'gal zhing / dus 'khor dang sdom 'byung du longs sku zhal tshad bcu pa zhal re la rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum ma dang / bde mchog sogs la sor bcu gnyis ma'i zhal bcu dang / phag mo dang / bdag med ma sogs dang / tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag po chu lha rlung lha sogs la zhal dgu pa dang / gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i khro bo dang / thag bzang ris dang / lus ngan dang / bden bral dang / gzhin rje dang / me lha dang / drag gza' rnams zhal brgyad pa dang / ro langs ni zhal bcu gnyis pa dang / kṛ ya sa mustsor mi'u thung dang / tshogs bdag sogs zhal lnga par bshad la/ 'byung po 'dul byed zhal gsum pa/ zhes nag po chen po lta bu rang zhal gsum par bshad pa yang yod par grags pa sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na zhal grangs ni dbu che chung dang / yan lag ring thung sogs kyis bzhag la/ sor grangs ni/ zhal so so'i bcu gnyis cha'am phyed dang bcu gsum cha la bzhag nas brtsi bar bya ba yin no//de ltar na dang por sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa brjod par bya ste/ gtsug tor sor mo bzhi/ de nas skra 'tshams phyed dang lnga/ de nas mdzod pu sor bzhi ste de ltar zhal gong / shangs rtse/ kosko/ mgrin phreng 'og ma'i bar yang de ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas snying lte gsang ba'i bar la zhal re re ste/ de ltar na gtsug tor nas gsang gnas kyi bar la zhal lnga'o/ /brla dang rje ngar gyi rkang la zhal do do/ dbyi dpus mo gnyis la sor bzhi bzhi/ long bu man la phyed dang lnga/ de ltar gsang gnas nas rting pa'i bar zhal lnga ste/ bcu po thams cad sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum par mnyam pas brgya nyer lnga/ zhabs mthil gyi dkyus la sor mo bcu bzhi ste/ de ni sku'i srid la rtsi don med do/ /kha cig thor cog sbrags pas zhal do ste zhal bcu gnyis bshad zer mod kyi/ kho bos ni sdom 'byung 'grel par ro langs zhal bcu gnyis par bshad pa ma gtogs 5longs sku zhal bcu gnyis par bshad pa ma mthong ngo / /de bzhin du zheng du brang gi tshangs thig nas phrag pa'i bar la zhal gang / bar lhu sor nyi shu/ lag ngar bcu drug phyag mgo bcu gnyis/ gru mo dang 'khrig mar sor re re/ 'grel chen dang sdom 'byung 'grel par gsungs mod kyi/ sdom grangs drug bcu re phyed dang gsum du gsungs shing mchu zheng gab par gsungs pa dang / cung mi 'grig pas na/ gru mo 'khrig ma phyag mgo rnams dus 'khor rgyud kyi rtsa bar ma thon pa 'grel pas kha skangs pa la rags rtsis shor bar snang bas dang po gnyis la sum cha re dbri zhing phyi ma la sor phyed mnan par bya'o/ /'dir

316 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/ni sor mo brgya dang brgyad pa la ring shos byed pa'i gzo bo sogs kyis bltas na lhu lag shin tu ring par snang mod kyi/ rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa 'di gtso bor bya yi mi phal gyi mig sngar mdzes pa gtso bor ma byed cigader ma zad cung zad khros pa'i bde mchog kyi rdor dang / dag pa'i byang sems kyi sku ni/ zhal tshad bcu po 'di'i steng nas/ sor phyed phyed kyi cha phri ste sor mo brgya nyi shu pa byas na'ang de ltar snang mod kyi snga ma bzhin no/ /zhal tshad dgu pa rnams la ni/ gtsug tor sor drug nor bu sor gnyis byed kyang dgu la mi thi bar byas/ sngar gyis sor phyed dang lnga pa thams cad bzhi pa dang zhal thams cad sor bcu gnyis par byas nas gzhan 'dra ba la/ spyi dang dpus mo'i sor bzhi po dang gtsug tor gyi sor bzhi po bor ba yin no/ /zhal tshad brgyad pa ni/ gzhan 'jal lugs dgu pa de ji bzhin la/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dbyibs gru bzhir mngon pa snga ma las che ba gcig byas la/ zhal tshad gzhan thams cad zhal de'i rang sor phyed dang bcu gcig ma la zhal du mig bdags shing sor mo bzhi pa rnams phyed dang bzhi par byas pas zhal de'i tshad brgya 'ong ba yin zhing / drug pa dang lnga pa dang gsum pa sogs kyang des bsgres nas shes par bya'o/ /dper na zhal lnga pa la bcu pa dang gzhi khyon mnyam pa la zhal nyis 'gyur gyis che ba byas zhal tshad gzhan thams cad de'i phyed phyed la ming du brtags pa bzhin no//de bzhin zhal gyi rnam pa yang / rgyud las/ khyim bya'i sgo nga til rnam pa/ /gru bzhi dang ni zlum por bcas/ /thun mong sku rnams thams cad kyi/ /zhal gyi dbyibs ni rnam bzhi'o/ /skyes bu chen po lha mo yis/ /khyim bya'i sgo nga til gyi dbyibs/ /mdzes shing blta na sdug pa yi/ /zhal ni rnam pa gnyis nyid bya//yi dwags 'byung po sha za dang / /khro bo rnams kyi rnam 'gyur dbyibs/ /zlum po dang ni gru bzhi ste/ /zhal ni gnyis dag bya ba yin/6/zhes gsungs pas/zhi zhal la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi khyim bya'i sgo nga / lha mo rnams kyi til/ khro zhal la khro bo spyi'i zlum po/ ha cang khros pa'i gru bzhi rnams/ zhal gyi gzhi gru gzhir byas pa'i grwa bzhi ka nas cha phran phyed dang gnyis bcad pa dang / gnyis ga nas gnyis gnyis bcad pa dang / gnyis ga nas re re bcad pas 'byung par bshad kyang / dang po gnyis la logs nas kyang re re bcad dgos la/ zhal bzhi po de 'khor lo bde mchog gi g.yas dang / rgyab dang mdun dang g.yon zhal gyi dbyibs su bshad cing / rim pa ltar sangs rgyas byang sems rnams dang / phag mo gzugs can dum skyes ma rnams dang / khro mo rnams dang / ma

rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las sku'i phyag tshad kyi skabs zur du phyung ba/ 317mo dang dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi zhal yang de dag dang 'dra bar bya bar gsungs la/ spyan ni rtsa zhal la zlum po zheng du nas bcu dang / dkyus la nas bcu bzhi/ rgyab zhal la zheng nas drug dang dkyus 7nas bco brgyad de nya lta bu/ gzhan gnyis la zheng sor gcig dang / dkyus sor gnyis padma lta bu bya bar bshad/ nas ni sor gyi brgyad cha la bya bar gsungs so/ /spyan rnams ni phal cher khro zhal gyi spyan du snang la/ zhi ba'i spyan ni sangs rgyas rnams la bsam gtan gyi gzigs stangs zheng nas gnyis dang dkyus nas nyer gcig pa gzhu'i rnam pa byang sems rnams la nas bzhi dang nyi shu ste utpal lta bu/ lha mo rnams la bde mchog gi nub zhal lta bu'o//de ltar zhal phyag rnams ldan lha/ khren tu zhi dang zhi ma khro/ /khro dang shin tu khros pa bzhi/ /dang po'i phyag tshad gtsor byas nas/ /gzhan rnams khyad par cung zad brjod/ /phal cher shugs la rtogs par 'gyur/ /dang po la yang longs sprul gnyis/ /longs sku bzhugs dang bzhengs pa dang / /gnyis ga'i thun mong mchu zheng ni/ /sangs rgyas sor mo brgya nyer lnga/ /zhal re phyed phyed bcu gnyis pa/ /zhal bcur mchu zheng mtshungs phyir ro/ /dag pa'i byang sems longs sku dang / /sangs rgyas sprul sku bde dgyes sogs/ /sor phyed bcu po phri ba yi/ /brgya dang nyi shur mchu zheng mnyam/ /sar gnas byang sems longs sku dang //phag mo spyan sor gshegs ma dang / /sangs rgyas sprul sku shāka thub sor/ /zhal dgu sor mo brgya dang brgyad/ /dgu brgyad gnyis ka zhi ma khro/ /khro bo phal cher zhal tshad brgyad/ /sor mo dgu bcu drug par 'dod/ /shin tu khros la zhal lnga dang / /sor mo drug bcu re gnyis sor/ /zhal tshad gsum pa'ang bshad ces grags/ /rgyal ba'i sprul sku yin na yang / /khro bo rnams la mtshan dpe yi/ /phyag ring mdzes sogs mi dgos kyi/ /mi sdug bco brgyad la sogs pa/ /gang la gang 'dul nges med yin/ /rgyal ba'i zhal tshad bcu po ni/ /gtsug tor skra 'tshams mdzod sbu rnams/ /sor phyi phyed dang lnga dang bzhi/ /shang rtse kos sko mgrin pa yang / /de bzhin snying lte gsang gnas rnams/ /zhal re phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa'o/ /brla dang rje ngar zhal do do/ /dbyi dang dpus mo long bu man/ /bzhi bzhi phyed bcas bzhi pa ste/ /zhabs 'thil bcu bzhi 'dir mi bgrang / /de bzhin 'doms la'ang zhal bcu ste/ /dbus nas phrag par zhal gang dang //bar lhu phyag ngar phyag mgo rnams/ /nyi shu bcu drug zhal gang ste/ /gru mo 'khrig ma sum gnyis re'o// gtsug tor dbus su tshud pa yi/ /thor cog srid la bcu gnyis dang / /dpa' bo sems dpa' brgyad dam dgu/thor cog srid la mi rtsi'o//

318 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/zhal la sogs pa'i zheng tshad ni/ /zhal bstod dgu dang zhal bskyed bcu/ /zhal smad bdun sogs ci rigs bya/ /snyan zheng gnyis ste srid du bzhi/ /snyan zhal bzhi sogs ci mdzes yin/ /spyan dkyus gsum lhag zheng du ni/ /nas gnyis bzhi sor mdzes par bya/ /smin dkyus bzhi po gzhu lta bu/ /snyan gyi rtse dang thad mnyam ste/ /snyan bug spyan las cung zad dma'/ /smin phrag phyed dang gnyis dbus su/ /mdzod dpu sor gcig zlum zhing mdzes/ /spyan dbus sor gcig bshad pa ni/ /bde mchog khro zhal dbang byas pas/ /smin ma'i phrag dang mnyam pa mdzes/ /spyan gyi nag cha sor gcig ste/ /'bras bu sor gyi lnga cha'o//shangs rtse'i zheng ni sor gnyis ste/ /mchu dang kosko'ang de dang mtshungs/ /mchu sgros ma mchu sor gcig dang //ya mchu sor phyed cher mi rung / /shang rtse dang ni ya mchu'i bar/ /sor gcig bshad pa'ang bde mchog sogs/ /cung zad zhal gdangs la dgongs pas/ /shin tu zhi la phyed gnyis lhag /kasko'i dpangs la gnyis bshad pa'ang / /de dang 'dra bas cung zad bskyed/ /zhal dkyus sor mo bzhi pa ste/ /gra gnyis gyen du cung zad bstod/ /smin ma'i sbom sar nas gnyis te/ /snyan gyi sgri kha sor phyed bskor/ /rdo gzhong lta bur sor gcig dang / /bu gar sor gcig zlum zhing 'gril/ /mgul zheng sor mo brgyad pa ste/ /snyan 'og mgul bsnyer sor mo dang / /de nas phra gong zhal re ste/ /sku stod sbom par sum cu'o//8dpung lhu'i sbom sar so drug ste/ /gru mor phyed lnga 'khrig mar ni/ /gsum zer 'phras pas phyed dang bzhi/ /phyag mthil gru bzhi drug zer yang / /srid bdun zheng la lnga par bshad/ /gung mo sor lnga 'dzub mo na/9 /de'i sen mo'i rtsa bar sleb/ /ming med de las sor phyed ring / /de gsum skyes pa mnyam po ste//mthe chung de las sor phyed dma'/ /rtse mos ming med sor gcig sleb/ /mthe bong skye sa sor gsum dma'/ /mdzub mo'i sum char cung mi sleb/ /mthe bong tshigs gnyis mngon pa ste/ /gzhan bzhi sum char mngon pa'o/ /sen mo tshigs kyi phyed nas rtsal/ /mdzub brtser cung zad ma sleb pa'o/ /byang stod sor mo bco brgyad ste/ /byang smad bcu gnyis sta zur smad/ /bco brgyad byin gyis 'phel ba'o//brla'i zheng tshad sor bcu ste/ /nya la sor drug byin bzhug bzhi/ /zhabs mthil che sar sor drug dang / /chung sar phyed dang bzhi yin te/ /gab pa'i tshul gyis cung zad skyung / /mthe bong sor gsum sboms su gnyis/ /gzhan kun mchu zheng rims kyis skyung / /bzhugs pa rdo rje'i skyil dkrung las/ /dpus mo'i rtse nas rtse yi bar/ /zhal tshad bzhi ru nges pas na/ /zla gdan steng nas mdzod dbu dang / /mchu zheng mnyam po yin pa la/ /bod 'ga' dkyil dkrung dpangs dma' bar/ /mthong nas skyed par sor bzhi bsnan//

rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las sku'i phyag tshad kyi skabs zur du phyung ba/ 319des na shang rtse dang mnyam zer/ /dpus mo'i dpangs la sor mo bzhi/ /nga pa sor gsum steng du ste/ /rting pa gnyis par sor bzhi lhag /gzhengs pa g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dang / /bzlog dang sa ga zlum po dang / /rol pa la sogs gang gsungs rnams/ /dang po bzhi po sor mo rnams/ /logs su bstan par khyad par med/ /dang po gnyis po mtho lnga'i rgyang / /bshad kyang zhabs gnyis tshad ldan du/ /btang nas brkyang bskum tshul bzhin du/ /byas pa nyid kyis kun la 'grub/ /sa ga snying ma'i bar sor bzhi/ /brla dang byin pa drang por srang / /bzlum po de dang 'dra ba la/ /dpus mo phyir la gdeng pa'o/ /rol pa g.yon gyi sor mo ni/ /mdun du drang bstan de'i long bur/ /g.yas pa'i rting pa bkan nas ni/ /sor mo logs su bstan pa nyid/ /g.yas rol zhes bya g.yon rol bzlog /mnyam pa sa ga lta bu la/ /bar med mnyam par gcer ba'o/ /gzhan yang bzhugs stabs mang bshad pas/ /dkyil chog sa chog skabs rnams dang / /rang rang mngon rtogs rnams su blta// de rnams zhal tshad bcu pa'i tshad/ /dgu pa la ni zhal ras nyid/ /cung zad bskyed de brgyad po rnams/ /rang sor byed dang bcu gcig la/ /zhal re'i ming de mdor na ni/ /mchu la bcu cha bri ba la/ /zheng la bcu cha kun du bskyed/ /de bzhin zhal tshad lnga pa la/ /mchu kun phyed la zhal mi ste/ /zheng kun 'dab kyis bskyed pas 'grub/ /'on kyang sbom sar sbom zhing grims/ /phra sar nyag cing mkhrang la 'gril/ /zhib rgyas sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs/ /gzhan du blta zhing mkhas la bslab/ /gtso por rgya bod mkhas pa yis/ /phyag rjes nan tan gyis brtsal nas/ /bltas shing dpyad la lag len gdab/ /slob dpon blun po'i ngag rgyun dang / /rang gis sdug goms ngan lang gis/ /dad ldan yo byad chud mi gzan/ /thub pa chu lon mar grags sogs/ /phyag tshad rnams dang mi mthun yang / /mkhas pas byas shing grags che ba/ /kun gyis mthun snang grub pa yi/ /kun la mdzes par snang ba 'ga'/ /shes na'ang mkhas pa'i phyag rjes bltos//phyag ni gnyis ga'am gang rung gcig /mnya ma bzhag yod na 'gying med gsungs/ /phyag mang yin na 'gal ba med/ /phyag g.yas lding la g.yon 'gying dang / /g.yon lding bzlog bya zhabs stabs kyang / /gang gi phyogs su dbu 'gying yang / /bzlog na 'gyel ba'i skyon du 'gyur/ /zhal 'gying gang du byas phyogs kyi/ /bzlog par byang bstod 'bur ba dang / /rang sar sta zur 'bur ba gces/ /sum khugs drang na mdzes par 'gyur/ /drang srong cha phyed skem pa dang / /gzhon nu'i cha lags gzhon sha rgyas/ /pho rnams

320 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/stod rgyas smad zhum dang / /mo rnams de las bzlog par bya/ /khro bo gar gyi nyams dgu ldan/ /rgyan dang mdangs kyis sgeg pa rnams/ /'gying dang rol pas dpa' ba ste/ /spyan log khro gnyer mi sdug pa/ /'dzum zhing bzhad 'dra dgod pa'i nyams/ /hūm̐ phaṭa sgrog 'dra drag shul che/ /mtshon cha phyar lding 'jigs su rung //spyan dmar gzhon sha snying rje'i nyams/ /zhal gdangs rkan sdeb dang 'dra rngams/ /gnyen lcug sha 'jam zhi ba'i nyams/ /dbu skra zhal gang gyen rjes shing / /ag tshoms smin ma'ang gyen rdzes 'byog /mdor na yid la legs shar ba/ /lag tu btab pas nyams kun 'byung / /yid 'phrog bstan pa'i phyi mor 'gyur//khri rgyab bshad par bya ba la/ dus 'bor rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu las/ khri la khri bstan dang / khri gdong dang / khri rkang dang / khri rmang gnyis dang / ba rga dang / lan gan rna pu shu ste/ bdun po byang phyogs sde tshan bdun dang dag pa sbyar ba tsam dang / rgyab yol la rgyan sna drug phyin drug dang sbyar te/ bya khyung ka ru ṇa ste snying rje dang / chu srin pu ru ṇa ste grong khyer dang / mi chung bya ra ṇa ste tshogs bdag dang / glang chen gu ra ṇa ste bla ma dang / ri dwags sha ra ṇa ste dbang phyug dang / klu phrug nā ra ṇa ste sgrol mdzad rnams/ rim pa bzhin shes rab nas sbyin pa'i bar phar phyin drug lugs bzlog dang dag pa sbyar nas gsungs shing / khri la la seṅge glang chen rta rma bya shang shang gi 'degs byed dang / nor bu dang nyi zla dang padma'i gdan rnams ni/rim pa bzhin stobs dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / dbang bcu dang / smon gnas shes pa dang / byang chub kyi phyogs dang / don dam e dang / kun rdzon baṃ dang / sgrib pa gsum gyi ma gos pa rnams dag pa dang / tshad med bzhi dang bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs pa rnams mtshon par byed pa seng rgyan dang / dar gyi blo bstan la sogs pa gsungs so//bod snga ma dag gis khri la brtsegs nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa'i spros pa dang / rgyab yol rgyas pa phub la zhol brtags pa lta bu dang / 'bring po pad 'dab lta bu dang / bsdus pa lcags rtse ma dang /sgong gzugs ma la sogs pa'i lag len mang du snang na yang / 'bring po tsam gyis tshad dang gzo lugs shes na gzhan rnams shugs la 'byung bas 'di skad ces bya ste/gdan khri 'phang du zhal drug bya/ /sa 'dzin zhal gang de steng du/ /rdo rje'i gdan phreng so bzhi'i spangs/ /nor bu sum brtsegs sor gnyis te/ /lha snam sor brgya nor bu gsum/ /phyed dang gnyis re de steng du/ /pad 'dab sor mo bcu drug spangs/ /nor bu nyis rtseg sor re dang / /sum cha re ste bre sor bzhi// de steng nor bu snga ma tsam/ /glang rgyab sor mo phyed dang bzhi/ /nor bu sor gang bzhi cha'i tshad/ /seng khri sor

rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las sku'i phyag tshad kyi skabs zur du phyung ba/ 321mo bcu pa ste/ /nor bu snga ma tsam steng du/ /pad chung sor do bzhi cha'i tshad/10 /pad chen sor bzhi bzhi gsum ste/ /tsaṇḍasor do bzhi chas dman/ /steng khebs sor gcig bzhi cha'o/ /srid du sa 'dzin zhal bcu gsum/ /lhas rnams sor bdun zhal bcu gcig /seng khri zhal brgyad tre(ra bzhi brgyab/ /da chen zhal tshad bcu yin zhing / /gzhan rnams skyong 'bur phugs la shes/ /'on kyang zhib tu sbyor 'dod na/ /tsaṇḍa bad las sor bzhi'i btung / /de bas sten khebs sor do 11bcag /pad chung bad las sor drug tu/ /de bas nor bu sor dos dman/ /de bas seng khri sor dos bcag /de 'og nor bu sor gsum bsring / /de bas glang rgyab sor bzhi bsring / /de 'og nor bu steng dang mnyam/ /de ba'i bre ni sor gang thung / /nor bu gnyis ni 'phang tsam bsring / /pad 'dab rtsa ba so gang bsring / /'dab ma'i rtse mo sor lnga bsring / /nor bu gnyis dang lha snam dag /sor mo do do phyir la skyed/ /nor bu gsum pa'o snga ma bzhin/ /rdor phreng sor dos sa 'dzin ni/ /sor mo gsum chas bsring bar bya//rgyab yol sku tshad nyis 'gyur dang / /zhal gang tshad kyi tshangs thig gdab/ /'og nas steng du zhal lnga dang / /sor gang tshad kyis rtags byas la/ /de nas steng du'ang de tsam bskyed/ /steng 'og rtags nas g.yas g.yon du/ /bya rog rjes btsan thig gcig gdab/ /de la dpung khri'i steng 'byung mod/ /'on kyang mtha' gnyis sor lnga la/ /stod nas thig gdab ci mdzes bya/ /tshangs thig dpung thig 'dzoms sa nas//steng gi phyogs su zhal do nur/ /nor bu ma gtogs sku de yi/ /zla steng gtsug tor bar tshad kyi/ /srad bus dpung khri'i steng nas bskor/ /rtse mor cung bsnan g.yas g.yon du/ /cung zad steng stod ci mdzes bya/ /rab yol dpung bar sor brgyad tsam/ /bsnan na stod brgyas dbyibs legs bya/ /bskor thig sna yi ci ran dang / /'og tu tshangs thig g.yas g.yon du/ /zhal bzhi sor lnga'i tshad tsam gyi/ /sa nas gyen 'thur thig re gdab/ /de dag rgyab yol phyir rgya'i tshad//stod rgyas smad phyogs cung zad zhum/ /pad 'dab zlum rgyas dbyibs 'dra bya/ /mtha' skor me ri pa ṭa dang / /rdo rje phreng dang zlum skor rnams/ /sor mo phyed dang bzhi dang ni/ /sor do dang ni sor brgyad tsam/ /de dag bar bar mu tig phreng / /sor mo phyed phyed mdes pas rgyan/ /de nang bar skor ldem pa gtso//bkod legs mdzes shing khyad 'phags bya/ /lugs 'di ding sang mdzes par grags/ /'on kyang phyi dus gdan khri rnams/ /bzhengs pa shin tu nyung bar snang / /rbestoms na shin tu gal che bas/ /gang 'grub nan tan bskyed par bya/ /gsag zhus// //

lung 'dren phyag dpe'i mtshan gzhung / 341rtsa she ṭika chen/ gsung 'bum/ ba zhol dpar ma/snye thang pa blo gros brtan pa bzhi pa/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos tshig gter gyi 'grel pa lung gi snye ma/ (tshig gter gyi ṭikka/)mkhan po kun dga' bzang pos phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa/ bod kyi bcu phrag rig mdzod chen mo/ dpal sa skya pa'i gsung rab/ pod bzhi pa/ mngon brjod/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 2003 lor dpar du btab/tā ra nā tha kun dga' sgrol mchog (1575 1634) rgya gar chosa'abyung / gsung 'bum/ ma rtag brtan phun tshogs gling gi dpar ma/rgya gar chos 'byung / deb/ mi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ (1406 lor 'khrungs ) rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ gsung 'bum pod dang po/ mes po'i shul bzhag nyer dgu pa/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas phyi lo 2007 lor dpar du btab/ —lung ston pa'i snying po cha bsags kyi mdo'i 'grel bshad/ (ka lā pa'i rnam par bshad pa legs sbyar snang ba'i sgron me/)gsung 'bum pod bdun pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag so lnga pa/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas phyi lo 2007 lor dpar du btab/dpal khang lo tsā ba ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde/ (1456 ) bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos tshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma/ (dag yig ngag sgron/) ngag sgron rtsa 'grel dang de'i yang 'grel/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 1989 lor dpar du btab/zha lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po/ (1441—1527) slob dpon a nus mdzad pa'i bod kyi skad kyi gsung rab la 'jug tshul sum cu pa'i rnam 'grel/ sum rtags skor gyi dpe rgyun dkon po 'ga' phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa mu tig phreng ba/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 2001 lor dpar du btab/bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog gangs ljongs brda dag kun btus nor bu'i bang mdzod/ rda sa bod gzhung shes rig las khungs nas phyi lo 2010 lor dpar du btab/ de bzhin mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 1998 lor dpar du btab/rin spungs ngag dbang 'jigs grags/ (1482 'das lo mi gsal/) snyan 'grel mi 'jigs seṅge'i nga ro/ mkhan po kun dga' bzang pos phyogasabasgrigasamadzad pa/ bod kyi bcu phrag rig mdzod chen mo/ dpal sa skya pa'i gsung rab/ pod bzhi pa/mngon brjod/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 2003 lor dpar du btab/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ pod/ 8sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ (1182—1251) mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgo/ gsung 'bum/ ba sde dge dpar ma/mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ gsung 'bum/ na dpe bsdur ma/ pod/ 4sgra la 'jug pa/ gsung 'bum/ pod/ tha gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma/ pod/ 4 phyi lo 2007 lor krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nasadapar du btab/nga brgyad ma'i rtsa 'grel/ gsung 'bum/ bod/ tha gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma/ pod/ 4

wa wa sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi ṭhā po/gsung 'bumathadape bsdur ma/pod/4wa wa sdom gsum rab dbye/so thar gyi sdom pa'i skabs/gsung 'bum/nadape bsdur ma/pod/2wa wa tshig gi gter/gsung 'bumathadaper bsdur ma/pod/4wa wa rol mo'i bstan los/gsung 'bum/thasum pa mkhan po ye shes dpal 'byor/(1704 1788)mi ge'i rnam bas rab gsal me long zhes bya ba'i mas 'grel/gsung 'bum/khalo ke she tsand+ra nas mkhas dbang ra gu lir gyi ma dpe la rgyal spyi'i rgya gar gyi shes yon bsti gnas nas phyi lo 1979lor ldi lir dpar du bto/

du btab/lce khyi 'brug gnas brgyad chen po'i rtsa ba/ sde dge 4350 bstan/ sna tshogs/ 〈 pe cing /'phags pa thogasamed/ byang sa/ sde dge 4037 bstan/ semasatsam/ li na cing / gangasacan rig brgya'i sgo ṇa sī rdo rje'i gtsug lag dpe mdzod nas bod nas thon pa'i deb de skyar du dpar skrun zhus/dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las/ (1927 1997) dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo/ phyi lo 2002 lor krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas dpar du btab/bha ra ta mu ni/ nāskyu shāsta/ (rgya gar gyi rol mo'i bstan bcosagragasache ba zhig) phyi lo 1971 lor wā rā ṇa sī ba nā ra sa hin du yu ni war si ṭi nas dpar du btab/mu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho/ (1914 1993) bod du rig gnas dar tshul/ dan su mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas/ phyi lo 1982la deb chung gi gzugs su dpar btab/myang ral nyi ma 'od zer/ (1124ge1192) chos 'byung me tog snying po sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ phyi lo 1988 lor bod ldongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas dpar du btab/smi ti dzña na garti/ smra ba'i sgo mtshon cha lta bu/ sde dge 4295 bstan/ sgra mdo/ brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas phyi lo 2007 lor dpar du btab/

344 brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnasakyi gzhung gces btus/glang ri ba thub bstan sbyin pa/brda sprod gsar bsgrigs smra sgo'i lde migaphyi lo 2010lor ldi lir dpar du btab/'dar stod dgra 'dul dbang po/tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/phyi lo 1987lor gangs can rig mdzod deb grangs bzhi pa bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas dpar du bto/dpal khang lo tsā ba ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde/(1456 )bod kyi brda'i bye brag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcosatshig le'ur byas pa mkhas pa'i ngag gi sgron ma/(dag yig ngag sgron/)ngag sgron rtsa 'grel dang de'i yang 'grel/mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas phyi lo 1989lor dpar du btab/tshe to zhabs drung /(1910 1984)snyan ngag spyi don/gangs ljongs rig brgya'i sgo 'byed lde migadeb/5dze smad rin po blo bzang dpal ldan bstan 'dzin yar rgyas/(1927 1996)rig gnas lnga 'i byung ba brjod pa gtam tshangasapa'i rol mo/gsung 'bum/pod/chanyi lo 1997lor ldi lir dpar du bto/saskya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/(1182—1251)mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgo/gsung 'bum/thakhre dge dpar ma/sa skya bka' 'bum dpe bsdur ma/deb/bzhi pa/wa wa mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/gsung 'bum/nadape bsdur ma/pod/4wa wa sgra la khrug pa/gsung 'bum/pod/thagasung 'bum dpe bsdur ma/pod/4phyi lo 2007lor krung sto bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas dpar du btab/wa wa sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po/gsung 'bumathadape bsdur ma/pod/4wa wa tshig gi gter/gsung 'bumathadaper bsdur ma/bod/4wa wa rol mo'i bstan bcos/gsung 'bum/tha.a mes ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan (159741660)rol mo'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs blo gsal yid 'phrogaphyi lo 2004lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas dpar du btab/

bod kyi gtsug lag gcesabakhul pod phreng rbershaganyis/kyi tho gzhud /1theg pa chen po blo sbyong brgya rtsa/byang sems gzhon nu rgyal mchog dang /mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mas gyisabasgrigs/2bka' gdams glegs bam las btus pa'i chos skor/mdzad pa po/jo bo rje dpal ldana.a ti sha/'brom ston pa/snar thang mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan sogs/2rdzogs pa wo po sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel pa shingarta wo po/kun mkhyen klong rsā rab tsoms pa/4dpal saskya pa'i lam 'brasakyi chosaskor/mdzad pa po/sachen kun dga' snying po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyugamang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho sogs/5mnyam āobaka'abargyud lugasakyiphyagargyas podang tsholaba'i chosaskor/mdzadapapo/dwag4lha rje/rha si po che/skyobapa 'garten mgonapo/sapa rangabyung rje/gyipaṇa ོ/rtsego gosarangagrol/dwagasapobakrisamagyo'agos/6dpal dge ldan pa'i lam rim dang snyan brgyud kyi chosaskor/mdzad pa po/rje i kha pa/sgom rsāngag dbang gragasapa/paṇa wo blo bzang chosargyan/rgyalamardzo lnga pa wo po/shar skal ldan rgya mtsho/yongasa'adzin ye shes rgyal mas sogs/7ri chos nges don rgya mtsho/dol po pa shes rab rgyal mas/8zhi byed dang gcod yul sogs gdams ngag thor bu'i chos skor/'jam mgon kong sprul blo gros mtha' yasakyi gdams ngag mdzod las yas/9g.yung drung bon gyi mdo sngags sems gsum gyi gzhung /mdzad pa po/'a zha 'gro mgon blo grosas mas/mkho med shesarab kṣiṃ mas/wī ston rgyal ba g.yung drung sogs/10bstan pa la 'jug pa'i lam gyi rim pa ston pa'i gzhung gcesabatus/mdzad pa po/dge bshes dol pa/dwags po lha rje/sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/11rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la 'jug pa'i chosaskor/mdzad pa po/sto srasathogasamed bzang po/rje i kha pa/kṣiṃ tshab rje/spyan mnga' blo gros rgyal mas/lca skya rol pa'i rdo rje/thu'u bkwan chosakyi nyi ma/dzodapal sprul/12sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag ston pa'i gzhung gsas btus/mdzad pa po/sa paṇa/go rams pa/mkhas grub rje/mnga' ris paṇa chen/garma nges don chos kyi snying po/13rnal 'byor bla med kyi sgrub thabs dang bskyed rim gyi khridayig khagamadzad pa po/rje tsotsho pa/rgyalabadago2na yo tsho/paṇa rsā blobazang chosa.a/rgyalamachoganyonapa/dngulachu sto bhra dra/14dus 'khor 'grel rpā dri med 'od kyi rgyan/mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho/15rdzogs rim rim lnga gsal sgron/rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa/

16phar phyin gyi skor gces btus kyi gzhung gsum/mdzad pa po/rngog blo ldan shes rab/rgyal kṣe rje/phrug pa padma dkar po/17bde gshegs snying po rigasakyi chosaskor/mdzad pa po/bu ston rin 'grub/lto pa rang khrung rdo rje/lto mkha' khyab rdo rje/sorsā shākya rgyalamaphywa/shākya mchogaldan/rjebatsun chosakyi rgyalams/'ju mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtsho/18zab mo lta ba'i khyad par bshad pa/ mdzadapapo/༷ye she'/rorlam sikyibazangapo/phyupa sikyisgogesapa li.āodardorje/'ang tā ran sagos/19dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa/20dpal saskya pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung gces btus/mdzad pa po/'jam mgon sapaṇa/kun mkhyen go rams pa/shākya mchog ldan/21dpal dge ldan pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung gces btus/mdzad pa po/rgyal tshab rje/mkhasagrub rje/kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/22mngon pa gong ma dang 'brel ba'i sems khams rig pa'i gzhung lugs/tshadapapo/rjered 'da'ab/rje sdugatsa/paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mas/dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mawo/23chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa mngon pa'i rgyan/mchimasa'ajam dpal dbyangs/24grub mtha' thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan/lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/25grub mtha' shel gyi me long /thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma/26zhal gdams dang nyams mgur gces btus/27legs bshad lugs kyi bslab bya'i dpe tshogis/mdzad pa po/'brom ston pa/sapaṇa/paṇa wo bgo grags/tso mardzo lnga pa ོ po/gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me sogs/28gso ba rig pa'i khog 'bugs beeḍūrya'i me long /sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/26rtsisakyi bstan bcos gces btus/mdzad pa po/smin gling lo chen sto shrī kha dge gos blobazang tso khrims/30brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/mdzad lo/rgomisasto ṭa/rngog blo ldan shesarab/rje btsun bsod nams rtse ma/sapaṇa/zhwa lu lo tsā ba/dpang lo tsā ba/dpal khang lo tsā ba/stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs/31bod kyi lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung che khag gces btus/32mkhasapa lde'us mdzad pa'i rgya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa bcas bzhugs so//

bod kyi gtsug lag gces btus phyogs sgrig 'gan 'dzin/thub bstan sbyin pa/dpe 'di'i zhu sgrig pa gtso bo/ thub bstan sbyin pa/blo bzang chos dar/ma dpe gam pu ṭar 'jug rgyu'i 'gan 'dzin/ dga' shar dpe mdzod khang /dpar sgrig dang dpe skrun 'gan khur ba/blo bzang chos dar/bod kyi gtsug lag gces btus pod phreng / 30brda dag snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gces btus/brjod bya/ bod kyi brda sprod/snyan ngag dang mngon brjod/bzo rig pa sogs kyi skor/bod kyi gtsug lag zhib dpyod khang nas phyogs bsgrigs dang dpar skrun zhus/spyi lo 2012lor ldi lir dpar thengs dang po bskrun/
